This work presents an AE-GCN-LSTM surrogate framework for long-horizon forecasting of microstructure evolution in the multicomponent AlCrFeNi high-entropy alloy system containing coexisting BCC and FCC phases. A multi-head autoencoder compresses the four elemental concentration fields and phase-field order parameter into latent representations, which are formulated as graphs for learning their spatial and temporal evolution. The framework accurately forecasts microstructure evolution over horizons extending to 3,000,000 simulation timesteps. Its robustness is systematically evaluated under previously unseen conditions without retraining, fine-tuning, or parameter adaptation. These evaluations include variations in FCC precipitate size and initial position, microstructures containing one, two, and five FCC precipitates, and complex phase interactions involving precipitate merging and splitting. Although trained only on 100 x 100 computational domains containing a single nominal alloy composition, the framework is successfully transferred to larger 256 x 256 and 512 x 512 systems and to previously unseen AlCrFeNi compositions. Across the evaluated configurations, the model preserves the dominant phase morphology and compositional evolution while providing computational speedups ranging from approximately 7200 to 62300 relative to conventional phase-field simulations. These results demonstrate that latent graph-based AE-GCN-LSTM forecasting provides a scalable and computationally efficient surrogate for long-horizon simulation of multicomponent, multiphase microstructures and offers a promising foundation for high-throughput alloy design.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出 AE-GCN-LSTM 替代模型，用于快速预测含 BCC 和 FCC 共存相的 AlCrFeNi 高熵合金微结构长时程演化。模型将元素浓度场和相场序参量压缩为潜在表示并构建图结构学习时空演化，可在未重新训练的情况下推广到不同析出物形貌、更大计算域和新合金组成。结果显示，该方法在保持主要相形貌和成分演化的同时，相比传统相场模拟实现数千到数万倍加速。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 相场建模为预测微结构演化提供了一种强有力的方法，但对于大空间和时间尺度上的多组元、多相体系而言，其计算成本高到难以承受。本工作提出了一种 AE-GCN-LSTM 替代框架，用于对含有共存 BCC 和 FCC 相的多组元 AlCrFeNi 高熵合金体系中的微结构演化进行长时程预测。一个多头自编码器将四个元素浓度场和相场序参量压缩为潜在表示，并将这些表示构造成图以学习其空间和时间演化。该框架能够准确预测延伸至 3,000,000 个模拟时间步的微结构演化。其稳健性在此前未见条件下进行了系统评估，且无需重新训练、微调或参数自适应。这些评估包括 FCC 析出物尺寸和初始位置的变化，包含一个、两个和五个 FCC 析出物的微结构，以及涉及析出物合并和分裂的复杂相互作用。尽管该框架仅在含单一名义合金组成的 100 x 100 计算域上训练，但它成功迁移到更大的 256 x 256 和 512 x 512 体系，以及此前未见的 AlCrFeNi 组成。在所评估的各种构型中，模型保持了主要相形貌和成分演化，同时相对于传统相场模拟提供了约 7200 到 62300 倍的计算加速。这些结果表明，基于潜在图的 AE-GCN-LSTM 预测为多组元、多相微结构的长时程模拟提供了一种可扩展且计算高效的替代模型，并为高通量合金设计提供了有前景的基础。

articles.title: Scalar-spin-chirality-driven fractional Chern insulator on a kagome lattice
articles.title_zh: Kagome 晶格上由标量自旋手性驱动的分数量子 Chern 绝缘体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27833v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fractional Chern insulators (FCIs) are the lattice analogs of the fractional quantum Hall states, emerging even without an external magnetic field. In this work, we demonstrate the emergence of the FCI states in a kagome magnet with a noncoplanar magnetic order that induces a finite scalar spin chirality. By incorporating in our model both electron-electron interactions and the effect of band dispersion, we find that stronger interactions relative to the band dispersion stabilize the FCI state over a broader range of scalar spin chirality. We characterize the emergent FCI state by calculating overlap with representative states, identifying the ground-state degeneracy and the finite energy gap in the thermodynamic limit, and tracking the spectral flow under multiple flux-quantum insertions. Our results suggest that kagome magnets with scalar spin chirality can be promising platforms for realizing FCIs.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究展示了在具有非共面磁序的 kagome 磁体中，有限标量自旋手性可诱导分数量子 Chern 绝缘体态。作者在模型中同时考虑电子-电子相互作用和能带色散效应，发现相互作用相对色散越强，FCI 态在更宽的标量自旋手性范围内越稳定。通过重叠、基态简并、能隙和通量插入谱流等分析，研究确认了该拓扑态特征。
authors: Shinnosuke Tsutsumi, Koji Kudo, Kentaro Nomura
articles.abstract_zh_full: 分数量子 Chern 绝缘体（FCI）是分数量子霍尔态的晶格类似物，即使没有外加磁场也能出现。在本工作中，我们证明了 FCI 态可在具有非共面磁序的 kagome 磁体中出现，该磁序诱导有限的标量自旋手性。通过在模型中同时纳入电子-电子相互作用和能带色散效应，我们发现，相对于能带色散更强的相互作用会在更宽的标量自旋手性范围内稳定 FCI 态。我们通过计算其与代表性态的重叠、识别热力学极限下的基态简并和有限能隙，以及跟踪多个磁通量子插入下的谱流，来表征出现的 FCI 态。我们的结果表明，具有标量自旋手性的 kagome 磁体可能是实现 FCI 的有前景平台。

articles.title: Giant nonlinear Hall effect in a Pt/ferrimagnetic insulator bilayer under Zeeman-exchange frustration
articles.title_zh: Zeeman-交换阻挫下 Pt/亚铁磁绝缘体双层中的巨非线性霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27848v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Competing magnetic interactions can create metastable or unstable states and render magnetic systems highly susceptible to external perturbations. Here we show that Zeeman-exchange frustration in an Al-substituted terbium iron garnet with a compositional gradient across its thickness gives rise to a giant nonlinear Hall response in an adjacent Pt layer. Near magnetic compensation, a field-induced spin-flip transition is accompanied by unusually large higher-order odd harmonic voltages, with the third, fifth, and seventh harmonics reaching amplitudes comparable to that of the first harmonic. The field, temperature, and current dependences collectively identify Joule heating as the parametric drive of the harmonic response. Macrospin-chain simulations further show that current-induced thermal modulation periodically switches the interfacial Fe magnetization between exchange- and Zeeman-dominated states and reproduces the observed harmonic signals. These results demonstrate how frustration can convert a weak thermal perturbation into a large nonlinear electrical response, providing a route to nonlinear magnetotransport in compensated ferrimagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究发现，在具有厚度方向成分梯度的 Al 掺杂铽铁石榴石中，Zeeman-交换阻挫会在相邻 Pt 层中诱发巨大的非线性霍尔响应。接近磁补偿时，场诱导自旋翻转伴随异常强的高阶奇次谐波电压，其三、五、七次谐波幅度可接近一次谐波。实验依赖关系和宏自旋链模拟表明，焦耳热驱动界面 Fe 磁化在不同主导状态间周期切换，从而产生该非线性响应。
authors: Takayuki Shiino, Matteo Fettizio, Weronika Janus, Can Onur Avci
articles.abstract_zh_full: 相互竞争的磁相互作用可以产生亚稳态或不稳定态，并使磁性体系对外部扰动高度敏感。在这里，我们表明，在厚度方向具有成分梯度的 Al 取代铽铁石榴石中，Zeeman-交换阻挫会在相邻 Pt 层中产生巨大的非线性霍尔响应。在磁补偿附近，场诱导的自旋翻转转变伴随着异常大的高阶奇次谐波电压，其中第三、第五和第七谐波的幅度达到与第一谐波相当的水平。场、温度和电流依赖性共同表明，焦耳热是谐波响应的参数驱动。宏自旋链模拟进一步表明，电流诱导的热调制会周期性地将界面 Fe 磁化在交换主导态和 Zeeman 主导态之间切换，并再现实验观察到的谐波信号。这些结果展示了阻挫如何将微弱热扰动转化为巨大的非线性电响应，为补偿亚铁磁体中的非线性磁输运提供了一条途径。

articles.title: High-Field EPR/ENDOR of N/Be Centers for Defect Engineering in 6H-SiC
articles.title_zh: 用于 6H-SiC 缺陷工程的 N/Be 中心高场 EPR/ENDOR 研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27862v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Silicon carbide (SiC) in its various structural modifications is widely used in power semiconductor electronics, operating under extreme conditions of high temperature, high voltage, and intense radiation. The discovery of spin defects (S>0) with unique optical and coherent properties has further positioned SiC as a promising platform for quantum technologies. Here, we investigate a 6H-SiC single crystal co-doped with nitrogen and beryllium at concentrations of 1018 cm-3, using continuous-wave and pulsed electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) and electron-nuclear double resonance (ENDOR). To enhance spectral resolution, experiments were conducted in the W-band (94 GHz; B = 3.4 T). Pulsed EPR identified nitrogen donors and beryllium acceptors in various lattice positions, allowing for the determination of their phase coherence and spin-lattice relaxation times. ENDOR measurements elucidated the electron-nuclear interactions with the local silicon and carbon environment, including distant coordination spheres. The observed hyperfine structures indicated highly delocalized spin density within the supercell. The TRIPLE resonance spectra verify coupled nuclear spin subspaces from different coordination spheres due to defect spin density. These results demonstrate the feasibility of incorporating dual impurities with distinct functional roles while preserving the crystal lattice`s structural features.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用 W 波段连续波和脉冲 EPR 以及 ENDOR 技术研究了氮、铍共掺 6H-SiC 单晶中的缺陷中心。实验识别了不同晶格位置的氮施主和铍受主，并测定了相干和自旋-晶格弛豫时间。ENDOR 与 TRIPLE 共振结果揭示了电子与局域硅、碳环境及更远配位壳层的相互作用，表明自旋密度高度离域。
authors: Yuliya Ermakova, Ekaterina Dmitrieva, Margarita Sadovnikova, Fadis Murzakhanov, George Mamin, Sergey Nagalyuk, Evgeny Mokhov, Marat Gafurov
articles.abstract_zh_full: 碳化硅（SiC）在其各种结构改型中广泛用于功率半导体电子学，并可在高温、高电压和强辐射等极端条件下工作。具有独特光学和相干性质的自旋缺陷（S>0）的发现，进一步使 SiC 成为量子技术的有前景平台。在这里，我们使用连续波和脉冲电子顺磁共振（EPR）以及电子-核双共振（ENDOR），研究了一种氮和铍共掺、浓度为 1018 cm-3 的 6H-SiC 单晶。为提高谱分辨率，实验在 W 波段（94 GHz；B = 3.4 T）进行。脉冲 EPR 识别了不同晶格位置的氮施主和铍受主，从而能够确定它们的相位相干时间和自旋-晶格弛豫时间。ENDOR 测量阐明了与局域硅和碳环境的电子-核相互作用，包括较远的配位壳层。观察到的超精细结构表明超晶胞内存在高度离域的自旋密度。TRIPLE 共振谱验证了由缺陷自旋密度导致的、来自不同配位壳层的耦合核自旋子空间。这些结果证明，在保持晶体晶格结构特征的同时，引入具有不同功能角色的双重杂质是可行的。

articles.title: Hyperchaos in a Magnetic Nanodisk Driven by Ferromagnetic Resonance
articles.title_zh: 铁磁共振驱动的磁性纳米盘中的超混沌
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27884v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the chaotic dynamics driven in the nonlinear regime of ferromagnetic resonance of an out-of-plane magnetized nanodisk in detail. By combining extensive micromagnetic simulations with time-series analysis across the control parameter space, we map the topological transitions from stable periodic orbits to strange attractors and quantify the dynamical complexity. Despite the simplicity of our nanoscale system, we evidence that it can exhibit hyperchaotic dynamics with up to three positive Lyapunov exponents in vast regions of the control plane accessible to experimental studies. Using a mode projection technique, we unveil that the generated complexity is related to the number of quantized spin-wave modes participating in the dynamics. Our findings establish magnon-spintronic nanodevices as versatile entropy sources for unconventional processing of information.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究系统考察了垂直磁化纳米盘在铁磁共振非线性区间中的混沌动力学。通过微磁模拟和时间序列分析，作者绘制了从稳定周期轨道到奇异吸引子的拓扑转变，并发现该纳米体系可在实验可达参数区域表现出最多三个正 Lyapunov 指数的超混沌。模投影分析表明，复杂性与参与动力学的量子化自旋波模数量有关。
authors: A Kolli (SPEC - UMR3680), Hugo Merbouche (SPEC - UMR3680), Salvatore Perna (DIETI), Claudio Serpico (DIETI), Damien Rontani (LMOPS), Grégoire de Loubens (SPEC - UMR3680)
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们详细研究了在面外磁化纳米盘的铁磁共振非线性区域中被驱动产生的混沌动力学。通过将广泛的微磁模拟与跨控制参数空间的时间序列分析相结合，我们绘制了从稳定周期轨道到奇异吸引子的拓扑转变，并量化了动力学复杂性。尽管我们的纳米尺度体系十分简单，但我们证明它能够在实验研究可及的控制平面广阔区域中表现出具有多达三个正 Lyapunov 指数的超混沌动力学。利用模投影技术，我们揭示了所产生的复杂性与参与动力学的量子化自旋波模数量有关。我们的发现确立了磁振子-自旋电子纳米器件作为用于非常规信息处理的多功能熵源的地位。

articles.title: Finite-size effects and interaction-driven crossovers in quarter-filled attractive Hubbard model: Exact diagonalization, DMRG and machine-learning analysis
articles.title_zh: 四分之一填充吸引性 Hubbard 模型中的有限尺寸效应与相互作用驱动交叉：精确对角化、DMRG 与机器学习分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27916v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the quarter-filled attractive Hubbard model on finite-width cylindrical lattices using exact diagonalization (ED), density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) and unsupervised machine-learning-based techniques. Analysis of the ground-state energetics, local observables and correlation functions reveals a continuous interaction-driven crossover from weakly correlated fermions to a regime dominated by tightly bound singlet pairs. This crossover originates from the competition between kinetic-energy-driven fermionic itinerancy and interaction-driven onsite pair formation and exhibits behavior consistent with the BCS--BEC crossover in the thermodynamic limit. Hole-binding-energy calculations provide direct energetic evidence for pair formation: the two-hole binding energy remains negative throughout the attractive regime whereas three-hole binding emerges only at sufficiently strong attraction and exhibits pronounced finite-size dependence. To obtain an unbiased characterization of the correlation landscape, we apply principal component analysis (PCA) and uniform manifold approximation and projection (UMAP) to the real-space correlation matrices. PCA reveals a systematic redistribution of correlation variance whereas UMAP identifies a clear separation between weak- and strong-pairing regimes. Both machine-learning-based approaches independently identify the same crossover region inferred from conventional observables while providing an order-parameter-independent characterization of the underlying reorganization of many-body correlations. Finite-size scaling analyses of the pairing structure factor and the leading PCA variance ratio demonstrate that these signatures remain robust with increasing system size.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了有限宽度圆柱晶格上的四分之一填充吸引性 Hubbard 模型，结合精确对角化、密度矩阵重整化群以及无监督机器学习方法进行分析。结果表明，基态能量、局域观测量和关联函数都显示出从弱关联费米子到紧束缚单态对主导区的连续相互作用驱动交叉，其行为与热力学极限中的 BCS–BEC 交叉一致。通过空穴束缚能以及 PCA、UMAP 等方法，作者进一步揭示了配对形成和多体关联重组的有限尺寸依赖与稳健特征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了有限宽度圆柱晶格上的四分之一填充吸引性 Hubbard 模型，并使用精确对角化（ED）、密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）以及基于无监督机器学习的技术进行分析。对基态能量、局域观测量和关联函数的分析揭示了一种连续的相互作用驱动交叉：系统从弱关联费米子态过渡到由紧束缚单态对主导的状态。该交叉源于动能驱动的费米子迁移性与相互作用驱动的本征位点配对形成之间的竞争，并表现出在热力学极限中与 BCS–BEC 交叉一致的行为。空穴束缚能计算为配对形成提供了直接的能量学证据：双空穴束缚能在整个吸引区间始终为负，而三空穴束缚仅在足够强的吸引下出现，并呈现显著的有限尺寸依赖。为了获得对关联景观无偏的表征，我们将主成分分析（PCA）和均匀流形近似与投影（UMAP）应用于实空间关联矩阵。PCA 显示关联方差发生系统性重分配，而 UMAP 则清晰地区分了弱配对区和强配对区。两种机器学习方法都独立识别出由常规观测量推断出的同一区域交叉，同时提供了一个不依赖序参量的表征，用以描述多体关联的内在重组。对配对结构因子和领先 PCA 方差比的有限尺寸标度分析表明，这些特征随系统尺寸增大仍然保持稳健。

articles.title: Probing the Potential Profile of Twisted Bilayer Graphene via Fabry-Pérot Interference
articles.title_zh: 利用法布里–珀罗干涉探测扭转双层石墨烯中的势能剖面
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27948v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We use Fabry-Pérot interference to probe the internal potential profile of large-angle twisted bilayer graphene. We trace anomalous resistance oscillations in the nominally unipolar regime to a hidden cavity formed by unintentional local doping in our device. By analyzing zero-field interference patterns, we determine the location and size of this inhomogeneity. Magnetotransport measurements support the model, distinguishing local cavity modes from global resonances through their different magnetic dependence. Simulations using our extracted profile reproduce the experimental features. Our results highlight interference spectroscopy as a simple, non-invasive probe for identifying local defects and internal potential barriers in ballistic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用法布里–珀罗干涉研究大角度扭转双层石墨烯的内部势能分布。作者将名义上单极性的电阻振荡归因于器件中意外局域掺杂形成的隐藏腔体，并通过零磁场与磁输运数据确定了该不均匀区的位置和尺度。实验与模拟相互印证，表明干涉谱学可作为识别弹道器件局域缺陷和内部势垒的简便、无损手段。
authors: Curtis McDowell, Alina Mreńca-Kolasińska, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Ming-Hao Liu, Thiti Taychatanapat
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们利用法布里–珀罗干涉来探测大角度扭转双层石墨烯的内部势能剖面。我们将名义上单极性区中的异常电阻振荡追溯到器件内由非预期局域掺杂形成的一个隐藏腔体。通过分析零磁场下的干涉图样，我们确定了这一不均匀性的具体位置和尺寸。磁输运测量支持这一模型，并通过其不同的磁场依赖性将局域腔模与整体共振区分开来。利用我们提取出的势能剖面进行的模拟重现了实验特征。我们的结果突出了干涉谱学作为一种简单、无侵入性的探针，在弹道器件中识别局域缺陷和内部势垒的潜力。

articles.title: Molecular Hyperpolarisability as a Screening Descriptor for Second-Order Nonlinear Optics in Ferroelectric Nematic Liquid Crystals
articles.title_zh: 以分子超极化率作为铁电向列液晶二阶非线性光学的筛选描述符
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27986v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferroelectric nematic liquid crystals combine fluidity with macroscopic polar order. Although the archetypal NF material RM734 exhibits large nonlinear optical coefficients, most known ferroelectric nematics were designed without consideration of optical nonlinearity. Here, we assess whether electronic-structure calculations can be used to identify promising nonlinear optical candidates within known polar liquid-crystal materials. Frequency-dependent molecular hyperpolarisability tensors were calculated using a range of DFT methods and basis sets, then converted to macroscopic d-coefficients using an oriented-gas model with empirical and values. Calculated values were benchmarked against available experimental d33, d15, and d13/d31 coefficients for representative materials. We find that absolute values depend strongly on method and bulk-parameter assumptions, whereas relative trends are more useful for screening. Explicit conformer averaging does not consistently improve agreement with experiment. Applying the best-performing single-conformer protocols to a broader polar liquid-crystal dataset identifies candidate materials with enhanced predicted nonlinear optical response and reveals simple design rules based on donor-acceptor asymmetry, conjugation length, and linker choice.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文评估了电子结构计算能否用于在已知极性液晶材料中筛选具有潜在二阶非线性光学响应的候选体系。作者发现，不同计算方法与体相参数假设会显著影响绝对值，但相对趋势更适合用于材料筛选；基于较优单构象方案得到的结果还能给出若干设计规则。研究表明，供受体不对称性、共轭长度和连接基团选择是提升响应的重要因素。
authors: Charles Parton-Barr, Nerea Sebastian, Richard Mandle
articles.abstract_zh_full: 铁电向列液晶兼具流动性和宏观极化有序。尽管原型 NF 材料 RM734 具有很大的非线性光学系数，但大多数已知铁电向列液晶在设计时并未考虑光学非线性。本文评估电子结构计算是否可用于在已知极性液晶材料中识别有前景的非线性光学候选者。我们使用多种 DFT 方法和基组计算了频率依赖的分子超极化率张量，然后通过取向气体模型并结合经验参数和体相参数，将其换算为宏观 d 系数。计算得到的数值与若干代表性材料已测得的 d33、d15 以及 d13/d31 系数进行了对比标定。我们发现，绝对数值强烈依赖于所用方法和体相参数假设，而相对趋势则更适合用于筛选。显式构象平均并不能稳定地改善与实验的一致性。将表现最佳的单构象方案应用于更广泛的极性液晶数据集后，我们识别出一些预测具有增强非线性光学响应的候选材料，并揭示了基于供受体不对称性、共轭长度以及连接基团选择的简单设计规则。

articles.title: PASS: Perturbation augmented space group structure sampling for transferable Fe-O machine learning interatomic potential
articles.title_zh: PASS：用于可迁移 Fe-O 机器学习原子势的微扰增强空间群结构采样方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28000v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate atomistic modelling of iron (Fe) oxidation requires a reliable interatomic potential, which necessitates an extensive and representative first-principles dataset for training the interatomic potential. However, Fe-oxygen (O) system is known for its structural and magnetic complexity, rendering the generation of high-quality dataset challenging. In this work, we propose the Perturbation Augmented Space group structure Sampling (PASS) method to generate extensive and representative dataset consisting of small-cell structures with less than 10 atoms. We present a systematic approach to developing a first of its kind transferable machine learning interatomic potential (MLIP) for Fe-O system based on the atomic cluster expansion (ACE) framework. We thoroughly validate the accuracy and capability of the ACE MLIP across both pure Fe and Fe-O systems through bulk, surface, and interface properties. We showcase the formation of FeO-like structure in large-scale Fe oxidation simulation using the ACE MLIP. This work demonstrates that the PASS method yields an accurate and transferable MLIP which is capable of capturing the reactive complexity of oxide growth while remaining computationally practical for extended systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 PASS 方法，用于生成适合铁氧体系建模的代表性第一性原理数据集，并据此构建基于 ACE 框架的可迁移机器学习原子势。作者对纯铁、铁氧体块体、表面和界面性质进行了系统验证，并展示了该势在大规模氧化模拟中捕捉 FeO-like 结构形成的能力。结果表明，该方法在保证计算可行性的同时，能够较好描述氧化生长中的反应复杂性。
authors: Zixiong Wei, Fei Shuang, Poulumi Dey
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对铁（Fe）氧化进行准确的原子尺度建模需要可靠的原子间势，这又要求用于训练该势的第一性原理数据集必须足够广泛且具有代表性。然而，Fe-O 体系以其结构和磁性复杂性著称，因此高质量数据集的生成颇具挑战。在本工作中，我们提出微扰增强空间群结构采样（PASS）方法，用于生成由小原胞结构组成的大规模且具有代表性的数据集，这些结构的原子数均少于 10 个。我们给出了一种系统化流程，用于开发首个基于原子簇展开（ACE）框架、且对 Fe-O 体系具有可迁移性的机器学习原子间势（MLIP）。我们通过块体、表面和界面性质，全面验证了该 ACE MLIP 在纯 Fe 和 Fe-O 体系中的准确性与能力。我们还利用该 ACE MLIP 在大尺度 Fe 氧化模拟中展示了 FeO-like 结构的形成。该工作表明，PASS 方法能够产生准确且可迁移的 MLIP，在保持计算上可行的同时，能够捕捉氧化物生长中复杂的反应行为。
articles.focus_summary: 该文提出PASS采样方法，并基于ACE框架构建了Fe-O体系的可转移机器学习原子间势。作者展示了该势函数在纯Fe、Fe-O体相、表面和界面上的准确性，并用于大尺度氧化模拟。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们在机器学习势、高通量数据构造和材料模拟方法方面较相关，尤其适用于复杂磁性/反应性体系的势函数开发。尽管体系不是团队主攻对象，但方法具有普适借鉴意义。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议关注其小胞结构采样策略、磁结构复杂性处理和ACE势的可转移性评估。若团队后续发展磁性材料或氧化过程的MLIP，这篇文章可作为方法参考。

articles.title: Orbital-Selective Mott Transition and Correlation-Amplified Charge Ordering in the Altermagnet CsCr₂S₂O
articles.title_zh: 反铁磁体 CsCr₂S₂O 中的轨道选择性莫特转变与相关增强的电荷有序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28029v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnet CsCr₂S₂O undergoes a Verwey-type metal-to-insulator transition (MIT) driven by lattice distortion and a stripe charge order on the Cr sublattice, reminiscent of the physics in Fe₃O₄. However, atomic distortions occur exclusively at the ligand sites rather than the Cr sites. What drives such a pronounced charge imbalance between Cr sites thus remains a mystery. Utilizing DFT+DMFT calculations, we identify an orbital-selective Mott transition, which leaves the correlated metallic dyz orbital governing the low-energy physics. We demonstrate that S-site distortions trigger an initial, tiny charge asymmetry between Cr sites via Cr-dyz and S-p orbital hybridization. Crucially, this asymmetry is significantly amplified by dynamical electronic correlations, resulting in a large discrepancy in both the charge and electron correlations of the Cr-dyz orbital between distinct Cr sites. This further induces a substantial differentiation in local spin polarizations in the altermagnetic state, ultimately driving the MIT. In contrast, we predict that replacing S with Te weakens this correlation-amplification effect and fails to induce an MIT due to weaker electron correlations. Our findings demonstrate that many-body effects can drastically amplify ligand instabilities to reshape the electronic structure of altermagnets, highlighting that ligand engineering is of paramount importance for realizing robust metallic altermagnetism.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用 DFT+DMFT 研究了反铁磁体 CsCr₂S₂O 中金属-绝缘体转变的微观机制。作者发现，S 位位移通过 Cr-dyz 与 S-p 轨道杂化先诱导出很小的电荷不对称，而动力学电子关联会显著放大这一差异，最终推动电荷不均与局域自旋极化分化，并导致金属-绝缘体转变。结果强调了配体工程在调控反铁磁金属态中的关键作用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反铁磁体 CsCr₂S₂O 经历一种 Verwey 型金属-绝缘体转变（MIT），其由晶格畸变和 Cr 子晶格上的条纹电荷有序共同驱动，这令人联想到 Fe₃O₄ 中的物理图景。然而，原子畸变只发生在配体位点而非 Cr 位点上。因此，是什么驱动了 Cr 位点之间如此显著的电荷不平衡仍然是一个谜。借助 DFT+DMFT 计算，我们识别出一种轨道选择性莫特转变，它使相关金属态的 dyz 轨道主导低能物理。我们证明，S 位畸变通过 Cr-dyz 与 S-p 轨道杂化，首先在 Cr 位点之间诱导出微小的电荷不对称。关键在于，这一不对称随后被动力学电子关联显著放大，导致不同 Cr 位点上的 Cr-dyz 轨道在电荷与电子关联方面都出现明显差异。这进一步诱导出反铁磁态中局域自旋极化的显著分化，最终驱动金属-绝缘体转变。相较之下，我们预测将 S 替换为 Te 会削弱这种关联放大效应，并由于电子关联较弱而无法诱导金属-绝缘体转变。我们的发现表明，多体效应能够极大放大配体不稳定性，从而重塑反铁磁体的电子结构，并强调配体工程对于实现稳健金属反铁磁性至关重要。
articles.focus_summary: 本文研究 altermagnet CsCr₂S₂O 中的绝缘体转变与电荷有序起源，利用 DFT+DMFT 发现轨道选择性 Mott 转变是关键机制。作者指出 S 位点畸变先诱发微弱电荷不对称，再被动力学电子关联放大，最终驱动显著的电荷/自旋极化差异和金属-绝缘体转变。
articles.focus_relation: 该工作与我们关注的磁性、强关联材料、电荷有序和结构畸变耦合问题直接相关，也涉及 altermagnet 与电子关联增强机制。方法上采用的 DFT+DMFT 可为我们研究强关联磁材料或缺陷诱导电荷重排提供参考。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议进一步比较该体系与其他 Cr 基或过渡金属硫族化合物中的轨道选择性转变机制，看看是否存在可通过应变、掺杂或层间调控实现的可控相变。也可结合自旋模型和输运计算评估其磁输运与电荷有序耦合特征。

articles.title: Thermal spin transport in easy-planar d-wave altermagnets controlled by magnetic field
articles.title_zh: 磁场调控的易平面 d 波反铁磁体中的热自旋输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28085v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets constitute a novel class of collinear spin-compensated materials in which magnon branches are spin-split even in the non-relativistic limit. The latter is the result of a more complex symmetry operation (compared to conventional antiferromagnets) that connects the two sublattices. Altermagnetic splitting strongly affects the magnon transport properties, leading, in particular, to the thermal magnon splitter effect in easy-axial d-wave altermagnets. Whether this effect also appears in easy-planar systems is not obvious, since the magnon branches do not carry a constant magnetic moment in this case. Here, we consider the easy-planar d-wave altermagnet of a rutile-type, e.g., NiF₂, and demonstrate the emergence of the altermagnetically generated magnon magnetic moment, which is momentum-dependent and possesses d-wave symmetry. This then leads to the spin-splitter effect, i.e., the emergence of a magnon-driven spin current (the flow of magnetic moment) in response to the applied temperature gradient. We also demonstrate that the corresponding thermal spin conductivity can be effectively tuned by an external magnetic field perpendicular to the easy plane.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了易平面 d 波反铁磁体中的热磁振子输运，重点考察外加磁场对热自旋输运的调控作用。作者表明，即使在易平面体系中也会出现具有动量依赖、d 波对称性的磁振子磁矩，从而导致热自旋“分流”效应，即温度梯度驱动的磁振子自旋流。相应热自旋电导还可通过垂直于易平面的外磁场有效调节。
authors: Yuliia I. Gusieva, Kostiantyn V. Yershov, Jeroen van den Brink, Volodymyr P. Kravchuk
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反铁磁体是一类新型的共线自旋补偿材料，其中即便在非相对论极限下，磁振子支也会发生自旋劈裂。后者源于连接两个子晶格的对称操作比常规反铁磁体更为复杂。反铁磁劈裂会强烈影响磁振子输运性质，特别是在易轴 d 波反铁磁体中会导致热磁振子分流效应。对于易平面体系而言，这一效应是否同样出现并不显然，因为在这种情况下磁振子支并不携带恒定的磁矩。本文考虑了金红石型的易平面 d 波反铁磁体，例如 NiF₂，并证明其会产生由反铁磁机制生成的磁振子磁矩。该磁矩依赖于动量，并具有 d 波对称性。由此产生自旋分流效应，即温度梯度响应下出现磁振子驱动的自旋电流（磁矩流）。我们还证明，相应的热自旋电导可以通过垂直于易平面的外加磁场有效调控。

articles.title: Semi-supervised Hopfield model: Theoretical and Numerical results
articles.title_zh: 半监督 Hopfield 模型：理论与数值结果
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28173v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In the daily practice of Machine Learning, fully labeled datasets are a luxury: labels demand expensive and time-consuming human annotation, whereas raw, unlabeled data can be harvested automatically and in bulk. Semi-supervised learning, where the network jointly exploits the few labeled and the many unlabeled examples at its disposal, is the standard answer to this asymmetry, yet a statistical mechanical theory of semi-supervised Hebbian learning is still lacking. In this paper we fill this gap for the Hopfield network: we prescribe a synaptic coupling given by the convex combination, weighted by a mixing parameter łambda in [0,1], of the supervised and unsupervised Hebbian kernels built from the same archetypes, and we solve for the emergent computational capabilities of the resulting network. A signal-to-noise analysis yields the one-step Mattis magnetization and the learning threshold, i.e. the minimum dataset size for stable retrieval. Using Guerra's interpolation, we then derive the Replica Symmetric quenched pressure in the high-storage regime, treating the correlated disorder generated by the supervised and unsupervised channels through a particular eigen-channel decomposition. The resulting phase diagram shows that a mixed strategy outperforms both pure protocols. Finally, we prove that the quenched pressure is convex in łambda, so thermodynamics cannot select an interior mixture: łambda is therefore a learning hyperparameter. All the analytical findings are successfully checked against extensive Monte Carlo simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从统计物理角度研究半监督 Hebb 学习在 Hopfield 网络中的性能，给出了一种由监督与无监督 Hebb 核按参数 λ 混合得到的耦合方案。作者通过信噪比分析和 Guerra 插值推导出高存储区的 Replica Symmetric 淬火压强，并证明混合策略优于纯监督或纯无监督方案。数值模拟进一步验证了理论结果，同时表明 λ 更适合作为学习超参数而非由热力学自动选择的量。
authors: Linda Albanese, Andrea Ladiana, Andrea Lepre
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在机器学习的日常实践中，完全标注的数据集是一种奢侈品：标签需要昂贵且耗时的人类标注，而原始的无标注数据则可以自动、大规模地获取。半监督学习利用少量带标签样本与大量无标签样本的联合信息，是应对这种不对称性的标准方案，但针对半监督 Hebb 学习的统计力学理论仍然缺失。本文针对 Hopfield 网络补上了这一空白：我们规定一种突触耦合，其由监督和无监督 Hebb 核按混合参数 λ∈[0,1] 的凸组合给出，且二者均由同一组原型构建；随后我们求解该网络所呈现的计算能力。通过信噪比分析，我们得到一步 Mattis 磁化强度以及学习阈值，即稳定检索所需的最小数据集规模。接着，利用 Guerra 插值法，我们在高存储极限下推导出 Replica Symmetric 淬火压强，并通过一种特定的本征通道分解来处理由监督与无监督通道产生的相关无序。所得相图表明，混合策略优于两种纯粹协议。最后，我们证明淬火压强关于 λ 是凸的，因此热力学无法选择内部混合点：λ 因而是一个学习超参数。所有解析结果都得到了大规模 Monte Carlo 模拟的成功检验。

articles.title: Negative Thermal Expansion in Cubic Ice: A Collective Quantum Effect of the hydrogen-bond network
articles.title_zh: 立方冰中的负热膨胀：氢键网络的集体量子效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28244v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report neutron powder diffraction measurements and path-integral molecular dynamics simulations of stacking-disorder-free cubic ice I_c, produced by topotactic degassing of C2 hydrogen hydrate. Across the cryogenic stability range, ice I_c exhibits a density maximum near 70 K, closely matching that of hexagonal ice Iₕ despite their different long-range stacking sequences. Negative thermal expansion in ice I is therefore not specific to hexagonal stacking, but arises from the shared open tetrahedral hydrogen-bond network. Simulations with the MB-pol potential quantitatively reproduce the experimental anomaly only when nuclear quantum effects are included. The density maximum coincides, within the temperature resolution, with maximal anisotropy of the proton quantum distribution. Neutron-derived displacement parameters independently reveal a strongly enhanced transverse proton displacement, while phonon calculations identify low-frequency transverse modes with the most negative Grüneisen parameters. Together, these results establish the negative thermal expansion of ice I as a collective quantum effect governed by nuclear statistics and the dynamics of the hydrogen-bond network.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过中子粉末衍射和路径积分分子动力学研究了无层错的立方冰 I_c。结果显示，冰 I_c 在低温稳定区间内也存在约 70 K 的密度最大值，与六方冰 Iₕ 十分接近，说明冰 I 的负热膨胀并不依赖于六方堆垛，而是源于共同的开放四面体氢键网络。模拟表明，只有在纳入核量子效应时才能定量再现实验异常，表明该现象本质上是由核统计与氢键网络动力学共同决定的集体量子效应。
authors: Loan Renaud, Tomasz Poreba, Richard Gaal, A. Marco Saitta, Michele Casula, Livia Eleonora Bove
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了对无层错立方冰 I_c 的中子粉末衍射测量和路径积分分子动力学模拟。该样品通过对 C2 氢水合物进行拓扑性脱气而制得。在整个低温稳定范围内，冰 I_c 在约 70 K 附近表现出一个密度最大值，这与尽管长程堆垛序列不同但仍相近的六方冰 Iₕ 的情形高度一致。因此，冰 I 中的负热膨胀并非六方堆垛所特有，而是源于它们共有的开放四面体氢键网络。使用 MB-pol 势的模拟表明，只有在纳入核量子效应时，才能定量再现实验中的反常行为。该密度最大值与质子量子分布各向异性的最大值在温度分辨率范围内一致。中子衍生的位移参数独立揭示出显著增强的横向质子位移，而声子计算则识别出低频横向模，其 Grüneisen 参数最为负。综合这些结果，我们确立了冰 I 的负热膨胀是一种由核统计与氢键网络动力学共同支配的集体量子效应。

articles.title: Synchronization, Kinematic Waves and Spike-Phase-Separation in Feedback Ising Neural Networks on Heterogeneous Graphs
articles.title_zh: 具有反馈环的异质图 Ising 神经网络中的同步、运动学波与尖峰-相位分离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28275v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Structural heterogeneity constrains collective dynamics in complex systems. However, its analytical tractability out of equilibrium remains limited. In this work, we study a class of kinetic Ising neural networks driven out of equilibrium by a homeostatic feedback loop between the neuronal excitability and the population firing rate. Using a Curie-Weiss heterogeneous mean-field approximation validated by Monte Carlo simulations, we provide an analytical characterization of how a macroscopic synchronized limit cycle emerges via an Andronov-Hopf bifurcation on heterogeneous networks. We derive closed-form phase boundaries and show that the onset of oscillations is explicitly controlled by network heterogeneity through the degree moment ratio. Degree heterogeneity decouples the spiking rate per neuron m from the spiking rate per synapse u, generating physical phenomena absent in homogeneous systems. These include (i) kinematic waves of sequential, degree-ordered activations propagating from the network periphery to the hubs, and (ii) a low-temperature phase-separated state emerging via a pitchfork bifurcation. We prove that for highly heterogeneous topologies, this phase-separated fixed point stabilizes and dynamically destroys the synchronized limit cycle. These results provide a mathematical framework for understanding how heterogeneity regulates macroscopic oscillations and out-of-equilibrium transitions in neural networks
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了由兴奋性与群体放电率之间的稳态反馈驱动、并在异质网络上远离平衡的动力学 Ising 神经网络。作者在经 Monte Carlo 验证的异质 Curie-Weiss 平均场近似下，解析刻画了同步极限环如何通过 Andronov-Hopf 分岔产生，并指出网络异质性会通过度矩影响振荡起始。进一步地，度异质性导致逐级传播的运动学波以及低温下的相分离固定点，这一机制在高度异质拓扑中会抑制同步极限环。
authors: Anna Poggialini, Irem Topal, Fabrizio Lombardi, Daniele De Martino
articles.abstract_zh_full: 结构异质性限制了复杂系统中的集体动力学，然而其在非平衡条件下的解析可处理性仍然有限。本文研究了一类动力学 Ising 神经网络，该网络通过神经元兴奋性与群体放电率之间的稳态反馈环而被驱动离平衡。借助经 Monte Carlo 模拟验证的异质 Curie-Weiss 平均场近似，我们给出了宏观同步极限环如何在异质网络上通过 Andronov-Hopf 分岔出现的解析表征。我们推导了闭式相边界，并表明振荡的起始由网络异质性通过度矩比显式控制。度异质性使每个神经元的尖峰率 m 与每个突触的尖峰率 u 脱耦，从而产生均质系统中不存在的物理现象。这些现象包括：(i) 沿度数排序、从网络边缘向枢纽传播的顺序激活运动学波；以及 (ii) 通过叉形分岔出现的低温相分离态。我们证明，对于高度异质的拓扑，该相分离固定点会稳定下来，并在动力学上破坏同步极限环。这些结果为理解异质性如何调节神经网络中的宏观振荡和非平衡转变提供了数学框架。

articles.title: Intertwined magnetoresistance and Hall multifunctionality in a non-coplanar magnetic Weyl semimetal DyB4
articles.title_zh: 非共面磁 Weyl 半金属 DyB₄ 中磁阻与霍尔多功能性的交织行为
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28283v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Anomalous magneto-transport responses provide complementary probes of orbital motion, momentum-space topology, and real-space spin chirality, yet their integration into a single material remains rare because their underlying requirements often compete. A promising materials-design strategy is to realize a magnetic Weyl semimetal that combines linearly dispersive high-mobility bands with tunable non-coplanar magnetism while limiting spin-dependent scattering. Here we identify DyB4, a frustrated rare-earth tetraboride, as a magnetic Weyl semimetal candidate that embodies this strategy and hosts intertwined magnetoresistance and Hall multifunctionality. Neutron diffraction reveals a sequence of field-tunable magnetic states, including non-coplanar spin configurations and PT-symmetry-broken phases. First-principles calculations identify steep linear dispersions and field-induced Weyl points near the Fermi level. Magneto-transport measurements establish a rare fourfold combination of extremely large magnetoresistance, chiral-anomaly-like negative magnetoresistance, large anomalous Hall conductivity arising from cooperative intrinsic Berry curvature and skew scattering, and scalar-spin-chirality-driven topological Hall responses. This multifunctionality arises from the distinct yet weakly coupled roles of itinerant carriers and localized 4f moments, which enable high-mobility transport, field-induced Weyl topology, and non-coplanar magnetism. DyB4 therefore provides a 4f-electron platform for correlating orbital transport, momentum-space Berry curvature, and real-space spin chirality, suggesting a route toward multifunctional magnetic topological materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将稀土四硼化物 DyB₄ 识别为一种磁 Weyl 半金属候选体，并证明其兼具强磁阻、类手征反常的负磁阻、较大的异常霍尔电导以及拓扑霍尔响应。中子衍射、第一性原理和输运测量共同表明，外场可调的非共面磁序与费米能附近的 Weyl 点协同作用，形成多种互相关联的磁输运功能。研究展示了 4f 电子平台上轨道输运、Berry 曲率与实空间自旋手性之间的耦合潜力。
authors: Long Chen, Yulin Shen, Songxue Chi, Seunghoon Song, Yang Zhang, Jian Liu, Haidong Zhou
articles.abstract_zh_full: 异常磁输运响应为研究轨道运动、动量空间拓扑以及实空间自旋手性提供了互补探针，但由于其内在条件往往相互竞争，将这些响应整合到一种材料中仍然罕见。一种有前景的材料设计策略是实现磁 Weyl 半金属，使线性色散的高迁移率能带与可调的非共面磁性相结合，同时尽量减少自旋依赖散射。本文将 DyB₄——一种受挫的稀土四硼化物——识别为符合这一策略的磁 Weyl 半金属候选体，并证明其具有交织的磁阻与霍尔多功能性。中子衍射揭示了一系列可由磁场调控的磁态，包括非共面自旋构型和破坏 PT 对称性的相。第一性原理计算识别出费米能附近陡峭的线性色散和场致 Weyl 点。磁输运测量确立了少见的四重组合：极大的磁阻、类手征反常的负磁阻、由协同的本征 Berry 曲率与偏斜散射共同导致的大异常霍尔电导，以及由标量自旋手性驱动的拓扑霍尔响应。这种多功能性源于巡游载流子与局域 4f 磁矩之间既不同又弱耦合的作用，它们分别实现了高迁移率输运、场致 Weyl 拓扑和非共面磁性。因此，DyB₄ 为关联轨道输运、动量空间 Berry 曲率与实空间自旋手性提供了一个 4f 电子平台，并提示了通向多功能磁拓扑材料的一条途径。

articles.title: An iterative method bridging DFT, disorder averaging, and experiment in intercalated materials: application to Au-intercalated graphene
articles.title_zh: 连接 DFT、无序平均与实验的插层材料迭代方法：以 Au 插层石墨烯为例
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28296v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Intercalation can strongly modify the electronic dispersion of a host material, as directly revealed by angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES). We develop a general iterative method combining density functional theory (DFT), tight-binding (TB), disorder averaging within the self-consistent T-matrix approximation (SCTMA), and experiment, to construct an effective model of the intercalated system. DFT identifies the relevant microscopic degrees of freedom and constrains selected model parameters, while comparison of SCTMA calculations with experiment guides their further refinement. We apply this method to graphene intercalated with Au clusters and show that it reproduces the main ARPES signatures of the Au-cluster phase, including the broadening of the V12an Hove singularity and the emergence of kink-like features in the dispersion. The essential microscopic ingredients identified by the analysis are the hybridization between selected intercalant orbitals and the graphene states, together with an intercalation-induced local scattering potential.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种将密度泛函理论、紧束缚模型、SCTMA 无序平均与实验相结合的迭代建模方法，用于建立插层体系的有效模型。以 Au 团簇插层石墨烯为例，作者重现实验 ARPES 中的主要特征，包括范霍夫奇点展宽和类 kink 色散，并指出关键微观因素是插层原子轨道与石墨烯态的杂化以及局域散射势。
authors: Poonam Kumari, Alberto Zobelli, Igor de Melo Froldi, Adeline Crepieux, Laurent Simon, Cristina Bena
articles.abstract_zh_full: 插层可以显著改变宿主材料的电子色散，而角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）可以直接揭示这一点。我们提出一种通用的迭代方法，将密度泛函理论（DFT）、紧束缚（TB）、自洽 T 矩近似（SCTMA）下的无序平均以及实验结合起来，用以构建插层体系的有效模型。DFT 用于识别相关的微观自由度并约束部分模型参数，而将 SCTMA 计算与实验比较则进一步指导参数修正。我们将该方法应用于 Au 团簇插层石墨烯，证明它能够重现实验中 Au 团簇相的主要 ARPES 特征，包括 van Hove 奇点的展宽以及色散中类 kink 特征的出现。分析所识别出的关键微观成分是：特定插层原子轨道与石墨烯态之间的杂化，以及插层引入的局域散射势。

articles.title: Coupled Spin-Density-Wave and Bond-Order Driven Metal-Insulator Transition in Altermagnetic CsCr₂S₂O
articles.title_zh: CsCr₂S₂O 中由耦合自旋密度波与键序驱动的金属-绝缘体转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28329v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A metal-insulator transition (MIT) driven by bond order (BO) coupled with a secondary spin-density wave (SDW) is identified in CsCr₂S₂O. Such coupling is enabled as a result of the broken time-reversal symmetry due to the pre-existing C-type antiferromagnetic (C-AFM) order. First-principles calculations reveal an orbital-selective physics that Cr-dyz orbitals form local moments and establish the altermagnetic order, while the Cr-dₓz orbitals remain metallic and hybridize with S-p_z. Thus the low-energy physics is governed by the Cr-dₓz and S-p_z orbitals. On-site interactions then enhance a secondary SDW (sSDW) instability of the itinerant dₓz electrons, which couples to the Cr-dₓz-S-p_z bonding order. The resulting coupled sSDW-BO simultaneously produces experimentally observed structural distortion, charge disproportionation, local Cr-moment modulation, and gap opening. Our results establish an orbital-selective mechanism upon which pre-existing altermagnetism and electronic correlations cooperate to drive a structural MIT.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了反铁磁体 CsCr₂S₂O 中由键序与次级自旋密度波耦合共同驱动的金属-绝缘体转变。作者指出，Cr-dyz 轨道形成局域磁矩并建立反铁磁序，而 Cr-dxz 轨道保持金属性并与 S-p_z 杂化；在电子关联作用下，次级自旋密度波与键序协同产生结构畸变、电荷反常、局域磁矩调制和能隙打开。该结果揭示了预先存在的反铁磁性与电子关联如何协同驱动结构型金属-绝缘体转变。
authors: Chenchao Xu, Wansheng Bai, Guo-Xiang Zhi, Yi Liu, Xiaoqun Wang, Jianhui Dai, Chao Cao
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们在反铁磁体 CsCr₂S₂O 中识别出一种由键序（BO）与次级自旋密度波（SDW）耦合驱动的金属-绝缘体转变（MIT）。由于预先存在的 C 型反铁磁（C-AFM）序已经破坏了时间反演对称性，这种耦合得以实现。第一性原理计算揭示了轨道选择性物理：Cr-dyz 轨道形成局域磁矩并建立反铁磁序，而 Cr-dxz 轨道保持金属性并与 S-p_z 杂化。因此，低能物理主要由 Cr-dxz 和 S-p_z 轨道主导。随后，位点上的相互作用增强了巡游 dₓz 电子的次级 SDW 不稳定性，并使其与 Cr-dxz–S-p_z 键合序发生耦合。最终形成的耦合 sSDW-BO 同时产生了实验观察到的结构畸变、电荷反常、局域 Cr 磁矩调制以及能隙打开。我们的结果确立了一种轨道选择性机制：在该机制下，预先存在的反铁磁性与电子关联协同作用，共同驱动结构型金属-绝缘体转变。

articles.title: FFLO transition and quantum criticality in polarized Fermi gases
articles.title_zh: 极化费米气体中的FFLO转变与量子临界性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28335v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the zero-temperature transition from the polarized normal phase to the FFLO state in a two-dimensional Fermi gas by means of a diagrammatic t-matrix approach. We first show that the standard non-self-consistent theory produces an unphysical phase diagram because of a severe violation of the Luttinger theorem. Motivated by this observation, we introduce a minimal self- consistent extension that largely restores compliance with the Luttinger theorem while preserving the analytical simplicity of the original formalism. This leads to a physically consistent phase diagram over the whole interaction range. Building on this improved description, we characterize the quantum critical behavior of the FFLO transition through the quasiparticle decay rates, quasiparticle weights, momentum distributions, and the critical dynamics of both fermionic and bosonic degrees of freedom. We further compare the two- and three-dimensional systems, showing that their critical properties can be understood within a unified geometrical picture based on the nesting of the majority and minority Fermi surfaces. Finally, for the three-dimensional case, we demonstrate within the Hertz-Millis framework that vertex corrections are irrelevant, thereby placing the FFLO quantum phase transition in the mean-field universality class, in close analogy with itinerant antiferromagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们采用图解 t 矩阵方法研究了二维费米气体中从极化正常相到 FFLO 态的零温转变。结果表明，标准的非自洽理论由于严重违反 Luttinger 定理而给出不物理的相图。为此，作者提出一种最小自洽修正，在基本保留原形式解析简洁性的同时显著恢复了对 Luttinger 定理的符合性，并据此获得整个相互作用范围内物理一致的相图。
authors: Francesco Pirolo, Leonardo Pisani, Pierbiagio Pieri
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们采用图解 t 矩阵方法研究了二维费米气体中从极化正常相到 FFLO 态的零温转变。首先我们表明，标准的非自洽理论由于严重违反 Luttinger 定理而产生了一个不物理的相图。基于这一观察，我们引入了一种最小自洽扩展，在保留原始形式主义解析简洁性的同时，在很大程度上恢复了对 Luttinger 定理的符合性。这使得我们在整个相互作用范围内得到一个物理上一致的相图。基于这一改进的描述，我们通过准粒子衰减率、准粒子权重、动量分布，以及费米和玻色自由度的临界动力学，对 FFLO 转变的量子临界行为进行了刻画。我们还比较了二维和三维体系，表明其临界性质可以在一个基于多数与少数费米面嵌套的统一几何图景下得到理解。最后，对于三维情形，我们在 Hertz-Millis 框架内证明顶角修正是无关的，因此将 FFLO 量子相变归入平均场普适类，这与巡游反铁磁体有着密切类比。

articles.title: Symmetry, Sound, and the Quest for Chiral Superconductors
articles.title_zh: 对称性、声学与手征超导体的探索
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28365v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The confirmation of a bulk, topological superconductor is a central goal of modern quantum materials research. Despite decades of searching, no confirmed examples yet exist. A primary difficulty is that most experimental signatures of topological superconductivity are ambiguous and indirect. I review efforts to narrow the search for a chiral topological superconductor using measurements of elastic moduli. In principle, these experiments can provide unambiguous thermodynamic evidence for multi-component superconductivity---a pre-requisite for chiral superconductivity in 2D and quasi-2D materials. Despite the potential strength of this program, the results are still negative. I provide a pedagogical introduction to multi-component order parameters, chiral topological superconductivity, and how superconducting order parameters couple to strain. I discuss ongoing efforts in heavy fermion, iron pnictide, and Kagome superconductors, and suggest routes for speeding up the search process, as well as other experimental tools that should be developed for the pursuit of this goal.
articles.abstract_zh: 确认体相拓扑超导体是现代量子材料研究的核心目标之一，但迄今仍没有公认的实验例子。本文回顾了利用弹性模量测量筛选手征拓扑超导体的努力，并介绍多分量序参量、手征拓扑超导以及超导序参量如何与应变耦合的基本概念。作者指出，这类实验在原则上可为多分量超导提供直接的热力学证据，但目前相关结果仍然是否定的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 确认一种体相、拓扑超导体是现代量子材料研究的核心目标之一。尽管经过数十年的寻找，至今仍没有公认的实例。实验上面临的一个主要困难是，大多数拓扑超导的实验信号都含糊且间接。本文回顾了利用弹性模量测量来缩小手征拓扑超导体搜索范围的努力。原则上，这些实验可以为多分量超导提供无歧义的热力学证据，而多分量超导是二维和准二维材料中实现手征超导的先决条件。尽管这一研究方向具有很强的潜力，但目前结果仍然是否定的。文中对多分量序参量、手征拓扑超导以及超导序参量如何与应变耦合作了教学性的介绍。我讨论了重费米子、铁砷化物以及 Kagome 超导体中的持续探索，并提出了加快搜索过程的途径，以及为实现这一目标还应发展哪些其他实验工具。

articles.title: Anomalous metal and superconducting phases in rhombohedral graphene
articles.title_zh: 菱方石墨烯中的反常金属与超导相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28425v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-dimensional superconductivity is now well established in graphene-based systems, with many such realizations showing evidence for unconventional pairing. Yet in several of the gate-tuned phases that otherwise exhibit clear signatures of superconductivity, the resistance does not vanish as temperature is lowered, instead saturating at a finite value. Here we report a systematic study of this behavior in rhombohedral graphene on a WSe₂ substrate, finding regions of gate space with zero-resistance superconductivity alongside others with finite saturation resistance. At zero magnetic field, these regions appear as isolated pockets in gate space that otherwise exhibit strikingly similar phenomenology, including abrupt transitions to the normal state as temperature, perpendicular magnetic field, and current are raised above critical values. A small in-plane field expands and merges these pockets without qualitatively altering their behavior, producing a sharp boundary at millikelvin base temperature between states of zero or finite resistance. The finite-resistance state reproduces key phenomenology associated with the anomalous metal, a state that has been observed in thin-film superconductors for decades but lacks an accepted theoretical explanation. The tunability and reproducibility of ultra-clean rhombohedral graphene place strong constraints on extrinsic explanations and provide a new platform for understanding this behavior.
articles.abstract_zh: 二维超导在石墨烯体系中已被充分证实，其中许多实现都显示出非常规配对的迹象。然而，在一些门控调控的相中，尽管具有清晰的超导特征，电阻在降温后并不消失，而是饱和到有限值。本文系统研究了 WSe₂ 基底上的菱方石墨烯，发现同时存在零电阻超导区和有限饱和电阻区；后者再现了与反常金属相关的关键现象，为理解这一长期未获公认理论解释的状态提供了新平台。
authors: Anna Okounkova, Abigail Sohm, Tobias Faehndrich, Manish Kumar, Derek Waleffe, Jiaqiang Yan, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Joshua Folk, Matthew Yankowitz
articles.abstract_zh_full: 二维超导在石墨烯基体系中如今已得到充分确立，而且许多此类实现都显示出非常规配对的证据。然而，在若干门控调控的相中，尽管表现出明确的超导特征，电阻在温度降低时并不会消失，而是饱和到某个有限值。这里我们报告了对 WSe₂ 基底上菱方石墨烯中这一行为的系统研究，发现门控空间中存在电阻为零的超导区域，同时也存在电阻有限饱和的区域。在零磁场下，这些区域在门控空间中表现为彼此分离的孤立“口袋”，但它们具有惊人相似的现象学特征，包括当温度、垂直磁场和电流超过临界值时突然转变为正常态。一个小的面内磁场会扩展并合并这些口袋，而不会从根本上改变其行为，从而在毫开尔文基温下形成一个清晰边界，将零电阻态和有限电阻态分开。有限电阻态再现了与反常金属相关的关键现象，而反常金属是一种几十年来在薄膜超导体中被观察到、但尚无公认理论解释的状态。超洁净菱方石墨烯的可调性和可重复性对各种外源性解释施加了强约束，并为理解这一行为提供了新的平台。

articles.title: Hydration-Controlled Layer Stacking in (NH₃₎₂Cu₅₍SeO₃₎₂₍OH)₆₍H₂O)₂₊ₓ (x = 0, 1, and 3)
articles.title_zh: 水合控制的层状堆垛：(NH₃)₂Cu₅(SeO₃)₂(OH)₆(H₂O)₂₊ₓ（x = 0、1 和 3）
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28427v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hydration and dehydration are powerful yet underexplored variables for controlling the architecture of layered inorganic materials, because intercalated water can modify interlayer separation, hydrogen-bonding networks, and layer stacking. Here, we report the reflux synthesis of a new family of hydrated layered copper selenites, (NH₃₎₂Cu₅₍SeO₃₎₂₍OH)₆₍H₂O)₂₊ₓ (x = 0, 1, and 3). From the crystal structures determined using electron diffraction and single crystal X-ray diffraction, we deduce that all three compounds share an identical layer built from Cu(OH)₄ squares and Cu-centered square pyramids forming distorted kagomé-like Cu²⁺ network. While the intralayer atomic arrangement is preserved across the series, the degree of hydration governs both the interlayer separation and the stacking sequence. These compounds therefore provide a rare platform relevant to the design of hydration-responsive materials for sensing, ion transport, separations, actuation, and energy-related applications. The preservation of distorted kagomé-like Cu²⁺ layers across hydration states further suggests potential interest for examining how interlayer water and stacking sequence affect low-dimensional magnetic coupling. Under reflux conditions, these phases are also shown to act as reactive intermediates in the formation of Cu₂OSeO₃, establishing them as tunable precursors for copper oxoselenite synthesis.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者报道了一类新型水合层状铜硒酸盐 (NH₃)₂Cu₅(SeO₃)₂(OH)₆(H₂O)₂₊ₓ（x = 0、1 和 3）的回流合成。基于电子衍射和单晶 X 射线衍射得到的晶体结构，可知三种化合物共享同一层内结构，但层间距和堆垛序列由水合程度决定。该系列为研究水合响应材料及其低维磁耦合提供了少见平台，同时还可作为 Cu₂OSeO₃ 合成中的可调前驱体。
authors: Priya R. Baral, Christian Jandl, Pauline Pradal, Johann Roos, Wenhua Bi, Arnaud Magrez
articles.abstract_zh_full: 水合与脱水是控制层状无机材料构型的强大但仍未被充分探索的变量，因为插层水可以改变层间距、氢键网络以及层堆垛方式。这里我们报道了一类新型水合层状铜硒酸盐 (NH₃)₂Cu₅(SeO₃)₂(OH)₆(H₂O)₂₊ₓ（x = 0、1 和 3）的回流合成。根据采用电子衍射和单晶 X 射线衍射确定的晶体结构，我们推断这三种化合物共享一个相同的层状结构，该层由 Cu(OH)₄ 方形和以 Cu 为中心的方锥体构成，形成一个畸变的类 Kagome Cu²⁺ 网络。尽管层内原子排布在整个系列中保持不变，但水合程度决定了层间距以及堆垛序列。因此，这些化合物为设计对水合有响应的材料提供了一个罕见的平台，在传感、离子输运、分离、驱动以及能源相关应用方面都具有潜在意义。畸变的类 Kagome Cu²⁺ 层在不同水合状态下仍得以保留，这也提示人们可进一步研究层间水和堆垛序列如何影响低维磁耦合。在回流条件下，这些相还被证明可作为形成 Cu₂OSeO₃ 的反应中间体，因此也可作为铜氧硒酸盐合成的可调前驱体。

articles.title: Transport Evidence of Magnetic Polarization in the Altermagnetic Candidate MnTe
articles.title_zh: 候选交替磁体 MnTe 中磁极化的输运证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28441v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The ability to precisely control magnetic properties is central to the development of future spin-based electronics. In this work, we report the successful growth of epitaxial α-MnTe thin films on InP(111) substrates using molecular beam epitaxy. Magneto-transport measurements at low temperatures reveal a distinct, hysteretic butterfly longitudinal magnetoresistance alongside a nonlinear transverse magneto-resistance response, suggesting the presence of a finite net magnetic polarization in the films. To understand the origin of this behavior, density functional theory (DFT) calculations were performed. While pristine bulk MnTe is a compensated antiferromagnet, our computational results suggest multiple pathways through which a finite magnetization can emerge in thin-film geometries, including interface-induced symmetry breaking and point defects. These findings demonstrate an epitaxial route for engineering magnetic responses in thin films.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过外延生长的 α-MnTe 薄膜与低温磁输运测量，报告了对候选交替磁体 MnTe 中有限净磁极化的证据。实验观察到明显的、具有磁滞性的蝶形纵向磁阻，以及非线性的横向磁阻响应。结合密度泛函理论计算，作者认为薄膜中的有限磁化可能源于界面诱导对称性破缺和点缺陷等机制。
authors: Younes Ghorbani, Nayana Devaraj, Joshua Maile, Samuel Poage, Qihua Zhang, Maria Hilse, Stephanie Law, Salva Salmani-Rezaie, Awadhesh Narayan, Kaveh Ahadi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 精确调控磁性是未来自旋电子学发展的核心。本文报道了利用分子束外延在 InP(111) 衬底上成功生长外延 α-MnTe 薄膜。低温下的磁输运测量显示出一种明显且具有磁滞性的蝶形纵向磁阻，同时伴随非线性的横向磁阻响应，这表明薄膜中存在有限的净磁极化。为理解这一行为的起源，我们进行了密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。尽管本征体相 MnTe 是一种补偿型反铁磁体，我们的计算结果表明，在薄膜几何中可通过多种途径产生有限磁化，包括界面诱导的对称性破缺和点缺陷。结果表明，外延生长为工程化薄膜磁响应提供了一条可行路径。

articles.title: Field-Selected Topological Buffering in a Disordered Skyrmion Crystal
articles.title_zh: 无序斯格明子晶体中的场选择拓扑缓冲
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28458v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quenched disorder can disrupt crystalline order without immediately destroying the topology of its constituent textures, but the relation between these processes in skyrmion crystals remains unclear. Using large-scale simulations of a triangular-lattice chiral magnet with random DM interactions, we show that the magnetic field selects between two disordering routes. At high fields, global translational coherence is lost at a weak-disorder scale, while sixfold bond-orientational order survives to a larger disorder strength and the total topological charge remains nearly locked up to a substantially larger scale. The resulting interval defines a topological buffer containing a Bragg-glass- like skyrmion regime followed by a skyrmion-glass regime. Finite-size scaling, spatial correlations, defect statistics, and spin autocorrelations support their distinct structural and glassy character. At lower fields, bond-orientational disordering nearly coincides with topological reconstruction, eliminating the skyrmion-glass window and contracting the buffer. These results identify the magnetic field as a control knob for separating crystalline disordering from topological-charge loss and establish topological buffering as a mechanism by which topological textures can remain robust in structurally disordered media.
articles.abstract_zh: 通过对具有随机 DM 相互作用的三角晶格手征磁体进行大规模模拟，作者发现磁场会选择不同的无序化路径。在高场下，全局平移相干性在较弱无序下即丧失，而六重键向有序可持续到更强无序，且总拓扑荷在更大的无序范围内基本保持不变，从而形成一个“拓扑缓冲区”。该缓冲区依次包含类 Bragg 玻璃的斯格明子区和斯格明子玻璃区；在较低磁场下，这两个区间会缩并甚至消失。
authors: Wenyu Su, Nvsen Ma, Chen Cheng, Hong-Gang Luo
articles.abstract_zh_full: 淬火无序可以破坏晶体有序性，而不立即摧毁其构成纹理的拓扑性，但在斯格明子晶体中，这两个过程之间的关系仍不清楚。我们使用带有随机 DM 相互作用的三角晶格手征磁体的大规模模拟表明，磁场会在两种无序化路径之间进行选择。在高磁场下，全局平移相干性会在较弱无序尺度下丧失，而六重键取向有序则可在更大的无序强度下继续存在，同时总拓扑荷在一个显著更大的尺度范围内几乎保持锁定。由此形成的区间定义了一个拓扑缓冲区，其中先后包含类 Bragg-玻璃的斯格明子态以及斯格明子玻璃态。有限尺寸标度分析、空间相关、缺陷统计和自旋自相关函数都支持这两种状态在结构和玻璃性质上的差异。在较低磁场下，键取向无序化几乎与拓扑重构同时发生，从而消除了斯格明子玻璃窗口并压缩了该缓冲区。这些结果表明，磁场是分离晶体无序化与拓扑荷损失的控制旋钮，并确立了“拓扑缓冲”作为拓扑纹理在结构无序介质中保持稳健的一种机制。

articles.title: Observation of long-lived spin order in nanoconfined water
articles.title_zh: 纳米受限水中长寿命自旋序的观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28480v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Liquids confined to nanometer-scale geometries exhibit behavior that departs markedly from their bulk counterparts, yet studying their dynamics under controlled conditions remains experimentally challenging. Here, we use nitrogen-vacancy (NV) center nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy to probe water confined in 5.6 nm channels as a function of temperature. The system remains liquid throughout the investigated temperature range and exhibits strongly suppressed diffusivity, enabling direct detection of its 1H NMR spectrum. Occasionally, the proton resonance transforms into a doublet with a splitting of several tens of kilohertz, which we tentatively attribute to hyperfine interactions mediated by long-lived paramagnetic charge complexes, in turn seeded by solvated electrons optically injected during laser illumination. The intermittent appearance of this feature suggests a metastable state comprising a correlated population of charge-hydration complexes extending throughout the confined liquid.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者利用氮空位中心核磁共振谱，研究了 5.6 nm 通道中受限水随温度变化的动力学。该体系在所研究温区内始终保持液态，但扩散显著受抑，因此能够直接探测其 1H NMR 谱。偶尔会出现质子共振分裂为双峰的现象，作者将其初步归因于长寿命顺磁电荷复合体介导的超精细相互作用。
authors: Rohma Khan, Kang Xu, Nathaniel Jeffries, Ankit Bhardwaj, Boya Radha, Daniela Pagliero, Carlos A. Meriles
articles.abstract_zh_full: 受限于纳米尺度几何中的液体，其行为与体相对应物有显著差异，但在受控条件下研究其动力学仍然具有实验挑战。这里我们使用氮空位（NV）中心核磁共振（NMR）谱来探测位于 5.6 nm 通道中的水，并考察其随温度的变化。该体系在所研究的温度范围内始终保持液态，并表现出强烈受抑的扩散性，因此能够直接探测其 1H NMR 谱。偶尔，质子共振会转变为一个双峰，分裂量达数十千赫兹；我们初步将其归因于由长寿命顺磁电荷复合体介导的超精细相互作用，而这些复合体又可能由激光照明期间光学注入的溶剂化电子所触发。该特征的间歇性出现表明，受限液体中存在一种亚稳态，其中包含延伸至整个受限液体的、相关联的电荷-水合复合体群体。

articles.title: Hubbard physics with ultracold polar molecules: on-site interaction energies for shielded molecules
articles.title_zh: 超冷极性分子的哈伯德物理：屏蔽分子的单址相互作用能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28533v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We explore on-site interaction energies U for pairs of shielded ultracold molecules on the same lattice site. We use 2-dimensional effective potentials appropriate for microwave shielding, which have dipole-dipole character at long range but feature a very large repulsive core when the two molecules come close together. This causes very strong correlation between the motions of two molecules on the same site. We find behavior very different from that for ultracold atoms: in particular, there are states for which U is negative for weak lattices but crosses zero to positive values as the lattice strength increases. This behavior is found for both unbound pairs and 2-body bound states. The latter will give access to previously unexplored types of strongly dipolar Hubbard physics with multiple site occupancy.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究同一晶格位点上成对屏蔽超冷分子的单址相互作用能 U，并采用适用于微波屏蔽的二维有效势。由于该势在远距离表现为偶极-偶极相互作用，而在近距离又具有很强的排斥核，因此同一位点上两个分子的运动高度相关。作者发现其行为与超冷原子显著不同，例如在弱晶格下 U 可能为负，而随着晶格增强又会穿过零变为正，这一现象既出现在非束缚对中，也出现在二体束缚态中。
authors: Carlin Stewart-Wiese, Joy Dutta, Jeremy M. Hutson
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究位于同一晶格位点上的一对经过屏蔽的超冷分子的单址相互作用能 U。我们使用适用于微波屏蔽的二维有效势，该势在远距离具有偶极-偶极特征，但当两个分子接近时会表现出非常大的排斥核心。这使得同一位点上的两个分子的运动之间具有很强的相关性。我们发现其行为与超冷原子大不相同：特别地，对于某些态，在弱晶格时 U 为负，但随着晶格强度增加会穿过零并变为正值。这种行为既出现在非束缚对中，也出现在二体束缚态中。后者将使人们能够接触到此前尚未探索过的新型强偶极哈伯德物理，其中允许多个粒子占据同一晶格位点。

articles.title: Graph Neural Network Force Fields for Spin Dynamics in Metallic Magnets
articles.title_zh: 金属磁体自旋动力学的图神经网络力场
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28537v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Metallic magnets exhibit complex spin dynamics governed by electronically generated interactions. Predictive simulations of such dynamics typically require repeated solutions of an underlying electronic problem throughout the time evolution, creating a major computational bottleneck. Here we introduce a graph neural network (GNN) magnetic force-field framework that learns the effective magnetic energy functional governing itinerant spin dynamics directly from electronic calculations. Conceptually analogous to machine-learned interatomic potentials, the proposed framework enables efficient evaluation of spin torques while capturing the nonlinear and spatially extended interactions generated by itinerant electrons. We benchmark the method on representative metallic magnetic systems exhibiting collinear, noncollinear, and noncoplanar magnetic order. The learned force fields accurately reproduce electronically generated spin torques and yield nonequilibrium spin dynamics in excellent agreement with direct electronic simulations. Our results establish graph neural networks as a powerful framework for machine-learned magnetic force fields, providing a pathway toward predictive large-scale simulations of nonequilibrium magnetism across multiple length and time scales.
articles.abstract_zh: 金属磁体中的自旋动力学由电子产生的相互作用所支配，传统模拟往往需要在时间演化过程中反复求解电子结构问题，计算开销巨大。本文提出一种图神经网络磁力场框架，可直接从电子计算中学习有效磁能泛函，并高效评估自旋力矩。作者在多种具有共线、非共线和非共面磁序的金属磁体上验证了该方法，结果表明其能够准确再现电子结构产生的自旋力矩及非平衡自旋动力学。
authors: Ali Rayat, Yunhao Fan, Gia-Wei Chern
articles.abstract_zh_full: 金属磁体表现出由电子产生相互作用所支配的复杂自旋动力学。对这类动力学进行可预测模拟，通常需要在时间演化过程中反复求解底层电子问题，从而形成严重的计算瓶颈。这里我们提出一种图神经网络（GNN）磁力场框架，它能够直接从电子计算中学习支配巡游自旋动力学的有效磁能泛函。该方法在概念上类似于机器学习的原子间势，但它可以高效求值自旋力矩，同时捕捉由巡游电子生成的非线性、空间延展的相互作用。我们在具有共线、非共线以及非共面磁序的代表性金属磁体系上对该方法进行了基准测试。学习得到的力场能够准确再现由电子结构产生的自旋力矩，并给出与直接电子模拟高度一致的非平衡自旋动力学。我们的结果表明，图神经网络是构建机器学习磁力场的强大框架，为跨越多种长度和时间尺度的非平衡磁学大尺度预测模拟提供了途径。
articles.focus_summary: 该文提出一种面向金属磁体自旋动力学的图神经网络磁力场框架，从电子结构计算中直接学习有效磁能泛函。该方法能够高效评估自旋力矩，并在共线、非共线和非共面磁序体系中较好重现实电子模拟结果。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们在磁性材料、自旋动力学、机器学习哈密顿量/势函数方向高度相关，也契合团队关注的itinerant magnetism与spin-gnn路线。可为后续构建自旋哈密顿量或磁力场代理模型提供直接借鉴。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议进一步关注其训练数据构造、力矩标签定义与泛化能力评估方式，并思考如何与自旋哈密顿量、有效模型或非绝热动力学耦合。若团队做金属磁体或非共线磁性，可优先阅读。

articles.title: Multibranched parametric resonance and swallowtail catastrophe in electromechanical oscillators with nonlinear friction
articles.title_zh: 含非线性摩擦的机电振荡器中的多分支参量共振与燕尾突变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27242v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Parametric resonance underpins the operation of a wide range of physical systems, from nanomechanical resonators to quantum-information systems and Ising machines. As an archetypal class of driven-dissipative systems, parametric oscillators are generally expected to exhibit a single pair of stable period-two states with opposite phases. This bistable behavior enables both the simulation of spin Hamiltonians and the preparation of superconducting cat states. Whether multiple pairs of such states can coexist in a single oscillator, however, remains an open question. Here, we show experimentally and theoretically that conventional controlled nonlinear friction can induce the coexistence of two distinct pairs of period-two states in a micromechanical oscillator. The friction is implemented via a canonical approach, utilizing a drive-induced resonant coupling that transfers two vibrational quanta from the oscillatory mode to a faster decaying mode. We demonstrate that the onset of multistability is governed by a swallowtail catastrophe and quantitatively map the associated bifurcation structure. Our results broaden the understanding of parametric resonance and establish micro- and nano-mechanical oscillators as a versatile platform for studying catastrophe theory and multistable nonequilibrium dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 参量共振是多种物理系统运行的基础，从纳米机械谐振器到量子信息系统和 Ising 机都依赖于此。通常，参量振子只会呈现一对相位相反的稳定二周期状态，但本文通过实验和理论表明，常规的可控非线性摩擦可以使两对这样的状态在同一个振子中共存。作者还表明，多稳态的出现由燕尾突变控制，并定量描绘了相应的分岔结构。
authors: P. Y. Chan, L. Huang, X. Dong, M. I. Dykman, H. B. Chan
articles.abstract_zh_full: 参量共振是从纳米机械谐振器到量子信息系统和 Ising 机器等广泛物理系统运行的基础。作为受驱耗散系统的一类典型代表，参量振子通常被认为只会出现一对稳定的、相位相反的二周期状态。这种双稳态行为既可用于模拟自旋哈密顿量，也可用于制备超导猫态。然而，同一个振荡器中是否可能共存多对这类状态，仍然是一个开放问题。这里我们通过实验和理论表明，常规的可控非线性摩擦可以在一个微机械振荡器中诱导两对不同的二周期状态共存。该摩擦通过一种标准方法实现，即利用驱动诱导的共振耦合，将两个振动量子从振荡模转移到一个衰减更快的模中。我们证明，多稳态的出现由燕尾突变所支配，并定量描绘了相关的分岔结构。我们的结果拓展了对参量共振的理解，并确立了微米和纳米机械振荡器作为研究突变理论和多稳态非平衡动力学的多功能平台。

articles.title: Mean-Field Theory of Chiral Active Model B: Arrested Coarsening and Chiral Fingering Instabilities
articles.title_zh: 手征活性 Model B 的平均场理论：粗化受阻与手征指状不稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27305v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We derive and analyze a mean-field theory of the chiral Ising model recently introduced by Wang, Pietzonka, and Jülicher in "Edge Currents Shape Condensates in Chiral Active Matter", arXiv:2603.20064. Starting from the master equation for clockwise and counterclockwise rotations of 2x2 spin blocks, we first obtain spatially discrete evolution equations for the spatially resolved average magnetization. On this discrete level, we show that a chiral bias strongly affects phase coarsening: domains coarsen anisotropically, develop nearly rectangular shapes, and eventually display chirality-induced arrested coarsening. Taking the continuum limit of these equations yields an active field theory that has the structure of a relaxational Model-B-type dynamics supplemented by a chiral current that permanently drives the system out of equilibrium. The coarse graining explicitly shows how microscopic rotational bias generates tangential currents localized at interfaces. Using this continuum theory, we perform a linear stability analysis of radially symmetric clusters and identify a chiral fingering instability in which angular perturbations of the interface are amplified and eventually lead to radially asymmetric rotating states or disordered states.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从最近提出的手征 Ising 模型出发，推导并分析了其平均场理论。离散层面上，手征偏置会显著影响相区粗化，使畴呈现各向异性演化、近矩形形状以及最终的粗化受阻。进一步取连续极限后，得到一个具有弛豫型 Model-B 结构、但叠加了手征电流的活性场论；该理论揭示了界面处局域切向电流的起源，并预言了径向簇的手征指状不稳定性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们推导并分析了最近由 Wang、Pietzonka 和 Jülicher 在“Edge Currents Shape Condensates in Chiral Active Matter”中提出的手征 Ising 模型的平均场理论。我们从顺时针和逆时针旋转的 2×2 自旋块的主方程出发，首先得到关于空间分辨平均磁化强度的离散演化方程。在这一离散层面上，我们表明手征偏置会强烈影响相区粗化：畴以各向异性的方式长大，形成近似矩形的形状，并最终表现出由手征性引起的粗化受阻。对这些方程取连续极限后，我们得到一个活性场论，其结构是带有手征电流补充项的弛豫型 Model-B 动力学，而该电流持续将系统驱离平衡。粗粒化过程明确显示了微观旋转偏置如何在界面处产生局域的切向电流。利用这一连续理论，我们对径向对称簇进行了线性稳定性分析，并识别出一种手征指状不稳定性，其中界面的角向扰动被放大，最终导致径向不对称的旋转态或无序态。

articles.title: Geometry-Induced Domain-Wall Pinning and Z₂ Asymmetry in Nominally One-Dimensional Rydberg Arrays
articles.title_zh: 名义上一维里德堡阵列中的几何诱导畴壁钉扎与 Z₂ 非对称性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27358v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We perform experiments on QuEra's neutral-Rydberg-atom Aquila quantum computer, using quasi-adiabatic evolution on 1-dimensional models. We use hardware fine-tuning to balance the measurement statistics close to zero net magnetization, in two different geometric outlines: one closed triangular model with 33 atoms, and one 47-atom square with an engineered atom vacancy. The nature of this processor restricts the geometry of the atoms that can be programmed to a 2D plane. We report effects not predicted by the pure 1D Ising model, such as pinning of domain walls and Z₂ symmetry breaking due to the interplay between van der Waals interactions and the Rydberg blockade. In particular, atoms around the atom vacancy and at the vertices of the 1-dimensional square-outline model strongly prefer the Rydberg state, leading to the effective model having a ferromagnetic bond across the vacancy.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用 QuEra 中性里德堡原子 Aquila 量子计算机，在一维模型上开展准绝热演化实验。作者通过硬件微调使测量统计接近零净磁化，并比较了两种几何轮廓：一个包含 33 个原子的闭合三角模型，以及一个带有人工原子空位的 47 原子正方形模型。结果观测到纯一维 Ising 模型并未预言的效应，如畴壁钉扎与 Z₂ 对称性破缺，这些现象源于范德华相互作用与里德堡阻塞之间的几何耦合。
authors: Elijah Pelofske, Frank Barrows, Cristiano Nisoli
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们在 QuEra 的中性里德堡原子 Aquila 量子计算机上进行了实验，针对一维模型实施准绝热演化。我们通过硬件微调，使测量统计在零净磁化附近达到平衡，并在两种几何轮廓下进行研究：一个是由 33 个原子构成的闭合三角模型，另一个是带有人为原子空位的 47 原子正方形模型。由于这一处理器的特性，可编程原子的几何形状被限制在二维平面中。我们报告了一些纯一维 Ising 模型无法预言的效应，例如畴壁钉扎以及由于范德华相互作用与里德堡阻塞共同作用而导致的 Z₂ 对称性破缺。尤其是，围绕原子空位以及一维正方形轮廓模型顶点附近的原子强烈偏好里德堡态，从而使有效模型在空位上形成了一条铁磁键。

articles.title: Phase noise analysis and control of VO₂₋based relaxation type oscillators
articles.title_zh: 基于VO2的弛豫型振荡器的相位噪声分析与控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27447v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: VO₂₋based relaxation oscillators form a rapidly developing field that finds applications in neuromorphic computing, Ising machines, and numerous signal processing concepts. These oscillators operate in a deeply nonlinear relaxation regime based on rapid phase transitions between insulating and metallic states in the VO₂ material. This process is governed by thermal effects, which lead to additional voltage fluctuations and contribute to a considerably wide spectral linewidth in the VO₂₋based oscillator signal. In this work, we thoroughly study the phase noise in VO₂₋based relaxation oscillators and demonstrate that the broadening of the generation spectrum linewidth at low oscillation frequencies is caused by an increased susceptibility to thermal fluctuations during the incubation phase. We explore the types of noise affecting oscillator stability and show that synchronization with an external square-wave signal improves the phase noise more effectively than a sinusoidal-shape injection locking signal.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文系统研究了基于VO2的弛豫振荡器中的相位噪声来源与抑制方法。作者指出，在低振荡频率下谱线展宽主要源于成核阶段对热涨落敏感性增强。研究还表明，与正弦形注入锁定相比，外部方波信号同步对相位噪声的改善更为有效。
authors: Artem Litvinenko, Erbin Qiu, Sambit Ghosh, Juan Andres Hofer, Akash Kumar, Jong-Guk Choi, Ivan K. Schuller, Johan Åkerman
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于VO2的弛豫振荡器是一个快速发展的领域，可应用于神经形态计算、Ising机器以及多种信号处理概念。这类振荡器工作在深度非线性的弛豫区间，依赖VO2材料在绝缘态与金属态之间的快速相变。该过程受热效应支配，会引入额外电压涨落，并导致VO2振荡器信号具有显著加宽的谱线宽度。在本文中，我们系统研究了VO2基弛豫振荡器中的相位噪声，并证明在低振荡频率下，生成谱线宽度的展宽是由成核阶段对热涨落敏感性增强所致。我们考察了影响振荡器稳定性的噪声类型，并表明，与正弦形注入锁定信号相比，借助外部方波信号进行同步对相位噪声的改善更为有效。

articles.title: Noise-resilient and Scalable Quantum Error Correction for Nuclear Spin Qubits in Silicon with Electron Shuttling
articles.title_zh: 利用电子穿梭实现硅中核自旋量子比特的抗噪且可扩展量子纠错
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27527v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Nuclear spin qubits in silicon are well-isolated from their environment. Consequently, they have very long lifetimes and low sensitivity to noise, but this also suggests that control and measurement is challenging. We introduce electron pair interferometry (EPI), a protocol to overcome this challenge and maintain robustness to noise. EPI is implemented using an array of quantum dots with isoelectronic nuclear spin qubits located in the dots. A pair of electrons are initialized into a singlet ground state, split apart, and shuttled to the dots containing nuclear spin qubits. We show it is possible to coherently transfer the parity of the nuclei onto the measurable state of singlet/triplet-encoded electrons. Global nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) can be used to change bases and implement dynamical decoupling (DD). Combined with selective hyperfine-induced Zπ rotations, our gate set is complete for universal quantum computation, tailored to Calderbank-Shor-Steane (CSS) quantum error correction, and robust to noise. We discuss very low sensitivity to charge noise and study the sensitivity to both DC and AC magnetic field inhomogeneity which depends strongly on their relative strengths.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出电子对干涉协议，以解决硅中核自旋量子比特因过度隔离而难以控制和测量的问题。该方案利用量子点阵列，将电子的奇偶信息从核自旋映射到可测量的单重态/三重态电子态，并结合全局核磁共振、动态解耦和选择性超精细相互作用旋转构成通用门集。研究表明，该方案对电荷噪声极不敏感，并适用于CSS量子纠错框架。文章还分析了其对直流与交流磁场不均匀性的敏感性。
authors: Wayne M. Witzel, Matthew D. Grace, Dwight R. Luhman
articles.abstract_zh_full: 硅中的核自旋量子比特与其环境高度隔离。因此，它们具有极长寿命并且对噪声不敏感，但这也意味着控制和测量具有挑战性。我们提出电子对干涉（EPI）协议，以克服这一挑战并保持对噪声的鲁棒性。EPI通过一个量子点阵列实现，其中同位素相同的核自旋量子比特位于各个量子点中。一对电子被初始化到单重态基态中，随后被分离并转移到包含核自旋量子比特的量子点中。我们表明，可以将核的奇偶信息相干地转移到可测量的单重态/三重态编码电子态上。全局核磁共振（NMR）可用于改变基，并实现动态解耦（DD）。结合选择性的超精细相互作用诱导的Zπ旋转，我们的门集是完备的，可用于通用量子计算，适配Calderbank-Shor-Steane（CSS）量子纠错，并且对噪声具有鲁棒性。我们讨论了其对电荷噪声极低的敏感度，并研究了其对直流和交流磁场不均匀性的敏感性，这种敏感性强烈依赖于二者的相对强度。

articles.title: Quantum Magnonics: Quantum States Generation and Applications
articles.title_zh: 量子磁振子学：量子态生成及其应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27771v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Hybrid systems based on magnons in ferromagnetic materials, such as yttrium iron garnet, have achieved remarkable development in the last decade. These include the coupling of magnons to microwave and optical photons, superconducting qubits, phonons, spins, the center-of-mass motion of a ferromagnet, etc. Here, we review both the experimental and theoretical progress in this field, focusing on the generation of magnonic quantum states and their applications in a broad range of fields. Since the strong coupling is a prerequisite for achieving coherent quantum control of magnons and preparing magnonic quantum states, we start by introducing representative strong-coupling experiments in cavity magnonics, then review a series of protocols for creating various magnonic quantum states, such as Fock, cat, squeezed, and entangled states, and discuss their potential applications in macroscopic quantum studies, quantum information science, quantum sensing, magnonic quantum devices, dark matter detection, and so on. Finally, we summarize the review and give an outlook for the future study of quantum magnonics.
articles.abstract_zh: 这是一篇关于量子磁振子学的综述，重点总结了磁振子量子态的制备与应用进展。文章回顾了磁振子与微波光子、光子、超导量子比特、声子、自旋以及铁磁体质心运动等多种体系的强耦合实验，并概述了Fock态、猫态、压缩态和纠缠态等量子态的生成方案。作者进一步讨论了其在宏观量子研究、量子信息、量子传感、磁振子器件和暗物质探测等方面的潜在应用。
authors: Zi-Xu Lu, Xuan Zuo, Xin-Lei Hei, Gang Liu, Zeng-Xing Liu, Qi Guo, Peng-Bo Li, Jie Li
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于铁磁材料中磁振子的混合系统，例如钇铁石榴石，在过去十年里取得了显著发展。这些系统包括磁振子与微波和光学光子、超导量子比特、声子、自旋、铁磁体质心运动等的耦合。本文对这一领域的实验和理论进展进行了综述，重点关注磁振子量子态的生成及其在广泛领域中的应用。由于强耦合是实现磁振子的相干量子控制和制备磁振子量子态的前提，我们首先介绍腔磁振子学中的代表性强耦合实验，然后回顾一系列用于创建各种磁振子量子态的方案，例如Fock态、猫态、压缩态和纠缠态，并讨论它们在宏观量子研究、量子信息科学、量子传感、磁振子量子器件、暗物质探测等方面的潜在应用。最后，我们对该综述进行总结，并展望量子磁振子学未来的研究方向。

articles.title: Nanoparticle Networks for Neuromorphic Computing
articles.title_zh: 用于神经形态计算的纳米颗粒网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27844v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Physical computing leverages complex dynamical systems for energy-efficient data processing. In this work, we present a neuromorphic architecture based on metallic nanoparticles interconnected by molecular junctions on a SiO₂/Si substrate. We demonstrate that surrounding static control electrodes transform this nanoparticle network from a passive reservoir into a tunable nonlinear dynamical system. By analyzing how these electrodes route simple one-dimensional voltage inputs into multidimensional signal responses, we establish three core design rules to maximize computational performance. First, operating near the system's cutoff frequency achieves an optimal balance between nonlinear charge tunneling and linear capacitive memory. Second, tuning the underlying SiO₂ thickness sets the electrostatic screening length and dictates the memory type. Thick oxide layers reduce the screening length, causing networks larger than this length to transition into a persistent, non-volatile-like regime. Conversely, networks smaller than the screening length exhibit only fading memory. Third, introducing structural disorder via heterogeneous molecular junctions overcomes inherent limits on expressivity. While a network's computational expressivity scales with its physical size, it is ultimately capped by the screening length. Breaking internal spatial symmetries with localized disorder bypasses this saturation, allowing control voltages to independently manipulate specific signal amplitudes and phases, universally maximizing performance for dynamic neuromorphic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于金属纳米颗粒和分子结的神经形态架构，并证明静态控制电极可将其从被动储备转化为可调非线性动力系统。作者总结出三条提高计算性能的设计原则：在截止频率附近工作、通过氧化层厚度调控屏蔽长度与记忆类型，以及引入结构无序突破表达能力上限。研究表明，内部空间对称性的打破能够使控制电压独立调节特定信号幅度和相位，从而显著增强动态神经形态应用性能。
authors: Jonas Mensing, Wilfred G. van der Wiel, Andreas Heuer
articles.abstract_zh_full: 物理计算利用复杂动力学系统来实现能效更高的数据处理。本文提出了一种基于SiO2/Si衬底上由分子结互连的金属纳米颗粒构成的神经形态架构。我们证明，围绕网络布置的静态控制电极可将这一纳米颗粒网络从被动储备转变为可调的非线性动力系统。通过分析这些电极如何将简单的一维电压输入路由为多维信号响应，我们建立了三条核心设计规则，以最大化计算性能。首先，在系统截止频率附近工作能够在非线性电荷隧穿与线性电容记忆之间实现最佳平衡。其次，调节底层SiO2厚度可以设定静电屏蔽长度并决定记忆类型。较厚的氧化层会缩短屏蔽长度，使得尺寸大于该长度的网络转变为持续性的、类似非易失性的状态；相反，尺寸小于屏蔽长度的网络则只表现为衰减记忆。第三，通过异质分子结引入结构无序可以突破表达能力的内在限制。虽然网络的计算表达能力随物理尺寸增大而提高，但最终会受到屏蔽长度的上限约束。通过局域无序打破内部空间对称性可以绕过这种饱和，使控制电压能够独立操纵特定的信号幅度和相位，从而在动态神经形态应用中普遍地最大化性能。

articles.title: Spin-canting-induced Giant Nonlinear Optical Magnetochirality in a 2D Ferrotoroid
articles.title_zh: 自旋倾转诱导的二维铁电环磁体中巨大的非线性光学磁手性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28067v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Achieving magnetically switchable chiral light emission is an important goal for 2D opto-spintronics. However, conventional strategies face a fundamental trade-off between dynamic tunability and polarization contrast. Nonlinear optics, particularly the emerging mechanism of chiral second-harmonic generation (SHG), offers a distinct strategy to bypass this restriction, yet its experimental realization remains elusive due to stringent symmetry requirements. Here, we report giant nonlinear optical magnetochirality in a centrosymmetric 2D ferrotoroid, bilayer (2L) CrSBr. We reveal that a field-induced spin-canting state breaks the parity-time (PT) symmetry of the unperturbed antiferromagnetic (AFM) ground state, activating a spin-chirality-driven i-type susceptibility. The coherent interference between this emergent i-type and intrinsic c-type SHG susceptibilities generates a macroscopic circularly polarized SHG signal whose helicity is magnetically switchable. Leveraging this sensitive mechanism, we uncover remanent magnetic states after field saturation that evade conventional linear probes. By exploiting the non-volatility of these states, we demonstrate magneto-optical memory and logic operations. Our work establishes a general symmetry-driven strategy for tailoring nonlinear magnetochirality, while providing a sensitive optical probe for subtle spin textures in the 2D limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在中心对称的二维铁电环磁体双层CrSBr中观察到巨大的非线性光学磁手性。作者发现，外场诱导的自旋倾转态打破了本征反铁磁基态的PT对称性，并激活由自旋手性驱动的i型极化率。该新兴响应与固有c型二次谐波极化率相干干涉，产生可磁场翻转螺旋度的宏观圆偏振二次谐波信号。基于这一机制，研究还揭示了传统线性探测难以发现的剩磁态，并演示了磁光存储与逻辑功能。
authors: Shian Xia, Sheng Liu, Wenhe Jia, Fanglu Qin, Xuanji Wang, Haixiang Luo, Yue Sun, Vanessa Li Zhang, Wenduo Chen, Jiazheng Qin, Cheng-Wei Qiu, Ting Yu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 实现可磁控切换的手性光发射是二维自旋光电子学中的一个重要目标。然而，传统策略在动态可调性与偏振对比度之间面临根本性的权衡。非线性光学，尤其是新兴的手性二次谐波产生（SHG）机制，提供了绕开这一限制的不同策略，但由于对称性要求严格，其实验实现仍然难以实现。本文报道了在中心对称的二维铁电环磁体双层（2L）CrSBr中出现的巨大非线性光学磁手性。我们揭示，外场诱导的自旋倾转态打破了未受扰动反铁磁（AFM）基态的PT对称性，从而激活了由自旋手性驱动的i型极化率。该新兴的i型极化率与固有c型SHG极化率之间的相干干涉，产生了一个宏观的圆偏振SHG信号，其螺旋度可由磁场切换。借助这一高度灵敏的机制，我们发现了在场饱和后仍存在的剩磁态，而这些状态无法被传统线性探测手段识别。进一步利用这些状态的非易失性，我们演示了磁光存储和逻辑运算。我们的工作建立了一种通用的、由对称性驱动的策略，用于调控非线性磁手性，同时也为二维极限下细微自旋纹理提供了一种灵敏的光学探针。

articles.title: Noise-aware emulation and cross-device validation of neutral atom analog quantum processing units
articles.title_zh: 具有噪声感知的中性原子模拟量子处理单元仿真与跨器件验证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28364v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Analog quantum processors based on Rydberg atom arrays are a powerful platform for many-body quantum simulation, combinatorial optimization, and graph machine learning. As these devices become increasingly accessible, establishing confidence in their outputs requires predictive models that quantitatively connect microscopic hardware imperfections to empirical results. Here, we present a noise-aware emulation framework that propagates the dominant noise mechanisms throughout the full computation cycle to predict device behavior. We validate the framework by benchmarking two representative protocols, quantum annealing and post-quench dynamics, on three Pasqal quantum processors where classical simulations still provide ground truth. Across all three devices, the measured observables fall within the uncertainty envelopes predicted by the emulator. Beyond reproducing the data, the framework isolates which physical mechanism dominates in each operating regime, provides quantitative guidance for algorithm design and hardware improvements, and establishes a foundation for verifying analog processors in regimes beyond classical reach.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种噪声感知的仿真框架，用于预测Rydberg原子阵列模拟量子处理器的器件行为。作者在量子退火和淬火后动力学两个代表性协议上，对三台Pasqal量子处理器进行了基准验证，结果显示实验观测量均落在仿真给出的不确定性范围内。该框架不仅能重现实验数据，还能识别不同运行区间中主导误差的物理机制，并为算法设计和硬件改进提供定量指导。
authors: Constantin Dalyac, Sergi Julià-Farré, Lucas Leclerc, Vittorio Vitale, Boris Albrecht, Lucas Béguin, Kemal Bidzhiev, Petru Borta, Clémence Briosne-Frejaville, Daniel J. Campbell, Dorian Claveau, Makrem Chatti, Antoine Cornillot, Julius de Hond, Anita Devi, Thomas Eritzpokhoff, Gaétan Hercé, Fergus Hayes, Soufiane Kaghad, Arun Kumar Abhimanyu, Lucas Lassablière, Mauro Mendizabal, Anton Quelle, Julien Ripoll, Henrique Silvério, Joseph Vovrosh, Guillaume Villaret, Adrien Signoles, Alexandre Dauphin
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于Rydberg原子阵列的模拟量子处理器是一个在多体量子模拟、组合优化和图机器学习中极具潜力的平台。随着这些器件越来越容易获得，建立对其输出的信心需要可预测模型，这类模型能够定量地把微观硬件缺陷与实验结果联系起来。本文提出了一种噪声感知的仿真框架，它将主要噪声机制贯穿整个计算周期进行传播，以预测器件行为。我们通过在三台Pasqal量子处理器上对两个代表性协议——量子退火和淬火后动力学——进行基准测试来验证该框架，在这些系统中，经典模拟仍然能够提供真实基准。对于这三台器件，测得的观测量都落在仿真器预测的不确定性包络内。除重现实验数据外，该框架还能识别在每种工作区间中占主导的物理机制，为算法设计和硬件改进提供定量指导，并为在超出经典可计算范围的区域中验证模拟处理器奠定基础。

articles.title: Fast and Accurate Foundation Models for Equivariant Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials
articles.title_zh: 用于等变机器学习原子间势的快速且准确的基础模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28461v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have emerged as a transformative tool for computational materials science and chemistry, with universal potentials trained on large and diverse datasets now routinely deployed as 'foundation models' for downstream fine-tuning in targeted chemical spaces. Many scientific applications of the resulting models, such as molecular dynamics (MD), require high inference and training speeds as well as accuracy. In this work, we examine the limits of equivariant MLIPs, which directly encode physical symmetries in model architectures, to achieve these competing targets -- particularly in the regime of extremely large datasets where data efficiency is less critical. We show how this trade-off can be addressed, and present a family of foundation potentials in the NequIP and Allegro equivariant MLIP architectures which achieve leading inference speeds and strong scalability as well as excellent accuracies across a range of community benchmarks -- spanning materials discovery, thermal conductivity prediction, and near-equilibrium mechanical and thermodynamic properties. Accelerations implemented within the NequIP infrastructure now permit training of high-accuracy foundation potentials on ultra-large datasets with dramatically reduced computational cost. Alongside, we show that efforts to improve model accuracy for materials discovery should focus on dataset diversity and improved, consistent descriptions of transition metal compound energy surfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了等变机器学习原子间势在超大规模数据集场景下的速度与精度权衡，并给出了解决方案。作者基于NequIP和Allegro框架构建了一组基础势函数，在多个社区基准上同时实现了领先的推理速度、良好的可扩展性和优异精度。研究还指出，对于材料发现任务，提高模型表现的关键在于数据集多样性以及对过渡金属化合物能量面更一致的描述。
authors: Seán R. Kavanagh, Chuin Wei Tan, Menghang Wang, Marc L. Descoteaux, Gabriel de Miranda Nascimento, Ulrik Unneberg, Laura Zichi, Francesco Libbi, Norma Rivano, Austin Glover, Vivek Bharadwaj, Anders Johansson, William C. Witt, Albert Musaelian, Boris Kozinsky
articles.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）已经成为计算材料科学和化学中的一种变革性工具。基于大规模、多样化数据集训练得到的通用势，如今已被常规地作为“基础模型”部署，并可针对特定化学空间进行下游微调。由此产生的模型在许多科学应用中，例如分子动力学（MD），既要求极高的推理和训练速度，也要求精度。在本文中，我们考察了等变MLIPs的极限。这类模型在体系结构中直接编码了物理对称性，旨在同时实现这些相互竞争的目标，尤其是在超大数据集的场景下，此时数据效率不再是关键限制。我们展示了如何解决这一权衡，并提出了一组基于NequIP和Allegro等变MLIP架构的基础势函数，它们在一系列社区基准上实现了领先的推理速度、强可扩展性以及优异的精度，这些基准涵盖材料发现、热导率预测以及近平衡力学和热力学性质。NequIP基础设施中实现的加速现在已可在超大数据集上以显著降低的计算成本训练高精度基础势。与此同时，我们表明，提高材料发现模型精度的努力应聚焦于数据集多样性，以及对过渡金属化合物能量面的更一致描述。

articles.title: Mitigating quantum decoherence via global optimal control
articles.title_zh: 通过全局最优控制缓解量子退相干
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28479v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We show that global optimal control can drastically suppress the impact of decoherence in globally driven superconducting quantum computing architectures, taking as a prototype a recently proposed quasi-two-dimensional ladder geometry. Using a tensor-network-based approach, we quantify how amplitude-damping and dephasing channels degrade the flow of quantum information along the ladder and the fidelity of one- and two-qubit gate operations. We then demonstrate that shaping the global drive compresses the gate sequences by an order of magnitude in time, restoring high gate fidelities. We stress that this mitigation is far from trivial: in a globally driven processor, dissipation acts on every physical qubit---including those outside the logical register that sustain the surrounding ordered phases---so its impact cannot be suppressed by protecting an isolated subsystem, and is instead overcome purely through the temporal shaping of the global drive.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们表明，在全局驱动的超导量子计算架构中，全局最优控制可以显著抑制退相干的影响，并以近期提出的一种准二维梯形几何为原型。借助张量网络方法，我们量化了振幅阻尼和退相干通道如何削弱沿梯形的信息流及一、两比特门操作保真度。进一步地，通过对全局驱动进行波形整形，可以将门序列时间压缩一个数量级，并恢复较高的门保真度。
authors: Ashkan Abedi, Roberto Menta, Julien Despres, Marco Polini, Francesco Caravelli, Vittorio Giovannetti
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们表明，在全局驱动的超导量子计算架构中，全局最优控制可以显著抑制退相干的影响，并以近期提出的一种准二维梯形几何为原型。借助基于张量网络的方法，我们量化了振幅阻尼和退相干通道如何削弱沿梯形的信息流以及一比特和两比特门操作的保真度。随后我们证明，对全局驱动进行波形整形能够将门序列的时间压缩一个数量级，同时恢复较高的门保真度。我们强调，这种缓解并非易事：在全局驱动的处理器中，耗散作用于每一个物理量子比特——包括那些位于逻辑寄存器之外、却支撑周围有序相的量子比特——因此其影响不能通过保护某个孤立子系统来抑制，而只能纯粹通过对全局驱动进行时间整形来克服。
