While all models show some degree of predictive skill for extreme heat, most emulators under-represent peak intensities, and IFS recall is greater than that of any of the emulators. These results highlight both the emerging potential of AI to enhance extended range temperature prediction, and the remaining challenges in delivering reliable, actionable early warnings in a changing climate.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究评估了六种先进深度学习天气仿真器在 10–15 天提前期预测全球近地表温度和极端高温方面的能力，并与动力系统和统计基准进行比较。结果发现，一些 AI 模型在确定性温度预报技巧上可媲美甚至超过基于物理的预报，但会牺牲谱保真度并出现模糊化。尽管所有模型对极端高温均有一定预测能力，多数仿真器低估峰值强度，说明 AI 在延伸期预报中具有潜力但仍面临可靠预警挑战。
authors: Cas Decancq, Thomas Mortier, Jessica Keune, Diego G. Miralles
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.28220v1 公告类型：新稿。摘要：大气可预报性在未来十天之后迅速下降，因此更长提前期的预报主要传达大尺度趋势，而非具体状态。然而，在变暖的世界中，改进极端高温早期预警正成为一项日益关键的挑战。在这里，我们评估了六种最先进的深度学习天气仿真器——Pangu-Weather、FuXi、ArchesWeather、AIFS、GraphCast 和 Aurora——并将其与领先的动力系统和统计基准一起，用于预测 10–15 天提前期的全球近地表温度和极端高温。我们发现，若干仿真器在确定性温度预报技巧上可媲美甚至超过基于物理的预报，但这是以降低谱保真度为代价实现的，这一过程通常被称为模糊化。虽然所有模型对极端高温都表现出一定程度的预测技巧，但多数仿真器低估峰值强度，并且 IFS 的召回率高于任何仿真器。这些结果突出了 AI 在增强延伸期温度预测方面的新兴潜力，同时也凸显了在气候变化背景下提供可靠、可行动早期预警所面临的剩余挑战。

articles.title: Variational Formulation of a Hybrid Kinetic and Gyrokinetic Model for Astrophysical and Laboratory Plasmas
articles.title_zh: 面向天体物理与实验室等离子体的混合动力学与回旋动力学模型的变分表述
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28305v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a Lagrangian model that encapsulates fully kinetic ions and gyrokinetic electrons for solar wind electromagnetic turbulence. Using a consistent method, where both electrons and protons are treated with the same mathematical formalism, we derive and implement a model in which high-frequency waves and kinetic electron effects are described in a computationally cost-efficient way. Higher-order Lie-transform perturbation methods applied to Hamiltonian formulation of guiding center motion are used to describe the dynamics of particles and fields. We use a variational approach to derive field equations for closure of the system.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种用于太阳风电磁湍流的拉格朗日模型，将全动力学离子与回旋动力学电子统一纳入同一数学框架。该模型以计算成本较低的方式描述高频波和电子动力学效应，并利用高阶李变换微扰方法处理导引中心运动。作者进一步通过变分方法推导场方程以闭合系统。
authors: F. N. deOliveira-Lopes, S. C. Thatikonda, D. Told, A. Mustonen, K. Pommois, K. Hagiwara, F. Jenko, R. Grauer
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.28305v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：我们提出一种拉格朗日模型，用于表征太阳风电磁湍流中的全动力学离子和回旋动力学电子。通过一种一致的方法，即用相同的数学形式处理电子和质子，我们推导并实现了一个模型，其中高频波和动力学电子效应能够以计算成本高效的方式加以描述。我们将高阶李变换微扰方法应用于导引中心运动的哈密顿表述，以描述粒子和场的动力学。我们采用变分方法推导用于系统闭合的场方程。

articles.title: Large-Time-Step Operation in a Volume Integral Equation for Dielectric Scattering
articles.title_zh: 介电散射中卷积积分方程的长时间步运行
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28309v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In transient electromagnetic analysis, explicit time-domain solvers are restricted by the Courant-Friedrichs-Lewy (CFL) condition, making finely discretized dielectric scattering problems computationally expensive. This work investigates large-time-step operation in a marching-on-in-time time-domain current-density volume integral equation (MOT-JVIE) solver for dielectric scattering. For the considered band-limited excitations, accurate transient analysis is demonstrated for time steps up to 16 times larger than the reference CFL-limited time step associated with the voxel discretization. The study reveals a fundamental computational shift in the large-time-step regime. As the time-step size increases, the present-time causal interaction region expands, increasing the number of nonzero entries in the present-time interaction matrix and causing the dominant computational cost to transition from history-term evaluations to repeated matrix--vector products involving this matrix. Consequently, the present-time interaction matrix emerges as the principal scalability bottleneck in the large-time-step regime. To address this bottleneck, a matrix-free FFT-based matrix--vector-product strategy that exploits the multilevel Toeplitz structure of the Green-function-related volume-integral operator is employed for the present-time interaction matrix. The proposed framework is evaluated through an inhomogeneous dielectric cube and an 8 X 8 array of inhomogeneous dielectric nanopillars representative of multiscale metasurface structures, demonstrating more than an order-of-magnitude reduction in computational cost. In single-threaded execution, the method is demonstrated for 15.6 million unknowns, providing a large-scale MOT-JVIE demonstration beyond 15 million unknowns on one CPU thread.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了用于介电散射的时域电流密度体积分方程（MOT-JVIE）求解器在大时间步条件下的性能。结果表明，对于带限激励，时间步可增大到参考 CFL 限制步长的 16 倍而仍保持准确的瞬态分析。研究还发现，大时间步下主要瓶颈转移为当前时刻相互作用矩阵的矩阵—向量乘法，并据此采用基于 FFT 的无矩阵策略显著降低计算成本。
authors: Sushil Kumar, Giampiero Gerini, M. C. van Beurden
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在瞬态电磁分析中，显式时域求解器受到 Courant-Friedrichs-Lewy（CFL）条件的限制，使得细网格离散的介电散射问题计算代价高昂。本文研究了用于介电散射的时域电流密度体积分方程（MOT-JVIE）求解器中的长时间步运行。对于所考虑的带限激励，结果表明，当时间步长相对于与体素离散相关的参考 CFL 限制时间步长增大到 16 倍时，仍可实现准确的瞬态分析。研究揭示了大时间步区域中的一个根本性计算转变。随着时间步长增大，当前时刻的因果相互作用区域扩大，导致当前时刻相互作用矩阵中的非零元素数量增加，并使主导计算开销从历史项求值转变为对该矩阵的重复矩阵—向量乘法。因此，当前时刻相互作用矩阵成为大时间步区域中的主要可扩展性瓶颈。为解决这一瓶颈，本文采用了一种基于 FFT 的无矩阵矩阵—向量乘法策略，利用与格林函数相关的体积分算子的多层 Toeplitz 结构来处理当前时刻相互作用矩阵。所提出框架通过一个非均匀介电立方体以及一个由 8×8 个非均匀介电纳米柱组成、代表多尺度超表面结构的阵列进行了评估，结果显示计算成本降低了一个数量级以上。在单线程执行下，该方法可用于 1560 万个未知量，展示了在单个 CPU 线程上超过 1500 万未知量的大规模 MOT-JVIE 演示。

articles.title: Studying Circular Motion with an AI-Generated Smartphone Physics Lab
articles.title_zh: 用人工智能生成的智能手机物理实验室研究圆周运动
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28352v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Smartphones have become a standard measurement instrument in the physics laboratory. Theirbuilt-in accelerometers, gyroscopes, magnetometers, and cameras have been used to investigate a wide range of phenomena in mechanics, and rotational motion in particular has proven especially well-suited to smartphone-based experiments. A recurring limitation, however, is that most experiments rely on precompiled sensor apps whose interfaces cannot be tailored to a specific activity, and until recently creating customized smartphone laboratories required programming knowledge beyond what most physics teachers possess. Following the approach, we recently introduced for acoustic experiments,10 in this paper we show that a fully customized, browser-based rotation laboratory can be generated entirely through natural-language prompting of an AI assistant, with no manual coding. We use it, together with a simple rotating platform, to characterize both uniform circular motion (UCM) and uniformly accelerated circular motion (UACM), and we validate the sensor measurements against independent video analysis with Tracker.
articles.abstract_zh: 智能手机已成为物理实验室中的标准测量仪器，其内置传感器和相机尤其适合研究旋转运动。本文展示了如何仅通过自然语言提示 AI 助手、无需手工编码，就生成一个完全定制的、基于浏览器的旋转实验室。结合简单旋转平台，作者利用该实验室表征匀速圆周运动和匀加速圆周运动，并用 Tracker 的视频分析对传感器测量结果进行了验证。
authors: Josep Ll. Suñer, Francisco M. Muñoz-Pérez, Juan C. Castro-Palacio, Juan A. Monsoriu, Martín Monteiro, Cecilia Stari, Arturo C. Martí
articles.abstract_zh_full: 智能手机已经成为物理实验室中的标准测量仪器。其内置的加速度计、陀螺仪、磁力计和摄像头已被用于研究力学中的广泛现象，而旋转运动尤其适合基于智能手机的实验。然而，一个反复存在的限制是，大多数实验依赖于预先编译好的传感器应用程序，其界面无法针对特定活动进行定制；直到最近，创建定制化智能手机实验室仍需要大多数物理教师所不具备的编程知识。沿着我们最近为声学实验提出的方法，本文表明，完全定制的、基于浏览器的旋转实验室可以仅通过向 AI 助手输入自然语言提示而生成，无需手工编码。我们将其与一个简单的旋转平台结合，用来表征匀速圆周运动（UCM）和匀加速圆周运动（UACM），并通过 Tracker 的独立视频分析对传感器测量进行了验证。

articles.title: Fast optics-based modeling enabling large-scale optimization of the H4 and M2 beamlines in the CERN SPS North Area
articles.title_zh: 基于快速光学模型实现 CERN SPS 北区 H4 与 M2 束线的大规模优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28370v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The CERN multi-purpose secondary beamlines are invaluable facilities offering a rich and diverse physics program to the international particle physics community, providing many different particle species and beam characteristics to fixed-target experiments and test-beam users. A number of magnetic elements are required to enable such flexibility, posing a significant challenge in the design and optimization of the beamline optics. In this work, we present the optimization of the H4 and M2 beamlines of the CERN SPS North Area using genetic algorithms. The aim of this study is to demonstrate the effectiveness of fast optics-based tracking models (here Xsuite), to enable large-scale, multi-objective optimization on standard computing hardware. The model is benchmarked and validated with high-fidelity Monte Carlo simulations using BDSIM and cross-validation of the results with experimental measurements. The optimized optics, applied to the H4 electron configuration for NA64, achieved a 30% increase in available electron rate and a five-fold reduction in beam-related background. In the M2 line, the optimized configurations yielded a nearly two-fold increase in electron rate and a 67% improvement in muon transmission.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用遗传算法，对 CERN SPS 北区的 H4 和 M2 束线进行了优化，旨在展示快速光学跟踪模型在标准计算硬件上支持大规模、多目标优化的能力。结果通过高保真蒙特卡洛模拟及实验测量交叉验证。优化后，H4 电子束配置的可用电子流强提高了 30%，束流相关本底降低了五倍；M2 束线的优化配置则使电子流强几乎翻倍，μ 子透过率提高了 67%。
authors: Giovanni Dal Maso, Dipanwita Banerjee, Nikolaos Charitonidis
articles.abstract_zh_full: CERN 的多用途次级束线是极为宝贵的设施，为国际粒子物理界提供丰富多样的物理计划，为固定靶实验和测试束用户提供多种不同的粒子种类和束流特性。为了实现这种灵活性，需要许多磁元件，这给束线光学设计与优化带来了重大挑战。本文利用遗传算法，对 CERN SPS 北区的 H4 和 M2 束线进行了优化。该研究旨在展示快速光学基跟踪模型（此处为 Xsuite）的有效性，以便在标准计算硬件上实现大规模、多目标优化。该模型通过高保真蒙特卡洛模拟（使用 BDSIM）进行基准测试和验证，并通过实验测量对结果进行交叉验证。应用于 NA64 的 H4 电子束配置的优化光学，使可用电子流强提高了 30%，并使束流相关本底降低了五倍。在 M2 束线中，优化配置带来了电子流强近两倍的提升，以及 μ 子透过率 67% 的改善。

articles.title: Optical Dipole Trap for Hg Atoms
articles.title_zh: 汞原子的光学偶极阱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28392v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report the first realization of an optical dipole trap (ODT) for ultracold mercury atoms, overcoming the challenge posed by the exceptionally low polarizability of Hg and the resulting weak optical trapping potential. We demonstrate the transfer of six naturally abundant Hg isotopes from a magneto-optical trap (MOT) into the ODT and characterize its loading dynamics, trap depth, and lifetime. Confinement of dense samples of ultracold Hg opens new opportunities for studies of isotope-dependent collisions and photoassociation and provides a route toward quantum degeneracy.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了超冷汞原子光学偶极阱的首次实现，克服了汞原子极低极化率所导致的弱光学俘获势这一挑战。作者将六种天然丰度的汞同位素从磁光阱转移到光学偶极阱中，并表征了其加载动力学、阱深和寿命。对高密度超冷汞样品的约束，为研究同位素依赖碰撞、光缔合以及迈向量子简并提供了新机会。
authors: I. Nandi, A. Sahu, M. Veis, A. Linek, R. Ciurylo, M. Witkowski
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文报道了超冷汞原子光学偶极阱（ODT）的首次实现，克服了汞原子极低极化率及由此产生的弱光学俘获势所带来的挑战。我们演示了将六种天然丰度的汞同位素从磁光阱（MOT）转移到光学偶极阱中，并表征了其加载动力学、阱深和寿命。对致密超冷汞样品的约束为研究同位素依赖碰撞和光缔合开辟了新的机会，并为迈向量子简并提供了一条途径。

articles.title: Design and beam-test characterization of the CRILIN semi-homogeneous crystal calorimeter
articles.title_zh: CRILIN 半均匀晶体量能器的设计与束流测试表征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28477v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: CRILIN is a high-granularity semi-homogeneous electromagnetic calorimeter based on longitudinally segmented PbF₂ crystal matrices read out by UV-extended silicon photomultipliers. The concept combines fast Cherenkov response, fine transverse granularity, longitudinal shower information, and radiation tolerance for future lepton-collider experiments. This paper reports the construction of a large-area prototype and its performance measured in beam tests at the CERN SPS. The detector comprises five 7×7 PbF₂ crystal matrices, has a depth of about 22X₀, and is read out by four 3×3~mm² SiPMs per crystal integrated in a single electronic channel. Electron data between 10 and 120~GeV and dedicated 150~GeV muon data were used to characterize the detector response. A time resolution below 50~ps is achieved for electron energies above 10~GeV, reaching values below 20~ps above 60~GeV. The energy resolution is described by a stochastic term of (6.58±0.04)%/sqrtE/GeV and a constant term of (0.23±0.02)%, with an additional noise contribution fixed from pedestal data. The longitudinal segmentation enables event-by-event corrections based on the reconstructed shower development, resulting in a significant improvement of the energy resolution. A light yield of approximately 0.54~photoelectrons/MeV is measured consistently using both electron showers and minimum-ionizing particles. A Geant4-based simulation incorporating the relevant experimental effects reproduces the measured energy resolution. These results validate the CRILIN architecture as a compact, fast, and longitudinally segmented electromagnetic calorimeter for future collider experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: CRILIN 是一种高粒度半均匀电磁量能器，采用纵向分段的 PbF₂ 晶体矩阵并由紫外增强型硅光电倍增器读出。本文介绍了一个大面积原型的构建及其在 CERN SPS 束流测试中的性能。结果表明，该探测器在 10 GeV 以上电子能量下时间分辨率优于 50 ps，60 GeV 以上优于 20 ps；同时纵向分段还能通过重建簇射发展进行逐事件修正，从而显著改善能量分辨率。
authors: S. Ceravolo, M. Cavallina, V. Ciccarella, E. Di Meco, E. Diociaiuti, R. Gargiulo, Q. Han, E. Leonardi, D. Lucchesi, M. Moulson, L. Palombini, N. Pastrone, I. Raghib, A. Russo, A. Saputi, I. Sarra, S. Salamino, L. Sestini, S. Squerzanti, D. Zuliani
articles.abstract_zh_full: CRILIN 是一种高粒度半均匀电磁量能器，基于纵向分段的 PbF₂ 晶体矩阵，并由紫外增强型硅光电倍增器读出。该概念结合了快速切伦科夫响应、精细横向粒度、纵向簇射信息以及面向未来轻子对撞机实验的辐照耐受性。本文报告了一个大面积原型的构建，以及其在 CERN SPS 束流测试中测得的性能。该探测器由五个 7×7 的 PbF₂ 晶体矩阵组成，深度约为 22X₀，每个晶体通过集成在单一电子通道中的四个 3×3 mm² SiPM 读出。使用 10 至 120 GeV 的电子数据以及专门的 150 GeV μ 子数据来表征探测器响应。当电子能量高于 10 GeV 时，时间分辨率优于 50 ps；当能量高于 60 GeV 时，该值优于 20 ps。能量分辨率可由随机项 (6.58±0.04)%/√(E/GeV) 和常数项 (0.23±0.02)% 描述，另有一个由基线数据固定的噪声贡献。纵向分段使得能够基于重建的簇射发展进行逐事件修正，从而显著改善能量分辨率。利用电子簇射和最小电离粒子一致测得约 0.54 光电子/MeV 的光产额。包含相关实验效应的基于 Geant4 的模拟重现了测得的能量分辨率。这些结果验证了 CRILIN 结构作为面向未来对撞机实验的紧凑、快速且具有纵向分段特性的电磁量能器的可行性。

articles.title: Frequency-Domain Analysis of Wave Scattering by Spatially Dispersive Metasurfaces Using the Method of Auxiliary Sources
articles.title_zh: 利用辅助源法对空间色散超表面散射的频域分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28558v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spatially dispersive metasurfaces exhibit angle-dependent responses that cannot be accurately modeled using conventional local susceptibilities. Extended Generalized Sheet Transition Conditions (GSTCs) have been introduced to account for spatial dispersion by incorporating spatial derivatives of the electromagnetic fields. In this work, these extended GSTCs are integrated into the Method of Auxiliary Sources (MAS), resulting in a meshless simulation framework for the analysis of spatially dispersive metasurfaces. The proposed formulation is developed for infinite planar, finite planar, polygon shaped, and cylindrical metasurfaces, while it is general and also applicable to bianisotropic spatially dispersive metasurfaces. For validation, the numerical examples consider Lorentz-type spatial resonators, consistent with previously published studies. The extended GSTCs are enforced within the MAS via appropriate placement of auxiliary sources. Numerical results are presented for several geometries, including planar, polygonal, semicircular, and cylindrical metasurfaces. The obtained results show very good agreement with previously published data, demonstrating the accuracy and flexibility of the proposed method.
articles.abstract_zh: 空间色散超表面的响应具有角度依赖性，传统局域表面极化率难以准确描述。本文将扩展广义薄层跃迁条件（GSTCs）与辅助源法（MAS）结合，建立了一种无网格仿真框架，用于分析多种几何形状的空间色散超表面。数值结果与已有文献高度一致，表明该方法具有良好的精度与灵活性。
authors: Minas Kouroublakis, Nikolaos L. Tsitsas, Yehuda Leviatan
articles.abstract_zh_full: 空间色散超表面表现出角度依赖响应，传统局域表面极化率无法准确建模。为考虑空间色散，已引入扩展广义薄层跃迁条件（GSTCs），其通过纳入电磁场的空间导数来加以描述。本文将这些扩展 GSTCs 与辅助源法（MAS）结合，形成了一个用于分析空间色散超表面的无网格仿真框架。所提出的公式适用于无限平面、有限平面、多边形形状以及圆柱形超表面，并且具有一般性，也可应用于双各向异性空间色散超表面。为进行验证，数值算例采用了洛伦兹型空间谐振子，与此前发表的研究一致。扩展 GSTCs 通过辅助源的适当布置在 MAS 中得到施加。本文给出了多种几何结构的数值结果，包括平面、多边形、半圆形和圆柱形超表面。所得结果与已发表数据符合得很好，证明了所提出方法的准确性与灵活性。

articles.title: Non-linear Evolution of Dark Plasma Subhalos
articles.title_zh: 暗等离子体子晕的非线性演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27312v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Dark matter that self interacts through long-range forces exhibits coherent, collective effects that are absent in short-range interactions. In the case where dark matter interacts through a hidden-photon mediator, its dynamics closely resemble those of Standard Model plasmas. In such models, various astrophysical environments, including cluster collisions and subhalos orbiting their host halo, are susceptible to plasma instabilities: processes that modify the dark matter velocity distribution and lead to exponential growth of dark electromagnetic fields. In this paper, we present the first study of the non-linear evolution of electrostatic instabilities in dark matter subhalos orbiting within the Milky Way potential using a suite of particle-in-cell simulations. We find that the growth and saturation of these instabilities produce substantial turbulent heating and mass loss, with an efficiency that depends sensitively on subhalo mass and orbital eccentricity. For highly eccentric orbits, plasma heating can reduce the initial mass of a 10⁷ (10⁹⁾ M_ødot subhalo by as much as sim 97% (sim 84%) soon after first pericenter. Plasma-induced heating and stripping may therefore leave observable signatures in the Milky Way subhalo population, including a suppression of the low-mass subhalo mass function.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文首次利用粒子-网格模拟研究了暗物质子晕在银河系引力势中运行时静电不稳定性的非线性演化。结果表明，不稳定性的增长与饱和会导致显著的湍流加热和质量损失，其效率对子晕质量和轨道偏心率高度敏感。对于高偏心率轨道，首次近心点后子晕质量可被大幅削减，暗示银河系子晕族群可能留下可观测的等离子体加热与剥离痕迹。
authors: Andrew Liu, Anirudh Prabhu, Akaxia Cruz, Mariangela Lisanti
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过长程力相互作用的暗物质会表现出短程相互作用中不存在的相干集体效应。在暗物质通过隐藏光子介子相互作用的情形下，其动力学与标准模型等离子体十分相似。对于这类模型，包括星系团碰撞和绕宿主晕运行的子晕在内的多种天体物理环境，都可能受到等离子体不稳定性的影响：这类过程会改变暗物质速度分布，并导致暗电磁场指数增长。本文首次利用一套粒子-网格模拟，研究了在银河系引力势中运行的暗物质子晕中静电不稳定性的非线性演化。我们发现，这些不稳定性的增长与饱和会产生显著的湍流加热和质量损失，其效率对子晕质量和轨道偏心率非常敏感。对于高度偏心的轨道，等离子体加热可在第一次近心点后不久将一个 10⁷（10⁹）太阳质量的子晕的初始质量最多削减约 97%（约 84%）。因此，由等离子体引起的加热与剥离可能在银河系子晕族群中留下可观测特征，包括低质量子晕质量函数的抑制。

articles.title: Comparison of a Parametric Physics-Informed Neural Network and a Tensorial Reduced-Order Model for the Shallow-Water Dam-Break Problem
articles.title_zh: 参数化浅水溃坝问题中参数化物理信息神经网络与张量型降阶模型的比较
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27433v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop two parametric data-driven reduced models: a physics-informed neural network (PINN) and a non-intrusive tensorial reduced-order model (TROM), and apply both approaches to the parametrized one-dimensional shallow-water dam-break problem. Both reduced models do not require time integration and learn a direct solution map from space, time, and dam-break parameters to the physical state. We present a detailed comparison for out-of-sample and extrapolated parameter values. In addition, we demonstrate that it is essential to introduce shock-aware collocation to improve the robustness of the PINN model.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对一维参数化浅水溃坝问题，构建了物理信息神经网络（PINN）和非侵入式张量型降阶模型（TROM）两种参数数据驱动降阶模型。两种方法均无需时间积分，可直接从空间、时间和溃坝参数映射到物理状态。研究还表明，引入面向激波的配点策略对提升 PINN 的鲁棒性至关重要。
authors: Anton Myshak, Md Rezwan Bin Mizan, Ilya Timofeyev
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们构建了两种参数化数据驱动降阶模型：物理信息神经网络（PINN）和非侵入式张量型降阶模型（TROM），并将二者应用于参数化的一维浅水溃坝问题。两种降阶模型都不需要时间积分，而是学习从空间、时间以及溃坝参数到物理状态的直接映射。我们对样本外参数值以及外推参数值进行了详细比较。此外，我们证明，引入面向激波的配点对于提高 PINN 模型的鲁棒性是必不可少的。

articles.title: Exploring the use of quantum computing for facilitating spatially and temporally resolved models of a biological cell
articles.title_zh: 利用量子计算促进生物细胞时空分辨模型的探索
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27571v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Whole-cell simulation, modeling all of a cell's functional systems over its life cycle, is an outstanding challenge in computational biology. Even the simplest living cell contains thousands of interacting proteins and metabolites (on the order of trillions of atoms) whose full functional dynamics spans roughly five orders of magnitude in space (nm to μm) and nearly nineteen in time (fs to hours). Further, many of the governing physical and chemical properties remain incompletely characterized. Simulating such complex systems at fully atomistic resolution over a full cell cycle is computationally intractable on classical architectures, raising a central question: Can quantum computing offer a viable path to whole-cell simulations that integrate molecular- and systems-level complexity? This Perspective examines the potential of quantum computing across three hierarchical scales: atomistic-molecular modeling, metabolic and regulatory networks, and whole-cell spatial modeling. We present a complexity analysis comparing classical and quantum algorithms for representative biological problems, identifying regimes of substantial theoretical speedup under specified algorithmic assumptions. We highlight algorithmic developments designed to leverage both near-term exploratory and fault-tolerant quantum architectures, and discuss practical bottlenecks: data encoding overhead, system conditioning, measurement constraints, and hybrid quantum-HPC integration. Together, these results outline a roadmap for quantum-accelerated whole-cell modeling and the biological insights such multiscale frameworks may eventually enable.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文讨论量子计算在全细胞模拟中的潜在作用，重点涵盖原子分子建模、代谢与调控网络以及全细胞空间建模三个层次。作者从复杂度角度比较了经典与量子算法在代表性生物问题上的表现，并指出在特定算法假设下存在显著理论加速的可能。文章同时分析了数据编码、条件数、测量以及与高性能计算的混合集成等关键瓶颈，并提出了面向未来全细胞建模的路线图。
authors: Muralikrishnan Gopalakrishnan Meena, Dileep Kishore, Jerry M. Parks, Luke Bertels, Dilipkumar N. Asthagiri, Travis Humble, Thomas L. Beck, Mitchel J. Doktycz
articles.abstract_zh_full: 全细胞模拟，即在整个生命周期内对细胞全部功能系统进行建模，是计算生物学中的一项重大挑战。即便是最简单的活细胞，也包含数以千计相互作用的蛋白质和代谢物（数量级可达万亿个原子），其完整功能动力学在空间上跨越约五个数量级（从纳米到微米），在时间上跨越近十九个数量级（从飞秒到小时）。此外，许多支配性的物理和化学性质仍未被完全表征。在经典体系结构上，以全原子分辨率对这类复杂系统进行整个细胞周期的模拟在计算上不可行，因此引出了一个核心问题：量子计算能否为整合分子尺度与系统尺度复杂性的全细胞模拟提供一条可行路径？本文综述了量子计算在三个层级上的潜力：原子-分子建模、代谢与调控网络，以及全细胞空间建模。我们给出了针对代表性生物问题的经典算法与量子算法复杂度分析，并在特定算法假设下识别出具有显著理论加速的情形。我们强调了旨在同时利用近期探索性量子架构和容错量子架构的算法进展，并讨论了实际瓶颈：数据编码开销、系统条件数、测量约束以及量子与高性能计算的混合集成。综合这些结果，本文勾勒出了一条面向量子加速全细胞建模的路线图，以及此类多尺度框架未来可能带来的生物学洞见。

articles.title: Quadruply Bonded Mo2 Molecules: An Innate Emitter-Resonator Quantum System in Free Space
articles.title_zh: 四重键 Mo2 分子：自由空间中的内禀发射体-谐振器量子体系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27683v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In recent decades, significant progress has been made in constructing and studying individual quantum systems based on two level atoms (molecules) and photons. Here we demonstrate that the quadruply bonded Mo2 unit, with a MoMo bond distance as short as 2.1A, functions as an innate emitter resonator molecular quantum system capable of trapping visible light photons between the two molybdenum atoms under ambient conditions, thereby generating an intense quantized local electromagnetic field with an extremely small mode volume. The resonance fluorescence spectra of three Mo2 complexes indicate that the intermetallic Mo-Mo charge transfer transition is coherently coupled to the local scattering field, exhibiting vacuum Rabi splitting and Mollow triplets. Resonant coupling of single molecules and N-molecule ensembles to the scattered light through sideband excitation produces a sequence of discrete optical modes spanning a broad wavelength range, with polaritonic transitions identical to those observed in Ni2 based systems. These results establish the Mo2 molecule as an independent emitter resonator integrated quantum system that enables quantum optical experiments in free space using conventional spectroscopic instrumentation. This work extends quantum electrodynamics into molecular science, providing new insights into metal metal bonding, molecular physics, and light matter interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文表明，具有极短 Mo–Mo 键长的 Mo2 单元可在常温下在两原子之间束缚可见光子，并形成极小模体积的局域量子电磁场。实验上观察到的真空 Rabi 劈裂和 Mollow 三重峰说明，该体系可作为独立的发射体-谐振器量子系统在自由空间中工作。该结果将量子电动力学推进到分子科学中，并为研究金属-金属键、分子物理和光-物质相互作用提供了新平台。
authors: Miao Meng, Ying Ning Tan, Zi Cong He, Zi Hao Zhong, Jia Zhou, Yu Li Zhou, Guang Yuan Zhu, Chun Y. Liu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在过去几十年中，基于二能级原子（分子）和光子的单个量子系统构建与研究取得了显著进展。这里我们证明，四重键 Mo2 单元具有短至 2.1 Å 的 MoMo 键长，在常温条件下可作为一种内禀的发射体-谐振器分子量子系统，能够在两个钼原子之间捕获可见光子，从而产生强烈的量子化局域电磁场，并具有极小的模体积。三个 Mo2 配合物的共振荧光光谱表明，金属间 Mo-Mo 电荷转移跃迁与局域散射场发生相干耦合，表现出真空 Rabi 劈裂和 Mollow 三重峰。通过侧带激发，单分子以及 N 分子集合通过散射光实现共振耦合，产生一系列离散光学模式，覆盖较宽的波长范围，其极化激元跃迁与基于 Ni2 的体系中观察到的跃迁完全相同。以上结果确立了 Mo2 分子作为一种独立的发射体-谐振器集成量子系统，可借助常规光谱仪器在自由空间中开展量子光学实验。这项工作将量子电动力学扩展到分子科学，为理解金属-金属键、分子物理以及光-物质相互作用提供了新的认识。

articles.title: Resource-efficient quantum-selected configuration interaction for molecular properties
articles.title_zh: 面向分子性质的资源高效量子选择组态相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27777v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The quantum-selected configuration interaction identifies important determinantal basis functions through real-time evolution of a reference wavefunction and diagonalizing the Hamiltonian matrix in the resulting selected subspace. However, implementing the full electronic Hamiltonian on noisy quantum devices leads to rapidly increasing circuit complexity, limiting its scalability. To address this issue, we identify the dominant fermionic excitation operators and perform reference-state fidelity loss analysis to construct a compact Hamiltonian, reducing computational overhead while retaining high precision. Applied to Group IIIA monofluorides (BF, AlF, GaF, InF, and TlF), the proposed framework achieves a near-quadratic improvement in Hamiltonian-term scaling, enabling resource-efficient simulations. We employ this framework to compute the relativistic ground-state energies and permanent electric dipole moments (PDMs) of the systems under consideration. After validating the framework via simulations, we demonstrate hardware execution for AlF and TlF on the IBM Marrakesh processor using active spaces of up to 20 qubits. For a 20-qubit TlF system, the reduced Hamiltonian yields a reduction of higher than  98% in both circuit depth and two-qubit gate counts, with the resulting PDMs from quantum hardware matching complete active space configuration interaction values within 99.99%. These results demonstrate the scalability of this approach on noisy intermediate-scale quantum devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种资源高效的量子选择组态相互作用框架，通过识别主导费米激发算符并压缩哈密顿量项，显著降低了量子线路复杂度。该方法被用于计算 IIIA 族单氟化物的相对论基态能和永久电偶极矩，并在 IBM 量子处理器上对部分体系进行了硬件验证。结果显示，在 20 量子比特规模下，线路深度和双量子比特门数均可降低 98% 以上，同时保持极高精度。
authors: Suprava Sahoo, Abdul Kalam, Kenji Sugisaki, V. S. Prasannaa, B. P. Das
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子选择组态相互作用通过对参考波函数进行实时演化，并在所得选定子空间中对哈密顿矩阵进行对角化，从而识别重要的行列式基函数。然而，在噪声量子设备上实现完整电子哈密顿量会导致线路复杂度快速增长，从而限制其可扩展性。为解决这一问题，我们识别出主导的费米激发算符，并进行参考态保真度损失分析，以构造一个紧凑的哈密顿量，在保持高精度的同时降低计算开销。将该方法应用于 IIIA 族单氟化物（BF、AlF、GaF、InF 和 TlF），所提出的框架实现了哈密顿量项标度接近二次的改进，从而支持资源高效模拟。我们利用该框架计算了所研究体系的相对论基态能和永久电偶极矩（PDM）。在通过模拟验证该框架后，我们进一步在 IBM Marrakesh 处理器上，对 AlF 和 TlF 进行了硬件执行，使用的活性空间最多达到 20 个量子比特。对于一个 20 量子比特的 TlF 体系，约化哈密顿量使线路深度和双量子比特门数都减少了超过 98%，且量子硬件得到的 PDM 与完整活性空间组态相互作用值在 99.99% 以内一致。这些结果表明，该方法在含噪中等规模量子设备上具有良好的可扩展性。

articles.title: Even-harmonic generation through nonequilibrium steady-state symmetry breaking
articles.title_zh: 通过非平衡稳态对称性破缺实现偶次谐波产生
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27847v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: High-harmonic generation (HHG) in inversion-symmetric systems is typically restricted to odd harmonics by symmetry. Here, we show that this selection rule can be broken without modifying the underlying Hamiltonian. We investigate a boundary-driven Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) chain coupled to source and sink reservoirs and demonstrate that dissipative dynamics generates a nonequilibrium steady state carrying a finite DC current. While the SSH Hamiltonian retains inversion symmetry, the current-carrying steady-state density matrix does not, leading to the emergence of even harmonics in the emitted spectrum. Using a correlation-matrix approach based on the Lindblad master equation, we obtain the steady state and calculate the resulting HHG response. We find that the intensity of the even harmonics is directly controlled by the transport current, establishing a link between nonequilibrium charge transport and HHG selection rules. Our results uncover a mechanism for even-harmonic generation that relies solely on nonequilibrium steady-state symmetry breaking and provide a route to probing transport currents through ultrafast nonlinear spectroscopy in centrosymmetric quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 传统上，具有反演对称性的体系中的高次谐波产生只允许出现奇次谐波。本文表明，在不改变哈密顿量本身的情况下，这一选择定则也可被打破：边界驱动的 SSH 链在耗散作用下形成带有直流电流的非平衡稳态，从而使发射谱中出现偶次谐波。研究揭示了非平衡输运电流与高次谐波选择定则之间的直接联系，并为通过超快非线性光谱探测输运电流提供了途径。
authors: Milad Jangjan, Arman Kashef, Siamak Pooyan, Stefan Scheel, Dieter Bauer
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在反演对称体系中，高次谐波产生（HHG）通常由于对称性限制而只能出现奇次谐波。本文表明，无需修改底层哈密顿量，这一选择定则也可以被打破。我们研究了一个边界驱动的 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）链，其与源和汇储库耦合，并证明耗散动力学会产生一个携带有限直流电流的非平衡稳态。尽管 SSH 哈密顿量保持反演对称性，但承载电流的稳态密度矩阵却不具备这种对称性，从而在发射谱中出现偶次谐波。利用基于 Lindblad 主方程的关联矩阵方法，我们求得稳态并计算了相应的 HHG 响应。我们发现，偶次谐波的强度可由输运电流直接控制，这建立了非平衡电荷输运与 HHG 选择定则之间的联系。我们的结果揭示了一种仅依赖非平衡稳态对称性破缺的偶次谐波产生机制，并为在中心对称量子系统中通过超快非线性光谱探测输运电流提供了一条路径。

articles.title: Signatures of kinetic gravity braiding in cosmological probes of the gravitational field
articles.title_zh: 运动重力编织在引力场宇宙学探针中的信号特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28207v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the observational signatures of kinetic gravity braiding (KGB) models in relativistic cosmological probes constructed along the past light cone. Using the relativistic N-body code KGB-evolution, we generate light-cone outputs and compute several observables that directly probe the gravitational field, including weak gravitational lensing convergence, Shapiro time delay, the integrated Sachs-Wolfe and Rees-Sciama (ISW-RS) effects, and gravitational redshift. Full-sky maps and angular power spectra of these quantities are constructed and compared with k-essence models and predictions from linear perturbation theory. We find that the derivative coupling between the scalar field and the metric modifies both the amplitude and the time evolution of the gravitational potentials, producing scale-dependent deviations ranging from a few percent to tens of percent. In particular, the ISW-RS signal exhibits the largest fractional response, as the slower decay of the Weyl potential suppresses the KGB signal in the ISW-dominated regime, whereas nonlinear evolution reverses this trend at higher multipoles, producing differences of tens of percent relative to k-essence. Weak gravitational lensing also provides a strong complementary probe and, for the model considered here, exhibits clear deviations from the k-essence prediction at small scales with enhancements up to sim 10-12% at multipoles ell sim 10²⁻¹⁰³. Our results show that linear perturbation theory accurately describes the large-scale behaviour, while nonlinear effects become important at smaller scales, particularly for the ISW-RS signal and, more moderately, for the convergence, and must therefore be included for reliable theoretical predictions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了沿过去光锥构建的相对论宇宙学探针中，运动重力编织（KGB）模型的观测特征。通过相对论 N 体代码生成光锥输出，并计算弱引力透镜、Shapiro 时延、ISW-RS 效应和引力红移等量，作者发现标量场与度规的导数耦合会在不同尺度上引起从几个百分点到几十个百分点的偏离。研究表明，线性扰动理论能很好描述大尺度行为，但在小尺度上必须纳入非线性效应，尤其是对 ISW-RS 信号而言。
authors: Ahmad Nouri-Zonoz, Farbod Hassani, Julian Adamek, Emilio Bellini, Martin Kunz
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了在过去光锥上构建的相对论宇宙学探针中，运动重力编织（kinetic gravity braiding, KGB）模型的观测特征。借助相对论 N 体代码 KGB-evolution，我们生成了光锥输出，并计算了若干直接探测引力场的观测量，包括弱引力透镜的汇聚、Shapiro 时延、积分 Sachs-Wolfe 与 Rees-Sciama（ISW-RS）效应以及引力红移。我们构建了这些量的全天空图和角功率谱，并将其与 k-本质模型以及线性扰动理论的预言进行了比较。我们发现，标量场与度规之间的导数耦合会同时改变引力势的幅度和时间演化，从而产生尺度依赖的偏离，范围从几个百分点到几十个百分点不等。尤其是，ISW-RS 信号表现出最大的分数响应，因为 Weyl 势较慢的衰减在 ISW 主导区间抑制了 KGB 信号，而非线性演化在更高多极矩处会反转这一趋势，使其相对于 k-本质模型产生数十个百分点的差异。弱引力透镜也提供了一个强有力的互补探针，并且在本文研究的模型中，在小尺度上相对于 k-本质预测表现出清晰偏离，在多极矩 ell 约为 10²–10³ 时增强可达约 10%–12%。我们的结果表明，线性扰动理论能够准确描述大尺度行为，而在较小尺度上，特别是对 ISW-RS 信号、以及在较小程度上对汇聚量，非线性效应变得重要，因此在可靠的理论预言中必须加以考虑。

articles.title: A conserved thermo-mechanic invariant in extended fluid description of collisionless plasmas
articles.title_zh: 碰撞无等离子体扩展流体描述中的守恒热机械不变量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2410.20002v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate linear perturbations of an incompressible, weakly collisional, anisotropic plasma in the low frequency limit using an extended 16-moment fluid description that retains parallel and perpendicular heat fluxes. We identify a new class of linear perturbations associated with a conserved thermo-mechanic invariant, a time independent, aperiodic structure involving coupled perturbations of heat fluxes, velocity, and magnetic field. In the standard CGL limit, where heat fluxes are neglected, no direct analogue of this invariant exists. Retaining heat flux dynamics alters the linear structure of the system promoting third order velocity moments to autonomous variables and gives rise to a thermo-mechanic mode with coupled thermal, kinetic, and magnetic components. The associated perturbations are inherently localized, favoring compact, filamentary aperiodic structures. The thermo-mechanic invariant reveals a previously unexplored stationary sector of collisionless anisotropic plasma dynamics, characterized by a fixed algebraic polarization that enforces time independent relations among the relevant perturbation fields.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在保留平行与垂直热流的 16 矩流体描述下，研究了不可压、弱碰撞、各向异性等离子体的低频线性扰动。作者发现了一类新的线性扰动，对应于一个守恒的热机械不变量，其表现为热流、速度和磁场的耦合、无周期的静态结构。该不变量揭示了碰撞无各向异性等离子体动力学中一个此前未被探索的静止分支。
authors: E. S. Uchava, A. G. Tevzadze
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们在低频极限下，利用一种扩展的 16 矩流体描述，研究了不可压、弱碰撞、各向异性等离子体的线性扰动，该描述保留了平行与垂直方向上的热流。我们识别出一类新的线性扰动，其对应于一个守恒的热机械不变量，这是一种时间不变的、无周期的结构，涉及热流、速度和磁场的耦合扰动。在标准的 CGL 极限中，即忽略热流时，不存在该不变量的直接对应物。保留热流动力学会改变系统的线性结构，使三阶速度矩成为自主变量，并产生一个同时包含热、动能和磁场分量的热机械模。与之相关的扰动本质上是局域化的，倾向于形成紧凑的、丝状的、无周期结构。热机械不变量揭示了碰撞无各向异性等离子体动力学中一个此前未被探索的静止分支，其特征是固定的代数极化关系，强制相关的扰动场之间满足时间不变关系。

articles.title: LdT: An indicator of ionospheric activity based on statistical distributions in GNSS-derived TEC rates of change
articles.title_zh: LdT：一种基于 GNSS 推导 TEC 变化率统计分布的电离层活动指标
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.06056v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Many aspects of our societies now depend upon satellite telecommunications, such as those requiring Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS). GNSS is based on radio waves that propagate through the ionosphere and experience complicated propagation effects caused by inhomogeneities in its electron density. The Earth's ionosphere forms part of the solar-terrestrial environment, and its state is determined by the spatial distribution and temporal evolution of its electron density. It varies in response to the "space weather" combination of solar activity and geomagnetic conditions. Notably, the radio waves used in satellite telecommunications suffer due to the dispersive nature of the ionospheric plasma. Scales and indices that summarise the state of the solar-terrestrial environment due to solar activity and geomagnetic conditions already exist. However, the response of the ionosphere to active geomagnetic conditions, its geoeffectiveness, and its likely impact on systems and services are not encapsulated by these. This is due to the ionosphere's intrinsic day-to-day variability, persistent seasonal patterns, and because radio wave measurements of the ionosphere depend upon many factors. Here we develop a novel index that describes the state of the ionosphere during specific space weather conditions. It is based on propagation disturbances in GNSS signals, and is able to characterise the spatio-temporal evolution of ionospheric disturbances in near real time. This new scale encapsulates day-to-day variability, seasonal patterns, and the geo-effective response of the ionosphere to disturbed space weather conditions; and can be applied to data from any GNSS network. It is intended that this new scale will be utilised by agencies providing space weather services, as well as by service operators to appreciate the current conditions in the ionosphere, thus informing their operations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新的电离层状态指标 LdT，用于表征特定空间天气条件下电离层的活动程度。该指标基于 GNSS 信号传播扰动，可近实时刻画电离层扰动的时空演化，并能反映日际变化、季节性规律以及受扰空间天气下的地球效应响应。该方法可适用于任意 GNSS 网络，具有空间天气服务和运行监测的应用潜力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当今社会的许多方面都依赖于卫星通信，例如依赖全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）的应用。GNSS 基于在电离层中传播的无线电波，而电离层电子密度的不均匀性会引起复杂的传播效应。地球电离层是太阳-地球环境的一部分，其状态由电子密度的空间分布和时间演化决定，并会对“空间天气”——即太阳活动与地磁条件的组合——作出响应。值得注意的是，卫星通信中所使用的无线电波会受到电离层等离子体色散特性的影响而受损。概括太阳活动和地磁条件所导致的太阳-地球环境状态的尺度和指数已经存在。然而，电离层对活跃地磁条件的响应、其地球效应性以及对系统和服务的潜在影响，并未被这些指标完整刻画。这是因为电离层本身具有日际变化的内在不确定性、持续的季节模式，而且对电离层的无线电测量还取决于许多因素。本文提出一种新的指标，用于描述特定空间天气条件下的电离层状态。该指标基于 GNSS 信号传播扰动，能够近实时表征电离层扰动的时空演化。这一新的尺度综合了日际变化、季节模式以及电离层对受扰空间天气条件的地球效应响应，并可应用于任何 GNSS 网络的数据。我们希望该新尺度可被提供空间天气服务的机构以及服务运营方采用，以便更好地了解电离层当前状况，从而指导其运行决策。

articles.title: Time-resolved role of coherence and delocalization in photosynthetic energy transfer from an extended exciton model
articles.title_zh: 来自扩展激子模型的时间分辨相干性与离域性在光合作用能量转移中的作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.29132v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Photosynthetic antenna complexes achieve high quantum efficiency through exciton transport in coupled pigment networks. Conventional Frenkel-exciton models treat each chromophore as a structureless site and neglect internal electronic degrees of freedom that can influence coherence and delocalization. Here we develop an extended excitonic network model that preserves the pigment-pigment coupling topology while introducing tunable intrachromophoric electronic mixing within the single-excitation manifold. Using a Lindblad open-quantum-system framework, we quantify coherence, delocalization, and trapping efficiency across parameter space. We show that intrachromophoric mixing plays a time-dependent role: enhanced mixing on the antenna side promotes short-time coherent delocalization and improves excitation injection, whereas excessive mixing near the trapping site induces persistent delocalization and suppresses transfer efficiency. Simulated two-dimensional electronic spectra reveal enhanced cross peaks and systematic blue shifts, providing spectroscopic signatures of coherence-modulated transport. These results establish a microscopic connection between internal electronic structure and quantum transport performance in excitonic networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于扩展激子网络模型，研究光合作用天线复合体中相干性和离域性对能量转移的时间依赖作用。与传统 Frenkel 激子模型不同，该模型保留色素间耦合拓扑，同时引入可调的色素内电子混合。结果表明，天线侧增强混合有助于短时间相干离域并提高激发注入效率，而在捕获位点附近过强的混合则会导致持续离域并降低转移效率。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光合作用天线复合体通过耦合色素网络中的激子输运实现了很高的量子效率。传统的 Frenkel 激子模型将每个发色团视为无结构的格点，并忽略了可能影响相干性和离域性的内部电子自由度。本文构建了一个扩展激子网络模型，在保留色素-色素耦合拓扑的同时，在单激发子空间内引入了可调的色素内电子混合。我们采用 Lindblad 开放量子系统框架，量化了参数空间中的相干性、离域性和俘获效率。结果表明，色素内混合具有时间依赖作用：在天线一侧增强混合有利于短时间尺度上的相干离域，并提升激发注入效率；而在俘获位点附近过强的混合会引发持续离域并抑制能量转移效率。模拟的二维电子光谱显示出增强的交叉峰和系统性的蓝移，为相干调制输运提供了光谱学特征。上述结果建立了内部电子结构与激子网络中量子输运性能之间的微观联系。

articles.title: The toroidal flux and separatrix effects in tokamaks
articles.title_zh: 托罗伊达磁通与托卡马克中的分离面效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12760v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: An implication of Faraday's Law is thst the rate of change of the poloidal flux relative to the toroidal flux associated with a magnetic surface is given by the loop voltage. The emphasis in the tokamak literature on the poloidal almost to the exclusion of the toroidal magnetic flux has led to fundamental mistakes in understanding magnetic field evolution, especially as it affects plasma disuptivity. Designs of tokamak power plants include a divertor that is defined by a separatrix at the plasma edge. The use of the toroidal flux clarifies the descriptions of such plasmas. This paper explores the effects of a separatrix on plasma parameters that are used for assessing disruptivity: the edge safety factor and the internal inductance. The exploration of these effects includes an analytic model, which illustrates why the use of the poloidal instead of the toroidal flux introduces a significant definitional uncertainty in what is meant by the edge safety factor and the internal inductance.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出，法拉第定律意味着某一磁面相关的极向磁通相对于环向磁通的变化率由回路电压给出。托卡马克文献长期强调极向磁通而几乎忽略环向磁通，导致了对磁场演化的根本性误解，尤其影响对等离子体破裂性的理解。本文还研究了用于评估破裂性的边界安全因子和内电感在分离面存在下的变化，并通过解析模型说明，用极向磁通代替环向磁通会在边界安全因子和内电感的定义上引入显著的不确定性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 法拉第定律的一个含义是，某一磁面相关的极向磁通相对于环向磁通的变化率由回路电压给出。托卡马克文献中过分强调极向磁通而几乎忽略环向磁通，已经导致了对磁场演化的根本性错误，尤其是在其如何影响等离子体破裂性方面。托卡马克发电厂的设计包括一个由位于等离子体边界的分离面所定义的偏滤器。使用环向磁通可以澄清对此类等离子体的描述。本文探讨了分离面对用于评估破裂性的等离子体参数的影响：边界安全因子和内电感。对这些效应的探讨包括一个解析模型，它说明了为什么使用极向磁通而不是环向磁通，会在边界安全因子和内电感的含义上引入显著的定义不确定性。

articles.title: On the bottom-up construction of many-electron relativistic QED Hamiltonian
articles.title_zh: 自底向上构建多电子相对论 QED 哈密顿量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.15040v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: It was shown more than a decade ago [J. Chem. Phys. 139, 014108 (2013)] that a many-electron relativistic quantum electrodynamics (QED) Hamiltonian for high-precision electronic structure calculations can be constructed in a bottom-up fashion, by virtue of charge-conjugated contraction (CCC) of fermion operators when normal-ordering the starting unbounded relativistic Hamiltonian (second-quantized in terms of the electronic Dirac field) with respect to the filled negative-energy Dirac sea of electrons. It is shown here that the same relativistic QED Hamiltonian can also be obtained by equal average of the two relativistic Hamiltonians resulting from the normal-ordering of the starting unbounded relativistic Hamiltonians (second-quantized in terms of the electronic and positronic Dirac fields, respectively) with respect to the filled negative-energy Dirac seas of electrons and positrons, respectively, via the standard contraction of fermion operators. In essence, both procedures incorporate properly the fundamental charge-conjugation symmetry of relativistic quantum mechanics to ensure the symmetric treatment of the electronic and positronic degrees of freedom.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文说明，多电子相对论量子电动力学（QED）哈密顿量可以通过两种等价的方式构造：一是对以电子狄拉克场二次量子化表示的无界相对论哈密顿量进行正常序并采用费米子算符的电荷共轭缩并，二是分别对以电子和正电子狄拉克场二次量子化表示的无界相对论哈密顿量进行正常序后取二者平均。两种方法都体现了相对论量子力学的电荷共轭对称性，从而保证对电子与正电子自由度的对称处理。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 十多年前已有研究表明 [J. Chem. Phys. 139, 014108 (2013)]，可通过对费米子算符进行电荷共轭缩并（CCC）来“自底向上”构造用于高精度电子结构计算的多电子相对论量子电动力学（QED）哈密顿量：即在相对于填满的负能电子狄拉克海进行正常序时，对起始的无界相对论哈密顿量（以电子狄拉克场二次量子化表示）进行处理。本文表明，同样的相对论 QED 哈密顿量也可通过另一种方式获得：分别对起始的无界相对论哈密顿量（分别以电子和正电子狄拉克场二次量子化表示）进行正常序，并相对于填满的负能电子和正电子狄拉克海，采用标准的费米子算符缩并，然后对所得两个相对论哈密顿量取等平均。实质上，这两种程序都恰当地纳入了相对论量子力学的基本电荷共轭对称性，以确保对电子与正电子自由度的对称处理。

articles.title: Entropy-stable positivity-preserving DG schemes for Boltzmann-Poisson models of collisional electronic transport along energy bands
articles.title_zh: 用于能带上碰撞电子输运 Boltzmann-Poisson 模型的熵稳定且保持正性的 DG 格式
articles.abstract: arXiv:1911.00593v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This work is related to the development of entropy-stable positivity-preserving DG methods as a computational scheme for Boltzmann-Poisson systems modeling the probability density of collisional electronic transport along energy bands in semiconductors. We pose, in momentum coordinates representing spherical / energy-angular variables, the respective Vlasov-Boltzmann eq. with a linear collision operator and a singular measure, modeling scatterings as functions of the bandstructure appropriately for hot electron nanoscale transport. We show stability results of semidiscrete DG schemes under an entropy norm for 1D, 2D position, using dissipative properties of the collisional operator given its entropy inequality. The latter depends on an exponential of the Hamiltonian rather than the Maxwellian associated with only kinetic energy. For the 1D problem, knowing the analytic solution to the Poisson equation and convergence to a constant current is crucial to obtaining full stability. For the 2D problem, specular reflection boundary conditions and periodicity are considered in estimating stability under an entropy norm. Regarding the positivity-preservation in the DG scheme for the 1D problem, we treat collisions as a source and find convex combinations of the transport and collision terms which guarantee positivity of the cell average of our numerical probability density at the next time. The positivity of the numerical solution to the probability density in the domain is guaranteed by applying well-known limiters that preserve the cell average modifying the slope of the piecewise linear solutions to make the function non-negative. The use of a spherical coordinate system whose radial component is the momentum magnitude is slightly different from choices in previous DG solvers for Boltzmann-Poisson, since the proposed DG formulation gives simpler integrals involving piecewise polynomials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对半导体中沿能带的碰撞电子输运概率密度 Boltzmann-Poisson 系统，发展了熵稳定且保持正性的 DG 数值方法。作者在动量坐标下建立了带有线性碰撞算子和奇异测度的 Vlasov-Boltzmann 方程，并在一维与二维位置情形下证明了离散格式在熵范数下的稳定性。文中还给出了保持单元平均值正性的限制器构造，以及适用于边界条件和二维情形的稳定性分析。
authors: Jose A. Morales Escalante, Irene M. Gamba
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本工作与熵稳定且保持正性的 DG 方法的发展有关，这些方法被用作描述半导体中沿能带发生碰撞电子输运概率密度的 Boltzmann-Poisson 系统的计算格式。我们在动量坐标中，即采用球坐标/能量-角变量，建立了带有线性碰撞算子和奇异测度的相应 Vlasov-Boltzmann 方程，用于以适当反映能带结构的方式建模散射，从而适用于热电子纳米尺度输运。我们证明了在一维和二维位置情形下，半离散 DG 格式在熵范数下的稳定性结果，这依赖于碰撞算子所具有的耗散性质及其熵不等式。后者依赖于哈密顿量的指数形式，而不是仅与动能相关的麦克斯韦分布。对于一维问题，已知 Poisson 方程的解析解以及收敛到恒定电流，对于获得完全稳定性至关重要。对于二维问题，在熵范数下估计稳定性时考虑了镜面反射边界条件和周期性。关于一维问题中 DG 格式的正性保持，我们将碰撞视为源项，并找到了输运项与碰撞项的凸组合，这保证了在下一时刻我们的数值概率密度的单元平均值保持正性。通过应用众所周知、可保持单元平均值的限制器，修改分片线性解的斜率，使函数非负，从而保证了计算域内数值解的正性。与以往 Boltzmann-Poisson 的 DG 求解器相比，采用径向分量为动量模长的球坐标系略有不同，因为所提出的 DG 公式给出了涉及分片多项式的更简单积分。

articles.title: A Nuclear Interferometer for Ultra-Light Dark Matter Detection
articles.title_zh: 用于超轻暗物质探测的核干涉仪
articles.abstract: arXiv:2407.11112v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We propose the nuclear interferometer - a single-photon interferometry experiment based upon the thorium-229 nuclear clock transition - as a novel detector for ultra-light dark matter. Thanks to the enhanced sensitivity of this transition to the variation of fundamental constants, we find that possible realisations of such an experiment deploying either single ions or clouds of atoms have the potential to complement advanced very-long-baseline terrestrial clock atom interferometers in the search for ultra-light dark matter with scalar couplings to photons in the future. Nuclear interferometry may also offer an unparalleled window to new physics coupling to the QCD sector via quarks or gluons, with a discovery reach that could enhance existing and proposed experiments over a range of frequencies in the direction of well-motivated parameter space.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于钍-229 核钟跃迁的单光子干涉实验——核干涉仪——作为探测超轻暗物质的新方案。由于该跃迁对基本常数变化具有增强灵敏度，作者认为采用单离子或原子云实现的此类实验，有望在未来补充先进的超长基线地面钟原子干涉仪，对具有光子标量耦合的超轻暗物质进行搜寻。该方法还可能为通过夸克或胶子与 QCD 部门耦合的新物理提供独特窗口。
authors: Hannah Banks, Elina Fuchs, Matthew McCullough
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出核干涉仪——一种基于钍-229 核钟跃迁的单光子干涉实验——作为一种新型超轻暗物质探测器。得益于该跃迁对基本常数变化的增强灵敏度，我们发现，采用单离子或原子云的此类实验实现方式，未来有潜力在搜寻与光子存在标量耦合的超轻暗物质方面，对先进的超长基线地面钟原子干涉仪形成补充。核干涉术还可能为通过夸克或胶子耦合到 QCD 部门的新物理提供无与伦比的窗口，其发现能力有望在一系列频率上增强现有和拟议实验，并朝着高度合理的参数空间方向推进。

articles.title: Exact and Asymptotically Complete Robust Verifications of Neural Networks via Ising Solvers
articles.title_zh: 通过 Ising 求解器对神经网络进行精确且渐近完备的鲁棒性验证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.00408v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We present an Ising-compatible framework for formal neural-network robustness verification under bounded input perturbations. For piecewise-linear activations, the Exact Logarithmic PWL Model (Log-PWL) provides an exact, sound, and complete formulation with a state-optimal logarithmic encoding, reducing the binary variables per neuron from linear to information-theoretically minimal logarithmic complexity. For general bounded element-wise activations, the Asymptotic Step-Envelope Model (Step-Env) uses sound piecewise-constant envelopes whose lower and upper neuron states remain decision variables coupled to a common adversarial input. We prove that its globally optimized output bounds converge uniformly to the true network extrema as the segment width vanishes, yielding asymptotic completeness of verification. We further develop a hybrid Benders solver. Interval pruning, certificate transfer for pruned networks, and layerwise classical--Ising partitioning further reduce spin requirements. Experiments show exact certification fidelity for piecewise-linear networks and near-reference accuracy for sigmoid networks with compact spin budgets.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个兼容 Ising 模型的形式化神经网络鲁棒性验证框架，可用于有界输入扰动下的验证。对于分段线性激活函数，Log-PWL 模型给出精确、可靠且完备的对数编码；对于一般有界逐元素激活函数，Step-Env 模型使用上下包络，并证明其全局优化输出界会随着分段宽度减小而一致收敛到真实网络极值。结合混合 Benders 求解器及若干剪枝与分层分解技术，实验表明该方法既能对分段线性网络实现精确认证，也能对 sigmoid 网络在紧凑比特预算下获得接近基准的精度。
authors: Wenxin Li, Wenchao Liu, Weihao Li, Chuan Wang, Qi Gao, Yin Ma, Hai Wei, Kai Wen
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一个兼容 Ising 的框架，用于在有界输入扰动下对神经网络鲁棒性进行形式化验证。对于分段线性激活函数，精确对数 PWL 模型（Log-PWL）提供了一个精确、可靠且完备的表述，并采用状态最优的对数编码，将每个神经元所需的二元变量数量从线性复杂度降低到信息论意义上的最小对数复杂度。对于一般有界逐元素激活函数，渐近阶跃包络模型（Step-Env）使用可靠的分段常数包络，其中神经元的上下状态仍作为与共同对抗输入耦合的决策变量。我们证明，当分段宽度趋于零时，其全局优化后的输出界会一致收敛到真实的网络极值，从而使验证具有渐近完备性。我们还开发了一个混合 Benders 求解器。区间剪枝、对已剪枝网络的证书传递以及逐层的经典—Ising 分解进一步减少了自旋需求。实验表明，该方法对分段线性网络具有精确的认证保真度，并对 sigmoid 网络在紧凑自旋预算下达到接近参考解的精度。

articles.title: Recursive transformers for semiconductor thermo-mechanical reliability
articles.title_zh: 用于半导体热-机械可靠性的递归 Transformer
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27251v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Transformer-based surrogate models are increasingly used to replace expensive first-principles simulation in engineering design. But conventional transformer architectures are often over parameterized for the small, low-dimensional datasets typical of engineering design spaces, where large simulation data is expensive to generate. Under these conditions, excess parameter capacity leads to overfitting rather than improved accuracy, while also incurring unnecessary memory and compute overhead. This motivates a shift towards architectures that focus on additional compute rather than additional learnable parameters. This paper presents a hardware-aware evaluation of three recursive transformer paradigms for surrogate thermo-mechanical analysis of advanced packages: a)Tiny Recursive Model, b) our proposed Depth Recursive transformer, c) and a simple recursive transformer. We systematically compare their predictive performance (Recall, Mean Reciprocal Rank), parameter count, computational complexity (FLOPs), providing practical design guidelines for selecting recursive transformer architectures under resource-constrained scenarios. We validate this principle on two low-dimensional engineering prediction tasks: 1) thermo-mechanical reliability analysis of advanced semiconductor packages, where stress and warpage from thermal cycling must be evaluated repeatedly across a design-of-experiments sweep under costly finite element analysis (FEA). 2) Laplace PDE iterative numerical solver for capacitance field. Overall, recursive weight-sharing transformers provide an effective and generalizable trade-off between prediction accuracy, parameter efficiency, and computational cost for small data engineering surrogate modeling.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出，面向工程设计的传统 Transformer 往往在低维小样本数据上参数过多，容易过拟合并带来额外计算开销。为此，作者评估了三种递归 Transformer 方案在先进封装热-机械分析代理建模中的表现，并以参数量、FLOPs 与预测指标进行比较。结果表明，递归权重共享 Transformer 在精度、参数效率与计算成本之间提供了有效平衡，适合资源受限场景。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于 Transformer 的代理模型正日益被用于替代工程设计中的高成本第一性原理模拟。然而，传统 Transformer 架构对于工程设计空间中常见的小规模、低维数据集来说往往参数过多，而生成大量模拟数据又十分昂贵。在这种条件下，过多的参数容量会导致过拟合，而不是提高精度，同时还会带来不必要的内存和计算开销。这促使人们转向那些侧重增加计算量而非增加可学习参数的架构。本文对三种递归 Transformer 范式进行了面向硬件的评估，用于先进封装的热-机械分析代理建模：a) Tiny Recursive Model，b) 我们提出的 Depth Recursive transformer，c) 以及一个简单的递归 Transformer。我们系统比较了它们的预测性能（Recall、Mean Reciprocal Rank）、参数数量和计算复杂度（FLOPs），为在资源受限场景下选择递归 Transformer 架构提供了实际设计指南。我们在两个低维工程预测任务上验证了这一原则：1）先进半导体封装的热-机械可靠性分析，其中需要在昂贵的有限元分析（FEA）下，跨设计实验扫描反复评估热循环引起的应力和翘曲；2）用于电容场的 Laplace 偏微分方程迭代数值求解器。总体而言，递归权重共享 Transformer 为小数据工程代理建模提供了在预测精度、参数效率和计算成本之间有效且具有泛化能力的折中。

articles.title: Neural Network-Assisted CLEAN for Channel Modeling in Low-SNR Regimes
articles.title_zh: 低信噪比条件下用于信道建模的神经网络辅助 CLEAN 方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27450v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate multipath parameter estimation is critical for modern wireless communication systems, particularly in challenging low-SNR environments. Traditional Maximum Likelihood Estimation algorithms, such as CLEAN, provide high-resolution parameter extraction but suffer from prohibitive computational complexity due to exhaustive grid search. Conversely, purely data-driven deep learning approaches lack physical grounding and struggle to generalize across variable multipath densities and off-grid parameters. To address these limitations, this paper proposes Neural Network-Assisted CLEAN (NN-CLEAN), a hybrid framework that embeds a multi-head residual network directly into the iterative CLEAN extraction loop. By replacing the exhaustive grid search with rapid, parallelizable forward passes while delegating residual subtraction to exact mathematical models, NN-CLEAN isolates physical multipath parameters without accumulating non- physical errors. Extensive Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate that NN-CLEAN achieves estimation accuracy exceeding 96% at 5 dB SNR, matching the traditional Grid-Search CLEAN (GS- CLEAN) baseline, while providing a massive reduction in computational complexity and substantially outperforming subspace methods and standalone one-shot neural networks. Crucially, NN-CLEAN exhibits a near-flat scaling in execution runtime and memory consumption as batch sizes increase. This highly efficient parallelization establishes NN-CLEAN as a robust, real- time solution for channel estimation in MIMO systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出神经网络辅助 CLEAN（NN-CLEAN）框架，用于低信噪比环境下的多径参数估计。该方法将多头残差网络嵌入 CLEAN 迭代提取过程，用快速并行前向推理替代代价高昂的网格搜索，同时保留残差消减的精确物理建模。蒙特卡洛仿真表明，NN-CLEAN 在 5 dB 信噪比下的估计精度超过 96%，与传统网格搜索 CLEAN 相当，同时显著降低计算复杂度，并在大批量条件下表现出近乎平坦的运行时间与内存扩展。
authors: Chaofan Deng, Linyu Sun, Jaeho Lee, Arijit Raychowdhury
articles.abstract_zh_full: 准确的多径参数估计对于现代无线通信系统至关重要，尤其是在具有挑战性的低信噪比环境中。传统的最大似然估计算法，如 CLEAN，能够提供高分辨率的参数提取，但由于需要穷尽式网格搜索，其计算复杂度高得难以承受。相反，纯数据驱动的深度学习方法缺乏物理基础，并且难以在不同多径密度和离网参数条件下泛化。为了解决这些限制，本文提出了神经网络辅助 CLEAN（NN-CLEAN），一种混合框架，它将多头残差网络直接嵌入迭代 CLEAN 提取循环中。通过用快速、可并行化的前向传播替代穷尽式网格搜索，同时将残差消减交由精确的数学模型处理，NN-CLEAN 能够隔离物理多径参数，而不会积累非物理误差。广泛的蒙特卡洛仿真表明，NN-CLEAN 在 5 dB 信噪比下的估计精度超过 96%，与传统的网格搜索 CLEAN（GS-CLEAN）基线相当，同时显著降低了计算复杂度，并且明显优于子空间方法和独立的一次性神经网络。关键的是，NN-CLEAN 在批大小增大时，其执行时间和内存消耗表现出近乎平坦的扩展性。这种高度高效的并行化使 NN-CLEAN 成为 MIMO 系统中信道估计的稳健实时解决方案。

articles.title: Sparsity Induced Identifiability in Matrix Tri-Factorisation
articles.title_zh: 矩阵三因子分解中由稀疏性诱导的可识别性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27507v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Matrix factorisation is a fundamental tool for exploiting low-dimensional structure in high-dimensional data, with applications such as data compression, denoising, structure discovery, interpretable representation learning, and dimensionality reduction. Compared to conventional two-factor models, matrix tri-factorisation provides greater modelling flexibility, while sparsity constraints often improve both interpretability and recovery performance. Although the role of sparsity has been extensively studied for two-factor matrix factorisation, rigorous theoretical guarantees for general real-valued matrix tri-factorisation remain largely unexplored. To address this gap, we establish, to the best of our knowledge, the first rigorous theoretical study for sparsity-induced identifiability in general real-valued matrix tri-factorisation. Our analysis is enabled by a novel decomposition strategy that transforms the original problem into two coupled auxiliary factorisation problems, while preserving the structural information necessary to the recovery of the original factor matrices from the observations. Building upon this decomposition, we derive recovery guarantees and structural consistency results that characterise how coefficient sparsity influences the sufficient recovery conditions, convergence behaviour, spectral approximation error, high-probability bounds, and structure preservation. Comprehensive Monte Carlo experiments validate the proposed theory and demonstrate close agreement between the theoretical results and empirical observations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究一般实值矩阵三因子分解中由稀疏性带来的可识别性理论保证。作者提出一种新的分解策略，将原问题转化为两个耦合的辅助分解问题，并据此给出恢复保证与结构一致性结果。蒙特卡洛实验验证了理论结论，并显示理论与经验观察高度一致。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 矩阵分解是利用高维数据中低维结构的基础工具，应用包括数据压缩、去噪、结构发现、可解释表示学习和降维。与传统的双因子模型相比，矩阵三因子分解提供了更大的建模灵活性，而稀疏性约束通常能够同时提高可解释性和恢复性能。尽管稀疏性在双因子矩阵分解中的作用已经得到广泛研究，但针对一般实值矩阵三因子分解的严格理论保证仍在很大程度上尚未被探索。为弥补这一空白，据我们所知，我们建立了关于一般实值矩阵三因子分解中稀疏性诱导可识别性的首个严格理论研究。我们的分析得益于一种新的分解策略，该策略将原始问题转化为两个耦合的辅助分解问题，同时保留从观测中恢复原始因子矩阵所必需的结构信息。在这一分解的基础上，我们推导出恢复保证和结构一致性结果，刻画了系数稀疏性如何影响充分恢复条件、收敛行为、谱近似误差、高概率界以及结构保持。全面的蒙特卡洛实验验证了所提出的理论，并展示了理论结果与经验观察之间的高度一致性。

articles.title: Policy Gradient Steering: Interventions from Behavioral Objectives
articles.title_zh: 策略梯度引导：来自行为目标的干预
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27574v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Activation steering has emerged in large language models as a lightweight alternative for dynamically changing a model's behavior at inference time. However, we show that existing steering methods fail to steer even a simple policy in a two-route gridworld environment. To address this limitation, we propose Policy Gradient Steering (PGS), which formulates steering as a reinforcement learning problem. PGS accumulates gradients of a temporary behavioral objective over a small set of rollouts or demonstrations to construct a removable task vector. We first demonstrate the calibration and reversibility of PGS in a two-route gridworld environment. Using chess puzzles, we then evaluate independently fitted PGS vectors both in isolation and in combination, finding that compatible tactical objectives accumulate constructively. Finally, in competitive football, we show that PGS can alter specific team behaviors and that its effects transfer across opponents. Together, these results show that policy gradients provide a natural interface for constructing temporary and composable behavioral adaptations across diverse decision-making domains.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出现有激活引导方法甚至难以在简单双路线网格世界中有效引导策略行为。作者提出策略梯度引导（PGS），将引导表述为强化学习问题，通过临时行为目标的梯度构造可移除任务向量。实验覆盖网格世界、国际象棋谜题和竞技足球，表明PGS可校准、可逆、可组合，并能跨对手迁移行为影响。
authors: Yoann Poupart, Aurélie Beynier, Nicolas Maudet
articles.abstract_zh_full: 激活引导已在大型语言模型中成为一种轻量级替代方案，用于在推理时动态改变模型行为。然而，我们表明，现有引导方法甚至无法在一个双路线网格世界环境中引导一个简单策略。为解决这一局限，我们提出策略梯度引导（Policy Gradient Steering，PGS），将引导表述为一个强化学习问题。PGS在一小组轨迹展开或示范上累积临时行为目标的梯度，以构造一个可移除的任务向量。我们首先在双路线网格世界环境中展示PGS的校准性和可逆性。随后，我们使用国际象棋谜题，对独立拟合的PGS向量进行单独和组合评估，发现兼容的战术目标会产生建设性的累积效果。最后，在竞技足球中，我们表明PGS能够改变特定的团队行为，并且其效果能够跨不同对手迁移。总体而言，这些结果表明，策略梯度为在多样化决策领域中构造临时且可组合的行为适配提供了一种自然接口。

articles.title: Event-Structured Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Differentiable Critical Clearing Boundaries
articles.title_zh: 用于可微临界清除边界的事件结构化物理信息神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27681v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Transient-stability assessment determines whether a power system can recover after a disturbance and is therefore essential to preventing generator trips and cascading outages. A key metric is the critical clearing time (CCT), which specifies the maximum time available to clear a fault before synchronism is lost. Reliable CCT estimation is challenging because complicated fault-clearing dynamics require repeated simulations over many fault severities and clearing times. We propose an event-structured physics-informed neural network (ES-PINN) that aligns its representation with the pre-fault, fault-on, and post-clearing swing dynamics and enforces exact state chaining across event interfaces. A smooth trajectory-induced stability margin defines a differentiable approximation of the CCT boundary, enabling accurate boundary extraction, local sensitivity analysis, and optional direct CCT prediction through a distilled readout. We further prove a local residual-to-trajectory-to-CCT error estimate, in which exact event chaining eliminates separate state-interface defect terms. Experiments on IEEE 9-, 14-, and 30-bus systems show that ES-PINN consistently improves held-out trajectory and stability-boundary accuracy over matched neural-surrogate baselines across mechanical and electrical contingencies with multiple clearing configurations. Additional full-network DAE validation, multi-fault experiments, and runtime analyses further demonstrate the effectiveness and computational efficiency of the proposed framework.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出事件结构化物理信息神经网络（ES-PINN），用于电力系统暂态稳定评估和临界清除时间边界估计。该方法对齐故障前、故障中和清除后的摆动动力学，并在事件界面上强制精确状态链接，从而支持可微边界提取和灵敏度分析。IEEE多个系统实验表明，该框架在轨迹预测、稳定边界精度和计算效率方面优于匹配的神经替代模型。
authors: Baoli Hao, Chenxi Hu, Ming Zhong, Ren Wang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 暂态稳定评估判断电力系统在扰动后是否能够恢复，因此对于防止发电机跳闸和级联停电至关重要。一个关键指标是临界清除时间（CCT），它规定了在失去同步之前清除故障所允许的最长时间。可靠的CCT估计具有挑战性，因为复杂的故障清除动力学需要在许多故障严重程度和清除时间上进行重复仿真。我们提出一种事件结构化物理信息神经网络（ES-PINN），使其表示与故障前、故障期间和清除后的摆动动力学相一致，并在事件界面之间强制执行精确的状态链接。一个由平滑轨迹诱导的稳定裕度定义了CCT边界的可微近似，从而能够进行准确的边界提取、局部灵敏度分析，并可通过蒸馏读出实现可选的直接CCT预测。我们进一步证明了一个局部的从残差到轨迹再到CCT的误差估计，其中精确事件链接消除了单独的状态界面缺陷项。在IEEE 9节点、14节点和30节点系统上的实验表明，在机械和电气事故以及多种清除配置下，ES-PINN相较于匹配的神经替代基线，持续提升了留出轨迹和稳定边界的精度。额外的全网络DAE验证、多故障实验和运行时间分析进一步证明了所提出框架的有效性和计算效率。

articles.title: NMINE: Normalized Mutual Information Neural Estimation
articles.title_zh: NMINE：归一化互信息神经估计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27710v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mutual information is a general measure of statistical dependence that captures both linear and nonlinear relationships between random variables. For continuous and multidimensional variables For continuous multidimensional variables, mutual information must be estimated from samples. Because mutual information is unbounded, its values are not directly comparable across datasets, dimensions, or applications. Normalized mutual information addresses this limitation by converting mutual information into a normalized dependency score. Recent work has demonstrated the practical value of normalized mutual information in applications such as molecular dynamics arXiv:2405.04980 and interpretable machine learning arXiv:2409.16768, but existing estimators remain sensitive to dimensionality and numerical stability arXiv:2410.07642. In this paper, we propose a fully neural normalized mutual information estimator for continuous variables. The proposed approach combines a MINE-based neural mutual information estimator arXiv:1801.04062 with MI-NEE-inspired neural marginal entropy estimators arXiv:1905.12957. Mutual information is estimated using the Donsker--Varadhan representation, while marginal entropies are estimated by learning the divergence between each marginal distribution and a uniform reference distribution, from which entropy is recovered. The resulting estimator provides a neural alternative to k-nearest-neighbor-based normalized mutual information estimation arXiv:2405.04980. Experiments on Gaussian data from one to eight dimensions show that the proposed estimator improves accuracy over a KSG-based normalized mutual information baseline. These results indicate that neural estimation is a promising direction for normalized dependency measurement in continuous multidimensional settings.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种面向连续变量的全神经归一化互信息估计器NMINE。该方法结合基于MINE的互信息估计与受MI-NEE启发的边缘熵神经估计，通过Donsker--Varadhan表示估计互信息，并通过相对于均匀参考分布的散度恢复边缘熵。高斯数据实验表明，该方法相较KSG归一化互信息基线具有更高精度。
authors: Petra Eerikinharju, Marko Tuononen, Ville Hautamäki
articles.abstract_zh_full: 互信息是一种通用的统计依赖性度量，能够捕捉随机变量之间的线性和非线性关系。对于连续且多维的变量，对于连续多维变量，互信息必须从样本中估计。由于互信息是无界的，其数值无法在不同数据集、维度或应用之间直接比较。归一化互信息通过将互信息转换为归一化的依赖性分数，解决了这一局限。近期工作已经展示了归一化互信息在分子动力学和可解释机器学习等应用中的实际价值，但现有估计器仍然对维度和数值稳定性敏感。本文提出一种用于连续变量的全神经归一化互信息估计器。所提出的方法将基于MINE的神经互信息估计器与受MI-NEE启发的神经边缘熵估计器相结合。互信息使用Donsker--Varadhan表示进行估计，而边缘熵则通过学习每个边缘分布与均匀参考分布之间的散度来估计，并由此恢复熵。所得估计器为基于k近邻的归一化互信息估计提供了一种神经替代方案。在一到八维高斯数据上的实验表明，所提出的估计器相较基于KSG的归一化互信息基线提高了准确性。这些结果表明，在连续多维场景中，神经估计是归一化依赖性测量的一个有前景方向。

articles.title: What Makes Graph Unified? Principles and Generative Sliding-Window Transformer for Graph Foundation Models
articles.title_zh: 图何以统一？图基础模型的原则与生成式滑动窗口Transformer
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27966v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose graph learning, aiming to learn reusable knowledge that generalizes across diverse graph domains and downstream tasks, reducing the need for specific model development. Achieving this goal requires reconciling the substantial heterogeneity in node features, graph structures, and semantic information across domains. Among them, heterogeneous node features constitute a fundamental input-level barrier, as their dimensionality and semantics vary substantially across datasets. Existing studies typically project or map heterogeneous node features into a fixed-dimensional space, often implicitly equating dimensional uniformity with effective feature unification. Yet dimensional consistency alone does not ensure that the unified features preserve informative semantics and capture transferable patterns that can support cross-domain knowledge transfer. To bridge this conceptual gap, we distill four desiderata for cross-domain graph feature unification: formal uniformity, cross-domain transferability, information preservation, and backbone compatibility. Guided by these principles, we propose SliGFM, a graph foundation model built upon topology-aware sliding-window feature encoding and generative reconstruction. SliGFM orders feature dimensions by topological smoothness and scans the reordered features with a shared sliding-window feature encoder, transforming heterogeneous features into a common space of ordered fixed-dimensional feature tokens. This formulation enables a smoothness-aware transformer to capture transferable relational patterns among feature tokens within each node, while the generative reconstruction objective encourages preservation of the original feature information.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文讨论图基础模型中跨领域图特征统一的核心问题，指出仅实现维度一致并不足以保证语义保留和可迁移性。作者提出形式统一性、跨领域可迁移性、信息保留和骨干兼容性四项原则，并据此设计SliGFM。该模型通过拓扑平滑性排序、滑动窗口特征编码和生成式重构，将异构节点特征转化为共享空间中的有序特征令牌。
authors: Dongxiao He, Siqi Liu, Jitao Zhao, Yawen Li, Yi Wang, Di Jin
articles.abstract_zh_full: 图基础模型（GFMs）近来成为通用图学习的一种有前景范式，旨在学习可复用知识，使其能够泛化到多样的图领域和下游任务，从而减少特定模型开发的需求。实现这一目标需要调和不同领域中节点特征、图结构和语义信息的显著异质性。其中，异构节点特征构成了基础的输入层面障碍，因为它们的维度和语义在不同数据集之间差异显著。现有研究通常将异构节点特征投影或映射到固定维空间，往往隐含地将维度统一等同于有效的特征统一。然而，仅有维度一致性并不能确保统一后的特征保留有信息量的语义，并捕捉能够支持跨领域知识迁移的可迁移模式。为弥合这一概念鸿沟，我们提炼出跨领域图特征统一的四项期望性质：形式统一性、跨领域可迁移性、信息保留和骨干兼容性。在这些原则指导下，我们提出SliGFM，这是一个基于拓扑感知滑动窗口特征编码和生成式重构构建的图基础模型。SliGFM按照拓扑平滑性对特征维度排序，并使用共享的滑动窗口特征编码器扫描重排后的特征，将异构特征转换为一个由有序固定维特征令牌组成的公共空间。该表述使平滑性感知Transformer能够捕捉每个节点内部特征令牌之间的可迁移关系模式，同时生成式重构目标鼓励保留原始特征信息。

articles.title: Learning features from Newton's algorithm: a way to accelerate nonlinear parametrized PDE solvers
articles.title_zh: 从牛顿算法中学习特征：一种加速非线性参数化偏微分方程求解器的方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28036v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: It is well known that Newton's method converges faster when the initial guess is closer to a root of a system of nonlinear equations. In this paper, a two-stage Newton initial guess strategy is proposed by learning features from a parameter-space sampling and a database of precomputed solutions. The method uses discrete Newton trajectories to construct two complementary reduced spaces: a solution feature space, built from converged states, and a corrective search direction feature space, built from intermediate Newton increments. For an unseen parameter, a regression model is used to predict a surrogate solution approximation. Then, in a second step, a residual-minimizing correction is computed using a dedicated GMRES-based approach. The resulting state is then used as an initial guess for the high-fidelity Newton method, which completes convergence. The corrective step is computationally inexpensive since it only requires residual evaluations and the solution of a small least-squares problem. The methodology is weakly intrusive once the high-fidelity residual fields and a script-based programming interface are available. This strategy reduces the number of Newton iterations and decreases the overall CPU time. Numerical experiments on representative PDE problems show quantifiable speedups compared with standalone surrogate initialization. Significant speedups are observed. This generic approach can be applied to a broad class of large-scale nonlinear problems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种两阶段牛顿初值策略，通过参数空间采样和预计算解数据库学习特征，以加速非线性参数化PDE求解。方法从收敛状态和中间牛顿增量构造两个互补降维空间，并结合回归预测与GMRES残差最小化校正生成高保真牛顿法初值。数值实验显示，该策略可减少牛顿迭代次数并降低总体CPU时间。
authors: Rémy Vallot (CB, Michelin), Florian de Vuyst (BMBI), Thibault Dairay (CB, Michelin), Mathilde Mougeot (CB, ENSIIE, ENS Paris Saclay)
articles.abstract_zh_full: 众所周知，当初始猜测更接近非线性方程组的根时，牛顿法收敛更快。本文提出一种两阶段牛顿初始猜测策略，通过从参数空间采样和预计算解数据库中学习特征来实现。该方法使用离散牛顿轨迹构造两个互补的降维空间：由收敛状态构建的解特征空间，以及由中间牛顿增量构建的校正搜索方向特征空间。对于一个未见过的参数，使用回归模型预测一个替代解近似。然后，在第二步中，使用一种专门的基于GMRES的方法计算残差最小化校正。所得状态随后被用作高保真牛顿方法的初始猜测，由其完成收敛。校正步骤的计算成本很低，因为它只需要残差评估和求解一个小型最小二乘问题。一旦高保真残差场和基于脚本的编程接口可用，该方法具有弱侵入性。该策略减少了牛顿迭代次数，并降低了总体CPU时间。在代表性PDE问题上的数值实验表明，与单独使用替代模型初始化相比，该方法具有可量化的加速效果。观察到了显著的加速。该通用方法可应用于广泛的大规模非线性问题。

articles.title: LM-GRASP: Instance-Specific Language Models for Combinatorial Construction via Online Imitation Learning
articles.title_zh: LM-GRASP：通过在线模仿学习进行组合构造的实例特定语言模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28135v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning for combinatorial optimization typically relies on neural constructors trained via reinforcement learning on large offline datasets for a fixed problem class-incurring high pretraining costs and generalizing poorly outside the training distribution. We propose an alternative: a metaheuristic framework that reformulates the randomized constructive phase of GRASP as an online imitation learning task, trained from scratch on each problem instance. A local search procedure acts as an expert oracle, while a decoder-only Transformer serves as the constructive policy. Unlike classical GRASP, which relies on static, myopic heuristic rules based on localized scalar costs, our approach is fully data-driven: the construction policy emerges from high-quality solutions discovered during the search itself, with no problem-specific feature engineering required. We instantiate this as LM-GRASP, a hybrid metaheuristic following an iterative learn-infer-improve cycle, training the policy online via behavioral cloning on a dynamic archive of elite trajectories-no external data or offline pretraining needed. The pipeline interfaces with the domain solely through the objective evaluator used by local search. Evaluated on the Taillard PFSP benchmark (ta51-ta60), the most discriminating block due to half its optima being unknown, LM-GRASP outperforms GPU-GRASP by 28.4 makespan units on average-comparable to the gain from GPU acceleration over sequential execution (27.2 units), though with overlapping standard deviations. This suggests instance-specific, online-trained language models are a promising, practical alternative to hand-engineered constructors, especially for landscapes resistant to classical greedy construction.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出LM-GRASP，将GRASP的随机构造阶段重构为针对每个问题实例从零训练的在线模仿学习任务。局部搜索作为专家预言机，解码器式Transformer作为构造策略，通过精英轨迹动态档案进行行为克隆，无需外部数据、离线预训练或问题特定特征工程。在Taillard PFSP基准上，LM-GRASP相较GPU-GRASP取得了有竞争力的平均makespan改进。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 用于组合优化的机器学习通常依赖于通过强化学习在大型离线数据集上针对固定问题类别训练的神经构造器，这会带来高昂的预训练成本，并且在训练分布之外泛化较差。我们提出一种替代方案：一个元启发式框架，将GRASP的随机构造阶段重新表述为一个在线模仿学习任务，并在每个问题实例上从零开始训练。局部搜索过程充当专家预言机，而仅解码器Transformer充当构造策略。不同于经典GRASP依赖基于局部标量成本的静态、短视启发式规则，我们的方法完全由数据驱动：构造策略来自搜索过程中发现的高质量解，无需问题特定的特征工程。我们将其具体实现为LM-GRASP，这是一种遵循迭代式学习—推断—改进循环的混合元启发式方法，通过在精英轨迹动态档案上进行行为克隆来在线训练策略，不需要外部数据或离线预训练。该流程仅通过局部搜索使用的目标评估器与领域交互。在Taillard PFSP基准（ta51-ta60）上进行评估，该区块最具区分性，因为其中一半最优解未知；LM-GRASP相较GPU-GRASP平均降低了28.4个makespan单位，这与GPU加速相较顺序执行带来的收益（27.2个单位）相当，尽管标准差存在重叠。这表明，实例特定、在线训练的语言模型是一种有前景且实用的手工设计构造器替代方案，尤其适用于对经典贪婪构造具有抗性的搜索景观。

articles.title: TopoFormer: Topology Meets Attention for Graph Learning
articles.title_zh: TopoFormer：拓扑与注意力相结合的图学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28259v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce Topoformer, a lightweight and scalable framework for graph representation learning that encodes topological structure into attention-friendly sequences. At the core of our method is Topo-Scan, a novel module that decomposes a graph into a short, ordered sequence of topological tokens by slicing over node or edge filtrations. These sequences capture multi-scale structural patterns, from local motifs to global organization, and are processed by a Transformer to produce expressive graph-level embeddings. Unlike traditional persistent homology pipelines, Topo-Scan is parallelizable, avoids costly diagram computations, and integrates seamlessly with standard deep learning architectures. We provide theoretical guarantees on the stability of our topological encodings and demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across graph classification and molecular property prediction benchmarks. Our results show that Topoformer matches or exceeds strong GNN and topology-based baselines while offering predictable and efficient compute. This work opens a new path for parallelizable and unifying approaches to graph representation learning that integrate topological inductive biases into attention frameworks.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出TopoFormer，一种轻量且可扩展的图表示学习框架，将拓扑结构编码为适合注意力机制处理的序列。其核心Topo-Scan模块通过节点或边过滤切片，将图分解为短的有序拓扑令牌序列，并由Transformer生成图级嵌入。作者给出稳定性理论保证，并在图分类和分子性质预测基准上取得先进表现。
authors: Md Joshem Uddin, Astrit Tola, Cuneyt Gurcan Akcora, Baris Coskunuzer
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出Topoformer，这是一个用于图表示学习的轻量级且可扩展框架，它将拓扑结构编码为适合注意力处理的序列。我们方法的核心是Topo-Scan，这是一个新颖模块，通过在节点或边过滤上进行切片，将图分解为短的、有序的拓扑令牌序列。这些序列捕捉从局部基序到全局组织的多尺度结构模式，并由Transformer处理以产生富有表达力的图级嵌入。不同于传统的持久同调流程，Topo-Scan可并行化，避免昂贵的图示计算，并可与标准深度学习架构无缝集成。我们为拓扑编码的稳定性提供理论保证，并在图分类和分子性质预测基准上展示了最先进的性能。我们的结果表明，Topoformer能够匹配或超过强大的GNN和基于拓扑的方法基线，同时提供可预测且高效的计算。这项工作为图表示学习开辟了一条新的道路，即以可并行且统一的方式将拓扑归纳偏置集成到注意力框架中。

articles.title: Hierarchical Multilevel Monte Carlo for Order-Optimal Neural Actor-Critic in Average-Reward CMDPs
articles.title_zh: 平均奖励约束马尔可夫决策过程中的分层多层蒙特卡洛阶最优神经Actor-Critic
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28390v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Constrained Markov Decision Processes (CMDPs) provide a natural framework for reinforcement learning in safety-critical applications, where agents maximize long-term reward while satisfying long-term constraints. Although primal-dual actor-critic methods with linear critics are well understood, extending order-optimal convergence guarantees to neural critics in average-reward CMDPs has remained open. The main challenge is a fundamental bias-cost trade-off in neural critic estimation: under Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) analysis, reducing critic bias substantially increases critic optimization cost, preventing order-optimal convergence in the primal-dual framework. We resolve this bottleneck by introducing a hierarchical Multilevel Monte Carlo (MLMC) neural critic that performs debiasing simultaneously across trajectory sampling and critic optimization. The resulting estimator attains the bias of a long critic optimization run with only logarithmic expected sample cost. Building on this estimator, we develop a primal-dual Natural Actor-Critic algorithm that achieves both an optimality gap and a constraint violation of order tildeO(T⁻¹/²). This establishes the first order-optimal convergence guarantees for infinite-horizon average-reward CMDPs with general policy parameterization and neural critics, while eliminating the need to know the underlying mixing time. Our results are novel even in the unconstrained setting.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究平均奖励约束马尔可夫决策过程中的神经critic阶最优收敛问题。作者提出分层多层蒙特卡洛神经critic，在轨迹采样和critic优化两个层面同时去偏，以缓解神经critic估计中的偏差—成本权衡。基于该估计器的原始—对偶自然Actor-Critic算法实现了最优性差距和约束违反均为tildeO(T⁻¹/²)的保证。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDPs）为安全关键应用中的强化学习提供了自然框架，其中智能体在满足长期约束的同时最大化长期奖励。尽管带线性critic的原始—对偶actor-critic方法已经得到充分理解，但将阶最优收敛保证扩展到平均奖励CMDP中的神经critic仍然是一个开放问题。主要挑战在于神经critic估计中存在根本性的偏差—成本权衡：在神经切线核（NTK）分析下，显著降低critic偏差会大幅增加critic优化成本，从而阻碍原始—对偶框架中的阶最优收敛。我们通过引入一种分层多层蒙特卡洛（MLMC）神经critic来解决这一瓶颈，该critic在轨迹采样和critic优化两个方面同时执行去偏。所得估计器能够以仅对数级的期望样本成本达到长时间critic优化运行的偏差。基于该估计器，我们开发了一种原始—对偶自然Actor-Critic算法，该算法实现了最优性差距和约束违反均为tildeO(T⁻¹/²)阶。由此，我们建立了针对具有一般策略参数化和神经critic的无限时域平均奖励CMDP的首个阶最优收敛保证，同时消除了对底层混合时间已知的需求。即使在无约束情形下，我们的结果也是新的。

articles.title: QAdapt: A Noise-Adaptive Neural Pre-Decoding Framework for Quantum Error Correction
articles.title_zh: QAdapt：用于量子纠错的噪声自适应神经预解码框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28422v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC) relies on quantum error correction to suppress physical errors and preserve logical information at scale. In practice, however, performance is constrained not only by physical noise but also by the latency of classical decoders processing rapidly generated syndrome data. This challenge is exacerbated by hardware noise that is strong, heterogeneous, and nonstationary, as well as by the simulation-to-hardware distribution shift that can substantially degrade fixed neural decoders. We present QAdapt, a noise-adaptive neural pre-decoding framework for surface-code quantum error correction. QAdapt captures local spatiotemporal correlations in syndrome data, sequentially adapts to evolving noise conditions while mitigating catastrophic forgetting, and forwards the residual syndrome to a conventional global decoder. Across 110 synthetic out-of-distribution noise configurations for rotated surface-code memory circuits, QAdapt consistently reduces the logical error rate relative to the neural pre-decoding baseline. On Google's Willow benchmark data, without target-domain fine-tuning, it achieves reductions of up to 5.79 percent in logical error rate and 9.32 percent in backend decoding latency on the residual syndrome. These results demonstrate that QAdapt provides a practical and decoder-compatible approach to improving the robustness and backend decoding efficiency of quantum error correction under evolving hardware noise.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出QAdapt，一种面向表面码量子纠错的噪声自适应神经预解码框架。该方法捕捉症状数据的局部时空相关性，顺序适应变化噪声并缓解灾难性遗忘，再将残余症状交给传统全局解码器处理。合成分布外噪声和Google Willow基准数据实验表明，QAdapt可降低逻辑错误率并改善后端解码延迟。
authors: Ran Miao, Rui Luo, Xiaohan Shan, Xiaoming Sun
articles.abstract_zh_full: 容错量子计算（FTQC）依赖量子纠错来抑制物理错误，并在大规模条件下保持逻辑信息。然而，在实践中，性能不仅受物理噪声限制，也受处理快速生成的症状数据的经典解码器延迟限制。硬件噪声强、异质且非平稳，以及仿真到硬件的分布转移会显著降低固定神经解码器性能，这进一步加剧了这一挑战。我们提出QAdapt，这是一个用于表面码量子纠错的噪声自适应神经预解码框架。QAdapt捕捉症状数据中的局部时空相关性，顺序适应不断演化的噪声条件，同时缓解灾难性遗忘，并将残余症状转发给传统全局解码器。在旋转表面码存储电路的110种合成分布外噪声配置中，QAdapt相对于神经预解码基线持续降低逻辑错误率。在Google的Willow基准数据上，在没有目标域微调的情况下，它在逻辑错误率上最高实现5.79%的降低，并在残余症状的后端解码延迟上最高实现9.32%的降低。这些结果表明，在不断演化的硬件噪声下，QAdapt为提升量子纠错的鲁棒性和后端解码效率提供了一种实用且与解码器兼容的方法。

articles.title: Foundation-Model Earth Representations Enable Regional-Scale Forest Aboveground Biomass Monitoring Across the Northeastern United States
articles.title_zh: 基础模型地球表征支持美国东北部区域尺度森林地上生物量监测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27217v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Forest aboveground biomass (AGB) is a critical indicator of ecosystem productivity and terrestrial carbon storage, yet regional carbon monitoring remains constrained by the sparse spatial and temporal availability of field inventories and airborne structural measurements. Recent Earth observation foundation models provide globally consistent geospatial representations derived from diverse multimodal datasets, offering a potential pathway toward scalable biomass monitoring. Here, we evaluate Google Satellite Embeddings (GSE), generated by the AplphaEarth Foundation Model, for regional-scale AGB estimation across diverse temperate forest ecosystems in the northeastern United States. We integrated annual GSE observations, airborne LiDAR, and continuous forest inventory measurements from the Northeastern Forest Inventory Network (NEFIN) within a machine-learning framework. Combined LiDAR-GSE models achieved an R² of 0.79 for AGB estimation. Capitalizing on annual GSE observations expanded the training dataset by more than tenfold through temporal growth adjustment, increasing predictive performance to R² = 0.82 while reducing model bias by over 70%.
