Spatial autocorrelation analyses showed that integrating foundation-model representations and structural predictors substantially reduced residual spatial dependence. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrated that hyperparameter optimization reduced model-performance variability by 27.9%. Our findings demonstrate that foundation-model Earth representations capture ecologically meaningful information relevant to forest biomass and provide a scalable framework for annual carbon monitoring in regions with incomplete airborne LiDAR coverage. Our fundings establish a pathway toward next-generation forest carbon assessment based on globally available foundation-model Earth observations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文评估Google Satellite Embeddings在美国东北部温带森林区域尺度地上生物量估计中的作用。作者结合年度基础模型表征、机载LiDAR和连续森林清查数据建立机器学习框架，发现LiDAR-GSE模型表现良好，并且通过年度观测扩展训练数据可进一步提高精度、降低偏差。结果表明，基础模型地球表征可支持LiDAR覆盖不完整地区的可扩展年度碳监测。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 森林地上生物量（AGB）是生态系统生产力和陆地碳储量的关键指标，但区域碳监测仍受限于野外清查和机载结构测量在空间和时间上的稀疏可用性。近期的地球观测基础模型提供了由多样化多模态数据集生成的全球一致地理空间表征，为可扩展的生物量监测提供了潜在路径。在此，我们评估由AplphaEarth基础模型生成的Google Satellite Embeddings（GSE），用于美国东北部多样温带森林生态系统的区域尺度AGB估计。我们在机器学习框架中整合了年度GSE观测、机载LiDAR以及来自东北森林清查网络（NEFIN）的连续森林清查测量。联合LiDAR-GSE模型在AGB估计中达到R²为0.79。利用年度GSE观测并通过时间生长调整将训练数据集扩展了十倍以上，使预测性能提高到R² = 0.82，同时将模型偏差降低超过70%。空间自相关分析显示，整合基础模型表征和结构预测因子显著降低了残差空间依赖性。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，超参数优化将模型性能变异性降低了27.9%。我们的发现表明，基础模型地球表征捕捉了与森林生物量相关的生态学意义信息，并为机载LiDAR覆盖不完整地区的年度碳监测提供了可扩展框架。我们的发现建立了一条基于全球可用基础模型地球观测的下一代森林碳评估路径。

articles.title: Emulating Cosmic Structure Formation with a Lagrangian Neural Cellular Automaton
articles.title_zh: 使用拉格朗日神经元胞自动机模拟宇宙结构形成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27320v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Field-level inference of cosmological initial conditions from galaxy surveys requires a forward model that is simultaneously accurate in the non-linear regime, computationally efficient, and fully differentiable. Traditional N-body simulations are accurate but computationally prohibitive for iterative inference, while approximate solvers like Lagrangian Perturbation Theory (LPT) fail to capture the knotty halo-forming dynamics of the cosmic web at late times. We introduce the Lagrangian Neural Cellular Automaton (LNCA), a hybrid deep learning framework that can be applied to emulate structure formation as a local, iterative dynamical process on a comoving lattice. Unlike standard Eulerian Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) which map fixed density fields, the LNCA operates in the Lagrangian frame, advecting the computational graph itself to follow the flow of mass. By training the network to learn only the residual displacement corrections to the Zeldovich approximation, we achieve high-fidelity emulation of the non-linear physics while guaranteeing accuracy at large scales. We further constrain our model to produce complete trajectories, not just final states, by adopting an equivariant cellular automaton architecture, which recurrently iterates on its internal states to yield a dynamic history. The resulting model is strictly local, translationally and rotationally equivariant, and naturally supports continuous time integration, making it a reliable differentiable forward model for reconstructing the initial conditions of the universe from lightcone data. Our trained model supports percent-level precision in the power and cross spectra well into the non-linear regime (k łesssim 0.5 , h Mpc⁻¹), while requiring sim10⁴ times fewer learned parameters than comparable models which take the form of an interpretable internal dynamic rule set.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出拉格朗日神经元胞自动机（LNCA），用于以局部、迭代且可微的方式模拟宇宙结构形成。该方法在拉格朗日框架中随质量流动平流计算图，并学习Zel'dovich近似的残差位移校正，从而兼顾大尺度准确性和非线性物理保真度。训练后的模型在非线性尺度上实现功率谱和交叉谱百分比级精度，并显著减少参数量。
authors: Cooper Jacobus, Beatriz Tucci, Oliver Philcox
articles.abstract_zh_full: 从星系巡天中对宇宙学初始条件进行场级推断，需要一个在非线性区域同时准确、计算高效且完全可微的正向模型。传统N体模拟准确但对于迭代推断而言计算代价过高，而拉格朗日微扰理论（LPT）等近似求解器无法捕捉晚期宇宙网中复杂的晕形成动力学。我们引入拉格朗日神经元胞自动机（LNCA），这是一个混合深度学习框架，可用于在共动格点上将结构形成模拟为一个局部的、迭代的动力学过程。不同于映射固定密度场的标准欧拉卷积神经网络（CNN），LNCA在拉格朗日框架中运行，使计算图本身平流以跟随质量流动。通过训练网络仅学习相对于Zel'dovich近似的残差位移校正，我们在保证大尺度准确性的同时，实现了对非线性物理的高保真模拟。我们进一步通过采用等变元胞自动机架构来约束模型生成完整轨迹，而不仅仅是最终状态，该架构在其内部状态上循环迭代以产生动态历史。所得模型严格局部，具有平移和旋转等变性，并天然支持连续时间积分，使其成为从光锥数据重建宇宙初始条件的可靠可微正向模型。我们训练后的模型在深入非线性区域（k łesssim 0.5，h Mpc⁻¹）的功率谱和交叉谱上支持百分比级精度，同时所需学习参数比可比模型少约10⁴倍，并以可解释的内部动力学规则集形式存在。

articles.title: Error Analysis of Neural-Network-Based Engression
articles.title_zh: 基于神经网络的 Engression 误差分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27723v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Engression (Shen and Meinshausen, 2024) learns a conditional distribution by fitting a generative model Y = f(X,ǎrepsilon) under the energy score, a strictly proper scoring rule. We provide a theoretical error analysis of engression implemented with deep neural networks. We decompose the excess risk into three components: the approximation error, the stochastic error, and the Monte Carlo error. Based on this decomposition, we establish convergence rates under the assumption that the target conditional generator admits a compositional smoothness structure.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文对使用深度神经网络实现的 Engression 方法进行了理论误差分析。作者将超额风险分解为逼近误差、随机误差和蒙特卡罗误差，并在目标条件生成器具有组合光滑结构的假设下建立了收敛速率。
authors: Juntong Chen, Zijian Guo, Xinwei Shen
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.27723v1，公告类型：交叉。摘要：Engression（Shen 和 Meinshausen，2024）通过在能量评分这一严格适当评分规则下拟合生成模型 Y = f(X, ε)，来学习条件分布。我们为使用深度神经网络实现的 engression 提供了理论误差分析。我们将超额风险分解为三个组成部分：逼近误差、随机误差和蒙特卡罗误差。基于这一分解，我们在目标条件生成器具有组合光滑性结构的假设下建立了收敛速率。

articles.title: Complementary Matrix-Gated QKAN Fast-Weight Programmers for Quantum Dynamics Forecasting
articles.title_zh: 用于量子动力学预测的互补矩阵门控 QKAN 快速权重编程器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27945v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Sequence models must decide what to write into memory and what to retain. In quantum and quantum-inspired sequence learning, nonlinear recurrent updates often require repeated circuit evaluations and sequential backpropagation through time, making long contexts costly. Gated fast-weight programmers (FWPs) based on quantum-inspired Kolmogorov-Arnold networks (QKANs) alleviate this bottleneck by storing context in time-varying fast parameters. However, their scalar gate applies one retention-write balance to every fast-state coordinate, forcing all parameters to share a memory timescale. We introduce Self-Modulating QKAN-based FWPs, which replace this broadcast gate with low-rank-generated element-wise modulation of the new-proposal branch, a bounded old-state branch, or both. We further propose Complementary Matrix Gating (CMG), which uses one sigmoid matrix gate to retain the old state and its complement to write the new proposal. CMG provides coordinate-wise memory control while preserving the bounded convex update and affine prefix-scan structure of scalar gating, at the modulation-head cost of a single-branch rule. We compare four self-modulating rules with scalar gating across four FWP architectures combining classical and QKAN-based slow and fast programmers. Across seven single-step forecasting benchmarks and five sequence lengths, CMG gives the most consistent improvements for architectures whose fast programmer incorporates a QKAN-based module. In direct multi-step forecasting of Jaynes-Cummings and transmon-resonator dynamics simulated with CUDA-Q Dynamics, CMG models maintain mean-squared errors on the order of 0.001 or lower across forecasting horizons of 4, 8, and 16 steps, while improving on their scalar-gated counterparts by at least 91.2%. These results establish coordinate-wise complementary modulation as a stable and effective update for QKAN-based FWPs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出基于 QKAN 的自调制快速权重编程器，并进一步提出互补矩阵门控（CMG），以实现逐坐标的记忆保留与写入控制。实验显示，在多个单步和多步量子动力学预测任务中，CMG 相比标量门控更稳定且性能提升显著，尤其适用于包含 QKAN 模块的快速编程器架构。
authors: Kuo-Chung Peng, Samuel Yen-Chi Chen, Jiun-Cheng Jiang, Chen-Yu Liu, En-Jui Kuo, Yun-Yuan Wang, Tzung-Chi Huang, Prayag Tiwari, Chi-Sheng Chen, Chun-Hua Lin, Yu-Chao Hsu, Tai-Yue Li, Saif Al-Kuwari, Simon See, Kuan-Cheng Chen, Nan-Yow Chen, Hsi-Sheng Goan
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.27945v1，公告类型：交叉。摘要：序列模型必须决定将什么写入记忆以及保留什么。在量子和受量子启发的序列学习中，非线性循环更新通常需要反复进行电路评估，并通过时间进行序列反向传播，这使得长上下文代价高昂。基于受量子启发的 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络（QKAN）的门控快速权重编程器（FWP）通过将上下文存储在随时间变化的快速参数中，缓解了这一瓶颈。然而，它们的标量门对每一个快速状态坐标都施加同一个保留—写入平衡，迫使所有参数共享同一种记忆时间尺度。我们提出了基于 QKAN 的自调制 FWP，用低秩生成的逐元素调制来替代这种广播门控，调制对象可以是新提议分支、有界旧状态分支，或二者兼有。我们进一步提出互补矩阵门控（CMG），它使用一个 sigmoid 矩阵门来保留旧状态，并使用其互补项来写入新提议。CMG 提供逐坐标的记忆控制，同时保持标量门控的有界凸更新和仿射前缀扫描结构，并且其调制头成本相当于单分支规则。我们在四种结合经典和基于 QKAN 的慢速与快速编程器的 FWP 架构中，将四种自调制规则与标量门控进行了比较。在七个单步预测基准和五种序列长度上，对于快速编程器包含基于 QKAN 模块的架构，CMG 给出了最一致的改进。在使用 CUDA-Q Dynamics 模拟的 Jaynes-Cummings 和 transmon-resonator 动力学的直接多步预测中，CMG 模型在 4、8 和 16 步预测跨度上将均方误差保持在 0.001 或更低的量级，同时相对于其标量门控对应模型至少提升了 91.2%。这些结果确立了逐坐标互补调制作为基于 QKAN 的 FWP 的一种稳定且有效的更新方式。

articles.title: Driving up Inference Energy on SNNs: Per-Sample and Universal Sponge Attacks
articles.title_zh: 抬高 SNN 推理能耗：逐样本与通用海绵攻击
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27990v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) communicate through sparse binary spike events rather than dense activations, enabling energy-efficient inference on neuromorphic hardware and motivating their use in always-on, battery-powered edge systems. We show that this same efficiency advantage creates a distinct security risk: sponge attacks can increase inference-time spike activity and synaptic workload, inflating energy consumption while remaining difficult to detect through correctness-based monitoring alone. Prior input-space efficiency attacks on SNNs have focused on per-sample optimization, primarily in rate-coded settings. We extend this threat to native event-based binary inputs and study two attack models. First, we develop a per-sample sponge attack that crafts a custom adversarial spike train for each input via gradient-based optimization. This attack increases per-inference SynOps by 1.5-2.6x on three SNN models for the NMNIST, SHD, and IBM DVS Gesture datasets, while preserving the predicted class on at least 98% of evaluated samples. Second, to the best of our knowledge, we introduce the first universal sponge attack for native event-based SNN inputs: a fixed binary perturbation computed offline and applied via XOR to all subsequent inputs. Although weaker, it still inflates SynOps by 1.09-1.24x across all three datasets and represents a more realistic deployment threat because it requires no per-input optimization. Mapping SynOp inflation to estimated Loihi-1 energy yields per-inference overheads from 14 μJ to 13.24 mJ. These results show that native event-based SNNs are vulnerable to practical input-space efficiency attacks, and that reusable universal perturbations can accumulate into meaningful battery drain in continuously deployed edge systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出，脉冲神经网络的稀疏事件通信虽有利于低能耗推理，但也带来了可通过增加脉冲活动与突触工作量来消耗能量的安全风险。作者提出逐样本海绵攻击和面向原生事件二值输入的通用海绵攻击，在保持分类结果基本不变的同时显著增加 SynOps，并可能导致边缘设备电池持续耗尽。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.27990v1，公告类型：交叉。摘要：脉冲神经网络（SNN）通过稀疏的二值脉冲事件而非密集激活进行通信，从而在神经形态硬件上实现节能推理，并推动其用于始终在线、由电池供电的边缘系统。我们表明，这种效率优势本身产生了一种独特的安全风险：海绵攻击可以增加推理时的脉冲活动和突触工作负载，从而抬高能耗，同时仅依靠基于正确性的监控很难检测到这类攻击。以往针对 SNN 的输入空间效率攻击主要集中于逐样本优化，且主要在率编码设置中进行。我们将这一威胁扩展到原生事件型二值输入，并研究两种攻击模型。首先，我们开发了一种逐样本海绵攻击，通过基于梯度的优化为每个输入构造定制的对抗性脉冲列车。该攻击在针对 NMNIST、SHD 和 IBM DVS Gesture 数据集的三个 SNN 模型上，使每次推理的 SynOps 增加了 1.5 到 2.6 倍，同时在至少 98% 的评估样本上保持预测类别不变。其次，据我们所知，我们引入了首个针对原生事件型 SNN 输入的通用海绵攻击：一种离线计算的固定二值扰动，并通过 XOR 应用于所有后续输入。尽管该攻击较弱，但它仍然在三个数据集上将 SynOps 提高了 1.09 到 1.24 倍，并且由于不需要逐输入优化，它代表了一种更现实的部署威胁。将 SynOp 膨胀映射到估计的 Loihi-1 能耗后，每次推理的额外开销从 14 微焦到 13.24 毫焦不等。这些结果表明，原生事件型 SNN 容易受到实用的输入空间效率攻击，并且可复用的通用扰动在连续部署的边缘系统中会累积成有意义的电池消耗。

articles.title: Echoverse: Deep, Evolving Environments for Training Computer-Use Agents at Scale
articles.title_zh: Echoverse：用于大规模训练计算机使用智能体的深度演化环境
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28074v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Computer-use agents learn from what their actions change, so training one needs applications it can act on, break and reset. The applications that matter most are login-gated and stateful, so synthetic environments stand in for them. Recent pipelines generate such environments in bulk, which moves the bottleneck from how many exist to what is inside each one. The returns, we find, come from three properties: how much behavioural depth an environment carries, whether it targets the interaction an agent actually fails, and whether it improves alongside the model. We present Echoverse, which compiles specifications into stateful applications whose tasks are graded against the application's own database, and a co-evolution loop that reads every graded rollout twice: as repairs to the environment, its tasks and its verifier, and as training signal for the model. Trained on twelve such environments, a 9B model improves from 36.5% to 67.1% across fourteen evaluation splits, within fourteen points of the much larger frontier model that taught it. We examine each property in turn. On the same domains, shallow environments push live-site accuracy below the base model (80.0 → 75.0) while deep ones raise it (80.0 → 85.0 and 48.0 → 65.0); drilling one interface control across many renderings transfers to held-out widget families and to the open web; and repairing a single environment lifts the model trained on it from 16.2% to 38.5%. The same worlds serve as reinforcement-learning environments, where a reward combining the grounded verifier with a dense per-step judge raises held-out score from 58.8% to 68.0%. We release four environments as a benchmark, with their applications, seed data and grounded graders. Code: https://aka.ms/echoverse
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 Echoverse，用于生成和演化具备状态的应用环境，以训练能够操作计算机应用的智能体。该框架将规格编译为可交互应用，并通过评分轨迹同时修复环境和训练模型；实验表明，深层环境、针对失败交互的任务设计以及随模型共同改进的环境均能显著提升模型表现。
authors: Yash Pandya, Sahil Gupta, Sarthak Harne, Archana Yadav, Kavyansh Chourasia, Hussein Mozannar, Vibhav Vineet, Sara Abdali, Corby Rosset, Yash Lara, Ahmed Awadallah, Ece Kamar, Akshay Nambi
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.28074v1，公告类型：交叉。摘要：计算机使用智能体从其行动所造成的变化中学习，因此训练这样的智能体需要它能够操作、破坏并重置的应用。最重要的应用往往需要登录并具有状态，因此合成环境被用作它们的替代。近期流程能够批量生成此类环境，这使瓶颈从“存在多少环境”转移到“每个环境内部包含什么”。我们发现，收益来自三个属性：环境承载多少行为深度，它是否针对智能体实际失败的交互，以及它是否能随模型一同改进。我们提出 Echoverse，它将规格编译为有状态应用，其任务依据应用自身数据库进行评分，并包含一个共同演化循环，对每次已评分的 rollout 进行两次读取：一次作为对环境、任务和验证器的修复，另一次作为模型的训练信号。在十二个这样的环境上训练后，一个 9B 模型在十四个评估划分上的表现从 36.5% 提升到 67.1%，与教授它的更大前沿模型相差不到十四个百分点。我们逐一考察这些属性。在相同领域中，浅层环境使在线站点准确率低于基础模型（80.0 → 75.0），而深层环境提高了准确率（80.0 → 85.0 和 48.0 → 65.0）；在许多渲染形式中反复训练一个界面控件，可以迁移到留出的控件家族以及开放网络；修复单个环境可使在其上训练的模型从 16.2% 提升到 38.5%。同样的世界也可作为强化学习环境，其中结合了落地验证器和密集逐步评判器的奖励，将留出评分从 58.8% 提高到 68.0%。我们发布四个环境作为基准，包括其应用、种子数据和落地评分器。

articles.title: On a joint simultaneous learning of relevant feature subsets and subspaces in regression-like problems
articles.title_zh: 回归类问题中相关特征子集与子空间的联合同步学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28080v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We extend a recently introduced Entropy-Optimal Manifold Clustering (EOMC) to allow for a joint simultaneous identification of subsets and subspaces of relevant features in nonstationary and nonlinear regression problems. It is shown that the proposed extension - that we coin as Entropy-Optimal Manifold Regression (EOMR) - allows a robust learning with linearly-scaling iteration and memory complexities. EOMR is compared to the most complete set of state-of-the-art tools from the Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) that is available to the author, on the very challenging problems from chaotic and fluid dynamics: (i) on predicting the Lorenz-96 systems dynamics in strongly- and very-strongly chaotic regimes (with forcing parameter being F=8 and F=12, respectively); and, (ii) on a data from the Hasegawa-Wakatani model on the edge of the tokamak plasma. It is demonstrated that the proposed benchmarks (i) and (ii), indeed, are the very challenging problems for the state of the art ML and AI tools - since both the general-purpose gradient boosted random forests and deep neuronal networks, as well as transformer-based AI tools like TabPFN v.03 (more spezialised for large-dimensional small data learning problems) - result in orders of magnitude inferior root mean squared prediction errors, and orders of magnitude larger model complexities, when compared to the EOMR. For a Hasegawa-Wakatani example, EOMR distills a very simple entropy-optimal and skilful description of the leading Essential Orthogonal Function (EOF) dynamics, given by linear, causal and weakly-stationary autoregressive process described by just 8 parameters.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将熵最优流形聚类扩展为熵最优流形回归（EOMR），用于在非平稳、非线性回归问题中联合识别相关特征子集与子空间。作者在 Lorenz-96 和 Hasegawa-Wakatani 等混沌与流体动力学任务上表明，EOMR 在预测误差和模型复杂度方面优于多种现代机器学习与人工智能工具，并能提炼出简洁的动力学描述。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.28080v1，公告类型：交叉。摘要：我们扩展了近期提出的熵最优流形聚类（EOMC），使其能够在非平稳和非线性回归问题中联合同步识别相关特征的子集与子空间。结果表明，所提出的扩展——我们将其称为熵最优流形回归（EOMR）——允许以线性缩放的迭代复杂度和内存复杂度进行稳健学习。作者将 EOMR 与其可获得的最完整的一组来自人工智能（AI）和机器学习（ML）的最新工具进行了比较，比较对象是来自混沌与流体动力学的极具挑战性问题：（i）在强混沌和极强混沌状态下预测 Lorenz-96 系统动力学，其强迫参数分别为 F=8 和 F=12；以及（ii）来自托卡马克等离子体边缘 Hasegawa-Wakatani 模型的数据。结果表明，所提出的基准（i）和（ii）确实是当前最先进 ML 和 AI 工具面临的极具挑战性的问题，因为无论是通用梯度提升随机森林和深度神经网络，还是基于 transformer 的 AI 工具如 TabPFN v.03（更专门面向大维度小数据学习问题），与 EOMR 相比，都产生了高出数个数量级的均方根预测误差，以及大出数个数量级的模型复杂度。对于 Hasegawa-Wakatani 示例，EOMR 提炼出一个非常简单、熵最优且有技巧的主导本质正交函数（EOF）动力学描述，该描述由一个线性、因果且弱平稳的自回归过程给出，仅由 8 个参数刻画。

articles.title: EMBL AI Librarian: Life-Sciences Knowledge Layer for AI Agents
articles.title_zh: EMBL AI Librarian：面向 AI 智能体的生命科学知识层
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28229v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The web is increasingly accessed by AI agents rather than humans. Every agent needs knowledge, especially in the life-sciences, where agentic pipelines are growing fast. Access to the literature is a crucial part of that need, and resources such as Europe PMC, with over 40M indexed records, are widely used to meet it. Yet these resources were not built for AI agents: they take keywords and complex syntax and return whole papers, so every agent must learn the syntax, issue several searches, and read full papers to find the evidence it needs. We introduce EMBL AI Librarian, a knowledge layer that upgrades the Europe PMC interface for AI agents: an agent asks in natural language and receives evidence that answers it. A single LLM orchestrates the whole knowledge retrieval process: it plans complementary subqueries executed by the live Europe PMC search engine, then reads the selected papers and locates the relevant evidence. We evaluate Librarian across four benchmarks: literature synthesis, claim verification, open-domain question answering, and downstream biology tasks such as protocol questions and sequence manipulation. On ScholarQABench, Librarian improves Citation F1 by more than 16 points over strong recently published baselines. Used as the retrieval layer of an existing claim-verification pipeline, it increases agreement with expert consensus; and on the open-form LitQA2 benchmark, a GPT-5.4 agent scores about 8 points higher when grounded in Librarian than with web search. Overall, our results show that equipping life-science agents with the Librarian knowledge layer improves performance across a range of tasks. We release our code publicly at https://github.com/petroni-lab/librarian
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 EMBL AI Librarian，作为面向生命科学 AI 智能体的知识检索层，使智能体能够用自然语言提出问题并获得相关证据。该系统由单一大语言模型编排子查询规划、文献检索、论文阅读与证据定位，并在文献综合、声明验证、开放域问答和下游生物学任务中提升了性能。
authors: Luigi Sigillo, Matteo Silvestri, Francesco Tabaro, Rajat Bhatnagar, Syed Irtaza Mubashar, Matt Jeffryes, Daljit Nijjer, Vittorio Perera, Ola Spjuth, Julio Saez-Rodriguez, Melissa Harrison, Fabio Petroni
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.28229v1，公告类型：交叉。摘要：网络正越来越多地由 AI 智能体而非人类访问。每个智能体都需要知识，尤其是在生命科学领域，智能体式流程正在快速增长。访问文献是这种需求的关键部分，而诸如 Europe PMC 这类拥有超过 4000 万条索引记录的资源被广泛用于满足这一需求。然而，这些资源并不是为 AI 智能体构建的：它们接受关键词和复杂语法并返回整篇论文，因此每个智能体都必须学习语法、发起多次搜索，并阅读整篇论文以找到所需证据。我们介绍 EMBL AI Librarian，这是一个知识层，用于为 AI 智能体升级 Europe PMC 接口：智能体用自然语言提问，并收到能够回答问题的证据。一个单一的大语言模型编排整个知识检索过程：它规划由实时 Europe PMC 搜索引擎执行的互补子查询，然后阅读所选论文并定位相关证据。我们在四个基准上评估 Librarian：文献综合、声明验证、开放域问答，以及如下游生物学任务，例如实验方案问题和序列操作。在 ScholarQABench 上，Librarian 相比近期发表的强基线将 Citation F1 提高了 16 个百分点以上。作为现有声明验证流程的检索层使用时，它提高了与专家共识的一致性；在开放形式的 LitQA2 基准上，与网络搜索相比，当 GPT-5.4 智能体以 Librarian 为依据时，得分约高 8 分。总体而言，我们的结果表明，为生命科学智能体配备 Librarian 知识层可在一系列任务中提升性能。我们公开发布了代码。

articles.title: ShadowDancer: Teaching Video World Models Any Action by Learning Unified Dynamics Representations from a Video and Its Shadow
articles.title_zh: ShadowDancer：通过从视频及其“影子”中学习统一动力学表征，教会视频世界模型任意动作
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28362v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present ShadowDancer, a novel approach to any-action, frame-level control of interactive video world models. The obstacle is representational: existing interfaces either encode an action loosely, leaving how it unfolds for the model to improvise, or encode it exactly through structured signals that serve one family and are hard to acquire, so precise control across diverse dynamics remains impractical. Demonstration videos are the natural remedy, specifying any dynamics frame by frame; yet a video shows its dynamics only through one particular appearance, a single shadow of the underlying dynamics, so actions learned from demonstrations transfer poorly to new scenes. ShadowDancer addresses this with two key innovations: (1) shadow pairs, video pairs that replay the same dynamics under independently resampled appearance, constructed at scale by our Shadow Library, so that a dynamics family becomes controllable exactly when such pairs can be constructed for it; and (2) cross-shadow prediction, which learns actions by predicting one shadow from the other, so that whatever the pairing resamples is discarded by construction and whatever it preserves becomes the action, yielding a unified dynamics representation that drives a block-causal world model. Any demonstrated clip thus becomes a reusable action asset, replayed in new environments without action labels, motion estimators, or fine-tuning. Experiments demonstrate improved action transfer and long action rollout over strong latent-action and interactive world model baselines across diverse dynamics families, with an average blinded win rate of 86% in rollout comparisons. We show video results at https://ShadowDancer-1.github.io
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 ShadowDancer，用于实现交互式视频世界模型的任意动作、帧级控制。该方法通过构造同一动力学在不同外观下重放的“影子对”，并进行跨影子预测，学习与外观无关的统一动力学表征，从而可将演示片段作为可复用动作资产迁移到新环境。
authors: Jin Cao, Zian Meng, Kaipeng Zhang
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.28362v1，公告类型：交叉。摘要：我们提出 ShadowDancer，这是一种用于交互式视频世界模型任意动作、帧级控制的新方法。障碍在于表征：现有接口要么松散地编码一个动作，把其如何展开留给模型即兴发挥；要么通过结构化信号精确编码动作，但这些信号只服务于某一类动作且难以获取，因此跨多样动力学进行精确控制仍不现实。演示视频是自然的补救方案，因为它逐帧指定任意动力学；然而，一个视频只通过一种特定外观展示其动力学，即底层动力学的单一“影子”，因此从演示中学到的动作难以迁移到新场景。ShadowDancer 通过两个关键创新解决这一问题：（1）影子对，即在独立重采样外观下重放相同动力学的视频对，由我们的 Shadow Library 大规模构建，因此只要能够为某个动力学家族构建这样的配对，该家族就能被精确控制；（2）跨影子预测，它通过从一个影子预测另一个影子来学习动作，因此配对过程重采样的任何内容都会按构造被丢弃，而被保留的任何内容都会成为动作，从而产生一种统一的动力学表征，用来驱动块因果世界模型。由此，任何演示片段都成为可复用的动作资产，可在新环境中重放，而无需动作标签、运动估计器或微调。实验表明，在多样的动力学家族中，相比强大的潜在动作和交互式世界模型基线，该方法改善了动作迁移和长动作 rollout，在 rollout 比较中的平均盲评胜率为 86%。我们展示了视频结果。

articles.title: SCOPE: Supply-Chain Operations through Coupled Policies for End-to-End Coordination
articles.title_zh: SCOPE：通过耦合策略实现端到端协调的供应链运营
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28488v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Can supply-chain AI move beyond isolated decision modules toward unified operational planning? A complete replenishment plan specifies which products each location carries, which upstream facility supplies it, how often it is replenished, and how deliveries are routed. These decisions are operationally coupled: the selected assortment changes the demand and load passed to later stages; source assignment and replenishment frequency reshape the delivery requests; and route feasibility and cost, in turn, determine the system value of the earlier choices. Yet in modern supply chains, these decisions are often handled by separate departments and optimized through separate systems, which can lead to stockouts, inventory exposure, and avoidable transportation. We propose SCOPE: Supply-Chain Operations through Coupled Policies for End-to-End Coordination, a composite policy model that represents supply-chain entities as tokens, contextualizes them through a shared operational representation, and maps each token type to the corresponding decision interface. Each decision builds on the partial plan formed by earlier decisions while the completed plan is evaluated using a shared system-level utility. We instantiate this framework in urban fresh-retail replenishment, where service frequency, assortment, capacity pressure, and road-network routing interact strongly, and evaluate it on real operational data from Dingdong and JD.com, two large-scale supply chains operating at different replenishment echelons. Across both settings, SCOPE consistently outperforms methods that optimize each decision stage separately, as well as practice-oriented baselines commonly used in supply-chain operations. These results show that learning and coordinating cross-department operational couplings lead to more effective end-to-end supply-chain decisions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 SCOPE，一个用于供应链端到端运营协调的复合策略模型，将商品、门店、仓库等供应链实体表示为 token，并在共享运营表征中学习相互耦合的决策。作者在城市生鲜零售补货场景中验证该方法，结果显示 SCOPE 优于分阶段优化和常用运营基线，说明跨部门决策耦合的学习有助于提升整体供应链决策质量。
authors: Yunhao Liang, Xianqi Cao, Pujun Zhang, Yuan Qu, Yongzhi Qi, Ningxuan Kang, Max Z. J. Shen
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.28488v1，公告类型：交叉。摘要：供应链 AI 能否超越孤立的决策模块，迈向统一的运营规划？一个完整的补货计划会指定每个地点经营哪些产品、由哪个上游设施供应、多久补货一次，以及如何安排配送路线。这些决策在运营上是耦合的：所选商品组合会改变传递到后续阶段的需求和负载；供应源分配和补货频率会重塑配送请求；而路线可行性和成本又反过来决定早期选择的系统价值。然而，在现代供应链中，这些决策通常由不同部门处理，并通过不同系统优化，这可能导致缺货、库存暴露以及可避免的运输。我们提出 SCOPE，即通过耦合策略实现端到端协调的供应链运营，这是一个复合策略模型，将供应链实体表示为 token，通过共享运营表征对其进行上下文化，并将每类 token 映射到相应的决策接口。每个决策都建立在先前决策形成的部分计划之上，而完整计划则使用共享的系统级效用进行评估。我们在城市生鲜零售补货中实例化该框架，在该场景中，服务频率、商品组合、容量压力和道路网络路由强烈交互，并在来自叮咚和京东这两个处于不同补货层级的大规模供应链的真实运营数据上进行评估。在两个设置中，SCOPE 都一致优于分别优化各决策阶段的方法，以及供应链运营中常用的面向实践的基线。这些结果表明，学习并协调跨部门运营耦合能够带来更有效的端到端供应链决策。

articles.title: MSGNN: A Spectral Graph Neural Network Based on a Novel Magnetic Signed Laplacian
articles.title_zh: MSGNN：一种基于新型磁性符号拉普拉斯算子的谱图神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2209.00546v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Signed and directed networks are ubiquitous in real-world applications. However, there has been relatively little work proposing spectral graph neural networks (GNNs) for such networks. Here we introduce a signed directed Laplacian matrix, which we call the magnetic signed Laplacian, as a natural generalization of both the signed Laplacian on signed graphs and the magnetic Laplacian on directed graphs. We then use this matrix to construct a novel efficient spectral GNN architecture and conduct extensive experiments on both node clustering and link prediction tasks. In these experiments, we consider tasks related to signed information, tasks related to directional information, and tasks related to both signed and directional information. We demonstrate that our proposed spectral GNN is effective for incorporating both signed and directional information, and attains leading performance on a wide range of data sets. Additionally, we provide a novel synthetic network model, which we refer to as the Signed Directed Stochastic Block Model, and a number of novel real-world data sets based on lead-lag relationships in financial time series.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种名为磁性符号拉普拉斯算子的有符号有向拉普拉斯矩阵，将有符号图上的符号拉普拉斯算子与有向图上的磁性拉普拉斯算子自然推广到统一框架。基于该矩阵，作者构建了高效的谱图神经网络，并在节点聚类和链路预测任务中验证其能够有效整合符号与方向信息，取得领先性能。
authors: Yixuan He, Michael Permultter, Gesine Reinert, Mihai Cucuringu
articles.focus_summary: 本文提出了一种基于“磁性有符号拉普拉斯矩阵”的谱图神经网络，用于同时处理有符号和有向网络。作者在节点聚类和链路预测任务上验证了模型效果，显示其能有效编码方向性与符号信息。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们工作的关系较弱，主要是在图神经网络方法层面可作为参考，但不涉及材料计算或物理建模。若后续做材料图学习中的有向/带符号关系建模，可借鉴其谱算子设计思路。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可关注其拉普拉斯构造与谱域建模方式，思考是否能迁移到材料中的带符号相互作用、缺陷关系或磁交换网络表示。若团队重视图学习方法，可进一步阅读其理论推导。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2209.00546v5，公告类型：替换。摘要：有符号和有向网络在现实应用中无处不在。然而，针对这类网络提出谱图神经网络（GNN）的工作相对较少。这里我们引入一个有符号有向拉普拉斯矩阵，称为磁性符号拉普拉斯算子，它自然地推广了有符号图上的符号拉普拉斯算子和有向图上的磁性拉普拉斯算子。随后，我们使用该矩阵构建一种新颖高效的谱 GNN 架构，并在节点聚类和链路预测任务上开展了广泛实验。在这些实验中，我们考虑了与符号信息相关的任务、与方向信息相关的任务，以及同时与符号和方向信息相关的任务。我们证明，所提出的谱 GNN 能够有效融合符号与方向信息，并在广泛的数据集上取得领先性能。此外，我们提供了一种新的合成网络模型，称为有符号有向随机块模型，并提供了若干基于金融时间序列中领先—滞后关系的新型真实世界数据集。

articles.title: Bayesian Classification with Probit-link Split-and-merge Gaussian Process Prior in EEG-based Brain-Computer Interfaces
articles.title_zh: 脑电脑机接口中采用 Probit 链接分裂合并高斯过程先验的贝叶斯分类
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.30775v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: A Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) speller systems based on Event-Related Potentials (ERPs) enables users to select characters by detecting brain responses to visual stimuli, recorded through electroencephalogram (EEG). One challenge is to accurately identify target-related responses, such as the P300 component. However, existing methods tend to ignore feature selection, perform feature selection without interpretability, or require large computational effort or data manipulation. To address these limitations, we propose a novel Bayesian generative modeling framework to the binary classification of EEG responses to stimuli. Our approach employs a Probit-link Split-and-merge Gaussian Process (P-SMGP) prior to perform spatial-temporal feature selection, effectively capturing the distinctions between target and non-target ERP responses. Through both simulation studies and real EEG data analysis, our approach provides statistical interpretations on transformed ERP functions while maintaining comparable prediction accuracy with a computationally motivated design. These findings underscore the value of interpretable, stimulus-level modeling for advancing predictive and personalized BCI systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文面向基于事件相关电位的脑机接口拼写系统，提出一种用于 EEG 刺激响应二分类的贝叶斯生成建模框架。该方法采用 Probit 链接分裂合并高斯过程先验进行时空特征选择，在保持可比预测准确率的同时提升了对目标与非目标 ERP 响应差异的统计可解释性。
authors: Yunong Wu, Jane E. Huggins, Jian Kang, Tianwen Ma
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2605.30775v2，公告类型：替换-交叉。摘要：基于事件相关电位（ERP）的脑机接口（BCI）拼写系统，使用户能够通过检测对视觉刺激的脑反应来选择字符，这些反应通过脑电图（EEG）记录。一个挑战是准确识别与目标相关的反应，例如 P300 成分。然而，现有方法往往忽略特征选择，或在没有可解释性的情况下进行特征选择，或需要大量计算工作或数据操作。为解决这些局限，我们提出了一种新颖的贝叶斯生成建模框架，用于 EEG 对刺激反应的二分类。我们的方法采用 Probit 链接分裂合并高斯过程（P-SMGP）先验来进行时空特征选择，从而有效捕捉目标与非目标 ERP 响应之间的区别。通过模拟研究和真实 EEG 数据分析，我们的方法在保持可比预测准确率的同时，凭借受计算动机启发的设计，对变换后的 ERP 函数提供了统计解释。这些发现强调了可解释的刺激层级建模对于推进预测性和个性化 BCI 系统的价值。

articles.title: Hamiltonian dynamics from pure dissipation
articles.title_zh: 由纯耗散产生哈密顿动力学
articles.abstract: The fundamental difference between closed and open quantum dynamics lies in their environmental interaction: closed systems are perfectly isolated and evolve reversibly under unitary Hamiltonian dynamics, whereas open systems continuously couple to an external bath, resulting in irreversible dissipation and information loss. In this work, we show internal Hamiltonian dynamics can be "faked`` via external pure dissipation, i.e., Lindbladians without a coherent Hamiltonian part. More concretely, we show that, in a GKSL representation with zero explicit Hamiltonian, bounded-norm dissipative generators can approximate Hamiltonian dynamics within ϵ error in diamond norm using O(t²/ϵ) evolution time. We further prove that for time-independent dynamics this O(t²/ϵ) scaling is in the worst case, necessary and optimal from a geometric perspective, which captures the fundamental decoherence cost for catching up with the speed of Hamiltonian dynamics. For practical considerations, we establish an autonomous QDRIFT protocol and show how to exponentially improve the dependence on ϵ for expectation value estimation via extrapolations. Our construction leads to various implications, including the BQP-completeness of purely dissipative dynamics even before reaching approximate equilibrium, a Zeno-adjacent state-independent freezing effect, the no super-quadratic fast-forwarding theorem of a class of purely dissipative dynamics, and reducing Lindbladian simulation cost via gauge changing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究如何用没有显式相干哈密顿项的纯耗散 Lindblad 动力学来近似“伪造”内部哈密顿演化。作者证明，在有界范数耗散生成元下可在菱形范数误差 ε 内近似哈密顿动力学，并给出最坏情况下必要且最优的时间尺度，同时讨论了自主 QDRIFT、期望值估计改进及其在复杂性、冻结效应、快进限制和 Lindbladian 模拟中的影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 闭合量子动力学与开放量子动力学之间的根本差异在于它们与环境的相互作用：闭合系统完全隔离，并在幺正哈密顿动力学下可逆演化；而开放系统持续耦合到外部热浴，从而导致不可逆耗散和信息损失。在本文中，我们表明内部哈密顿动力学可以通过外部纯耗散来“伪造”，即通过没有相干哈密顿部分的 Lindbladian 来实现。更具体地说，我们表明，在显式哈密顿量为零的 GKSL 表示中，有界范数耗散生成元可以用 O(t²/ε) 的演化时间，在菱形范数中以 ε 误差近似哈密顿动力学。我们进一步证明，对于时间无关动力学，这种 O(t²/ε) 缩放在最坏情况下从几何角度看是必要且最优的，它刻画了追赶哈密顿动力学速度所需的基本退相干代价。出于实际考虑，我们建立了一种自主 QDRIFT 协议，并展示如何通过外推在期望值估计中指数级改善对 ε 的依赖。我们的构造带来多种影响，包括纯耗散动力学即使在达到近似平衡之前也是 BQP 完全的、一种类似 Zeno 且与状态无关的冻结效应、一类纯耗散动力学不存在超二次快进的定理，以及通过规范变换降低 Lindbladian 模拟成本。

articles.title: First-Principles Study on the Structural, Electronic, Thermophysical, Mechanical and Elastic Properties of Cubic LaTiO3 Perovskite
articles.title_zh: 立方 LaTiO3 钙钛矿结构、电子、热物理、力学与弹性性质的第一性原理研究
articles.abstract: Density functional theory (DFT) has been used to examine the structural, electronic, thermophysical, mechanical, and elastic properties of LaTiO3 and the quasi-harmonic Debye model has been used to account for high temperatures. The equilibrium lattice constant, bulk modulus and its pressure derivative for LaTiO3 are determined. For the exchange correlation potential, the generalized gradient approximation (GGA) in the Perdew, Burke and Ernzerhof (PBE) scheme was used. The computed lattice constant was found to be in agreement with the available experimental and theoretical results. We have presented the results of the electronic band structure, density of states and charge densities. According to the electronic structure, the material is metallic in nature. These findings agree favourably with both the available experimental data and earlier theoretical works. The thermodynamic properties, including the Grüneisen parameter, specific heats, and thermal expansion coefficient, have been examined for the entire pressure range of 0 GPa and temperature range of 0 to 1073 K. The elastic constants were also calculated and used to determine mechanical properties like Young's modulus (Y), the shear modulus (G), Poisson's ratio (σ) and the anisotropic factor (A).
articles.abstract_zh: 本文采用密度泛函理论研究立方 LaTiO3 的结构、电子、热物理、力学和弹性性质，并用准谐 Debye 模型处理高温效应。计算结果包括晶格常数、体模量、能带结构、态密度、热力学量和弹性常数等，表明该材料呈金属性，且部分结果与已有实验和理论研究相符。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 密度泛函理论（DFT）被用于研究 LaTiO3 的结构、电子、热物理、力学和弹性性质，并使用准谐 Debye 模型来考虑高温。本文确定了 LaTiO3 的平衡晶格常数、体模量及其压力导数。对于交换相关势，使用了 Perdew、Burke 和 Ernzerhof（PBE）方案中的广义梯度近似（GGA）。计算得到的晶格常数与已有实验和理论结果一致。我们给出了电子能带结构、态密度和电荷密度的结果。根据电子结构，该材料本质上是金属性的。这些发现与已有实验数据和早期理论工作均符合良好。本文在 0 GPa 的整个压力范围以及 0 到 1073 K 的温度范围内考察了热力学性质，包括 Grüneisen 参数、比热和热膨胀系数。还计算了弹性常数，并用其确定了杨氏模量（Y）、剪切模量（G）、泊松比（σ）和各向异性因子（A）等力学性质。

articles.title: Polarity-dependent effects of 400 Hz cortico-cerebellar pulsed current stimulation on corticospinal excitability and hand dexterity: A pilot randomized crossover study
articles.title_zh: 400 Hz 皮层—小脑脉冲电流刺激对皮质脊髓兴奋性和手部灵巧性的极性依赖效应：一项随机交叉预实验研究
articles.abstract: Background Transcranial pulsed current stimulation (tPCS) is an emerging non-invasive neuromodulation approach with potential applications in neurorehabilitation. However, the influence of stimulation montage polarity on motor cortical excitability and motor function remains poorly understood. This pilot study investigated the feasibility and preliminary neurophysiological and behavioural effects of two bipolar 400 Hz cortico-cerebellar tPCS montages on corticospinal excitability, cortico-cortical excitability, and hand dexterity in healthy adults.Methods Twenty-six healthy adults participated in a double-blind, randomized, sham-controlled, counterbalanced crossover pilot study. Participants completed three stimulation conditions: (1) anodal primary motor cortex with cathodal cerebellar stimulation (M1+/CB−), (2) reversed polarity stimulation (M1−/CB+), and (3) sham stimulation, with sessions separated by at least 48 hours. Corticospinal excitability was assessed using single-pulse transcranial magnetic stimulation, while cortico-cortical excitability was evaluated using paired-pulse measures of intracortical facilitation and inhibition. Hand dexterity was assessed using the Purdue Pegboard Test before and immediately after stimulation.Results The M1+/CB− montage produced preliminary evidence of enhanced corticospinal excitability, increased intracortical facilitation, and improved hand dexterity compared with sham stimulation. In contrast, the M1−/CB+ montage resulted in reduced corticospinal excitability without measurable changes in cortico-cortical excitability or hand dexterity. No significant changes were observed following sham stimulation.Conclusions This pilot study demonstrates that bipolar 400 Hz cortico-cerebellar tPCS produces polarity-dependent modulation of motor system function. Anodal motor cortex combined with cathodal cerebellar stimulation may facilitate corticospinal output and motor performance, whereas reversed polarity may exert inhibitory effects. These preliminary findings provide a foundation for future studies investigating optimized tPCS protocols and their potential application in neurorehabilitation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本预实验研究评估了两种双极 400 Hz 皮层—小脑经颅脉冲电流刺激方案在健康成人中的可行性及其初步神经生理和行为效应。结果显示，M1 阳极/小脑阴极刺激可能增强皮质脊髓兴奋性、促进皮层内易化并改善手部灵巧性，而反向极性则可能降低皮质脊髓兴奋性。研究提示该刺激方式对运动系统具有极性依赖性调节作用，并为神经康复中的优化方案提供初步依据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 背景：经颅脉冲电流刺激（tPCS）是一种新兴的非侵入性神经调控方法，在神经康复中具有潜在应用价值。然而，刺激布置的极性对运动皮层兴奋性和运动功能的影响仍了解不足。本预实验研究考察了两种双极 400 Hz 皮层—小脑 tPCS 布置对健康成人皮质脊髓兴奋性、皮层—皮层兴奋性和手部灵巧性的可行性及初步神经生理和行为效应。方法：26 名健康成人参加了一项双盲、随机、假刺激对照、平衡交叉预实验研究。参与者完成三种刺激条件：（1）初级运动皮层阳极联合小脑阴极刺激（M1+/CB−），（2）反向极性刺激（M1−/CB+），以及（3）假刺激，各次实验间隔至少 48 小时。采用单脉冲经颅磁刺激评估皮质脊髓兴奋性，同时采用成对脉冲指标评估皮层内易化和抑制，以评价皮层—皮层兴奋性。在刺激前和刺激后即刻使用 Purdue 插板测验评估手部灵巧性。结果：与假刺激相比，M1+/CB− 布置产生了皮质脊髓兴奋性增强、皮层内易化增加和手部灵巧性改善的初步证据。相反，M1−/CB+ 布置导致皮质脊髓兴奋性降低，但未观察到皮层—皮层兴奋性或手部灵巧性的可测量变化。假刺激后未观察到显著变化。结论：本预实验研究表明，双极 400 Hz 皮层—小脑 tPCS 对运动系统功能产生极性依赖性调节。运动皮层阳极联合小脑阴极刺激可能促进皮质脊髓输出和运动表现，而反向极性可能产生抑制效应。这些初步发现为未来研究优化 tPCS 方案及其在神经康复中的潜在应用奠定了基础。

articles.title: Machine Learning the Phase Structure and Algebraic Invariants of Clifford- and Grassmann-Valued Cellular Automata
articles.title_zh: 利用机器学习研究 Clifford 值与 Grassmann 值元胞自动机的相结构和代数不变量
articles.abstract: The application of data-science methods to the discovery of mathematical structure, from the string landscape to topological invariants, representation theory and automated conjecture generation, has grown into a distinct branch of experimental mathematics. In the spirit of that programme, and of the interests of this collection, we ask what machine learning can reveal about Clifford and Grassmann algebras when those algebras are used to drive a discrete dynamical system. We introduce a family of normalized multivector-valued cellular automata whose sites carry states in the Clifford algebra Cl(p, q) or in the exterior (Grassmann) algebra Λ(V), and treat the automaton as a generator of algebra-labeled dynamical data. Using grade-resolved algebraic statistics, grade energy and entropy, a grade-mixing index, a stabilized Clifford energy and perturbation-growth descriptors, we (i) compute two-parameter phase diagrams for Cl(2,0), Cl(3,0), Cl(1,2), Cl(1,3), and the nilpotent Grassmann algebra Λ(V), exposing ordered, periodic, chaotic grade-mixing, algebraically constrained, and intermittent regimes; (ii) show that grade entropy and an effective Lyapunov exponent act as coincident order parameters; and (iii) demonstrate that unsupervised learning recovers the phase organization directly from trajectory descriptors. Crucially for the experimental-mathematics setting, supervised learning recovers the generating algebra and its metric-signature class from dynamical observables alone. Under a genuinely blind protocol, using eight descriptors computed in Euclidean coefficient space that contain neither the algebra dimension nor the Clifford metric, and folds grouped so that every algebra at a parameter coordinate shares a fold, the signature class is recovered with 87% accuracy (chance level 33%), and a definite-versus-indefinite classifier trained on one algebra pair transfers to the other at 81–94% balanced accuracy (chance level 50%); the dynamics carry a learnable, transferable algebraic fingerprint, although a normalization control shows that the metric normalization contributes part of it. Finally, symbolic regression proposes a compact candidate scaling relation for the onset of chaos, λₑff ≈ 0.41 · Hₛₚₑc³.33, and a depth-three decision tree reproduces all five phase labels with 98.3% fidelity as an interpretable surrogate. A matched-protocol comparison across scalar, complex, quaternionic, Clifford, and Grassmann automata shows that phase diversity is not monotone in algebra dimension. A normalization control, however, shows that the collapse of the indefinite algebras is produced by the interaction of the indefinite bilinear form with the normalization step rather than by the signature of the product itself: under a common Euclidean coefficient normalization, the indefinite algebras recover a phase diversity comparable to the definite ones.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将机器学习用于由 Clifford 代数和 Grassmann 代数驱动的多向量值元胞自动机，探索其相图、动力学描述符和可学习的代数指纹。结果表明，等级熵和有效 Lyapunov 指数可作为相变序参量，无监督学习能够恢复相组织，监督学习可从动力学观测中识别生成代数及其度量符号类别。研究还提出了混沌起始的候选标度关系，并指出相多样性并不随代数维数单调增加。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 将数据科学方法应用于数学结构的发现——从弦景观到拓扑不变量、表示论和自动猜想生成——已经发展成为实验数学的一个独特分支。本着这一计划以及本专辑关注点的精神，我们询问：当 Clifford 代数和 Grassmann 代数被用于驱动离散动力系统时，机器学习能够揭示什么。我们引入一族归一化的多向量值元胞自动机，其格点状态取值于 Clifford 代数 Cl(p, q) 或外代数（Grassmann 代数）Λ(V)，并将该自动机视为代数标记动力学数据的生成器。利用按等级分解的代数统计量、等级能量和熵、等级混合指数、稳定化 Clifford 能量以及扰动增长描述符，我们：（i）计算 Cl(2,0)、Cl(3,0)、Cl(1,2)、Cl(1,3) 以及幂零 Grassmann 代数 Λ(V) 的双参数相图，揭示有序、周期、混沌等级混合、代数约束和间歇性等区域；（ii）表明等级熵和有效 Lyapunov 指数可作为相互一致的序参量；（iii）证明无监督学习能够直接从轨迹描述符中恢复相组织。对于实验数学背景而言，关键的是，监督学习能够仅从动力学观测量中恢复生成代数及其度量符号类别。在真正盲测的协议下，使用在欧氏系数空间中计算的八个描述符，这些描述符既不包含代数维数，也不包含 Clifford 度量，并且将折叠分组为使参数坐标上的每个代数都共享同一折，符号类别以 87% 的准确率被恢复（机会水平为 33%）；在一对代数上训练的“定号对不定号”分类器迁移到另一对代数时达到 81–94% 的平衡准确率（机会水平为 50%）；这些动力学携带一种可学习、可迁移的代数指纹，尽管归一化对照显示度量归一化贡献了其中一部分。最后，符号回归提出了混沌起始的一个紧凑候选标度关系，λₑff ≈ 0.41 · Hₛₚₑc³.33，并且一个三层深度的决策树以 98.3% 的保真度复现了全部五种相标签，作为一种可解释的替代模型。在标量、复数、四元数、Clifford 和 Grassmann 自动机之间进行的匹配协议比较表明，相多样性并不随代数维数单调变化。然而，一个归一化对照显示，不定号代数的塌缩是由不定双线性型与归一化步骤之间的相互作用产生的，而不是由乘积本身的符号导致的：在共同的欧氏系数归一化下，不定号代数恢复了与定号代数相当的相多样性。

articles.title: Solar-driven photocatalytic ceramic membrane reactors from Tunisian clay for efficient paracetamol degradation
articles.title_zh: 利用突尼斯黏土制备的太阳能驱动光催化陶瓷膜反应器用于高效降解对乙酰氨基酚
articles.abstract: Pharmaceutical residues such as paracetamol are increasingly detected in aquatic environments, raising concerns about their persistence and potential ecological impact. In this study, a solar-driven photocatalytic membrane reactor (PMR) was developed using low-cost ceramic membranes fabricated from Matmata-Gabes clay (southern Tunisia) and functionalized with TiO2 P25. The membranes were prepared by uniaxial pressing followed by sintering at 1000°C, while TiO2 was immobilized via dip-coating and calcined at 450°C. The influence of catalyst loading and operating conditions was systematically investigated under both UV irradiation and natural sunlight. The results indicate that increasing TiO2 loading improves surface hydrophilicity with the water contact angle decreasing to 17.5°, but excessive deposition reduces membrane porosity and permeability. Optimal performance was achieved at 0.6 g/L 1.0 and g/L of TiO2 loading solution concentration under UV and solar conditions, respectively leading to degradation efficiencies of 74.9% and 55.5% after 5.5 h of treatment. In addition, horizontal membrane configuration (0° inclination) enhanced photon utilization resulting in improved reaction kinetics. Although permeate flux declined over time due to fouling, the photocatalytic layer contributed to partial self-cleaning under irradiation. Over five consecutive cycles, the membranes retained more than 35% of their initial activity, indicating moderate stability. These findings demonstrate the potential of combining locally available materials with solar photocatalysis as a sustainable approach for decentralized water treatment, particularly in regions with high solar irradiance.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究使用突尼斯南部 Matmata-Gabes 黏土制备低成本陶瓷膜，并负载 TiO2 P25 构建太阳能驱动光催化膜反应器，用于降解水中对乙酰氨基酚。结果表明，适当 TiO2 负载可提高亲水性和降解效率，但过量沉积会降低孔隙率和渗透性；水平膜构型有利于光子利用和反应动力学。膜在多次循环后仍保留一定活性，显示出用于高日照地区分散式水处理的潜力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对乙酰氨基酚等药物残留物在水环境中被越来越多地检测到，引发了人们对其持久性和潜在生态影响的担忧。本研究开发了一种太阳能驱动的光催化膜反应器（PMR），该反应器采用由 Matmata-Gabes 黏土（突尼斯南部）制备的低成本陶瓷膜，并用 TiO2 P25 进行功能化。膜通过单轴压制后在 1000°C 烧结制备，而 TiO2 通过浸涂固定并在 450°C 煅烧。研究在紫外照射和自然太阳光下系统考察了催化剂负载量和运行条件的影响。结果表明，增加 TiO2 负载量可改善表面亲水性，使水接触角降低至 17.5°，但过量沉积会降低膜孔隙率和渗透性。在紫外和太阳光条件下，分别以 0.6 g/L 和 1.0 g/L 的 TiO2 负载溶液浓度获得最佳性能，经 5.5 小时处理后降解效率分别达到 74.9% 和 55.5%。此外，水平膜构型（0° 倾角）增强了光子利用，从而改善了反应动力学。尽管由于污染，渗透通量随时间下降，但光催化层在照射下有助于部分自清洁。经过五个连续循环后，膜仍保留超过 35% 的初始活性，表明其具有中等稳定性。这些发现证明，将当地可获得材料与太阳能光催化相结合，是一种可持续的分散式水处理方法，尤其适用于太阳辐照度高的地区。

articles.title: Indirect electrification enables the 2°C goal without reliance on carbon dioxide removal
articles.title_zh: 间接电气化使不依赖二氧化碳去除实现 2°C 目标成为可能
articles.abstract: Achieving the Paris Agreement’s 2°C goal has generally been considered to require carbon dioxide removal (CDR); however, large-scale CDR deployment faces technical and societal challenges. Strategies to reduce reliance on CDR have mainly focused on lower energy demand and direct electrification. However, it remains unclear whether the 2°C goal can be achieved by maximizing indirect electrification without reliance on CDR. Here, we used an energy system model to assess the feasibility of such pathways. Indirect electrification is a potential enabler, but rapidly expanding renewables and electrolyzers, as well as widespread electrification and hydrogen use on the demand side, present substantial technical challenges. Furthermore, constraining CDR increases total mitigation costs by approximately 20% over the twenty-first century. These results indicate that CDR is not necessarily indispensable to achieving the 2°C goal, provided that the technical challenges of scaling up indirect electrification across the energy system can be addressed.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究使用能源系统模型评估在不依赖二氧化碳去除的情况下，通过最大化间接电气化实现《巴黎协定》2°C 目标的可行性。结果显示，间接电气化可能成为关键促成因素，但需要快速扩张可再生能源和电解槽，并在需求侧广泛推进电气化和氢能使用。限制二氧化碳去除会增加减排成本，但研究认为只要克服系统扩张挑战，CDR 并非实现 2°C 目标的绝对必要条件。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 实现《巴黎协定》的 2°C 目标通常被认为需要二氧化碳去除（CDR）；然而，大规模部署 CDR 面临技术和社会挑战。减少对 CDR 依赖的策略主要集中在降低能源需求和直接电气化上。然而，通过最大化间接电气化且不依赖 CDR 是否能够实现 2°C 目标仍不清楚。在这里，我们使用能源系统模型评估了此类路径的可行性。间接电气化是一种潜在的促成因素，但快速扩张可再生能源和电解槽，以及在需求侧广泛推进电气化和氢能使用，带来了重大的技术挑战。此外，限制 CDR 会使 21 世纪的总减排成本增加约 20%。这些结果表明，只要能够解决在整个能源系统中扩大间接电气化规模的技术挑战，CDR 对实现 2°C 目标并非必不可少。

articles.title: Fractal morphology-governed structural build-up in reactive particulate suspensions: insights from tricalcium silicate hydration
articles.title_zh: 分形形貌控制的反应性颗粒悬浮液结构构建：来自硅酸三钙水化的启示
articles.abstract: Structure formation in reactive particulate suspensions is governed by the coupled evolution of particle connectivity, interfacial growth, and multiscale morphology. This study applies a modeling framework that integrates boundary nucleation and growth (BNG) kinetics with a fractal-based hydrate-bridging model for tricalcium silicate (C₃S) pastes. The framework describes the evolution of structural build-up measured by slow penetration tests and small-amplitude oscillatory shear (SAOS) across different water-to-solid ratios and calcium nitrate dosages. A fitted fractal-related parameter, β, is used as a model-derived descriptor of hydrate morphology and internal connectivity. The trends in β are corroborated by observations from scanning electron microscopy (SEM), dynamic light scattering (DLS), and ¹H nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR). In calcium nitrate-modified systems, the reduced hydrate size is consistent with classical dissolution-precipitation theory. At comparable hydration levels, β shows a positive correlation with T₂ relaxation time differences, suggesting that hydrate morphology influences pore filling. The temporal evolution of β, showing initial simplification followed by re-complexification, is consistent with Monte Carlo simulations. These results provide a physically informed interpretation of the link between hydrate-scale structural evolution and early-age rheological behavior within the proposed modeling framework.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出将边界成核与生长动力学同基于分形的水化物桥联模型相结合的框架，用于描述硅酸三钙浆体早期结构构建。模型参数 β 被用作水化物形貌和内部连通性的描述符，并得到 SEM、DLS 和 ¹H NMR 等观测支持。结果为理解水化物尺度结构演化与早龄期流变行为之间的联系提供了物理解释。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反应性颗粒悬浮液中的结构形成受颗粒连通性、界面生长和多尺度形貌耦合演化的控制。本研究将一种整合边界成核与生长（BNG）动力学以及基于分形的水化物桥联模型的建模框架应用于硅酸三钙（C₃S）浆体。该框架描述了在不同水固比和硝酸钙掺量下，通过慢速贯入试验和小振幅振荡剪切（SAOS）测得的结构构建演化。拟合得到的分形相关参数 β 被用作模型推导的水化物形貌和内部连通性描述符。β 的变化趋势得到了扫描电子显微镜（SEM）、动态光散射（DLS）和 ¹H 核磁共振（NMR）观测的印证。在硝酸钙改性体系中，水化物尺寸减小与经典溶解—沉淀理论一致。在相近水化程度下，β 与 T₂ 弛豫时间差呈正相关，表明水化物形貌会影响孔隙填充。β 的时间演化表现为初始简化随后重新复杂化，这与 Monte Carlo 模拟一致。这些结果在所提出的建模框架内，为水化物尺度结构演化与早龄期流变行为之间的联系提供了具有物理依据的解释。

articles.title: Electrons on Helium and Entangled Quantum Sensors for Particle Physics
articles.title_zh: 液氦表面电子与用于粒子物理的纠缠量子传感器
articles.abstract: Quantum sensors that harness quantum coherence and entanglement are emerging as powerful tools in many fields, including particle physics, promising unprecedented sensitivity beyond classical detection methods. At the same time, electrons trapped on the surface of liquid helium have emerged as a promising quantum computing, and possibly sensing, platform owing to a nearly impurity-free environment and large predicted coherence times. In this context, single-electron confinement and control using microfabricated traps on helium has been experimentally demonstrated, highlighting the feasibility of scalable qubit architectures on this platform. Leveraging these features, and in line with CERN’s Detector R&D Initiative 5 (DRD5)1 on Quantum Sensors, we propose here a sensor concept that uses an entangled pair of electron qubits on superfluid helium for particle physics experiments. We outline the motivation for such spatially and spin-entangled sensors, develop the theoretical formalism for two electrons and their spins and spatial degrees of freedom in a helium-based double-well trap (analogous to a double quantum dot in semiconductor systems), and discuss the potential advantages for detecting rare high-energy events with quantum-enhanced sensitivity. By exploiting quantum entanglement between the two trapped electrons, this sensor concept can surpass classical sensitivity limits.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出一种基于超流氦表面纠缠电子量子比特对的粒子物理量子传感器概念。作者讨论了液氦表面电子作为量子计算和传感平台的优势，并建立双阱俘获中两个电子自旋与空间自由度的理论形式。该概念旨在利用空间和自旋纠缠实现对罕见高能事件的量子增强探测。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 利用量子相干性和纠缠的量子传感器正在成为许多领域中的强大工具，包括粒子物理，并有望实现超越经典探测方法的前所未有的灵敏度。与此同时，被俘获在液氦表面的电子由于几乎无杂质的环境和预测的长相干时间，已经成为一种有前景的量子计算平台，并且可能也是传感平台。在这一背景下，已经通过实验展示了利用氦表面微加工陷阱对单电子进行限制和控制，突显了在该平台上构建可扩展量子比特架构的可行性。利用这些特性，并与 CERN 探测器研发倡议 5（DRD5）中关于量子传感器的方向一致，我们在此提出一种传感器概念，该概念在粒子物理实验中使用超流氦上的一对纠缠电子量子比特。我们阐述了这种空间纠缠和自旋纠缠传感器的动机，发展了在基于氦的双阱陷阱中两个电子及其自旋和空间自由度的理论形式（类似于半导体系统中的双量子点），并讨论了其以量子增强灵敏度探测罕见高能事件的潜在优势。通过利用两个被俘获电子之间的量子纠缠，这一传感器概念能够超越经典灵敏度极限。

articles.title: A Computational Investigation of the Conserved OCT4 Linker Identifies a Candidate Structural Interface Underlying Pluripotency
articles.title_zh: 对保守 OCT4 连接区的计算研究识别出潜在的多能性结构界面
articles.abstract: OCT4 is a pioneer transcription factor indispensable for cellular reprogramming and pluripotency. While structural variants like OCT1 and OCT6 share the canonical octamer DNA-binding motif (5'-ATTTGCAT-3'), they lack reprogramming capacity. Landmark experimental studies established that a 17-amino-acid alpha-helical linker dictates this functional specificity, yet a detailed structural-evolutionary mapping of this critical interface remains incomplete. Here, we present a systematic in silico comparative analysis profiling the sequence divergence, cross-species conservation, and spatial microenvironment of the POU–linker interface across mammalian orthologs. Utilizing multiple sequence alignments and structural microenvironment mapping via PDB/UniProt databases, we demonstrate near-absolute structural constraint (94.1% sequence identity) across mammalian species, marked strictly by a single conservative Alanine-to-Serine substitution at position 11. Spatial coordinate mapping reveals that the key functional residue Gln81 (Q81) operates within a complex, chemically mixed network stabilized by a direct hydrogen bond to Tyr25 of the POU-specific domain, rather than interacting with DNA. By systematically auditing alternatives—including the 9aaTAD transactivation motif and SOX2-binding topographies—our models provide an evolutionary rationale for why localized perturbations like the Q81R mutation selectively dismantle pluripotency networks while leaving baseline DNA-binding machinery intact. This work provides a refined computational framework to guide future molecular dynamics simulations and targeted wet-lab mutagenesis strategies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过计算比较分析 OCT4 的 POU—连接区界面，探讨其在细胞重编程和多能性中的结构与进化基础。结果显示，该 17 个氨基酸 α 螺旋连接区在哺乳动物中高度保守，关键残基 Q81 位于复杂化学网络中并与 POU 特异结构域 Tyr25 形成氢键，而非直接与 DNA 作用。研究为解释 Q81R 等局部突变选择性破坏多能性网络提供了模型，并为后续分子动力学和实验突变研究提供框架。
articles.abstract_zh_full: OCT4 是一种先锋转录因子，对细胞重编程和多能性不可或缺。尽管 OCT1 和 OCT6 等结构变体共享经典的八聚体 DNA 结合基序（5'-ATTTGCAT-3'），它们却缺乏重编程能力。里程碑式的实验研究确定，一个由 17 个氨基酸组成的 α 螺旋连接区决定了这种功能特异性，但对这一关键界面的详细结构—进化映射仍不完整。在这里，我们提出一项系统的计算机比较分析，对哺乳动物直系同源物中 POU—连接区界面的序列分化、跨物种保守性和空间微环境进行剖析。利用多序列比对以及通过 PDB/UniProt 数据库进行的结构微环境映射，我们证明了哺乳动物物种间存在近乎绝对的结构约束（94.1% 序列一致性），其严格标志仅为第 11 位一个保守性的丙氨酸到丝氨酸替换。空间坐标映射显示，关键功能残基 Gln81（Q81）在一个复杂的化学混合网络中发挥作用，该网络由其与 POU 特异结构域 Tyr25 的直接氢键稳定，而不是通过与 DNA 相互作用实现。通过系统审查其他可能性——包括 9aaTAD 转录激活基序和 SOX2 结合拓扑——我们的模型为为何 Q81R 突变等局部扰动会选择性瓦解多能性网络、同时保留基本 DNA 结合机制提供了进化依据。本工作提供了一个精细化的计算框架，可用于指导未来的分子动力学模拟和靶向湿实验突变策略。

articles.title: Mixed Convection Darcy-Forchheimer MHD flow and radiative heat transfer of water-ethylene glycol hybrid fluid based copper nanofluid via a permeable stretching surface with convective boundary conditions
articles.title_zh: 具有对流边界条件的可渗透拉伸表面上水—乙二醇基铜混合纳米流体的混合对流 Darcy–Forchheimer 磁流体动力学流动与辐射传热
articles.abstract: In the present manuscript, the influence of thermal radiation on mixed convection magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) flow and heat transfer of a hybrid nanofluid over a stretching permeable surface embedded in a Darcy–Forchheimer porous medium is investigated. The study incorporates the effects of convective boundary conditions, Joule heating, internal heat generation, and viscous dissipation. The governing equations are formulated using the boundary layer approximation in a Cartesian coordinate system. By employing suitable similarity transformations, the partial differential equations are reduced to a system of ordinary differential equations, which are subsequently solved using the Differential Transform Method (DTM). The effects of key physical parameters on the Nusselt number, skin-friction coefficient, temperature distribution and velocity profile are analyzed through graphical representations. The results reveal that an increase in the mixed convection parameter enhances radiative heat transfer, whereas the opposite trend is observed for the Brinkman number. Furthermore, the radiative heat transfer rate increases with a higher Biot number in the presence of suction, while it decreases under injection conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究分析了嵌入 Darcy–Forchheimer 多孔介质的可渗透拉伸表面上混合纳米流体的混合对流 MHD 流动与传热，并考虑热辐射、对流边界、焦耳热、内热源和黏性耗散等效应。通过相似变换将控制方程化为常微分方程，并用微分变换法求解。结果表明，混合对流参数会增强辐射传热，而 Brinkman 数呈相反趋势；Biot 数对传热速率的影响取决于吸入或注入条件。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本文中，研究了热辐射对嵌入 Darcy–Forchheimer 多孔介质中的拉伸可渗透表面上混合纳米流体的混合对流磁流体动力学（MHD）流动与传热的影响。该研究纳入了对流边界条件、焦耳热、内部热生成和黏性耗散的效应。采用笛卡尔坐标系中的边界层近似建立控制方程。通过使用适当的相似变换，偏微分方程被化简为一组常微分方程，随后使用微分变换法（DTM）求解。通过图形表示分析了关键物理参数对 Nusselt 数、表面摩擦系数、温度分布和速度剖面的影响。结果表明，混合对流参数的增加会增强辐射传热，而 Brinkman 数则表现出相反趋势。此外，在存在吸入时，辐射传热速率随 Biot 数增大而增加，而在注入条件下则降低。

articles.title: Nonresonant nonlinear magnonics in an antiferromagnet
articles.title_zh: 反铁磁体中的非共振非线性磁振子学
articles.abstract: Antiferromagnets exhibit rapid spin dynamics in a net zero magnetic background which enables novel spintronic applications and interrogation of manybody quantum phenomena. The layered antiferromagnet Sr2IrO4 hosts an exotic spin one-half Mott insulating state with an electronic gap arising from on-site Coulomb repulsion and strong spin-orbit coupling. This makes Sr2IrO4 an interesting candidate to interrogate dynamical attributes of the magnetic order using ultrafast laser pulses. We investigate the magnetization dynamics of Sr2IrO4 following circularly polarized photoexcitation with below-gap mid-infrared (mid-IR – 9 μm) and above-gap near-infrared (near-IR – 1.3 μm) pulses. In both cases, we observe excitation of a zone-center coherent magnon mode featuring a 0.5 THz oscillation in the pump-induced Kerr-rotation signal. However, only below-gap excitation exhibits a helicity dependent response and linear (quadratic) scaling of the coherent magnon amplitude with excitation fluence (electric field). Moreover, below-gap excitation has a magnon generation efficiency that is at least two orders of magnitude greater in comparison to above-gap excitation. Our analysis shows that the helicity dependence and enhanced generation efficiency are consistent with a one-photon–two-magnon coupling mechanism for magnon generation. Thus, preferential spin-photon coupling without resonant photoexcitation of electrons permits extremely efficient magnon generation. Our results reveal new possibilities for ultrafast control of antiferromagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用低于带隙的中红外和高于带隙的近红外圆偏振光激发层状反铁磁体 Sr2IrO4，并观测其超快磁化动力学。两种激发均产生区中心相干磁振子模式，但只有低于带隙激发表现出螺旋度依赖响应、更强效率以及与电场平方对应的标度关系。研究认为这与单光子—双磁振子耦合机制一致，表明无需共振激发电子即可高效产生磁振子。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反铁磁体在净零磁背景中表现出快速自旋动力学，这使其能够用于新型自旋电子学应用，并可用于探测多体量子现象。层状反铁磁体 Sr2IrO4 具有一种奇异的自旋 1/2 Mott 绝缘态，其电子能隙源自局域 Coulomb 排斥和强自旋—轨道耦合。这使得 Sr2IrO4 成为利用超快激光脉冲探测磁有序动力学属性的有趣候选材料。我们研究了 Sr2IrO4 在低于带隙的中红外（mid-IR，9 μm）和高于带隙的近红外（near-IR，1.3 μm）圆偏振光激发后的磁化动力学。在两种情况下，我们都观察到区中心相干磁振子模式的激发，其特征是在泵浦诱导 Kerr 旋转信号中出现 0.5 THz 振荡。然而，只有低于带隙的激发表现出螺旋度依赖响应，并且相干磁振子振幅随激发通量（电场）呈线性（二次）标度。此外，与高于带隙激发相比，低于带隙激发的磁振子产生效率至少高出两个数量级。我们的分析表明，螺旋度依赖性和增强的产生效率与一种用于磁振子产生的单光子—双磁振子耦合机制一致。因此，在不发生电子共振光激发的情况下，选择性自旋—光子耦合能够实现极其高效的磁振子产生。我们的结果揭示了反铁磁体超快控制的新可能性。

articles.title: Technological Diversification or Structural Convergence? Türkiye's EPO Patent Portfolio in Comparative Perspective (2016-2025
articles.title_zh: 技术多元化还是结构趋同？2016—2025 年 Türkiye 在欧洲专利局专利组合的比较视角
articles.abstract: This article examines whether Türkiye's European Patent Office (EPO) patent portfolio became more diversified between 2016 and 2025 and whether the observed transformation represented structural convergence with major technology centres. It treats national patent portfolios as observable outcomes of accumulated industrial capabilities and institutional configurations, thereby linking patent analysis to comparative innovation systems. The dataset covers annual EPO applications in 35 technology fields for Türkiye, the United States, China, Japan, South Korea, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Italy, Spain, and Russia. Two five-year periods, 2016-2020 and 2021-2025, are compared using the Revealed Technological Advantage Index, the Herfindahl-Hirschman Index, normalised Shannon entropy, cosine similarity, and the Finger-Kreinin Index. Exact permutation tests, effect sizes, chi-square tests, and false-discovery-rate corrections complement the portfolio measures. Türkiye's five-year applications rose only from 3,069 to 3,109, while its share of total EPO applications declined from 0.3575 to 0.3168 per cent. Nevertheless, concentration fell and diversity increased. Relative specialisation strengthened in pharmaceuticals, chemical engineering, materials, environmental technologies, and special machinery, but weakened in computer technology, digital communication, telecommunications, audiovisual technology, and semiconductors. Similarity with the Europe-5 increased, whereas similarity with the Asia-3 and the United States declined. The results indicate selective, path-dependent convergence towards Europe's applied industrial profile rather than broad convergence with the digital-electronics frontier. The article contributes to comparative economics by distinguishing diversification from structural convergence and by showing how different innovation-system configurations are reflected in the composition of national patent portfolios. JEL codes: O31; O33; O38; O57; P51
articles.abstract_zh: 该文考察 2016—2025 年 Türkiye 在欧洲专利局的专利组合是否更加多元化，以及这种变化是否代表与主要技术中心的结构趋同。结果显示，尽管申请量增长有限且份额下降，Türkiye 的专利集中度下降、多样性提高，并在制药、化学工程、材料、环境技术和专用机械等领域相对专业化增强。研究认为，这体现了向欧洲应用型工业结构的选择性、路径依赖式趋同，而非向数字电子前沿的广泛趋同。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文考察 Türkiye 的欧洲专利局（EPO）专利组合在 2016 年至 2025 年之间是否变得更加多元化，以及所观察到的转型是否代表了与主要技术中心的结构趋同。文章将国家专利组合作为累积工业能力和制度配置的可观察结果，从而将专利分析与比较创新体系联系起来。数据集涵盖 Türkiye、美国、中国、日本、韩国、德国、法国、英国、意大利、西班牙和俄罗斯在 35 个技术领域的年度 EPO 申请。研究比较了 2016—2020 年和 2021—2025 年两个五年期，并使用显性技术优势指数、Herfindahl-Hirschman 指数、归一化 Shannon 熵、余弦相似度和 Finger-Kreinin 指数。精确置换检验、效应量、卡方检验和错误发现率校正对组合指标进行了补充。Türkiye 的五年申请量仅从 3,069 件增加到 3,109 件，而其在 EPO 申请总量中的份额从 0.3575% 下降到 0.3168%。尽管如此，集中度下降，多样性增加。相对专业化在制药、化学工程、材料、环境技术和专用机械领域增强，但在计算机技术、数字通信、电信、视听技术和半导体领域减弱。与欧洲五国的相似性增加，而与亚洲三国和美国的相似性下降。结果表明，Türkiye 出现的是向欧洲应用型工业特征的选择性、路径依赖式趋同，而不是与数字电子前沿的广泛趋同。本文通过区分多元化与结构趋同，并展示不同创新体系配置如何反映在国家专利组合构成中，对比较经济学作出贡献。JEL 代码：O31；O33；O38；O57；P51。
