For many-particle systems, we construct a prior distribution based on the Hessian at a local minimum of the potential, which ensures both rotation-translation invariance and physically meaningful configurations. We evaluate the proposed method across a variety of potential functions and collective variables, including alanine dipeptide in implicit solvent as a molecular benchmark. Comparative experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly improves sampling speed while maintaining accuracy.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 FES-FM，一种用于自由能面采样的降维流匹配方法，直接在集体变量空间中学习动力输运映射，从而实现对目标分布的高效采样与自由能面的重构。针对多粒子体系，作者基于势能局部极小点处的 Hessian 构造先验分布，以保持平移-旋转不变性并生成物理上合理的构型。数值实验覆盖多种势函数、集体变量及丙氨酸二肽基准体系，结果表明该方法在采样效率与重构质量上均具有明显优势。

articles.title: Diffusion-based Annealed Boltzmann Generators : benefits, pitfalls and hopes
articles.title_zh: 基于扩散模型的退火 Boltzmann 生成器：优势、局限与展望
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.21026v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Sampling configurations at thermodynamic equilibrium is a central challenge in statistical physics. Boltzmann Generators (BGs) tackle it by combining a generative model with a Monte Carlo (MC) correction step to obtain asymptotically unbiased samples from an unnormalized target. Most current BGs use classic MC mechanisms such as importance sampling, which both require tractable likelihoods from the backbone model and scale poorly in high-dimensional, multi-modal targets. We study BGs built on annealed Monte Carlo (aMC), which is designed to overcome these limitations by bridging a simple reference to the target through a sequence of intermediate densities. Diffusion models (DMs) are powerful generative models and have already been incorporated into aMC-based recalibration schemes via the diffusion-induced density path, making them appealing backbones for aMC-BGs. We provide an empirical meta-analysis of DM-based aMC-BGs on controlled multi-modal Gaussian mixtures (varying mode separation, number of modes, and dimension), explicitly disentangling inference effects from learning effects by comparing (i) a perfectly learned DM and (ii) a DM trained from data. Even with a perfect DM, standard integrations using only first-order stochastic denoising kernels fail systematically, whereas second-order denoising kernels can substantially improve performance when covariance information is available. We further propose a deterministic aMC integration based on first-order transport maps derived from DMs, which outperforms the stochastic first-order variant at higher computational cost. Finally, in the learned-DM setting, all DM-aMC variants struggle to produce accurate BGs; we trace the main bottleneck to inaccurate DM log-density estimation. Code available at https://github.com/h2o64/dabg.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究以扩散模型为骨干的退火 Monte Carlo 型 Boltzmann 生成器，旨在缓解传统生成式采样中对可处理似然和高维多峰分布适应性不足的问题。作者通过控制性的多峰高斯混合实验，对不同模态间距、模态数和维度条件下的性能进行元分析，并尽量区分学习误差与推断过程带来的影响。研究总结了这类方法的潜在优势与实际局限，并对其未来应用前景作出评估。

articles.title: BKP: An R Package for Beta Kernel Process Modeling
articles.title_zh: 用于贝塔核过程建模的 BKP R 软件包
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.10447v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Estimating input-dependent probability surfaces from binary, binomial, categorical, or multinomial response data is a common task in statistics and machine learning. Latent Gaussian process classifiers provide flexible nonparametric models for such problems, but posterior inference with discrete responses typically requires approximation or simulation. We discuss an implementation of probability-scale beta and Dirichlet kernel models in the pkgBKP package for proglangR. The package implements the Beta Kernel Process (BKP), which uses kernel-weighted pseudo-count aggregation and beta-binomial conjugacy to obtain closed-form conjugate posterior summaries and posterior predictive distributions for binomial probabilities. It also implements the Dirichlet Kernel Process (DKP) for multi-class responses, together with TwinBKP and TwinDKP, scalable twinning-based global-local approximations for larger datasets. The resulting workflow supports transparent kernel-weighted evidence borrowing, several kernel families, fixed and data-adaptive priors, effective-sample-size calibration, loss-based hyperparameter tuning, and standard S3 methods for fitting, prediction, simulation, visualization, and extraction of posterior summaries. Reproducible examples demonstrate probability-surface estimation, binary and multi-class classification, computational comparison, and real-data applications to emphLoa loa infection prevalence mapping and Mourning Warbler distribution modeling.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 R 语言软件包 pkgBKP，用于二元、二项、类别及多类别响应数据的概率尺度建模。该包实现了 Beta Kernel Process（BKP）与 Dirichlet Kernel Process（DKP），能够通过核加权的伪计数聚合和共轭更新给出封闭形式的后验摘要与后验预测分布。与此同时，软件包还提供 TwinBKP 和 TwinDKP 等可扩展近似方法，并支持核函数选择、先验设定与超参数调优。
authors: Jiangyan Zhao, Kunhai Qing, Jin Xu

articles.title: Achieving 100% Accuracy in Steel Surface Defect Classification Using a Custom High-Performance CNN
articles.title_zh: 利用定制高性能 CNN 实现钢材表面缺陷分类的 100% 准确率
articles.abstract: Steel surface defect detection is a critical task in industrial quality control. In this study, we propose a custom high-performance Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture specifically designed for classifying six types of steel surface defects using the NEU-CLS dataset. Our model achieves 100% accuracy, 100% precision, 100% recall, and 100% F1-score, establishing a new global state-of-the-art on the NEU-CLS benchmark. This result surpasses all previously reported methods and demonstrates that a well-engineered, task-specific architecture can outperform general-purpose models in specialized industrial inspection tasks. The code and trained models are publicly available for full reproducibility
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对 NEU-CLS 数据集上的六类钢材表面缺陷识别任务，设计了一种定制化高性能卷积神经网络。实验结果显示，该模型在准确率、精确率、召回率和 F1 值上均达到 100%，优于此前报道的方法。作者据此表明，面向特定工业检测场景的专用架构有望超越通用模型，并公开了代码与训练模型以支持复现。

articles.title: Assessing Geographic Accessibility to Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care in Kwara State, Nigeria: A Travel-Time and Referral Network Analysis
articles.title_zh: 尼日利亚夸拉州紧急产科与新生儿救治可及性评估：旅行时间与转诊网络分析
articles.abstract: Objective To quantify Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care (EmONC) geographic accessibility across Kwara State, Nigeria, and characterise referral connectivity between Basic EmONC (BEmONC) and Comprehensive EmONC (CEmONC) facilities.Methods Travel-time surfaces were computed using AccessMod version 5, a WHO-endorsed least-cost path modelling platform, with a validated facility dataset, satellite-derived land cover, road network data, hydrological barriers for the Kainji Lake system, and WorldPop 2020 population estimates across all 16 LGAs. Transport speed parameters were established through a participatory Travel Scenario Workshop. Population coverage was estimated at 30-, 60-, and 120-minute thresholds; referral travel times were computed for active BEmONC-to-CEmONC pathways.Results Against a state population of 3,205,923, only 7.0% could reach an EmONC facility within 30 minutes, rising to 24.7% within 60 minutes and 56.9% within 120 minutes; 43.1% (approximately 1.38 million) remained beyond two hours. LGA-level disparities were extreme: 120-minute coverage was only 30% in Baruten, 38% in Ifelodun, 53% in Kaiama, and 58% in Patigi, while Ilorin South achieved 100% coverage within 60 minutes. The referral analysis identified 205 active pathways with a mean travel time of 28.3 minutes; 22% exceeded 60 minutes.Conclusion Kwara State has a severe EmONC accessibility deficit requiring urgent investment. The primary challenge is not referral efficiency but the fundamental absence of any accessible first-contact facility across most of the state. Geospatially guided facility investment in Baruten, Kaiama, Ifelodun, and Patigi, combined with formalised emergency transport and integration of geospatial evidence into health planning, is necessary.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用 AccessMod 5 构建最小成本旅行时间表，评估尼日利亚夸拉州紧急产科与新生儿救治（EmONC）的地理可及性，并分析基础与综合 EmONC 设施之间的转诊连通性。研究综合了设施数据、遥感土地覆盖、道路网络、水体阻隔及人口栅格信息，计算 30、60 和 120 分钟阈值下的人口覆盖率。结果显示，该州不同地区医疗可达性差异显著，说明产科急救服务布局与转诊网络仍存在明显短板。

articles.title: Efficient Sensor Configuration for Accelerometer-based Silent Speech Interfaces: Regionally Distributed Sensor Placement Strategy Considering Articulatory Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 考虑构音动力学的区域分布式传感器布设策略：面向加速度计静默语音接口的高效配置
articles.abstract: Silent speech interfaces (SSIs) decode articulatory activity without audible speech. Although accelerometers can capture facial and neck movements in compact wearable setups, accelerometer-specific sensor placement has not been systematically examined. This study evaluated all combinations of ten accelerometers across the lower face and neck in a 100 English word silent speech classification task with 20 participants. Subject-dependent classification was performed using a convolutional neural network followed by a bidirectional long short-term memory network. Accuracy improved as the number of sensors increased, reaching a plateau with five sensors. At this point, Sensors 1, 4, 5, 7, and 8 achieved the highest accuracy of 92.30 ± 4.64% and were selected as the efficient configuration. Regional coverage comparisons showed that configurations spanning broader functional articulatory regions outperformed those with more restricted coverage. Together, these results support regionally distributed placement as a design strategy for capturing complementary articulatory information in compact accelerometer-based SSI systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文系统评估了下颌与颈部区域 10 个加速度计的全部组合，用于 20 名参与者的 100 个英文词静默语音分类任务。结果表明，随着传感器数量增加，分类性能先提升后趋于平台，在 5 个传感器时达到较优平衡。进一步分析发现，覆盖更广泛构音功能区域的布设方案优于覆盖范围较窄的方案，支持采用区域分布式传感器布局来获取互补的构音信息。

articles.title: Mitigation of cadmium, lead and copper uptake in French beans (Phaseolus vulgaris L.) using Vermicompost-assisted phytomanagement under contaminated irrigated soils
articles.title_zh: 利用蚯蚓堆肥辅助植物修复减轻污染灌溉土壤中菜豆对镉、铅和铜的吸收
articles.abstract: French bean (Phaseolus vulgaris L.) is a high-value vegetable crop widely grown under irrigated conditions; however, its production in contaminated soils raises concerns due to the accumulation of heavy metals in edible tissues. Continuous use of polluted irrigation water introduces cadmium (Cd), lead (Pb), and copper (Cu) into the soil–plant system, posing potential risks to human health through the food chain. This study evaluated the combined effects of irrigation methods and soil amendments on the uptake of Cd, Pb, and Cu in French bean grown under contaminated irrigated conditions in Kabaa Irrigation Scheme, Machakos County, Kenya. Field experiments were conducted during two consecutive cropping seasons (short rains 2021 and long rains 2022) using a split-plot arrangement in a randomized complete block design with three replications. Irrigation methods (basin and furrow) were assigned to main plots, while soil amendments (control, fertium, farmyard manure, gypsum + farmyard manure, and vermicompost) were applied to subplots. Heavy metal uptake in roots, shoots, and pods was determined based on biomass and tissue metal concentrations. Results showed that heavy metal accumulation varied significantly (p ≤ 0.05) across treatments, with roots consistently recording higher uptake than shoots and pods. Vermicompost markedly reduced Cd, Pb, and Cu uptake across plant tissues, with the lowest values observed in pod tissues (Pb: 0.003 kg ha⁻¹; Cd: 0.005 kg ha⁻¹; Cu: 0.01 kg ha⁻¹). Similarly, furrow irrigation consistently resulted in lower metal uptake compared to basin irrigation across both seasons. The combined application of vermicompost and furrow irrigation produced the greatest reduction in heavy metal accumulation. These reductions were associated with enhanced immobilization, adsorption, and complexation of metals within the soil matrix, alongside improved regulation of moisture dynamics in the root zone. From a remediation perspective, the findings demonstrate that integrating vermicompost with appropriate irrigation management can significantly limit metal mobility and transfer into edible plant parts. Therefore, this approach represents a practical and sustainable phytomanagement strategy for mitigating heavy metal risks in contaminated irrigated agroecosystems while supporting safer crop production.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在肯尼亚一处受污染灌溉系统中，考察了灌溉方式与土壤改良措施对菜豆体内镉、铅和铜吸收的影响。研究采用随机区组裂区设计，比较了盆灌与沟灌，以及对照、化肥、有机肥、石膏加有机肥和蚯蚓堆肥等处理。结果表明，不同灌溉与改良方案会显著影响重金属在根、茎叶和豆荚中的累积，蚯蚓堆肥等处理有望降低食用部位的重金属风险。

articles.title: A Comparative study of KNN-based piezoceramic composite synthesized by two different sintering methods
articles.title_zh: 两种烧结方法制备的 KNN 基压电陶瓷复合材料比较研究
articles.abstract: The presented work attempts to compare the electrical properties of lead-free piezoceramics 0.982(K0.485Na0.485Li0.03)(Nb0.96Sb0.04)O3-0.015Bi0.5Na0.5ZrO3-0.003SnO2 (KNN-BNZ-SnO2) fabricated by two different sintering techniques, namely two-step sintering method (TSS) and conventional sintering method (CS). Study of resulting ceramics using XRD profiles reveals pure perovskite form but exist distinct impacts of the two approaches of sintering on dielectric, ferroelectric and piezoelectric properties. Diffused phase transition around the Curie temperature with larger diffusivity (γ = 1.70) reveals that ceramic prepared by two-step sintering method behaves as stronger relaxor ferroelectric. Room temperature dielectric constant (εrt = 2496), remanent polarization (Pr = 9.55 µC/cm2) and piezoelectric coefficient (d33 = 288 pC/N), obtained from two-step sintering are greater than those (εrt = 1502, Pr = 5.53 µC/cm2, d33 = 221 pC/N) of conventional sintering. This study demonstrates that two-step sintering method is a better method in comparison to conventional sintering technique in enhancing the overall performance of this composite piezoceramics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文比较了两步烧结与常规烧结对无铅压电陶瓷 0.982(K0.485Na0.485Li0.03)(Nb0.96Sb0.04)O3-0.015Bi0.5Na0.5ZrO3-0.003SnO2 的结构与电学性能影响。XRD 结果显示两种方法均得到纯钙钛矿相，但两步烧结样品在介电、铁电和压电性能上表现更优，并呈现更强的弛豫铁电特征。与常规烧结相比，两步烧结可获得更高的介电常数、剩余极化和压电系数，说明其更有利于提升该类材料的综合性能。

articles.title: Deep-learning climate emulator ACE2 reveals a global decrease in tropical cyclone frequency in the 15th Century under an El Niño-like sea surface temperature pattern
articles.title_zh: 深度学习气候模拟器 ACE2 揭示：在类厄尔尼诺海温格局下，15 世纪全球热带气旋频数下降
articles.abstract: The relatively short modern observational record limits our understanding of the relationship between global tropical cyclone (TC) frequency and sea surface temperature (SST), resulting in uncertain future TC projections. Using novel deep-learning-based past-millennium simulations with the Ai2 Climate Emulator version 2 (ACE2), we provide insight into the connections between SSTs and TCs. ACE2 simulations reveal that the Atlantic and global tropical cyclone numbers decreased in the 15th Century under an El Niño-like SST pattern, consistent with the high-resolution dynamical climate model HiRAM, and Atlantic sediment proxies. Global TC frequency decreased mainly due to stronger vertical wind shear and the drier midtroposphere as the Hadley circulation strengthened. Conversely, global TC frequency would increase under a La Niña-like SST pattern, as shown in idealized SST experiments with ACE2. This study demonstrates an exciting opportunity to examine TC-climate interactions using deep-learning-based paleoclimate simulations and highlights the need to constrain future projections of SST patterns to accurately estimate TC frequency.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文借助 Ai2 Climate Emulator version 2（ACE2）开展过去千年气候模拟，探讨海表温度模态与全球热带气旋频数之间的关系。模拟结果显示，在类厄尔尼诺海温背景下，15 世纪大西洋及全球热带气旋数量下降，这与高分辨率动力气候模式和沉积物代用指标的结论相一致。研究进一步指出，气旋减少主要与垂直风切变增强和中对流层更干燥有关，而类拉尼娜型海温则可能导致气旋频数增加。

articles.title: Lithography-Free Terahertz Low Pass Filters from Quasiperiodic PDMS/Diamond Composites
articles.title_zh: 基于准周期 PDMS/金刚石复合材料的无光刻太赫兹低通滤波器
articles.abstract: A flexible terahertz (THz) optical low pass filter (LPF) based on a quasiperiodic polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS)/diamond composite is demonstrated. A key advantage is fabrication simplicity: the LPF is realized by electrically induced particle alignment and in situ curing in a single soft composite body, without metallic micropatterning, multilayer stacking, or cleanroom based lithography. THz time domain spectroscopy shows clear low pass behavior in two samples, including delayed and broadened transmitted pulses, high frequency attenuation, and strong stopband suppression. Frequency domain transmittance confirms different cutoff characteristics between samples, and the higher loading sample exhibits a better on/off ratio. These results show that practical LPF functionality can be achieved through a lithography free process route while preserving strong filtering behavior. The central conceptual contribution is a new quasiperiodic to predictive modeling route: optical micrographs are analyzed by two dimensional fast Fourier transform (2D FFT) to extract dominant wave number features, then mapped to an equivalent periodic lattice for transverse magnetic (TMy) finite difference time domain (FDTD) evaluation. This model reproduces the essential low pass trend and the relative on/off performance difference between samples. Although the measured cutoff edge is smoother than the idealized prediction, the discrepancy is consistent with quasiperiodic disorder and experimental spectral window effects. The results provide both a practical low complexity fabrication strategy for soft THz LPFs and a transferable modeling framework for turning real quasiperiodic composite morphology into predictive electromagnetic design rules.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了一种基于准周期聚二甲基硅氧烷/金刚石复合材料的柔性太赫兹低通滤波器。该器件通过电场诱导颗粒取向与原位固化在单一软复合体中完成制备，无需金属微加工、多层堆叠或洁净室光刻工艺。太赫兹时域光谱表明样品具有明确的低通特性，且不同填充条件下截止行为与截止频率存在差异。作者还提出利用二维快速傅里叶变换从显微图像提取特征并映射到等效周期晶格的建模思路，用于后续电磁分析。

articles.title: Monitoring farmland soil moisture status in semi-arid regions using multi-source remote sensing fusion data and machine learning algorithms
articles.title_zh: 基于多源遥感融合数据与机器学习算法的半干旱区农田土壤水分监测
articles.abstract: To enable rapid and effective monitoring of the spatiotemporal dynamics of soil moisture (SM) across different growth stages and soil depths in spring maize fields in Northwest China, this study integrates optical vegetation indices (VIs) with radar backscatter features (RBFs) within a machine learning framework. The contributions of different features and their combinations to soil moisture prediction across various soil layers were analyzed, and the estimation potential of three models, XGBoost, SVR, and KNN, during key growth stages of spring maize was investigated. The results indicated that: (1) VIs and RBFs exhibited complementarity in soil moisture retrieval. Surface soil moisture was more sensitive to radar backscatter, whereas deeper soil moisture showed a stronger correlation with vegetation indices. As the growth stage progressed, the correlation between surface moisture and radar features gradually decreased, while the correlation between deeper moisture and radar features first increased and then decreased. (2) The XGBoost model consistently outperformed SVR and KNN across all growth stages, soil depths, and input feature combinations, achieving validation R² values ranging from 0.525 to 0.825, with significantly superior generalization capability. (3) The combined VI + RBF feature set outperformed single-feature inputs at all growth stages and depths, substantially improving soil moisture estimation accuracy. (4) SHAP-based global interpretation revealed that VV polarization served as the core driving feature for surface soil moisture estimation, whereas vegetation indices were more important for estimating deeper soil moisture. (5) Soil moisture exhibited pronounced spatiotemporal heterogeneity. At each growth stage, soil moisture increased with soil depth, with substantial surface variability and stable distribution at deeper layers. Temporally, soil moisture followed a unimodal trend across the growing season, first increasing and then decreasing, peaking at the tasseling stage and reaching its minimum at the jointing stage. This approach enables effective spatiotemporal dynamic monitoring of soil moisture in spring maize fields.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文面向中国西北春玉米田的土壤水分监测，融合光学植被指数与雷达后向散射特征，构建机器学习估算框架，以刻画不同生育阶段和不同土层的时空变化。研究比较了 XGBoost、SVR 和 KNN 三种模型，并分析了不同特征组合对土壤水分反演的贡献。结果表明，光学与雷达特征具有明显互补性，其中 XGBoost 在各生育期、各土层及不同输入组合下整体表现最佳。

articles.title: Spatial Segmentation and Controllable Connection Enabled Hollow Microsphere-Carbon Distributed RLC Networks for Multifunctional EM/Thermal Regulation
articles.title_zh: 具有空间分段与可控连接的空心微球-碳分布式 RLC 网络用于多功能电磁/热调控
articles.abstract: Lightweight hierarchical porous composites for electromagnetic (EM) wave attenuation and thermal management face a common trade‑off: conductive networks needed for dissipation often ruin impedance matching. Here we resolve this by an ice‑templated heterogeneous nucleation strategy. Magnetic dual-shell hollow microspheres (DSHM) serve as ice‑nucleating agents, directing nitrogen‑doped carbon nanosheets (N-CNSs) to bridge the isolated microspheres without forming continuous conductive shells. The resulting architecture is a distributed resistive‑inductive-capacitive (RLC) network. The optimized aerogel achieves a reflection loss of − 54.86 dB and an effective absorption bandwidth of 6.56 GHz at only 8 wt% filler, together with a thermal conductivity of 0.0605 W·m⁻¹·K⁻¹ and > 95% infrared absorptivity. Nitrogen doping (pyridinic/pyrrolic N) and nickel-induced graphitization of amorphous carbon enhance polarization and conduction losses, respectively. Resin infiltration further raises the compressive strength to 45.70 MPa without harming EM performance. This ice‑templated heterogeneous nucleation paradigm provides a generalizable route to program filler connectivity in carbon nanosheet networks for lightweight EM/thermal management.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过冰模板法的异质成核策略，构建了由磁性双壳空心微球与氮掺杂碳纳米片组成的轻质分级多孔复合材料。该结构促使碳纳米片桥接分散的微球而不形成连续导电壳层，从而形成分布式 RLC 网络，有利于阻抗匹配与多机制耗散协同。优化后的气凝胶在较低填料含量下即可实现优异的电磁波吸收、低热导率和高红外吸收率，同时经树脂浸渍后仍保持较高的力学强度。

articles.title: Effect of Mg-Controlled Solidification Pathways on Microstructure and Properties of As-Cast Al-1Y-xMg Alloys
articles.title_zh: Mg 控制凝固路径对铸态 Al-1Y-xMg 合金组织与性能的影响
articles.abstract: Understanding the relationships among solidification processing, microstructure, and properties is central to the design of advanced aluminum alloys. In this work, as-cast Al-1Y-xMg (x = 0–8 wt.%) alloys were prepared via conventional casting to investigate how Mg content controls solidification pathways and, consequently, the resulting microstructure and associated mechanical and thermal properties. With increasing Mg content, the solidification pathway evolves from isolated Y-rich phases to sequential precipitation of τ-AlxMgY and β-Al3Mg2, ultimately forming a continuous τ + β eutectic network at high Mg levels. The alloy with 6 wt.% Mg achieves a peak tensile strength of 158.0 MPa—approximately 95% higher than the Mg-free alloy—while retaining 11.0% uniform elongation, demonstrating a favorable strength-ductility balance. Concurrently, the eutectic network topology governs fracture behavior, transitioning from ductile dimple to quasi-cleavage, and mediates dynamic strain aging via Portevin-Le Chatelier serrations. Physically, electrical and thermal conductivities are continuously tunable within 28.2–51.8% IACS and 148–218 W·m− 1·K− 1, respectively. The dominant electron scattering mechanism shifts from solute-controlled scattering at low Mg contents to interface-controlled scattering at high Mg contents, directly correlating with the evolving eutectic network. This study establishes quantitative processing-microstructure-property relationships in Al-Mg-Y alloys, offering guidance for tailoring cast aluminum alloys for combined structural and thermal management applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了铸态 Al-1Y-xMg 合金中 Mg 含量对凝固路径、显微组织及性能的调控作用。结果表明，随着 Mg 增加，合金凝固过程由孤立的富 Y 相逐步演化为 τ-AlxMgY 与 β-Al3Mg2 的连续共晶网络。该共晶网络显著提升了合金强度与延展性的平衡，并进一步影响断裂行为、动态应变时效以及电导率和热导率等物理性能。

articles.title: ASSURE-BVLOS: An Assurance-Aware Space–Air–Ground Intelligence Framework for Risk-Adaptive Autonomous Operations
articles.title_zh: ASSURE-BVLOS：面向风险自适应自主运行的空间-空中-地面智能保障框架
articles.abstract: Beyond-visual-line-of-sight (BVLOS) unmanned aircraft operations increasingly depend on heterogeneous space-air-ground networks, on-board autonomy, remote sensing, edge computing and external geospatial information. Existing safety approaches typically assess these dependencies separately: command-and-control (C2) performance is treated as a communications problem, perception confidence as an autonomy problem, and operational authorisation as a pre-flight compliance problem. This separation creates an assurance gap because degradation can propagate across layers before any single subsystem crosses its conventional failure threshold. This method article introduces ASSURE-BVLOS, an assurance-aware architecture that combines five continuously updated risk dimensions: C2 integrity, sensing reliability, data freshness and provenance, environmental exposure, and vehicle health. A weighted multiplicative risk index, an explicit uncertainty penalty, hysteretic authority transitions and a digital safety-case evidence loop are defined. The method is evaluated using 100,000 reproducible Monte Carlo mission states spanning disaster response, linear-infrastructure inspection and maritime surveillance, with mixed terrestrial, low-Earth-orbit and geostationary links. Against a static, teleoperation-centred baseline, the proposed policy reduced simulated hazardous outcomes from 12.76% to 9.62%, corresponding to a 24.6% relative risk reduction, while eliminating simulated continuation under the predefined high-C2-risk condition. Sensitivity analysis indicates that benefits are retained across mission classes but depend strongly on correct threshold calibration and trustworthy input confidence. The contribution is not a certified control law; it is a transparent systems-engineering method for linking communications, sensing, data pipelines, autonomy and traceable runtime evidence. The framework is designed to support subsequent hardware-in-the-loop and flight-test validation and to provide a structured bridge between runtime assurance research and operation-centric risk assessment.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 ASSURE-BVLOS，一种面向超视距（BVLOS）无人机运行的保障感知型架构，用于整合空间、空中与地面异构网络中的风险信息。该框架将指挥控制完整性、传感可靠性、数据时效与溯源性、环境暴露以及飞行器健康五个维度纳入持续更新的风险评估，并结合权重式乘积风险指数、显式不确定性惩罚和滞回式权限切换机制。作者还通过数字化安全案例证据闭环与大规模蒙特卡洛仿真，对该方法在多类任务场景中的适用性进行了验证。

articles.title: Why Has Jupiter’s Great Red Spot Survived for Centuries? Jet Confinement, Potential-Vorticity Barriers, and Topology-State Metastability
articles.title_zh: 木星大红斑为何能存续数百年？喷流约束、位涡屏障与拓扑态亚稳性
articles.abstract: Jupiter’s Great Red Spot (GRS) is the longest-lived large atmospheric vortex known in the Solar System. Its persistent identity coexists with secular shrinkage and continuous morphological variability, indicating a driven, dissipative, metastable structure rather than a static equilibrium. We develop a bounded mechanism model that connects established local fluid dynamics to slow structural evolution. Quasi-geostrophic or multilayer shallow-water equations remain the physical backend. A coherent-vortex feasible set is defined by hard gates on anticyclonic polarity, confinement between neighboring jets, continuity of a potential-vorticity (PV) transport barrier, finite vertical coherence, and the absence of catastrophic merger or filamentation. Only within this feasible set is the physical state projected onto reduced coordinates comprising normalized circulation, compactness, PV-barrier integrity, vertical coherence, aspect ratio, and jet-clearance margin. A reduced free-energy landscape then ranks legal coherent states and describes their slow relaxation. A forced complex saturation equation is introduced as a branch-admissible normal form for an isolated coherent mode, not as a replacement for the local atmospheric equations. The proposed longevity mechanism is the joint action of lateral confinement by zonal jets, suppressed cross-boundary mixing by an annular PV barrier, an increased disruption scale due to vertical coherence, and environmental energy input that offsets dissipation. These processes raise the effective escape barrier from the coherent-anticyclone basin and thereby permit secular shrinkage without loss of vortex identity. We formulate falsifiable predictions: lifetime and post-perturbation recovery should correlate more strongly with PV-barrier integrity and vertical coherence than with visible area alone; genuine destabilization should be preceded by a joint decline in boundary PV gradient, compactness recovery rate, vertical phase locking, and jet-clearance margin. This is a testable response-level mechanism hypothesis, not a direct empirical proof of the centuries-long lifetime and not a universal topological body force.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文围绕木星大红斑长期存续这一问题，提出一个将局地流体动力学与缓慢结构演化联系起来的有界机制模型。作者以准地转或多层浅水方程作为物理基础，并定义了由旋涡极性、邻近喷流约束、位涡输运屏障连续性、垂直连贯性及并合/丝状化风险等条件组成的可行态集合。基于此，研究构建了简化自由能景观与分支可容许的正常形态描述，以解释大红斑的驱动耗散型亚稳结构特征。

articles.title: AI–IoT–Digital Twin Framework for Predictive Maintenance in Smart Manufacturing
articles.title_zh: 面向智能制造预测性维护的 AI–IoT–数字孪生框架
articles.abstract: The convergence of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), and Digital Twin (DT) technologies is revolutionizing modern manufacturing, yet existing implementations often remain fragmented, lacking real-time adaptability, human-centric integration, and scalable architecture. This study proposes a novel five-layer AI–IoT–DT framework designed to enable intelligent, sustainable, and human-aligned manufacturing systems. The architecture incorporates real-time data acquisition through IoT sensors, dynamic digital twin modeling for simulation and control, machine learning-driven analytics for predictive maintenance, AR-enabled interfaces for human–machine collaboration, and closed-loop feedback for continuous optimization. Validated in a Python-based simulation environment using synthetic industrial datasets, the framework demonstrated high predictive accuracy with LSTM models (F1-score: 0.93), a 27% reduction in unscheduled downtime, a 12.4% decrease in energy consumption per unit, and a 17% improvement in Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF). Additionally, operator cognitive load was reduced by 19% through AI-assisted interfaces. Comparative analysis with prior studies highlights the framework’s superior performance and unique emphasis on Industry 5.0 values—such as sustainability, human inclusion, and ethical AI deployment. This research offers a scalable, modular blueprint for transitioning from traditional automation to intelligent augmentation in manufacturing. Future work will focus on real-world deployment, integration with cybersquatting and edge computing, and adherence to international digital twin standards.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一个五层式 AI–IoT–数字孪生框架，用于构建智能、可持续且以人为中心的制造系统。该架构集成了物联网传感采集、动态数字孪生建模、机器学习驱动的预测性维护分析、增强现实人机协作界面以及闭环反馈优化机制。基于 Python 仿真与合成工业数据的验证表明，该框架可提升故障预测性能，并在降低非计划停机、能耗和操作员认知负荷方面表现出较好效果。

articles.title: Research on Voltage Unbalance in Shared Transmission Corridors Based on Capacitance Parameter Matrix Asymmetry
articles.title_zh: 基于电容参数矩阵非对称性的共用输电走廊电压不平衡研究
articles.abstract: Shared-right-of-way (SROW) corridors between 750 kV UHV transmission and 35 kV distribution lines are prevalent in Northwest China. The resulting three-phase voltage unbalance in distribution lines threatens power system reliability. This paper proposes a mechanism analysis method based on multi-conductor system capacitance matrix unbalance theory. By deconstructing capacitance matrices, the mechanism of zero-sequence voltage rise due to geometric asymmetry under strong electric field coupling is investigated. Capacitance matrices are extracted via finite element method (FEM). A line model incorporating distributed parameters and asymmetric coupling is developed to quantify the impacts of coupling distance, length, ratio, and load on zero-sequence voltage unbalance. Results show that unbalance decreases as distance increases, significantly beyond 100 m, but increases with coupling length and ratio. Loading causes the unbalance to drop sharply and stabilize after 200 kW. Furthermore, a BP neural network model using these factors yields a test correlation above 0.998 and an average relative error within 1%. This research provides an efficient assessment tool for the engineering design of SROW power lines.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对 750 kV 超高压输电与 35 kV 配电线路共用走廊中的三相电压不平衡问题，提出了一种基于多导体系统电容矩阵不平衡理论的机理分析方法。作者通过有限元方法提取电容矩阵，并建立包含分布参数与非对称耦合的线路模型，以定量评估耦合距离、耦合长度、线路比例和负载等因素对零序电压不平衡的影响。研究结果还表明，基于这些因素构建的 BP 神经网络可实现较高的预测精度，为工程设计与评估提供了工具。

articles.title: Metric-Based Few-Shot Learning Framework for User-Defined Vocabulary Registration in Electromyography-Based Silent Speech Interfaces
articles.title_zh: 面向肌电静默语音接口自定义词汇注册的度量型小样本学习框架
articles.abstract: Electromyography (EMG)-based silent speech interfaces (SSIs) enable hands-free communication by decoding articulatory muscle activity without vocalization. However, Existing SSI systems rely on predefined vocabularies, making personalized vocabulary registration difficult. Indeed, to enable recognition of user-defined vocabulary, conventional classifiers require repeated data collection and model training. To address this limitation, this study proposes a metric-based few-shot learning (FSL) framework for user-defined vocabulary recognition in EMG-based SSI. Four representative metric-learning approaches—Siamese, Matching, Relation, and Prototypical Networks—were evaluated and compared with a fine-tuning baseline. The effects of model training strategy, system-defined vocabulary size, and support set size were evaluated. EMG signals were recorded from 20 participants while they silently articulated 100 English words, which were partitioned into system-defined and user-defined vocabularies to simulate user customization scenarios. The best performance was achieved by pre-training on data from all participants followed by participant-specific metric learning. The Prototypical network showed the most robust performance, achieving 82.85% and 90.17% accuracy in a 20-way classification task under the one-shot and three-shot settings, respectively. The Prototypical network also maintained strong performance when the size of the system-defined vocabulary was reduced. The superior performance of the Prototypical network suggests that prototype-based representations are particularly effective for scalable user-defined vocabulary registration. Unlike conventional classifiers, metric-based FSL enables new vocabulary registration without updating model weights. This eliminates repeated retraining while reducing the need to store vocabulary-specific model parameters. Therefore, the proposed framework provides a practical and computationally efficient solution for user-customizable EMG-based SSIs, particularly on edge devices with limited computational and storage resources.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文面向基于肌电信号的静默语音接口，提出一种用于用户自定义词汇注册的度量型小样本学习框架。研究比较了 Siamese、Matching、Relation 和 Prototypical Network 等多种度量学习方法，并与微调基线进行了对照，以评估系统词汇规模、支持集大小及训练策略对识别性能的影响。基于 20 名参与者的 100 个英文词数据，结果表明先进行全体参与者预训练、再进行个体化度量学习的策略更有利于个性化词汇识别。

articles.title: Electrochemical Oxidation of p-Phenylenediamine in Aqueous Media: A pH-Dependent Study and Synthesis of a new trimer of p-Phenylenediamine
articles.title_zh: p-苯二胺在水溶液中的电化学氧化：pH依赖性研究及一种新型三聚体的合成
articles.abstract: The electrochemical oxidation of p-phenylenediamine (PPDA) was investigated in aqueous media over a wide pH range using cyclic voltammetry, controlled-potential coulometry, conductometric titration, and spectroscopic techniques. The results demonstrate that PPDA undergoes a two-electron, two-proton oxidation to form p-quinonediimine as the primary electroactive intermediate. The subsequent chemical behavior of this intermediate is strongly dependent on the solution pH. It is hydrolyzed in acidic media (pH lower than 4.0) and converted to p-benzoquinone via two successive hydrolysis reactions. At intermediate and weakly alkaline pHs, p-benzoquinonediimine is trimerized via two successive Michael addition reactions. Moreover, the protonation of p-phenylenediamine and the produced p-quinonediimine at various pHs was studied using conductometry. This work also provides a facile and one-pot electrochemical method for synthesizing a novel trimer of p-phenylenediamine via the electrochemical oxidation of PPDA under green conditions using a carbon electrode.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在宽pH范围内系统研究了p-苯二胺在水溶液中的电化学氧化行为，并结合循环伏安、控电位库仑、电导滴定和光谱技术进行分析。结果表明，p-苯二胺首先经历两电子、两质子氧化生成对苯醌二亚胺，该中间体的后续反应强烈依赖溶液pH：在酸性条件下发生水解并最终生成对苯醌，而在中性至弱碱性条件下则通过连续Michael加成形成三聚体。该工作还提出了一种在绿色条件下、以碳电极为基础的一锅法电化学合成新型p-苯二胺三聚体的方法。

articles.title: Self-configuring complex-valued photonic convolution accelerator based on cascaded Mach–Zehnder interferometers
articles.title_zh: 基于级联马赫-曾德尔干涉仪的自配置复数光子卷积加速器
articles.abstract: Complex-valued convolutional neural networks can jointly represent amplitude and phase information, making them well suited for wave-based data such as radar echoes, communication signals, spectral responses, and electromagnetic fields. To accelerate such networks in the photonic domain, the computing system must natively load, transform, and read out complex-valued signals while maintaining stable matrix programmability under device imperfections. Here we propose, fabricate, and demonstrate a self-configuring complex-valued photonic convolution accelerator (SCPCA), which combines a native complex-valued photonic computing architecture with a measurement-driven self-configuration algorithm. The architecture uses an IQ modulator, a cascaded Mach--Zehnder interferometer mesh, and coherent MMI-assisted balanced detection, thereby preserving complex-valued photonic signals across the full computing chain. The self-configuration algorithm directly optimizes the experimentally measured end-to-end complex-valued matrix response, enabling adaptation to the cascaded MZI architecture without device-by-device pre-calibration and compensating for practical nonidealities. Experiments show that SCPCA reaches convergence in six iterations on average and achieves an effective mapping precision of approximately 5 bits. We further apply SCPCA to polarimetric synthetic aperture radar image recognition, achieving 84.98% test accuracy on the AIRSAR San Francisco dataset, close to the 86.00% electronic baseline. These results provide a practical route toward native complex-valued photonic acceleration with low calibration burden.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出、制备并演示了一种自配置复数值光子卷积加速器，用于加速复数值卷积神经网络在光子域中的计算。该系统结合了原生复数光子计算架构与基于测量的自配置算法，使用IQ调制器、级联马赫-曾德尔干涉仪网络以及相干MMI辅助平衡探测，在完整计算链路中保持复数信号传输。自配置算法直接优化实验测得的端到端复矩阵响应，无需逐器件预校准，并可补偿实际器件非理想性，从而提升系统可编程性与鲁棒性。

articles.title: Topology from Decoherence
articles.title_zh: 由退相干产生的拓扑
articles.abstract: Decoherence is conventionally regarded as an obstacle to realizing topological quantum phases. This has motivated extensive efforts to suppress noise in candidate topological materials and devices. Here, we show that decoherence can instead induce topological phenomena. We demonstrate this in a lattice system subject to environment-induced dephasing. The noise-averaged dynamics, governed by an interacting quantum master equation, realize a topological phase characterized by a winding number and the non-Hermitian skin effect. The dynamical consequence is striking: the correlated nature of the stochastic noise yields asymmetric diffusion, whose direction is fixed by the winding number and is reversible only through a topological phase transition. This effect is induced purely by interactions, distinguishing it from previous studies of free, effectively single-particle systems. It also disappears upon postselecting measurement outcomes, confirming that it is a genuinely open-system phenomenon with no effective Hamiltonian description. Remarkably, the model remains analytically tractable. Our results establish correlated quantum noise as a route to topology in open many-body systems, beyond free-particle and non-Hermitian Hamiltonian paradigms.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出，退相干并不一定只是实现拓扑量子相的障碍，也可以反过来诱导拓扑现象。作者研究了一个受环境诱导退相位影响的晶格系统，发现其噪声平均动力学在相互作用量子主方程下可实现由绕数和非厄米皮肤效应表征的拓扑相。由相关随机噪声引起的非对称扩散方向由拓扑性质决定，且只能通过拓扑相变反转；该效应依赖相互作用，并在后选择测量结果后消失，表明它是纯粹的开放体系现象。

articles.title: Climate overshoot and irreversibility: Implications for the social cost of greenhouse gases and emission metrics
articles.title_zh: 气候超调与不可逆性：对温室气体社会成本及排放指标的启示
articles.abstract: Temperature overshoot pathways, where warming exceeds a target before declining, may entail irreversible climate damages. We assess how damage irreversibility affects the social cost of carbon dioxide (SCC), methane (SCM), and contrail cirrus (SC-contrail) using an integrated assessment model. We introduce an asymmetric damage function in which some damages remain, and depends on the peak temperature, even as temperatures fall, and evaluate social costs across overshoot pathways, discount rates, and irreversibility assumptions. Before peak temperature, damage irreversibility has only a modest effect on SCC but substantially raises the SCM and SC-contrail near the peak. Consequently, the relative valuation of methane and contrail cirrus compared with carbon dioxide rises sharply before peak warming, diverging from insights found using conventional emission metrics such as Global Warming Potentials. After the peak, accounting for irreversibility lowers social cost estimates because some damages are already locked in and depend on peak warming.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用综合评估模型考察了温度超调路径中气候损害不可逆性对二氧化碳、甲烷和尾迹卷云社会成本的影响。作者引入非对称损害函数，使部分损害即使在温度回落后仍持续存在，并随峰值温度而定。结果显示，在达到峰值温度之前，不可逆性对二氧化碳社会成本影响较小，但会显著抬高甲烷和尾迹卷云的社会成本；峰值之后，考虑不可逆性则会降低社会成本估计，因为部分损害已被锁定。

articles.title: Entropic Selection of Spin-Foam Amplitudes: A Relative-Entropy Monotone on Spin-Network Coarse-Graining and the Dissipation Structure of Pre-Geometric Fixed Points
articles.title_zh: 旋量泡振幅的熵选择：旋量网络粗粒化上的相对熵单调量与前几何固定点的耗散结构
articles.abstract: Spin networks, spin foams, and tensor networks are the three principal pre-geometric structures of background-independent quantum gravity, yet the dynamical input of the theory—the spin-foam vertex amplitude—is convention-ally fixed by simplicity constraints rather than derived from a physical principle. We propose an entropic selection principle: the physical spin-foam amplitude is a coarse-graining quantum channel on spin-network states along which a relative-entropy functional is exactly monotone, with dissipation vanishing precisely on the fixed-point sector. Three structural results are proved unconditionally: (i) monotonicity of the functional along any completely positive trace-preserving coarse-graining flow, by the data-processing inequality; (ii) an exact dissipation identity decomposing the total entropy drop into non-negative per-step productions; and (iii) vanishing dissipation of topological BF-type amplitudes, which act as conditional expectations onto their flat sector and are therefore the entropically reversible case. The selection principle recasts the question of which pre-geometric structure is fundamental in operational terms: spin foams are trajectories of an entropy flow on spin-network states, tensor networks are its representation, and fundamentality is stability of the flow’s attractors. As a fully controlled pilot test we realize the framework in a Z2 finite-group spin net, combining the Migdal–Kadanoff coarse-graining map with exact finite-volume enumeration of the Gibbs ensemble. The dissipation landscape σ(K) = D(pK ∥pR(K))/N is found to vanish, to machine precision, exactly at the three renormalization-group fixed points (K = 0, K∗≃ 0.6094, K → ∞) and to be strictly positive elsewhere, while the relative entropy to the attracting fixed point decreases monotonically along every flow tested, confirming the entropic classification of pre-geometric fixed points in this model. A proved/open status ledger delineates the unconditional theorems from the conjectural extension to SU(2)k spin nets and Lorentzian Engle–Pereira–Rovelli–Livine amplitudes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种熵选择原理，用以从物理原则上确定旋量泡的顶点振幅。作者将物理旋量泡振幅表述为旋量网络态上的粗粒化量子信道，并证明相对熵泛函沿该过程严格单调，而耗散在固定点子空间中精确消失。文中还给出了总熵下降的逐步耗散分解，以及拓扑BF型振幅作为熵上可逆情形的结果，从操作层面重塑了前几何结构的物理选择问题。

articles.title: Dynamic bond reconfiguration drives crack-tip carbon migration to strengthen iron grain boundaries
articles.title_zh: 动态键重构驱动裂纹尖端碳迁移以强化铁晶界
articles.abstract: Developing stronger alloys is essential for structural applications, but their reliability is limited by brittle cracking along general grain boundaries (GGBs). Solute segregation can control grain-boundary fracture, yet its effects are typically interpreted in terms of static cohesion changes before and after interfacial separation. How trace solutes modify moving-crack resistance at GGBs remains unclear because realistic segregation and crack propagation are difficult to treat atomistically. Here, we develop a fast and transferable Fe–C machine-learning interatomic potential. Using simulations of experimentally consistent carbon-segregated α-Fe GGBs, we show that trace carbon markedly increases crack-growth resistance, consistent with observed transition from intergranular fracture to cleavage. Carbon follows the moving crack tip through repeated breaking and reforming of Fe–C bonds, enriching the crack-tip region. We term this process dynamic bond reconfiguration (DBR). DBR dynamically amplifies static cohesive strengthening, revealing dynamic solute–crack-tip interactions as a framework for controlling brittle fracture in alloys.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对铁合金中一般晶界的脆性开裂问题，研究了微量碳偏聚对裂纹扩展阻力的影响。作者开发了快速且可迁移的Fe–C机器学习原子势，并结合与实验一致的碳偏聚α-Fe晶界模拟，发现微量碳可显著提高裂纹扩展抗力，与脆性沿晶断裂向解理断裂转变的实验现象一致。研究表明，碳会通过Fe–C键的反复断裂与重形成跟随裂纹尖端迁移并富集于局部区域，作者将这一过程命名为动态键重构。

articles.title: Testing the Consent-Friction Functional: Preference-Design Artifacts and the Contention-Bounded Limits of Coordination Friction in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
articles.title_zh: 检验“同意-摩擦”函数：多智能体强化学习中偏好设计伪影与协调摩擦的争议边界
articles.abstract: This is the empirical companion to the Axiom of Consent, which derives a consent-friction functional F = σ(1+ε)/(1+α) from a single axiom and leaves its adequacy open. We test that functional in a four-agent shared-resource MARL environment—a 5×5×5 factorial of 125 conditions, 30 independent replications each—3,750 Independent Q-Learning (IQL) training runs, with an additive value-decomposition learner (VDN) re-run alongside on reduced control grids—and report two things: an honest characterization of which of its variables survive, and a methodological control battery showing how design choices manufacture spurious coordination findings. The kernel variables matter directionally, but the specific monotone form is rejected as a single-index predictor on comparative grounds (an independent-effects model decisively beats it; on the signed re-test the form itself clears the pre-registered absolute fit bar for VDN). The control battery then peels back three artifacts: the dominance of stakes is mechanical (reward is degree-1 homogeneous in σ; the ranking inverts under stake-normalization, though the direction—higher stakes raise friction—holds); the symmetric U-shape of the initial factorial is a sign-blind data-generating-process artifact (a shared-anchor sampler realizes correlation α²/(α²+(1−|α|)²), never negative); and opposition-helps never materializes in any tested design—at a genuine, sign-verified ρ = −1 (n = 2, no PSD cap) opposition shows no detectable advantage over indifference and at most fragilely loses to it, never beats it. The one surviving structural effect—cooperative alignment lowers the coordination gap (only the VDN cooperation-beats-indifference contrast survives Holm correction, Holm-adjusted p = 0.0072; the IQL direction corroborates; η² ≈ 0.036–0.058)—is shared-state-contention-mediated: it flattens entirely when each agent is given its own separable resource pool (ρ-slope → 0, n.s.), and a parametric partial-sharing sweep grades it as a monotone dose–response in contention degree (per-overlap ρ-slopes null at low sharing and significant only once a majority of resources are shared; the single continuous ρ×overlap interaction is significant (p ≈ 0.002–0.003) but a misspecified summary—the categorical per-overlap model C(w)×ρ is AIC-preferred (nested F, p ≤ 0.004, both learners)—so the per-overlap slopes, not the pooled linear term, carry the dose–response; a perfect but low-power Spearman = −1.000 over four overlap levels), bounding the claim to common-pool environments. A feasibility–learning decomposition downgrades even this survivor: the decline is the achievable joint optimum rising toward cooperation (feasibility), not reduced learning friction—once feasibility is controlled the learning shortfall does not fall. We give the formal desiderata, the competing functional forms, Holm-adjusted contrasts, and the verification each control implements, so the test stands alone and feeds back to the formal paper which variables to keep.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文作为“同意公理”的经验配套研究，在四智能体共享资源的多智能体强化学习环境中检验由单一公理导出的同意-摩擦函数。作者通过125种条件、每种30次重复的系统实验，以及独立Q学习和价值分解学习器对照，考察该函数中关键变量的作用及其预测有效性。结果显示，若干核心变量在方向上确有影响，但所提出的单索引单调形式并未被整体支持；同时，控制实验揭示了一些协调结论可能由实验设计伪影所制造，而非系统真实机制。

articles.title: Seeing quality through AI: YOLOv11 for automated grading of dried sea cucumber processing methods
articles.title_zh: 通过人工智能洞察质量：利用YOLOv11对干海参加工方式进行自动分级
articles.abstract: Sea cucumber is a high-value marine commodity widely traded in dried form. Drying and pre-processing methods such as salting, smoking, and roasting produce visible changes in surface color, morphology, texture, and shrinkage that are relevant to product grading and market quality. Conventional inspection is still commonly performed by visual judgment, which is subjective, labor-intensive, and difficult to standardize across processing sites. This study develops a deep learning-based computer vision framework using Ultralytics YOLO11n to identify dried sea cucumber processing categories in dense-object images. An original dataset of 1,450 images was collected from sea cucumber processing environments in North Sulawesi, Indonesia. The dataset includes three primary categories (salting, smoking, and roasting) and mixed-category scenes. After instance-level bounding-box annotation, images were divided into training, validation, and testing subsets using an 80:10:10 ratio. YOLO11n, trained for 100 epochs at 320 × 320 (batch 16), achieved 99.73% precision, 99.87% recall, 99.80% F1-score, 99.41% mAP@0.5, and 92.78% mAP@0.5:0.95. Consistently high class-wise results show that a lightweight detector can learn visual cues from drying methods, supporting non-destructive quality inspection for postharvest sea cucumbers and advancing AI-enabled smart fisheries and agriculture.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文面向干海参加工质量识别，构建了一种基于Ultralytics YOLO11n的计算机视觉框架，用于识别密集目标图像中的加工类别。研究采集了来自印度尼西亚北苏拉威西海参加工场景的1450张图像，覆盖盐渍、烟熏、烘烤三类主要加工方式及混合场景，并进行了实例级边界框标注与训练验证测试划分。实验表明，该轻量化模型在测试集上取得了很高的精度、召回率和mAP，说明其可用于干海参加工方式的自动识别与质量分级。

articles.title: Engineering Hybrid Fano Resonances in Periodic Gold Nanorod– Dye Architectures for High-Performance Refractive-Index Sensing
articles.title_zh: 在周期性金纳米棒-染料结构中构建混合Fano共振以实现高性能折射率传感
articles.abstract: A hybrid plasmon–exciton nanostructure consisting of periodic gold nanorods conformally coated with a molecular dye layer is theoretically investigated as a high-performance refractive-index sensor. Three-dimensional finite-difference time-domain (3D-FDTD) simulations demonstrate that cooperative interaction among localized surface plasmon resonances (LSPRs), molecular excitons, and Fabry–Pérot cavity feedback produces a narrow Fano-like reflection resonance with a linewidth of 2.87 nm and a quality factor of Q ≈ 343. The resonance behavior was systematically investigated by varying the nanorod height, dye-layer thickness, and lattice period. Building on this parametric analysis, the study establishes a resonance-engineering framework in which cooperative plasmon–exciton coupling, lattice-assisted optical confinement, and Fabry–Pérot cavity feedback are intentionally combined to generate narrow hybrid Fano resonances with improved spectral selectivity and sensing performance. The selected configuration, comprising a 25 nm nanorod height, 30 nm dye layer, and 620 nm lattice period, achieves a maximum wavelength sensitivity of 333.93 nm RIU− 1 with a figure of merit of 116.35 RIU− 1 and an estimated detection limit of 3.0 × 10− 5 RIU for biomaterial sensing in the refractive-index range of 1.46–1.55. For low-index gaseous environments, the same platform enables fixed-wavelength intensity interrogation with an intensity sensitivity of 17.58 RIU− 1. The enhanced performance is attributed to strong electromagnetic field localization, efficient overlap between the hybrid optical mode and the surrounding analyte, and collective lattice effects. The proposed architecture supports both wavelength-shift and intensity-based sensing within a single platform and provides general design principles for engineering hybrid Fano resonances in compact, label-free plasmonic sensors for biochemical and environmental monitoring..
articles.abstract_zh: 本文理论研究了一种由周期性金纳米棒及其表面染料层构成的混合等离激元-激子纳米结构，用于高性能折射率传感。基于三维时域有限差分模拟，作者发现局域表面等离激元共振、分子激子与Fabry–Pérot腔反馈之间的协同作用可形成窄线宽的类Fano反射共振。通过调节纳米棒高度、染料层厚度和晶格周期，研究建立了一种共振工程框架；在优化结构下可获得较高的波长灵敏度和优良的传感品质因子。

articles.title: Proposal for a cryogenic source of atomic tritium for neutrino-mass measurements and precision spectroscopy
articles.title_zh: 面向中微子质量测量与精密光谱的原子氚低温源方案
articles.abstract: Author(s): A. Semakin, J. Ahokas, T. Kiilerich, S. Vasiliev, F. Nez, P. Yzombard, V. V. Nesvizhevsky, E. Widmann, P. Crivelli, C. Rodenbeck, M. Röllig, and M. Schlösser We propose a concept for a cryogenic source of atomic tritium at sub-Kelvin temperatures and energies suitable for magnetic trapping. The source is based on the dissociation of solid molecular T₂ films below 1 K by electrons from a pulsed rf discharge, a technique recently demonstrat… [Phys. Rev. Research 8, 033096] Published Thu Jul 23, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种用于中微子质量测量和精密光谱的原子氚低温源概念，目标是在亚开尔文温度下产生适合磁俘获的原子氚。该方案基于电子在脉冲射频放电作用下对低于1 K的固态T₂薄膜进行解离，从而获得低温原子氚。作者主要展示了该源的实现思路及其潜在应用前景，具体实验性能与系统优化细节需进一步参阅原文。
authors: A. Semakin, J. Ahokas, T. Kiilerich, S. Vasiliev, F. Nez, P. Yzombard, V. V. Nesvizhevsky, E. Widmann, P. Crivelli, C. Rodenbeck, M. Röllig, and M. Schlösser

articles.title: Mixed state entanglement via the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality
articles.title_zh: 通过柯西-施瓦茨不等式研究混态纠缠
articles.abstract: Author(s): Nishaant Jacobus, Paul Brumer, and Chern Chuang This work develops an approach to analyze the quantum entanglement of mixed states by comparing the relative magnitudes of populations and coherences of the density operator. This is applied to models of light-matter interaction to examine how the symmetries of the interaction influence entanglement in thermal and nonequilibrium steady states. [Phys. Rev. Research 8, L032014] Published Thu Jul 23, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种分析混态量子纠缠的方法，通过比较密度算符中布居与相干项的相对大小来判定纠缠特征。该方法被应用于光-物质相互作用模型，以研究相互作用对热平衡态和非平衡稳态中纠缠性质的影响。研究表明，体系对称性在决定混态纠缠结构方面具有重要作用。
authors: Nishaant Jacobus, Paul Brumer, and Chern Chuang

articles.title: Molecular clock transitions tune out the noise in the hunt for new physics
articles.title_zh: 分子钟跃迁有助于在寻找新物理时抑制噪声干扰
articles.abstract: Heavy polar molecules are some of the most sensitive tools physicists have for probing what lies beyond the Standard Model, the theory that describes the particles and forces we know about. But turning that sensitivity into precise, trustworthy measurements has long been held back by one stubborn problem: Stray electric and magnetic fields drown out the tiny signals researchers are actually looking for.
articles.abstract_zh: 重极性分子是物理学家探测标准模型之外新物理的重要工具，因为它们对微弱效应极为敏感。然而，杂散电场和磁场会淹没真正关心的微小信号，使高精度测量长期受限。该工作围绕如何通过分子钟跃迁等方法降低噪声、提升测量可靠性展开，旨在为新物理搜寻提供更稳健的实验手段。

articles.title: Earth’s magnetic field remained weak for 40 million years after the Cambrian radiation
articles.title_zh: 寒武纪辐射后地球磁场仍持续偏弱达四千万年
articles.abstract: Science Advances, Volume 12, Issue 30, July 2026.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文关注地球早期磁场强度的长期演化及其与寒武纪生物大辐射后的地球环境之间的关系。根据题目所示，作者提出寒武纪辐射之后，地球磁场在相当长时间内仍保持较弱状态。该研究有助于理解古地磁场演变及其对地球表层环境与生命演化的潜在影响，具体证据与方法需参见原文。
authors: Simon J. Lloyd, Andrew J. Biggin, Rebecca Hopkins, Alexander Tully, Brendan Cych, Greig A. Paterson, Ricardo Trindade

articles.title: Dark Matter Sensitivity of the CYGNO Detector with HFO-1234ze Enhanced Gas Mixtures
articles.title_zh: 采用HFO-1234ze增强气体混合物的CYGNO探测器暗物质灵敏度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.20370v2 Announce Type: new Abstract: The CYGNO collaboration introduces an innovative approach to direct dark matter detection, proposing a high-resolution optical Time Projection Chamber. It operates at atmospheric pressure with a He:CF₄ (60:40) gas mixture and uses a triple Gas Electron Multiplier stage for signal amplification. A key feature is its optical readout system, which captures the scintillation light produced during the electron avalanche. This setup allows 3D event reconstruction by combining the time profile of the light detected by photomultiplier tubes with high-granularity, pixelated X-Y tracking recorded by a scientific camera. The CYGNO experiment's projected sensitivity to both spin-independent and spin-dependent interactions is competitive in the framework of directional dark matter detectors. However, incorporating a hydrogen-based gas would introduce an even lighter target, further improving the detection potential at low dark matter masses. In this work, we present the performance characterization of one of the CYGNO experiment prototypes, MANGO, operated with the standard gas mixture enriched with varying concentrations of HFO-1234ze, a gas with a promising low global warming potential. The study includes measurements of the detector charge gain and scintillation yield for each configuration. In addition, to evaluate the impact of HFO-1234ze on scintillation light quenching, the secondary scintillation spectrum was collected for each gas mixture tested.
articles.abstract_zh: CYGNO合作组提出一种用于直接暗物质探测的高分辨率光学时间投影室方案，并以原型机MANGO开展性能研究。该装置在标准氦四氟化碳气体混合物基础上引入不同浓度的HFO-1234ze，以评估其对探测性能和低质量暗物质灵敏度的改善作用。研究重点在于比较这种增强气体配置下的事件重建与灵敏度表现，为方向性暗物质探测提供实验依据。
