Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN), a key NAD⁺ precursor, has gained attention for its roles in cellular energetics and redox balance. However, direct evidence regarding its potential reprotoxic effects on human spermatozoa is lacking. This preliminary Human Sperm Assay (HSA) evaluated the compatibility of NMN with human sperm progressive motility. Seven normozoospermic semen samples were exposed to NMN at 0 (control), 50, 100, or 150 µM. Progressive motility was assessed according to WHO 2021 criteria at baseline and after 0.5, 1, 2, 4, and 24 hours of incubation. NMN at 50 µM and 100 µM did not impair progressive motility relative to untreated controls throughout the 24-hour incubation. In contrast, exposure to 150 µM NMN resulted in a substantial reduction in progressive motility. These preliminary findings suggest that NMN does not exert reprotoxic effects on sperm progressive motility at 50 and 100 µM, whereas 150 µM induces motility impairment. Larger studies with additional sperm function parameters are warranted to confirm the short-term safety of these lower concentrations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该初步人类精子试验评估了烟酰胺单核苷酸（NMN）对人类精子前向运动能力的影响。七份正常精液样本暴露于 0、50、100 和 150 µM NMN，并在 24 小时内按 WHO 2021 标准多时间点评估前向运动率。结果显示，50 和 100 µM NMN 未明显损害前向运动能力，而 150 µM 暴露导致显著运动能力下降，提示需在更大样本和更多精子功能指标下进一步验证。

articles.title: Quantile Time-Frequency Higher-Moment Risk Spillovers and Multilayer Networks: Bridging Climate Risks to Carbon, Energy, and Metals Markets
articles.title_zh: 气候风险向碳、能源和金属市场的分位数时频高阶矩风险溢出与多层网络研究
articles.abstract: In this paper, we explore the quantile time-frequency connections among climate physical risk, climate transition risk, and the carbon, energy, and metals markets, with the analysis conducted through the lens of higher-moment risks. Furthermore, we construct a multilayer network that integrates information on return, volatility, skewness, and kurtosis risks under diverse market conditions, and measure the topological properties of this network. The results reveal the following key insights: First, within the spillover effects among climate physical risk, climate transition risk, and the carbon, energy, and metals markets, the overall higher-moment risk spillovers exhibit statistical significance and time-varying characteristics, even though their magnitude is lower than that of return and volatility spillovers. Second, risk spillovers associated with returns, skewness, and kurtosis are primarily driven by short-term dynamics, whereas volatility-related risk spillovers tend to be concentrated largely in the long run. In the "climate risk-carbon-energy-metals" system, climate risks generally act as spillover receivers; however, they shift to become spillover transmitters in the context of long-term risks during market downturns. Finally, findings from the multilayer complex network analysis demonstrate significant differences in the structural configurations of the interconnected networks linking climate risks to the return, volatility, skewness, and kurtosis risks of the carbon, energy, and metals markets across varying market states. JEL classification: G10, G15
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究从高阶矩风险视角分析气候物理风险、气候转型风险与碳、能源和金属市场之间的分位数时频关联。作者构建融合收益、波动率、偏度和峰度风险信息的多层网络，并考察不同市场状态下的网络拓扑性质。结果表明，高阶矩风险溢出具有统计显著性和时变特征，但总体强度低于收益和波动率溢出；收益、偏度和峰度溢出主要由短期动态驱动，而波动率溢出更多集中于长期。

articles.title: Symmetry-guided interfacial Ti incorporation in epitaxial Sr-doped HfO2 memristors for energy-efficient analog computing
articles.title_zh: 对称性引导的外延 Sr 掺杂 HfO2 忆阻器界面 Ti 掺入用于能效模拟计算
articles.abstract: Ferroelectric HfO2 memristors are promising for analog conductance control and low-power computing, but stable operation requires polar-phase stabilization and interfacial-transport regulation. Here, using termination-controlled epitaxial Sr-doped HfO2/Nb:SrTiO3 (111) heterostructures, we identify localized Ti incorporation and accompanying Ti valence reduction at the TiO2-terminated interface as a mechanism that stabilizes the orthorhombic ferroelectric phase and regulates carrier transport, while hexagonal surface symmetry enables buffer-free epitaxial growth of Sr-doped HfO2. The films exhibit a remanent polarization of 41.2 µC cm− 2 and an estimated full polarization of 71 µC cm− 2 along [001], approaching the predicted limit for Sr-doped hafnia. The corresponding devices sustain 1010 switching cycles and expand the number of programmable conductance states in ferroelectric hafnia memristors to 1,104. As application-level validation of this high-resolution conductance modulation, these stable analog states support high-fidelity in-memory inverse discrete Fourier transform image reconstruction and a 27-device lightweight fuzzy controller for robotic obstacle avoidance. Enabled by ~ 2.4 fJ single-device readout, a projected fully parallel implementation reaches 130.57 pJ per inference, more than two orders of magnitude below conventional CMOS fuzzy ASICs. This work establishes symmetry-guided interface engineering as a route to high-performance ferroelectric memristors for compact, energy-efficient analog computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用端面控制的外延 Sr 掺杂 HfO2/Nb:SrTiO3(111) 异质结构，揭示 TiO2 端面界面处局域 Ti 掺入及 Ti 价态降低可稳定正交铁电相并调控载流子输运。六方表面对称性支持无缓冲层外延生长，薄膜表现出较高剩余极化和接近理论极限的估计全极化。相应器件实现高耐久开关和 1,104 个可编程电导态，并在存内逆离散傅里叶图像重建和轻量模糊机器人避障控制中展示了高分辨率模拟电导调制的应用潜力。

articles.title: Heavy metal contamination and human health risk assessment of invasive sailfin catfishes (Pterygoplichthys spp.) from urban river basins in Klang Valley, Malaysia
articles.title_zh: 马来西亚巴生谷城市河流流域入侵帆鳍鲶鱼的重金属污染及人体健康风险评估
articles.abstract: The widespread distribution of invasive sailfin catfishes (Pterygoplichthys spp.) in the freshwater ecosystems of the Klang Valley, Malaysia, has led to their increased harvesting as an alternative and readily accessible source of dietary protein. However, heavy metal contamination in polluted waterways has raised concerns regarding the safety of their consumption. This study aimed to evaluate the concentrations of Cu, Cd, Ni, Pb, and Zn and assess the associated human health risks using sailfin catfishes collected from 17 sampling sites across the Langat and Klang river basins. Fish muscle tissue and habitat surface sediment exhibited site-specific contamination, with significant variation in heavy metal concentrations among sampling sites. Hierarchical cluster analysis further identified three distinct groups of sites based on their pollution levels. However, no significant correlations (p > 0.05) were observed between the concentrations of the five metals in fish muscle tissue and habitat surface sediment, consistent with the low bioaccumulation factors, which indicated limited transfer of heavy metals from sediment to fish. Human health risk assessment revealed that fish collected from two sites, Sungai Langat Kampung Jambu, Kajang, and Sungai Klang Prima Koi, Puchong, had Cd target hazard quotient values exceeding the recommended safety threshold. These findings were further supported by the provisional tolerable weekly intake assessment. Therefore, consumption of sailfin catfishes harvested from these sites should be approached with caution due to the potential risk of Cd accumulation. Overall, these findings highlight the need for continuous monitoring of heavy metal contamination and the implementation of effective risk management strategies to ensure the safe utilisation of sailfin catfishes as a food resource in urban freshwater ecosystems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究评估了马来西亚巴生谷 Langat 和 Klang 河流域 17 个采样点入侵帆鳍鲶鱼及其栖息地沉积物中 Cu、Cd、Ni、Pb 和 Zn 的浓度，并进行人体健康风险评估。鱼肌肉和表层沉积物中的重金属污染呈明显地点差异，聚类分析区分出不同污染水平的采样点组。鱼肌肉与沉积物金属浓度之间未发现显著相关性，且生物富集因子较低，表明沉积物向鱼体的金属转移有限；消费安全性仍需结合完整健康风险指标判断。
authors: Sayed Muhamad Daniel Sayed Shamsul Effendi

articles.title: Dual-Guidance Framework for Semi-Supervised Semantic Segmentation via Uncertainty and Prototypes
articles.title_zh: 基于不确定性与原型的半监督语义分割双重引导框架
articles.abstract: Semi-supervised semantic segmentation (SSSS) reduces the dependence on dense pixel-level annotations, but current weak-to-strong consistency methods remain vulnerable to noisy pseudo-labels and poorly separated feature representations. To address these limitations, we propose a Dual-Guidance framework that jointly refines the prediction space and regularizes the representation space. The Uncertainty-Aware Dynamic Pseudo-Label Refinement (UADPR) module estimates pixel-level uncertainty with Monte Carlo Dropout and uses it to adapt confidence thresholds and assign reliability-aware supervision weights. In parallel, the Class-Prototype Contrastive Guidance (CPCG) module maintains dynamic class prototypes and applies variance-aware contrastive learning with hard negative mining to improve intra-class compactness and inter-class separability. Prototype-guided similarity is further fused with network logits to generate more structured pseudo-labels. Experiments on PASCAL VOC 2012 and Cityscapes demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework. Under the UniMatch protocol with DeepLabv3+ and a ResNet-101 backbone, our method achieves 78.16% and 82.94% mIoU on the VOC 92 and 732 labeled splits, showing robust performance in data-scarce settings.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种用于半监督语义分割的双重引导框架，同时优化预测空间并正则化表征空间，以缓解伪标签噪声和特征类别分离不足的问题。其不确定性感知动态伪标签细化模块通过 Monte Carlo Dropout 估计像素级不确定性，自适应调整置信阈值和监督权重；类别原型对比引导模块维护动态类原型，并通过方差感知对比学习和困难负样本挖掘提升类内紧凑性与类间可分性。在 PASCAL VOC 2012 和 Cityscapes 上的实验表明，该方法在 UniMatch 设置下取得了具有竞争力的 mIoU 表现。

articles.title: Enhanced Electrocatalytic Oxygen Reduction to H₂O with High Selectivity via 2D 1T-MoS₂ Integrated with Functionalized Carbon Nanohorns
articles.title_zh: 二维 1T-MoS₂ 与功能化碳纳米角复合实现高选择性电催化氧还原生成 H₂O
articles.abstract: Developing cost-effective and high-performance electrocatalysts for the oxygen reduction reaction (ORR) is essential for advancing anion-exchange membrane fuel cell technologies. In this study, we report a robust heterostructure formed by covalently functionalized carbon nanohorns (CNH-N) integrated with metallic 1T-MoS₂ 2D nanosheets. Through tailored diazonium chemistry, positively charged ammonium groups were introduced onto CNHs, enabling strong electrostatic and van der Waals interactions with negatively charged exfoliated MoS₂. Structural and spectroscopic analyses confirm successful functionalization, enhanced defect modulation, and intimate CNH–MoS₂ coupling. The resulting CNH-N-MoS₂ catalyst exhibits remarkable ORR performance, including an optimized onset potential of 0.80 V, reduced charge-transfer resistance, and a dominant four-electron reduction pathway with ~ 94% selectivity toward H₂O, which is comparable to commercial Pt/C. These results highlight how controlled chemical functionalization and heterointerface engineering can synergistically enhance catalytic activity and stabilize the 1T-MoS₂ phase. The CNH-N-MoS2 heterostructures thus represent a promising class of metal-free/low-metal-content electrocatalysts for efficient fuel cell applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道了一种由共价功能化碳纳米角与金属性二维 1T-MoS₂ 纳米片构成的异质结构电催化剂，用于阴离子交换膜燃料电池相关的氧还原反应。通过重氮化学在碳纳米角上引入带正电的铵基，增强其与带负电剥离 MoS₂ 之间的静电和范德华相互作用，并形成紧密耦合界面。所得 CNH-N-MoS₂ 催化剂表现出 0.80 V 起始电位、较低电荷转移阻抗以及约 94% 生成 H₂O 的四电子选择性，说明化学功能化和异质界面工程可协同提升 ORR 活性并稳定 1T-MoS₂ 相。

articles.title: NMIRacle: Multi-modal Generative Molecular Elucidation from IR and NMR Spectra
articles.title_zh: NMIRacle：基于红外与核磁共振谱的多模态生成式分子结构解析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.19733v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Molecular structure elucidation from spectroscopic data is a long-standing challenge in Chemistry, traditionally requiring expert interpretation. We introduce NMIRacle, a two-stage generative framework that builds upon recent paradigms in AI-driven spectroscopy with minimal assumptions. In the first stage, NMIRacle learns to reconstruct molecular structures from count-aware fragment representations, capturing both fragment identities and their occurrences. In the second stage, a spectral encoder maps input spectra (IR, 1H-NMR, 13C-NMR) into a latent embedding used to condition the pre-trained generator, which is fine-tuned for direct spectra-to-molecule generation. This formulation bridges fragment-level chemical modeling with spectral evidence, yielding accurate molecular predictions. Empirical results demonstrate that NMIRacle outperforms existing baselines on molecular elucidation, while maintaining robust performance across increasing levels of molecular complexity.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出 NMIRacle，一种两阶段生成式框架，用于从红外、¹H-NMR 和 ¹³C-NMR 光谱直接推断分子结构。第一阶段从包含计数信息的片段表示学习分子重构，第二阶段用光谱编码器将谱图映射到潜在嵌入以条件化预训练生成器。实验结果表明，该方法在分子结构解析任务上优于现有基线，并在分子复杂度增加时保持较强鲁棒性。
authors: Federico Ottomano, Yingzhen Li, Alex M. Ganose

articles.title: Analytical evaluation of surface barrier and resistance in iron-based superconducting multilayers for Superconducting Radio-Frequency applications
articles.title_zh: 面向超导射频应用的铁基超导多层结构表面势垒与电阻的解析评估
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.03702v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: New superconducting materials, particularly iron-based superconductors (IBS), have recently attracted attention for their potential applications in particle detectors and accelerators. This paper discusses the application of these materials in multilayer structures for radio-frequency resonators used to accelerate charged particles, with the aim of improving performance compared to bulk niobium. These materials are compared with previously studied multilayers composed of conventional superconductors in terms of the maximum magnetic field they can withstand, their surface resistance, and their power loss per unit surface area. Finally, perspectives and future applications aimed at increasing operating temperatures are discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文讨论铁基超导体在用于带电粒子加速的射频谐振器多层结构中的应用潜力，目标是相较块体铌提升性能。研究从可承受最大磁场、表面电阻和单位表面积功率损耗等方面，将铁基超导多层与传统超导多层方案进行比较。文章还展望了通过新材料与结构设计提高工作温度的未来应用方向。

articles.title: Distributional Inverse Homogenization
articles.title_zh: 分布式逆均匀化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.14083v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: For many materials, macroscopic mechanical behavior is determined by an intricate microstructure. Understanding the relation between these two scales helps scientists and engineers design better materials. The relation which maps microstructure to bulk material properties can be understood via the well-established theory of homogenization. However inverting the homogenization process, to recover microstructural information from measured macroscopic properties, is fraught with difficulties because of the averaging processes that underlie homogenization. Therefore, scientists and engineers usually need recourse to more invasive, often highly localized, investigations to estimate the microstructure. In this work, we develop a noninvasive methodology by which one can leverage large collections of measured bulk material properties to infer information about the statistics of microstructure at a global level. We call this, distributional inverse homogenization. We study this problem in one and two dimensions, considering both periodic and stochastic homogenization. We demonstrate the methodology in the context of 2D Voronoi constructions and underpin the observed empirical success with theory in 1D. We also show how the natural spatial variability of microstructure can be exploited to gather data that enables distributional inversion. And we concurrently learn a surrogate model, approximating the homogenization map, that accelerates the resulting computations in this setting. The work formulates a new class of inverse problems, bridging ideas from probability and homogenization to facilitate the inference of microstructural material variability from macroscopic measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注如何从大量宏观材料性质测量中非侵入式推断材料微结构统计信息，提出“分布式逆均匀化”方法。传统均匀化描述微结构到宏观性质的映射，但其逆问题因平均化过程而高度不适定。作者在一维和二维、周期与随机均匀化情形下研究该问题，并以二维 Voronoi 构造为例展示方法。
authors: Arnaud Vadeboncoeur, Mark Girolami, Kaushik Bhattacharya, Andrew M. Stuart

articles.title: Propagation of laser-generated GHz surface acoustic wavepackets in FeRh/MgO(001) below and above the antiferromagnetic-ferromagnetic phase transition
articles.title_zh: 反铁磁—铁磁相变上下 FeRh/MgO(001) 中激光产生的 GHz 表面声波包传播
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.14845v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Magnetoacoustic devices that harness the strong coupling between acoustic waves and magnons have emerged as a promising platform for energy-efficient spintronics. Laser-generated pulsed surface acoustic waves (SAWs) are particularly attractive for such applications, offering broadband frequency content up to the gigahertz (GHz) range, remote excitation without lithographic patterning, and surface localization for efficient on-chip integration. In this work, we present a comprehensive experimental study of laser-generated SAW pulses in the Fe49Rh51/MgO(001) system. A thin film of the near-equiatomic FeRh alloy serves both as an opto-acoustic transducer and as a mechanical load that modulates SAW propagation. The antiferromagnetic to ferromagnetic phase transition in FeRh, occurring slightly above room temperature, is accompanied by abrupt changes in its elastic properties, enabling controlled modification of the SAW excitation efficiency and dispersion characteristics by tuning the sample temperature and laser fluence. Using 160 fs laser pulses for excitation and time-resolved Sagnac interferometry for detection, we evaluated key SAW parameters, including amplitude, spectral content, phase and group velocities, and their in-plane anisotropy. Particular emphasis is placed on the dispersion relation and its anisotropy, which govern the coherent interaction between phonons and magnons and are determined primarily by the FeRh film.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究实验考察 Fe49Rh51/MgO(001) 体系中激光激发表面声波脉冲的产生与传播。近等原子比 FeRh 薄膜既作为光声换能层，又因其略高于室温的反铁磁到铁磁相变而改变弹性性质，从而调控声波激发效率和色散特征。作者利用 160 fs 激光脉冲激发和时间分辨 Sagnac 干涉检测，为磁声器件中宽带 GHz 声波操控提供实验依据。
authors: Ia. A. Mogunov (Ioffe Institute, St. Petersburg, Russia), A. Yu. Klokov (P.N. Lebedev Physical Institute of the RAS, Moscow, Russia), N. Yu. Frolov (P.N. Lebedev Physical Institute of the RAS, Moscow, Russia), A. I. Sharkov (P.N. Lebedev Physical Institute of the RAS, Moscow, Russia), A. V. Devyaterikov (Institute of Metal Physics of the Ural Branch of the RAS, Ekaterinburg, Russia), V. I. articles.title: Optical Lineshape Models and the Generalized Einstein Relation between Absorption and Stimulated Emission
articles.title_zh: 光学线型模型与吸收和受激发射之间的广义爱因斯坦关系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.22173v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Recently, Ryu et al. generalized Einstein's three coefficients for absorption, stimulated emission, and spontaneous emission between two quantum levels to a set of four spectra between two broadened bands. The spectra obey generalized Einstein relationships at thermal equilibrium; Einstein's relations are obtained as an approximation for line spectra. Here, the generalized Einstein relation between absorption and stimulated emission dipole-strength spectra is applied to investigate optical lineshape models. Lineshapes for the Bloch model, the stochastic model, and the semi-classical Brownian oscillator model do not obey the generalized Einstein relation and therefore fail to satisfy detailed balance with Planck blackbody radiation. The quantum Brownian oscillator model treats a harmonic quantum vibration that is bi-linearly coupled to a thermal bath of quantum harmonic oscillators which generate damping and a random force. The two-state quantum Brownian oscillator lineshape model provides lineshapes for transitions between two displaced, but otherwise identical, harmonic potential energy surfaces on which the same quantum vibration is coupled to the same thermal bath of quantum harmonic oscillators. The absorption and stimulated emission lineshapes were calculated using the quantum Brownian oscillator model in under-damped, critically damped, and over-damped cases. The thermal and reorganization energy were each varied from much less to greater than the vibrational quantum of energy. All quantum Brownian oscillator lineshapes obey the generalized Einstein relation within the numerical precision of the calculation (14 to 30 digits), suggesting this lineshape model is compatible with detailed balance. The formula giving the electric-dipole transition cross-section in terms of these lineshapes is presented.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文将 Ryu 等人提出的宽化能带间吸收、受激发射和自发发射的广义爱因斯坦关系用于检验光学线型模型。研究指出 Bloch 模型、随机模型和半经典布朗振子模型的线型不满足吸收与受激发射偶极强度谱之间的广义关系，因此不能与普朗克黑体辐射满足细致平衡。文章进一步讨论量子布朗振子线型模型在处理热浴耦合、阻尼和随机力时的物理一致性。
authors: Aman K. Agrawal, Jisu Ryu, David M. Jonas

articles.title: Thermodynamic Properties of Diatomic Molecules from the Frost-Musulin Potential
articles.title_zh: 基于 Frost–Musulin 势的双原子分子热力学性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.00039v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this study, we present a quantum-statistical analysis of H₂ and LiH diatomic molecules within the Frost--Musulin potential framework. By combining the analytical bound-state approach to the radial Schrödinger problem with the near-equilibrium Pekeris representation, we obtain a validated rotation-vibration spectrum that reproduces a physically consistent ordering of energy levels. These bound states are subsequently combined with standard translational and rotational ideal gas contributions to construct the total partition function and the corresponding thermodynamic observables of the ground state. The resulting formulation captures the Gibbs free energy deviation function for both molecules with high quantitative accuracy and provides chemically plausible trends for heat capacity and enthalpy increase over a wide temperature range. At the same time, residual errors become increasingly pronounced in derivative-sensitive quantities, particularly at high temperatures; this indicates that the dominant limitations now stem not from the local bound-state spectrum itself, but from the neglect of inelastic rotational, continuity contributions and dynamics close to dissociation. Consequently, the present results define the potential model as a compact and analytically tractable representation of the bound region, recovering a significant portion of the observed thermochemistry whilst also delineating the regime where more comprehensive molecular statistical mechanics is required.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在 Frost–Musulin 势框架下，对 H₂ 和 LiH 双原子分子进行量子统计分析。作者结合径向薛定谔方程束缚态解析方法与近 equilibrium 的 Pekeris 表示，得到转动—振动能谱，并与平动和转动理想气体贡献共同构建配分函数及热力学量。结果能够较准确描述吉布斯自由能偏差函数，并给出热容和焓增随温度变化的合理趋势，但高温下对导数敏感的量仍存在更明显误差。
authors: Mohammadjavad Parsanasab, Reza Khordad, Meysam Asadipour, Ahmad Ghanbari, Vatan Badalov

articles.title: Magnetic Field Walls in Flat-band Superconductors
articles.title_zh: 平带超导体中的磁场壁
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06791v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Superconductors of different types have distinct magnetic properties; for example, they can form Abrikosov vortices or alternating normal-superconducting domains. We predict that, in flat bands, a superconducting phase exhibiting walls of magnetic flux is stable in an applied magnetic field. This phase relies on the lack of a single particle energy penalty for forming condensates of any momentum in flat bands and, consequently, their superconducting free energy being a negative and periodic function of the vector potential at low temperatures. Using a minimal lattice-periodic model of free energy, we study two types of soliton modes of the wall phase: the kink and breather solitons. They determine the lower critical field and the high-field behavior of the wall phase, respectively. The competition between the walls and vortices in flat bands is also discussed. Our results suggest that flat bands help sustain superconductivity in the presence of large magnetic fields.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究预言，在外加磁场下平带体系中可稳定出现由磁通“壁”构成的超导相。其机制源于平带中形成任意动量凝聚态几乎没有单粒子能量代价，使低温下超导自由能可成为矢势的负周期函数。作者用最小晶格周期自由能模型分析壁相中的 kink 与 breather 两类孤子，并讨论其与涡旋相的竞争，指出平带有助于在强磁场中维持超导性。
authors: Guodong Jiang, Aaron Dunbrack, Tero T. Heikkilä, Päivi Törmä

articles.title: Iron-mediated on-surface synthesis of substrate-decoupled graphdiyne monolayers
articles.title_zh: 铁介导的表面合成衬底解耦石墨二炔单层
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06992v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Graphdiynes are emerging two-dimensional sp-sp² carbon materials with electronic structures complementing those of graphene, yet their on-surface synthesis is limited by the persistence of metalated intermediates or yields disordered covalent networks. Here, we report an iron-assisted route to covalent hydrogenated graphdiyne monolayers on Au(111) from 1,3,5-tris(bromoethynyl)benzene. Low-temperature scanning tunnelling microscopy, X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy and density functional theory show that Fe scavenges chemisorbed Br byproducts forming FeBr₂, in turn promoting the removal of Au adatoms from the organometallic network, thus enabling its metalated-to-covalent conversion under mild thermal treatment. Subsequent annealing removes FeBr₂ and yields covalent, ordered domains weakly coupled to the substrate. Scanning tunnelling spectroscopy, combined with density functional theory, reveals a semiconducting gap of about 1.6 eV associated with carbon p_z frontier orbitals. This Fe-mediated on-surface synthesis strategy provides a route to atomically precise, weakly substrate-coupled graphdiyne networks and offers a design principle for two-dimensional carbon semiconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道一种铁辅助表面合成路线，可在 Au(111) 上由 1,3,5-三(溴乙炔基)苯制备共价氢化石墨二炔单层。低温扫描隧道显微镜、X 射线光电子能谱和密度泛函理论表明，Fe 通过捕获化学吸附的 Br 副产物形成 FeBr₂，促进有机金属网络向共价网络转化。退火去除 FeBr₂ 后得到有序且与衬底弱耦合的共价畴，扫描隧道谱显示其具有约 1.6 eV 的半导体带隙。
authors: Alice Cartoceti, Simona Achilli, Gianni Conti, Eliecer Pelaez-Sifonte, Alessio Orbelli Biroli, Sabine Maier, Francesco Sedona, Paolo D'Agosta, Francesco Tumino, Andrea Li Bassi, Jorge Lobo-Checa, Carlo S. Casari

articles.title: Systematic Comparison between Constrained Transport and Mixed Divergence Cleaning Methods for Astrophysical Magnetohydrodynamic Simulations
articles.title_zh: 天体物理磁流体动力学模拟中约束输运与混合散度清除方法的系统比较
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.07928v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) simulations are indispensable research infrastructure in astrophysics today. In order to satisfy the solenoidal constraint of the MHD equations on discretized grids, modern simulation codes often employ either constrained transport (CT) with a staggered grid or divergence cleaning using an additional variable. We compare CT and Dedner's mixed divergence cleaning schemes systematically, and find that the divergence cleaning scheme can produce substantial artifacts in certain situations. Through numerical experiments including both idealized tests and practical applications, we show that the original implementation of Dedner's scheme becomes inaccurate when magnetic fields are strongly localized or when the timestep suddenly changes. We find that some previous results, such as the extremely rapid growth of magnetic fields during star formation in the early Universe, may be affected by the spurious behavior of the divergence cleaning scheme. We propose a few modifications to improve the robustness of the divergence cleaning method. Nevertheless, we find that the CT scheme is more accurate and reliable in many situations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究系统比较了磁流体动力学模拟中用于满足磁场无散约束的约束输运方法和 Dedner 混合散度清除方法。数值实验显示，当磁场高度局域或时间步长突变时，原始 Dedner 方案可能产生显著伪影并导致不准确结果。作者指出部分既有天体物理结果可能受此影响，并提出改进散度清除鲁棒性的修改方案，但总体认为约束输运方法更准确可靠。
authors: Kengo Tomida, Kenji Eric Sadanari, Shinsuke Takasao, Kazunari Iwasaki

articles.title: Integrated full pulse modeling for pellet injection in tokamaks: HPI2 model improvement and validation in WEST
articles.title_zh: 托卡马克丸粒注入的全脉冲集成建模：HPI2 模型改进及在 WEST 中的验证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.10465v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Reliable modeling and control of core density is essential for reactor-relevant magnetic confinement fusion operation, motivating cryogenic pellet injection as a primary fueling actuator and the need for predictive pellet source models in integrated modeling. Here we present an upgrade of the physics-based pellet code HPI2 in which the plasmoid release spatial step is determined self-consistently from ablation physics, dxᵥₐᵣ=vₚₑₗ,tₑₓᵢₜ (optionally rescaled to trade accuracy for computational cost), removing an ad-hoc discretization parameter and improving numerical robustness across injection conditions. The upgraded model is first validated in stand-alone against a high-field-side pellet-fueled, ohmic, WEST discharge (#58656) by comparing synthetic and measured interferometry line-integrated density increments, obtaining a mean error of sim 10%. We then perform full-radius, time-dependent integrated modeling validation by coupling the new HPI2 within the High Fidelity Pulse Simulator (HFPS) workflow (JINTRAC/IMAS), combining JETTO with SANCO for the impurity/radiation evolution and TGLF-SAT2 for the turbulent transport. The coupled simulations reproduce the main density rise and relaxation after pellet injection and the associated electron-temperature transient, while taking into account the strong influence of tungsten radiation in WEST, supporting the consistency of HPI2 as a predictive pellet particle source in integrated modeling frameworks. Ultimately, this validation study supports the use of pellet modeling tools in integrated modeling studies for larger devices such as ITER.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究改进了基于物理的低温丸粒注入模型 HPI2，使等离子体团释放的空间步长由消融物理自洽确定，从而去除经验离散参数并提升数值鲁棒性。升级模型首先在 WEST 高场侧丸粒加料欧姆放电中进行独立验证，通过合成与实测干涉密度增量比较获得约 10% 的平均误差。随后作者将新 HPI2 耦合进 HFPS 集成建模流程，结合输运、杂质和辐射模型开展全半径、时变验证。
authors: A. Panera Alvarez, F. Koechl, J. Artaud, E. Geulin, B. Pégourié, E. Vergnaud, C. Bourdelle, S. Wiesen, the WEST Team

articles.title: Superconducting Qubits with Altermagnetic Josephson Junctions
articles.title_zh: 具有交替磁性约瑟夫森结的超导量子比特
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.02761v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Identifying a materials platform for creating qubits that are both tunable and resilient towards environmental noise is one of the main hurdles that need to be overcome to realize quantum computation that is practically useful. One pursued avenue to this end is to use superconducting qubits with intrinsic spin-dependent interactions, such as spin-orbit coupling or magnetism. However, the recently discovered class of materials known as altermagnets remains largely unexplored in this context. We here use microscopic calculations to determine how the properties of superconducting qubits are modified when altermagnetic Josephson junctions are included. The key qubit performance parameters, including splitting, anharmonicity, decoherence, and single/coupled-qubit gate operation times, display rich behavior depending on the characteristic properties of the altermagnetic material, such as the strength of the Néel field and the crystallographic orientation of the altermagnetic relative to the interfaces in the system. We focus in particular on the transmon design and show that the qubit is very well protected against decoherence and simultaneously shows superior anharmonicity both near 0-π transition points and when it is in a φ-state. We propose that by using strain, the altermagnetic qubit can be moved out of its protected regime to enable faster gate operation times, and then moved back to its protected state. We establish the physical mechanism underlying the behavior of all central qubit metrics, clarifying how real devices interpolate between an altermagnetic double-well regime exhibiting barrier-induced protection and a conventional transmon-like single-well regime. We also discuss how the altermagnetic properties influence flux qubits and fluxonium.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用微观计算分析在超导量子比特中引入交替磁性约瑟夫森结后器件性质的变化。结果表明，能级劈裂、非谐性、退相干以及单/双量子比特门操作时间等关键性能参数，会随交替磁材料的 Néel 场强度及其相对界面的晶体取向而呈现丰富变化。作者重点讨论 transmon 设计，指出交替磁性结有望在保持可调性的同时增强对环境噪声的保护。
authors: Johanne Bratland Tjernshaugen, Morten Amundsen, Jacob Linder

articles.title: Direct observation of spontaneous magnon coherence at room temperature
articles.title_zh: 室温下自发磁振子相干性的直接观测
articles.abstract: Researchers at RPTU University Kaiserslautern-Landau have achieved a key experimental breakthrough: For the first time, the spontaneous macroscopic coherence of magnons—the quantized excitations of magnetic materials—has been directly observed. These experiments confirm a central prediction of the theory of magnon Bose-Einstein condensates. Eventually, these findings could open new avenues for signal processing, sensing technologies and information processing. The study has been published in Nature Physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究人员首次直接观测到磁振子的自发宏观相干性，磁振子是磁性材料中磁激发的量子化形式。该实验验证了磁振子玻色—爱因斯坦凝聚理论的一项核心预言，并且是在室温条件下实现的。相关发现有望为信号处理、传感技术和信息处理开辟新的研究方向。

articles.title: Twisted ultrathin magnet retains magnetization after field changes, study finds
articles.title_zh: 研究发现扭转超薄磁体在磁场变化后仍能保持磁化
articles.abstract: The properties of ultrathin magnets can be specifically altered by a slight twist between two atomic monolayers. This is the conclusion reached by an international research team led by TU Darmstadt in a study published in Nature Communications. The findings open new prospects for future memory devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究表明，通过在两层原子级单层材料之间引入微小扭转，可以有针对性地改变超薄磁体的性质。研究发现，这类扭转结构在外部磁场变化后仍可保持磁化状态。该结果为未来基于二维磁性材料的存储器件提供了新的设计可能。

articles.title: Understanding Chemical Short-Range Order in CoNiV via Mode Analysis
articles.title_zh: 通过模式分析理解 CoNiV 中的化学短程有序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.10775v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We analyze chemical short-range order in equiatomic fcc NiCoV using molecular-dynamics snapshots generated with a machine-learned interatomic potential. Radial distribution functions identify stable coordination shells, while shell-resolved Warren-Cowley parameters and bond probabilities reveal continued chemical ordering after the radial structure has largely converged. The dominant signal is V-V avoidance in the first shell and V-V enrichment in the second shell, consistent with an L1₂₋ₗᵢₖₑ local ordering tendency, while the third-shell response remains weak. Lagged Jensen-Shannon diagnostics show that bond statistics relax more slowly than the RDF. Principal component analysis of per-replica-centered bond probabilities resolves three collective modes: a V-sublattice ordering amplitude, a Ni-Co redistribution mode, and a Co-V exchange-like mode. These results show that scalar RDF convergence can miss slow chemical relaxation, and that shell-resolved bond statistics provide a compact route for tracking SRO development in multicomponent alloys.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者利用机器学习原子间势生成的分子动力学快照，分析等原子比面心立方 NiCoV 合金中的化学短程有序。径向分布函数用于识别稳定配位壳层，而分壳 Warren-Cowley 参数和键概率显示，在径向结构基本收敛后化学有序仍在继续演化。主要特征包括第一壳层 V-V 回避和第二壳层 V-V 富集，指向类似 L1₂ 的局域有序倾向；主成分分析进一步分辨出 V 子晶格有序、Ni-Co 再分布和 Co-V 交换样模式。研究强调，仅凭标量 RDF 收敛可能遗漏缓慢化学弛豫，而分壳键统计可有效追踪多组元合金短程有序的发展。

articles.title: AI-Driven Spatiotemporal Decoding of Counter-Propagating OAM States for Highly Resilient Physical-Layer Security
articles.title_zh: 用于高韧性物理层安全的反向传播 OAM 态的 AI 驱动时空解码
articles.abstract: The capacity limits of conventional optical communication networks and their vulnerability to physical interception necessitate novel physical-layer architectures. This paper proposes "OAM-NET," a hybrid spatiotemporal network utilizing the superposition of counter-propagating Orbital Angular Momentum (OAM) states (l = ± 21). By exploiting the rotational Doppler effect, data is encoded into a specific harmonic spiral velocity sequence (9, 6, 3). To overcome severe modal dispersion and extreme hardware imperfections, we introduce an AI-driven physical-layer equalizer using a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM) neural network. Numerical simulations subject the architecture to extreme stress testing with Gaussian noise masking the original signal (SNR approx 0 dB). Remarkably, the Bi-LSTM decoder maintained a stable decoding accuracy of 92.67%, proving that the harmonic sequence acts as an immutable topological footprint. This architecture establishes a highly resilient, decentralization-ready infrastructure for Free-Space Optics (FSO) and secure physical-layer communication.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种名为 OAM-NET 的混合时空光通信架构，利用反向传播轨道角动量态（l=±21）的叠加，并通过旋转多普勒效应将数据编码为特定谐波螺旋速度序列。为应对强模态色散和硬件缺陷，作者引入基于双向长短期记忆网络（Bi-LSTM）的物理层均衡器。在约 0 dB 信噪比的极端噪声条件下，解码准确率仍达到 92.67%，表明该方案有望用于自由空间光通信和安全物理层通信。

articles.title: From Programs to Predictions: A Scalable, Multilingual Platform for Automated Evaluation of Machine-Learning Olympiads
articles.title_zh: 从程序到预测：面向机器学习奥林匹克竞赛自动评测的可扩展多语言平台
articles.abstract: The rise of the International Olympiad in Artificial Intelligence and of affiliated national contests has created demand for judging infrastructure that differs fundamentally from classic programmingcontest judges: competitors submit prediction files rather than executable programs, and these are scored against held-out ground truth using heterogeneous, often problem-specific metrics. We present MLCompete, a web platform engineered for hosting, evaluating, and operating machinelearning olympiads at national and international scale. Its contributions are an asynchronous, metric-agnostic evaluation pipeline that supports both standard scikit-learn metrics and author-supplied custom scoring scripts; a two-tier model for untrusted execution, a data-only evaluator for prediction files and, for tasks that require server-side training, a defence-in-depth contest environment that runs participant code on MIG-partitioned NVIDIA H200 GPUs through JupyterHub behind a whitelisting proxy and host-level anti-cheat; and a fully internationalised interface covering 30 languages. The platform is the official infrastructure for all four stages of Romania’s National AI Olympiad (ONIA 2026) and has organically attracted participants from 13 countries. We report production evidence from the live cluster: over 8.1 million backend requests in a 15-day window served at a 0.007% server-error rate, a 255 ms 95th-percentile backend latency, a 99.999% database cache-hit ratio on a single commodity K3s node with external PostgreSQL, and a recovered 3–6× contest-load spike during the national team-selection camp absorbed without latency or reliability regressions. We distil the architectural decisions, the security model, and the operational lessons into guidance for organisations building comparable AI-competition infrastructure.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文介绍 MLCompete，一个用于承办和评测机器学习奥林匹克竞赛的网络平台，其评测对象是预测文件而非传统可执行程序。平台提供异步、指标无关的评测流程，支持 scikit-learn 标准指标和自定义评分脚本，并针对不可信执行设计了数据评测与受控 GPU 训练环境两类机制。系统还具备覆盖 30 种语言的国际化界面，并已用于罗马尼亚国家人工智能奥林匹克竞赛等场景。

articles.title: Surrogate-Free Inverse Design of High-IP/High-EA Polyimide Constitutional Repeating Units with In-Loop Semiempirical Quantum Scoring
articles.title_zh: 无代理模型的高电离势/高电子亲和能聚酰亚胺结构重复单元逆向设计：循环内半经验量子评分
articles.abstract: Simultaneously achieving deep ionization potentials (IP) and large electron affinities (EA) is difficult because LUMO-stabilizing strategies often raise the HOMO. Here we report a surrogate-free inverse-design workflow for polyimide constitutional repeating units (CRUs) that couples recurrent-neural-network-guided Monte Carlo Tree Search with in-loop GFN2-xTB evaluation of IP and EA. The workflow explored 360,846 candidates, of which 179,316 yielded valid three-dimensional geometries for quantum-chemical evaluation. Relative to the training set, the generated library showed a sixfold enrichment in the high-IP/high-EA region, with 75.4% of candidates satisfying IP > 7.8 eV and EA > 1.5 eV. DFT benchmarking confirmed strong rank consistency between semiempirical and higher-level calculations for IP, EA, frontier-orbital gaps, optical gaps, and dipole moments. Top-ranked CRUs reached DFT EA values of 2.85–3.99 eV while retaining deep IP values of 7.97–9.01 eV, occupying a region distinct from reported polyimides and representative n-type organic semiconductors. BRICS fragment analysis identified imide-rich, cyano-substituted, and fluorinated motifs that promote this property combination, offering molecular design principles for electronically robust polyimide building blocks relevant to n-type organic electronics and high-temperature dielectric materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种无需代理模型的聚酰亚胺结构重复单元逆向设计流程，将循环神经网络引导的蒙特卡洛树搜索与循环内 GFN2-xTB 量子化学评估相结合，以同时优化电离势和电子亲和能。该流程探索了 360,846 个候选结构，其中 179,316 个获得有效三维几何并完成量子评估，生成库在高 IP/高 EA 区域相较训练集显著富集。DFT 基准验证显示半经验方法在多项电子性质排序上具有良好一致性，并识别出富酰亚胺、氰基取代和氟化片段等有利结构 motif。

articles.title: A machine learning-based method for adulteration detection in white rice vinegar using different non-targeted spectroscopy
articles.title_zh: 基于机器学习与多种非靶向光谱技术的白米醋掺假检测方法
articles.abstract: White rice vinegar is highly susceptible to economically motivated adulteration, necessitating rapid and reliable authentication methods. This study systematically evaluated and compared the efficacy of near-infrared (NIR), Fourier transform infrared (FTIR), and fluorescence excitation-emission matrix (EEM) spectroscopy coupled with machine learning for detecting synthetic acetic acid adulteration in white rice vinegar. Four commercial brands were subjected to simulated adulteration levels ranging from 0% to 50% (v/v). A data-driven workflow was implemented, incorporating systematic spectral preprocessing, t-SNE dimensionality reduction, and four feature selection algorithms (UVE, VIP, CARS, and GA) to optimize five classification models (LDA, PLS-DA, DT, RF, and SVM). Results demonstrated that FTIR spectroscopy exhibited the strongest discriminative potential, consistently outperforming NIR and EEM techniques across all brands. The optimal FTIR models based on selected characteristic bands achieved identification accuracies ranging from 85.00% to 100.00%. Furthermore, the analysis revealed pronounced brand specificity, as the optimal preprocessing pipelines, feature selection methods, and model architectures varied significantly among different vinegar brands. In conclusion, FTIR spectroscopy integrated with a systematic chemometric strategy provides a robust foundation for adulteration detection. This study highlights the critical need to account for brand variability when developing generalized, high-precision authentication tools for the food industry.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究比较了近红外、傅里叶变换红外和荧光激发-发射矩阵光谱结合机器学习检测白米醋中合成乙酸掺假的能力。研究对四个商业品牌设置 0% 至 50% 的模拟掺假水平，并采用光谱预处理、t-SNE 降维、特征选择和多种分类模型构建数据驱动流程。结果表明，FTIR 光谱整体判别能力最强，基于特征波段的最优模型识别准确率为 85.00% 至 100.00%，同时显示不同品牌之间存在明显差异。

articles.title: Epitaxial Co₂MnSi with intrinsic magnetocrystalline anisotropy as a route to bias-field-free nonlinear half-metal magnonics at the nanoscale
articles.title_zh: 具有本征磁晶各向异性的外延 Co₂MnSi：通向纳米尺度无偏置场非线性半金属磁振子学的路径
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.03431v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Half-metallic Heusler compounds like Co₂MnSi allow to bridge magnonic and spintronic functionality for hybrid unconventional computing approaches with sought-after properties like 100% spin polarization and associated low Gilbert damping αłeq 10⁻³. However, the desirable material parameters are inherently tied to the crystal lattice with a particularly critical dependence on structural order in Co₂MnSi. To date, the successful fabrication of nanoscale devices with robust structural integrity remains yet a challenge, and consequently the impact of the material parameters on the resulting nonlinear spin-wave dynamics remains largely unexplored. Here, we report on a study of linear and nonlinear spin-wave dynamics in transversally magnetized Co₂MnSi waveguides with impeccable crystalline ordering. We show that epitaxial, L2₁₋ₒᵣdered Co₂MnSi exhibits an intrinsic cubic anisotropy with first- and second-order contributions, stabilizing a magnetization alignment along the crystal łangle110ångle directions. We confirm the implication of an unaffected crystal structure resulting in preserved magnetic properties in the patterned structures. Herein, the persistent magnetocrystalline anisotropy reshapes the spin-wave dispersion which yields a first-order nonlinear instability suppression range extending over several GHz - even for vanishing bias fields. Moreover, the intrinsic magnetocrystalline anisotropy can be exploited to counteract shape demagnetization for a stabilized low bias field operation in the favourable Damon-Eshbach geometry with high group velocities and decay lengths. Together with the proven half-metallicity and ultralow Gilbert damping, this research establishes Co₂MnSi as a robust, scalable platform towards bias-field-free nonlinear half-metal magnonics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察了高晶体有序度外延 Co₂MnSi 波导中的线性与非线性自旋波动力学，关注其在磁振子学与自旋电子学融合器件中的潜力。作者表明，L2₁ 有序 Co₂MnSi 具有包含一阶和二阶贡献的本征立方各向异性，可稳定沿晶体〈110〉方向的磁化取向。研究强调纳米图形化后晶体结构和磁性参数的保持对于实现无偏置场、低阻尼和非线性半金属磁振子器件至关重要。
authors: Anna Maria Friedel, Jaafar Ghanbaja, Björn Heinz, Moritz Bechberger, Sylvie Migot, Sébastien Petit-Watelot, Stéphane Andrieu, Philipp Pirro

articles.title: Physicists confirm 20-year-old theory that could boost quantum technology
articles.title_zh: 物理学家证实一项有望促进量子技术发展的 20 年前理论
articles.abstract: Future quantum computing will require correlations between distant modules—a feature known as distributed entanglement. Traditionally, such entanglement has relied on active control and repeated measurements. Now, physicists at the Institute of Science and Technology Austria (ISTA) have realized a fully autonomous method for distributed entanglement using a "quantum bath" of correlated light particles. Published in Physical Review X, their work experimentally confirms a 20-year-old prediction and could provide a new platform for applied quantum technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该新闻报道介绍了奥地利科学技术研究所研究人员实现的一种全自主分布式纠缠方法。该方法利用由相关光粒子组成的“量子浴”建立远距离模块之间的纠缠，不依赖传统方案中的主动控制和反复测量。相关实验验证了约 20 年前的理论预言，并可能为应用量子技术提供新平台。

articles.title: White-beam neutron device unlocks precise control of twisted quantum waves
articles.title_zh: 白束中子装置实现对扭曲量子波的精确控制
articles.abstract: CANISIUS is the official name of the new spin-echo neutron interferometer developed at Atominstitut, TU Wien. It enables precise control of neutron waves, something that was previously impossible.
articles.abstract_zh: 该新闻介绍了维也纳工业大学 Atominstitut 开发的新型自旋回波中子干涉仪 CANISIUS。该装置能够对中子波进行以往难以实现的精确控制，尤其有助于操控具有扭曲特征的量子波。报道属于科学新闻概述，具体技术细节和实验结果需查阅原始研究。

articles.title: Engineering Topology by Design in Two-dimensional Materials
articles.title_zh: 二维材料中的按设计拓扑工程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.10049v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-dimensional topological insulators (2D TIs) have emerged as a cornerstone of next-generation spintronic technologies due to their robust, dissipationless edge states protected by time-reversal symmetry. Initial realizations of 2D TIs have primarily focused on materials with strong intrinsic spin-orbit coupling capable of driving band inversion, an approach that significantly constrains the accessible materials landscape. More recently, a paradigm shift has occurred toward engineering topological phases in van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures, where nontrivial band topology can arise from interfacial coupling rather than relying solely on intrinsic material properties. This framework provides an exceptionally versatile platform with multiple tunable degrees of freedom, including stacking configuration, twist angle, and chemical functionalization, allowing systematic manipulation of the band topology. Furthermore, external stimuli, such as electric fields, strain, and light-matter coupling, enable dynamic and reversible control of the topological character. The combined use of vdW interface engineering and external modulation allows the realization of 2D TI phases even in otherwise topologically trivial systems, substantially expanding the accessible materials landscape. This Research Update reviews key milestones in the development of vdW-engineered 2D topological quantum materials, critically assesses outstanding theoretical and experimental challenges, and outlines promising directions for future breakthroughs.
articles.abstract_zh: 该综述/研究概述二维拓扑绝缘体在下一代自旋电子技术中的重要性，并指出传统依赖强自旋轨道耦合和带反转的材料发现路径较为受限。作者强调范德华异质结构中的界面耦合可用于工程化非平庸拓扑相，并可通过堆垛方式、扭转角、化学功能化等自由度调控能带拓扑。外加电场、应变和光-物质耦合等刺激还可实现拓扑性质的动态可逆调控。

articles.title: Growing, Buckling, and Swirling: motility from polymerization
articles.title_zh: 生长、屈曲与旋涡：由聚合驱动的运动
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.10446v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Locomotion in low-Reynolds-number environments is achieved through a remarkable diversity of strategies, from flagellar rotation and ciliary beating to large-scale body deformations. A distinct and biologically important class of propulsion arises when surface-anchored filaments grow and collectively reorient - as seen in the cellulose-extruding bacterium Acetobacter xylinum and in recent experiments on actin-propelled synthetic colloids inspired by the motility of Listeria monocytogenes - suggesting that polymerization itself is a generic route to self-propulsion. Developing a theoretical framework for this class of problems requires simultaneously resolving filament kinetics, their orientational dynamics, and fluid-structure interactions - all self-consistently coupled to the resulting locomotion. To address this, we formulate a continuum framework in which the active forces driving locomotion emerge self-consistently from filament nucleation, growth, catastrophe, and hydrodynamic interactions. We show analytically that polymerization-induced compressive forces drive a long-wavelength buckling instability, leading to spontaneous symmetry breaking of the filament carpet and large-scale flows. In coupling this framework to a force- and torque-free motile spheroidal particle, a wide variety of behaviors emerge - this includes spontaneous spinning, directed motility, and chiral swimming - whose selection is governed by the spatial patterning of polymerizing filaments. These results establish a general theoretical foundation for motility, driven by collective dynamics of polymerizing filaments and point towards new design principles for synthetic micron-scale swimmers.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究建立了一个连续介质理论框架，用于描述由表面锚定丝状体的成核、生长、灾变和水动力相互作用共同产生的低雷诺数自推进。作者受到细菌纤维素挤出和肌动蛋白推动合成胶体等体系启发，探讨聚合作为一种通用运动机制的可能性。分析表明，聚合诱导的压缩力可触发长波屈曲不稳定性，并进一步导致自发对称性破缺和运动模式形成。
authors: Naveen Kumar D, Michael J. Shelley, Brato Chakrabarti

articles.title: Chiral, Electronically Decoupled Layers of 1T'-WS2 Topological Insulator via Neutral-Molecule Intercalation
articles.title_zh: 通过中性分子插层获得手性、电子解耦的 1T'-WS₂ 拓扑绝缘体层
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.10457v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Monolayer 1T'-WS2 is predicted to be a two-dimensional topological insulator, but its intrinsic electronic properties are masked by strong interlayer coupling in its metallic and superconducting bulk parent phase, 2M-WS2. Isolating monolayers by mechanical exfoliation is also hindered by this coupling, preventing experimental examination of monolayer properties. Here we show that 2M-WS2 undergoes amine intercalation through a simple wet-chemical reaction, yielding superlattices in which the 1T' layers are structurally preserved but electronically decoupled by neutral molecular spacers. Intercalation expands the interlayer spacing from 0.5 to 1-4 nm and reconstructs the stacking while preserving the intralayer 1T' framework. Controlled (de)intercalation reversibly switches the system between a superconducting metal and an insulator with an activation gap matching that of the isolated monolayer. Density functional theory indicates that the electronically decoupled layers retain the nontrivial Z2 topology of the monolayer. Chiral amine intercalation further induces chiroptical activity in WS2 electronic transitions. Overall, the successful intercalation challenges the long-held view that group VIB dichalcogenides are inert toward neutral-molecule intercalation and demonstrates molecular intercalation as a general chemical route for realizing monolayer-like topological-insulator physics and enabling chiral van der Waals superlattices in bulk single crystals.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究展示了通过简单湿化学反应对 2M-WS₂ 进行胺分子插层，从而形成由中性分子间隔物隔开的 1T' 层超晶格。插层将层间距从约 0.5 nm 扩展至 1–4 nm，在保持层内 1T' 框架的同时实现电子解耦，并可在超导金属态与具有单层相近激活能隙的绝缘态之间可逆切换。密度泛函理论表明解耦层保留单层的非平庸 Z₂ 拓扑，手性胺插层还诱导 WS₂ 电子跃迁的手性光学活性。
authors: Jiaze Xie, Fatmagül Katmer, Fang Yuan, Jaime M. Moya, Guangming Cheng, Connor J. Pollak, Xiaoyu Song, Nirmal Roy, Yakov Bloch, Moshe Ben Shalom, Jennifer Cano, Leslie M. Schoop

articles.title: Evolution from an acoustic-plasmon-mediated superconductivity to an acoustic-phonon-mediated superconductivity in bilayers
articles.title_zh: 双层体系中由声学等离激元介导超导向声学声子介导超导的演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.10835v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by recent developments in van der Waals heterostructures, we revisit the acoustic plasmon mechanism of superconductivity in bilayer systems composed of a light layer (LL) and heavy layer (HL) by employing Eliashberg theory. The exchange of virtual plasmons in the HL can lead to a retarded in time attractive interaction between electrons of LL that we model through the screened interaction in the bilayer system within the random phase approximation. We explore the evolution from acoustic plasmon mediated superconductivity to phonon mediated superconductivity by studying the evolution of T_c as the HL mass is increased by a few orders of magnitude compared with the electronic mass in LL. The lower HL mass corresponds to the bilayer acoustic plasmon, while the latter regime is closer to the Born-Oppenheimer regime of acoustic phonon mediated strongly retarded pairing. The heavy HL mass limit is known to obey Migdal's theorem by virtue of the small ratio of the two individual layer masses. We study the nonadiabatic effects for the arbitrary mass ratio with no small parameter systematically by using a frequency cut off in the Eliashberg theory, providing T_c as a function of this cut off.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究基于 Eliashberg 理论重新考察由轻层和重层组成的双层体系中的声学等离激元超导机制。作者用随机相位近似下的屏蔽相互作用描述重层虚等离激元交换在轻层电子之间产生的延迟吸引作用，并通过改变重层质量研究临界温度的演化。结果旨在连接声学等离激元介导配对与接近 Born-Oppenheimer 极限的声学声子介导强延迟配对，并系统分析任意质量比下的非绝热效应。
authors: Shuyang Wang, Sankar Das Sarma, Jay D. Sau

articles.title: Dimensional and Spin Interpolation for the O(n) Model: From Exact Anchors to RG-Improved Critical Exponents
articles.title_zh: O(n)模型的维度与自旋插值：从精确锚点到重整化群改进的临界指数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.10865v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a two-axis interpolation framework for the O(n) universality family, treating the spatial dimension D and the spin-component number n as independent continuous parameters connecting exact limiting solutions. On the spatial axis, anchoring between the Onsager solution at D=2 and mean-field theory at D→infty yields a closed-form prediction for the 3D Ising critical coupling that agrees well with Monte Carlo benchmarks K_c = 0.2204 (benchmark: 0.22165) with no adjustable parameters. Wilson--Fisher-constrained polynomial interpolation gives ν=2/3, β=31/96, and η=35/864 at D=3 (benchmarks: 0.6299, 0.3265, 0.0362), and reproduces conformal-bootstrap results across 3 łe D < 4. On the spin axis, we establish a necessary compatibility criterion: two-anchor interpolation succeeds only for observables that vary monotonically between the anchor values. The critical coupling K_c(n) violates this criterion because the Heisenberg value falls below the spherical limit, whereas the correlation-length exponent ν(n) satisfies it. A perturbative 1/n² expansion yields ν(3) = 0.7493 (benchmark: 0.7112), and propagation through exact scaling relations gives β(3) = 0.3797 (benchmark: 0.3689) and γ(3) = 1.489 (benchmark: 1.396), without introducing additional parameters. The framework naturally extends to non-integer spin, producing the prediction ν(2.5) = 0.7143 for the O(2.5) universality class. These results establish dimensional and spin interpolation as a unified and predictive approach to critical phenomena, while clarifying the structural conditions under which interpolation succeeds.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出了一个针对 O(n) 普适性族的双轴插值框架，将空间维度 D 与自旋分量数 n 视为相互独立的连续参数，并用若干精确极限解作为锚点。在空间维度方向上，作者从二维 Onsager 解与高维平均场理论出发，给出三维 Ising 临界耦合和临界指数的无可调参数预测，并与蒙特卡洛和共形 bootstrap 结果比较。在自旋轴方向上，文章指出双锚点插值只有在观测量随锚点单调变化时才适用，并讨论了临界耦合与相关长度指数的不同表现。

articles.title: A minimal model for the Weyl nodes and Fermi arcs of PtBi₂
articles.title_zh: PtBi₂ 的 Weyl 节点与费米弧的最小模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.10937v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Weyl semimetals host topologically protected Fermi arcs on their surfaces, originating from the Chern number of the bulk Weyl nodes. In trigonal PtBi₂, superconducting signatures have been associated with the Fermi arcs. Theoretical descriptions of this surface superconductivity have so far relied on effective models that are not directly tied to the microscopic electronic structure of the material. In this work we develop a minimal description of the low-energy bands guided by density functional theory calculations and fully constrained by the relevant crystalline and time-reversal symmetries. The model captures the evolution of the Weyl nodes with spin-orbit coupling, including node annihilations, and is able to describe the spin-momentum locking of the surface Fermi arcs. It reproduces the orbital content and the band topology of PtBi₂ and provides a starting point for further studies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究为三方晶系 PtBi₂ 的低能电子结构建立了一个由密度泛函理论引导、并受晶体对称性和时间反演对称性约束的最小模型。模型能够描述自旋轨道耦合下 Weyl 节点的演化与湮灭，并捕捉表面费米弧的自旋-动量锁定特征。该模型再现了 PtBi₂ 的轨道成分和能带拓扑，可作为研究其表面态及相关超导现象的基础。
authors: Tobias Cristófoli, Manuel Alonso Lemos, Jorge I. Facio, Pablo S. Cornaglia

articles.title: Layer-Resolved Topological Metals in the Bilayer Lieb Lattice
articles.title_zh: 双层 Lieb 晶格中的层分辨拓扑金属
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.11009v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We identify a two-dimensional time-reversal-invariant topological metallic phase on a bilayer Lieb lattice, characterized by a quantized layer--resolved pseudo-spin Chern number. Without the orbital-angular-momentum-dependent (OAM-dependent) coupling, the system gives rise to a time-reversal-invariant topological semimetal with a zero indirect gap and quantized pseudo-spin Chern number. Opposite-sign intralayer OAM-dependent coupling immediately converts the zero-indirect-gap semimetal into a metal, in which the global spectrum is metallic while the layer--resolved pseudo-spin Chern number remains well defined as long as the direct gap at each crystal momentum and the pseudo-spin gap remain open. The model also exhibits asymmetric boundary states: in the semimetallic regime, one edge hosts perfectly flat bands, whereas the opposite edge supports gapless counter-propagating modes forming a one-dimensional Dirac cone. An edge-localized interlayer coupling gaps only the counter-propagating edge states, leaving the flat-band edge essentially intact, while intralayer OAM-dependent coupling bends the exact flat band into a dispersive boundary mode without affecting the gapped Dirac edge. These results open a route toward the controlled engineering of layer--resolved topological gapless phases in synthetic and quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作在双层 Lieb 晶格中识别出一种二维时间反演不变的拓扑金属相，其特征是量子化的层分辨赝自旋 Chern 数。在没有轨道角动量依赖耦合时，体系表现为零间接带隙的拓扑半金属；引入相反符号的层内轨道角动量依赖耦合后，整体能谱变为金属性，但在直接带隙和赝自旋带隙保持打开时拓扑数仍可定义。模型还显示出不对称边界态，包括一侧平带与另一侧无能隙反向传播模式，并讨论了层间与层内耦合对边界态的不同影响。
authors: Mengjie Yang, S Rahul, Giandomenico Palumbo

articles.title: Spectroscopy of low-lying valley states in hot Si/SiGe quantum dots
articles.title_zh: 热 Si/SiGe 量子点中低能谷态的光谱学研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.11048v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The presence of low-lying valley states in Si may hinder the development of large-scale spin-based quantum processors. Rapid prototyping of novel Si/SiGe heterostructures and gate stacks will be central to identifying pathways that increase the valley splitting. We compare the performance of pulsed-gate spectroscopy (PGS) and detuning axis spectroscopy (DAPS) at temperatures up to 700 mK. We find that DAPS outperforms PGS, with DAPS resolving valley splittings as small as ~86 μeV, while the energy resolution of PGS is only ~210~μeV. Our work demonstrates that DAPS can be used to efficiently extract valley splittings at elevated temperatures in high throughput cryostats.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注硅中低能谷态对大规模自旋量子处理器发展的潜在限制，并比较了升高温度下两种快速表征谷劈裂的方法。作者在最高 700 mK 条件下比较脉冲栅光谱和失谐轴光谱，发现失谐轴光谱具有更高能量分辨率，可分辨约 86 μeV 的谷劈裂，而脉冲栅光谱分辨率约为 210 μeV。结果表明，失谐轴光谱适合在高通量低温系统中高效提取 Si/SiGe 量子点的谷劈裂。
authors: Connor Nasseraddin, Heun Mo Yoo, Tanner M. Janda, Jason R. Petta

articles.title: Generalized Keldysh formalism for nonequilibrium correlation functions and its application to fluctuation dynamics
articles.title_zh: 非平衡关联函数的广义 Keldysh 形式及其在涨落动力学中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.11055v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent advances in time-resolved spectroscopies provide increasing access to collective dynamics in correlated quantum materials. However, computing the corresponding nonequilibrium two-particle correlation functions remains a major challenge. Here, by introducing a contour-dependent virtual probe field within the generalized Keldysh formalism, we propose an approach that computes such correlation functions with the vertex corrections essential for describing collective dynamics. In particular, we introduce a linear integral equation that computes the correlation functions without explicitly constructing the four-time vertex kernel, and develop its matrix-free Krylov solver based on quantics tensor trains. Combining our method with nonequilibrium dynamical mean-field theory, we show that the fluctuation dynamics of the order parameter in a nonequilibrium symmetry-broken state depends significantly on whether vertex corrections are included, and that the fluctuation and its decay time grow near the nonthermal critical point. Our approach thus provides a practical route for evaluating nonequilibrium correlation functions, which are emerging as key observables for characterizing states far from equilibrium.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种广义 Keldysh 形式，通过引入轮廓依赖的虚拟探测场来计算非平衡两粒子关联函数，并包含描述集体动力学所必需的顶角修正。作者构造了一个线性积分方程，避免显式建立四时间顶角核，并发展了基于量子张量列车的无矩阵 Krylov 求解器。结合非平衡动力学平均场理论，研究表明在非平衡对称性破缺态中，是否包含顶角修正会显著影响序参量涨落动力学，且在非热临界点附近涨落及其衰减时间增大。
authors: Ken Inayoshi, Hiroshi Shinaoka, Yuta Murakami

articles.title: Strain-Tuned Nodal Superconductivity in the Charge-Ordered Kagome Metal CsV₃Sb₅
articles.title_zh: 电荷有序 Kagome 金属 CsV₃Sb₅ 中应变调控的节点超导
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.11115v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The nature of the superconducting pairing symmetry in the kagome metal CsV₃Sb₅ and its relationship with the charge density wave (CDW) order are central unresolved issues. Here, we investigate the evolution of superconductivity in CsV₃Sb₅ under in-situ uniaxial pressure using ¹²¹Sb nuclear quadrupole resonance (NQR). We find that tensile strain significantly enhances the superconducting transition temperature, Tₘ̊ c, while the CDW remains unchanged, demonstrating that superconductivity can be tuned independently of the bulk charge order. At a tensile strain of ǎrepsilon = +0.90%, the nuclear spin-lattice relaxation rate reveals a remarkable double transition: an upper transition at Tₘ̊ c₁ = 3.6 K to a nodal gap state, and a lower one at Tₘ̊ c₂ = 3.0 K characterized by a nodeless gap. These results evidence degenerate superconducting states with different gap symmetry in the kagome metal at ambient pressure which split under strain. Our work demonstrates a high tunability of superconductivity by uniaxial pressure.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用原位单轴压力下的 ¹²¹Sb 核四极共振，考察 Kagome 金属 CsV₃Sb₅ 的超导配对对称性及其与电荷密度波的关系。结果显示，拉伸应变显著提高超导转变温度，而体电荷密度波基本不变，说明超导可独立于体电荷序被调控。在 +0.90% 拉伸应变下，核自旋-晶格弛豫率揭示两个超导转变：较高温转变对应节点能隙态，较低温转变对应无节点能隙态，表明常压下可能存在简并的不同能隙对称性超导态并在应变下发生分裂。
authors: Yusuke Takeuchi, Akito Kobayashi, Saki Uchida, Takumi Nagao, Seigo Ogawa, Rui Zhou, Shinji Kawasaki, Fei Song, Hao Ni, Yong Zhao, Guo-qing Zheng

articles.title: Electric field induced Berry curvature dipole in quasi-one-dimensional Bi₄I₄
articles.title_zh: 准一维 Bi₄I₄ 中电场诱导的 Berry 曲率偶极矩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.11188v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The nonlinear Hall effect in time-reversal symmetric materials offers a powerful probe into quantum geometry. Here, we investigate the electric-field-tunable nonlinear Hall response in few-layer Bi₄I₄ using comprehensive first-principles calculations across both its α and β phases. Guided by symmetry analysis, we track the evolution of the Berry curvature dipole (BCD) tensor from the monolayer to the bilayer configuration under an out-of-plane electric field. While the monolayer features a highly rigid band structure and modest BCD tunability, the bilayer architecture exhibits substantial field-induced band modifications, including a progressive Rashba splitting and eventual gap closure in the β phase. Crucially, this field-tunability allows substantial enhancement of the BCD magnitude relative to the monolayer counterpart. Our findings establish quasi-one-dimensional bismuth halogenides as a promising platform for engineering nonlinear Hall response.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作通过第一性原理计算研究少层 Bi₄I₄ 在 α 相和 β 相中的电场可调非线性 Hall 响应。基于对称性分析，作者追踪单层到双层体系在垂直电场下 Berry 曲率偶极张量的演化。结果表明，单层能带较为刚性且可调性有限，而双层结构在电场下出现显著能带重构，包括 Rashba 劈裂增强以及 β 相中带隙闭合，从而显著提高 Berry 曲率偶极矩，显示准一维铋卤化物是调控非线性 Hall 效应的有前景平台。

articles.title: Temperature dependence of charge-to-spin conversion in rhombohedral (110) bismuth thin film
articles.title_zh: 菱方相 (110) 铋薄膜中电荷-自旋转换的温度依赖性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.11189v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The amplitude of charge-to-spin conversion, namely the spin Hall effect (SHE), in bismuth (Bi) strongly depends on its crystal orientation. The conversion efficiency at room temperature in rhombohedral (110) bismuth is notably large as expected from its large spin-orbit interaction, and such a large SHE is ascribed to the large effective g-factor in bismuth [N. Fukumoto et al., Proc. Nat. Acad. Sci. 120, e2215030120 (2023)]. Despite the successful observation of the large conversion efficiency, a more detailed physical mechanism of the SHE in (110) bismuth is still elusive and under debate. In this work, we investigate the temperature dependence of charge-to-spin conversion in an epitaxial Bi(110)/Ni bilayer system using the second harmonic Hall method, revealing that both spin Hall conductivity and spin diffusion length augment with decreasing temperature. This finding suggests that spin scattering in (110) bismuth is dominated by the Elliott-Yafet mechanism, and the charge-to-spin conversion is mainly attributed to skew scattering.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察菱方相 Bi(110) 薄膜中电荷到自旋转换，即自旋 Hall 效应的温度依赖性，以澄清其大转换效率的物理机制。作者在外延 Bi(110)/Ni 双层结构中采用二次谐波 Hall 方法，发现自旋 Hall 电导率和自旋扩散长度都随温度降低而增大。该结果表明 Bi(110) 中的自旋散射主要由 Elliott-Yafet 机制支配，而电荷-自旋转换主要源于斜散射。
authors: K. Tatsuoka (Kyoto Univ), N. Fukumoto (Kyoto Univ), S. Sakamoto (ISSP, Univ. Tokyo), S. Miwa (ISSP, Univ. Tokyo), Y. Fuseya (Kobe Univ), J. Fujimoto (Saitama Univ), R. Ohshima (Kyoto Univ), J. Puebla (Kyoto Univ), Y. Ando (Osaka Metropolitan Univ), M. Shiraishi (Kyoto Univ)

articles.title: Conformal Nature of Quantum Phase Transitions via Fuzzy Three-Sphere Regularization
articles.title_zh: 通过模糊三维球面正则化揭示量子相变的共形性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.11371v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Conformal field theory (CFT) offers a modern viewpoint for understanding phase transitions. However, directly accessing the conformal algebra and microscopically uncovering the emergent conformal symmetry, especially in higher dimensions, remains a significant challenge. Motivated by recent advances in revealing CFT features via the fuzzy two-sphere, here we generalize this approach to higher dimensions and aim to expose the conformality at the (3+1)-D quantum critical point. We demonstrate this framework by investigating quantum phase transitions belonging to the Ising and Yang-Lee universality classes in a (3+1)-D quantum model (equivalent to a classical four-dimensional system), realized via Landau level projection on the fuzzy three-sphere. By computing the energy spectra at criticality, we explicitly verify the state-operator correspondence, a hallmark of conformal invariance. Together with prior advances, this work establishes a new pathway for the microscopic study of emergent conformality in higher-dimensional phase transitions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作将基于模糊球面的共形场论研究方法推广到更高维度，旨在显微层面揭示 (3+1) 维量子临界点的涌现共形对称性。作者通过在模糊三维球面上进行 Landau 能级投影，研究属于 Ising 与 Yang-Lee 普适类的 (3+1) 维量子相变。通过计算临界点处的能谱，文章明确验证了共形不变性的标志性特征——态-算符对应，为高维相变中涌现共形性的微观研究提供了新途径。
authors: Xue Meng, Liangdong Hu, Wei Zhu

articles.title: Fractionalized metals from doped anyons: Application to tMoTe2
articles.title_zh: 掺杂任意子产生的分数量子化金属：在扭转 MoTe₂ 中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.11484v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A fluid of mobile anyons may arise naturally when a Fractional Quantum Anomalous Hall (FQAH) state is doped. Motivated by recent experiments on twisted MoTe₂, we study metallic phases obtained by doping the σₓy = 2e²/3h state. We propose that the high-resistivity metal observed adjacent to this FQAH state is a Z₃ Orthogonal Metal: a non-Fermi liquid with sharp charge 1/3 fermionic quasiparticles coupled to a discrete Z₃ gauge field but with no sharp electronic quasiparticle. For a dilute gas of three species of charge-1/3 anyons with π/3 statistics, we construct two U(3) symmetric Z₃ Orthogonal Metals, distinguished by whether the gapless fermions transform as SU(3) triplets or singlets. We show that these states naturally yield large electrical resistivities even when the fractionalized quasiparticles are in a good metallic regime. Pairing of the charge-1/3 fermions produces an ordinary charge-2e superconductor, smoothly connected to a BCS state but obtained through an intrinsically fractionalized normal state. We discuss experimental signatures of the idea that the normal metallic state in the lightly doped 2/3 state may have fractionalized charge carriers.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文研究分数量子反常 Hall 态被掺杂后可能形成的可动任意子流体，并以扭转 MoTe₂ 中 σxy = 2e²/3h 态附近的实验现象为动机。作者提出相邻的高电阻金属可能是一种 Z₃ 正交金属：它具有清晰的电荷 1/3 费米准粒子并耦合到离散 Z₃ 规范场，但没有清晰的电子准粒子。文中构造了两类 U(3) 对称的 Z₃ 正交金属，说明其可自然产生大电阻率，并讨论电荷 1/3 费米子的配对如何生成普通电荷 2e 超导以及相关实验特征。

articles.title: Microscopic equivalence of the vortex-entry current and the depairing current in a superconducting thin-film strip
articles.title_zh: 超导薄膜条带中涡旋进入电流与退配对电流的微观等价性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.11518v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The current at which vortices enter a superconducting strip is usually identified in Pearl--London theory with the disappearance of an edge barrier. This work reformulates the same question microscopically as the loss of local stability of the vortex-free current-carrying state, using the fixed-current Gibbs functional of dirty-limit Usadel theory, which is valid at arbitrary temperatures. For an ideal homogeneous thin-film strip at zero applied field, with self-field effects neglected, the stability of the vortex-free state is examined against both spatially uniform and nonuniform perturbations. The barrier-disappearance current is shown to be set by the uniform perturbation and to coincide exactly with the depairing current.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作从微观角度重新表述超导条带中涡旋进入电流的问题，将其视为无涡旋载流态局域稳定性的丧失，而不是仅依赖 Pearl-London 理论中的边界势垒消失。作者采用适用于任意温度的脏极限 Usadel 理论固定电流 Gibbs 泛函，在零外场、忽略自场效应的理想均匀薄膜条带中考察均匀和非均匀扰动。结果表明，势垒消失电流由均匀扰动决定，并与退配对电流严格相同。

articles.title: Thermodynamic bound on the Fano factor of a coherent thermoelectric heat engine
articles.title_zh: 相干热电热机 Fano 因子的热力学下界
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.11704v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that for fermionic coherent thermoelectric transport, selecting heat-engine operation yields a thermodynamic uncertainty relation for the charge current that imposes a universal lower limit of F > 1/2 on the corresponding Fano factor. We find that violations of the thermodynamic uncertainty relation for classical Markov processes, typically associated with a quantum advantage, are far more restricted for heat engines than what is allowed by a generic thermodynamic process. For bosonic and classical carriers, the minimum Fano factor increases to F > 1, and the thermodynamic uncertainty relation for classical Markov processes is never violated. We provide numerical evidence that all the obtained bounds are tight and can be saturated by properly designed transmissions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究表明，在费米子相干热电输运中，当系统工作于热机模式时，电荷流的热力学不确定性关系会对相应 Fano 因子施加普适下界 F > 1/2。作者指出，通常被视为量子优势标志的经典 Markov 过程热力学不确定性关系违背，在热机中受到比一般热力学过程更严格的限制。对于玻色子和经典载流子，最小 Fano 因子提高到 F > 1，且不会违背经典 Markov 过程的不确定性关系；数值结果表明这些界限是紧的，并可通过合适设计的透射函数达到。
authors: Nahual Sobrino, Rosario Fazio, Matteo Acciai

articles.title: Quantum Thermodynamics of Electron Transport along Chains of Redox Centers
articles.title_zh: 氧化还原中心链中电子输运的量子热力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09728v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Intramolecular electron transport in biological systems is typically described as a diffusive hopping process, according to the semi-classical rate theories of Marcus and Hopfield combined with classical Pauli-type master equations. However, the possibility that non-trivial quantum mechanical effects could play a functional role in the transport dynamics in certain biomolecular processes has attracted increasing attention. Here, we extend the quantum mechanical model of open system dynamics by the Lindblad equation to a key biological component, the long chains of redox centers based on iron-sulfur clusters or heme groups that are widespread in many biological organisms, where they realize the cellular respiration. This approach allows to explore a wide range of physical parameters, showing key features of electron transport in these multi-domain protein structures. We pay particular attention to heat and entropy transfer between the electrons and the protein bath, which constitutes a benchmark of physical realism for the models. Electron currents, average transfer times and relative efficiency of the transport process are also explicitly characterized.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将基于 Lindblad 方程的开放量子系统动力学模型应用于由铁硫簇或血红素基团组成的长链氧化还原中心，以描述生物体系中的分子内电子输运。不同于传统 Marcus、Hopfield 半经典速率理论与经典 Pauli 主方程，该框架可考察量子力学效应在多结构域蛋白电子传递中的潜在功能作用。作者重点分析电子与蛋白热浴之间的热量和熵传递，并计算电子流、平均转移时间和输运效率等指标，以评估模型的物理现实性和输运特征。
authors: Fabrizio Cleri, Ralf Blossey, Stefano Giordano

articles.title: An Autonomous Scientific Knowledge Generation Framework for AI-Driven Scientific Discovery
articles.title_zh: 面向人工智能驱动科学发现的自主科学知识生成框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09806v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming scientific discovery, but its effectiveness is fundamentally limited by the availability of structured scientific knowledge. Although existing databases have accelerated data-driven materials research, much of the knowledge needed for predictive modeling and inverse design remains embedded in unstructured scientific literature. We present an Autonomous Scientific Knowledge Generation Framework that transforms scientific publications into a Unified AI-Ready Scientific Knowledge Base. The framework integrates ontology-guided literature acquisition, hybrid scientific knowledge extraction, semantic harmonization, knowledge fusion, and validation within a unified workflow. Rather than treating literature retrieval, information extraction, and database construction as separate tasks, the framework progressively converts scientific publications into structured, semantically consistent, and provenance-preserving knowledge suitable for AI-driven reasoning. As a proof of concept, the framework was applied to electro-optic materials. Autonomous literature acquisition retrieved and validated about 1,000 publications from multiple scholarly repositories. A representative subset of eight publications was processed through the complete workflow, generating 29 structured scientific records that were harmonized into 7 canonical scientific records. The results demonstrate the complete transformation from scientific literature to an AI-ready scientific knowledge base while preserving quantitative measurements, operating conditions, provenance, and scientific context. The proposed framework provides a scalable, domain-independent foundation for predictive AI, generative AI, and closed-loop AI-driven scientific discovery.
articles.abstract_zh: 人工智能正在改变科学发现，但其效果受限于结构化科学知识的可获得性。该文提出一种自主科学知识生成框架，将科学文献通过本体引导检索、混合知识抽取、语义协调、知识融合与验证，转化为统一的、适合 AI 使用且保留来源信息的科学知识库。作者以电光材料为概念验证对象，展示了从非结构化文献到可用于推理和建模的结构化知识的自动化流程。

articles.title: Fourth-order Optoelectronic Response from Cascaded Circular Photogalvanic and Nonlinear Hall Effects
articles.title_zh: 级联圆偏振光电流效应与非线性霍尔效应产生的四阶光电响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.10012v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The interplay between nonlinear optical transitions and topological band structure offers a route to control photocurrents. We reveal a fourth-order optoelectronic response that emerges due to an interlink between the circular photogalvanic effect (CPGE) and the Berry curvature dipole (BCD) in noncentrosymmetric 2D materials. Using monolayer Td-WTe₂ as a prototype, we predict that circularly polarized mid-infrared light produces a steady dc injection current that induces an internal electric field, which in turn drives a transverse nonlinear Hall response through BCD. The resulting cascaded photovoltage scales as the fourth power of the optical field E₀⁴. By mapping the full injection current tensor, we show that this cascaded voltage is strongly tunable by the optical geometry: normal incidence drives an in-plane resonance Im(ηyₓy), whereas oblique illumination (θ = 45ⁱ̧rc) recruits a dominant out-of-plane component Im(ηyyz) and amplifies the signal by more than two orders of magnitude (sim10²~μV). While the massive linear Drude background typically screens nonlinear responses in semimetals, we argue that the amplitude modulation of the optical pump allows lock-in detection to cleanly isolate the frequency-doubled cascaded response. The proposed mechanism converts mid-infrared light into a gate-tunable transverse signal, providing a route for probing quantum geometry and realizing topological photodetectors and frequency doublers.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究揭示了非中心对称二维材料中由圆偏振光电流效应与贝里曲率偶极相互关联产生的四阶光电响应。以单层 Td-WTe₂ 为例，作者预测圆偏振中红外光可产生直流注入电流，并诱导内部电场，进而通过贝里曲率偶极驱动横向非线性霍尔响应。该级联光电压随光场四次方标度变化，并可通过入射几何显著调控，斜入射情况下信号可增强两个数量级以上。

articles.title: Unique temporal scaling dimension for quantum criticality in open systems weakly coupled to environment
articles.title_zh: 弱耦合环境开放系统量子临界性的唯一时间标度维度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.11206v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Probing, understanding, predicting, and controlling the real-time dynamics of quantum phase transitions in open systems are of pivotal importance to modern condensed matter physics, statistical physics, and quantum computing, among others. Here it is argued that a distinct temporal renormalization-group eigenvalue is needed for quantum criticality in open systems weakly coupled to their finite-temperature environment. This new physics enables the formulation of a general scaling theory that can accurately account for the critical properties including the specific Kibble-Zurek scaling in such open quantum systems. Remarkably, the critical exponents of time-related quantities are altered nonperturbatively regardless of how weak the coupling is, except for an Ohmic bath. Perspectives for future study are also discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文讨论了与有限温环境弱耦合的开放量子系统在量子相变实时动力学中的临界标度问题。作者指出，此类开放系统的量子临界性需要引入一个不同的时间重整化群本征值，由此建立可描述临界性质和 Kibble-Zurek 标度的一般理论。结果表明，除欧姆浴情形外，即使系统—环境耦合极弱，与时间相关量的临界指数也会发生非微扰改变。

articles.title: Uncertainty-Aware Structure-Property Mapping of Spinodoid Metamaterials via Heteroscedastic Gaussian Process Regression
articles.title_zh: 基于异方差高斯过程回归的 Spinodoid 超材料不确定性感知结构—性能映射
