articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08928v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This work presents a study of an implementation of a novel Quantum Convolutional Neural Network (QCNN) for binary classification of images from the Modified National Institute of Standards and Technology (MNIST) dataset. Using a novel architecture inspired by previous QCNN and classical convolutional neural network (CNN) implementations, we use a hierarchical partitioning approach to implement a QCNN circuit that can be approximated and simulated efficiently on a classical machine for a large problem. First, the original image is partitioned such that each process handles a smaller portion of the image, which is encoded into independent states. Then, these partitions merge and combine, resulting in states that contain information from both partitions while halving the number of processes. After repeating this until one process remains, we reduce the dimensionality of the state until a single qubit remains for measurement. Using this approach, we can use multiple processes in parallel to simulate a large QCNN program without the need for exponentially growing hardware requirements as the number of qubits increases. In our work, we use this scheme to train a 128-qubit model, which is impossible to run on any classical supercomputer without the novel architecture. We also explore the impact of this new model architecture on prediction accuracy by training it to perform binary classification on the MNIST dataset with a small number of qubits, and comparing it to a model without partitioning. Our initial findings show that partitioning images into smaller sub-images with this architecture does not degrade the model's performance and sometimes even improves it, likely because it reduces the Barren plateaus issue in the partitioning process.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种新的量子卷积神经网络架构，用于MNIST图像二分类，并强调其可在经典计算机上高效近似与并行模拟。方法将图像层次化分区，各进程处理较小图像区域并编码为独立量子态，随后逐步合并分区信息、减少进程数量，并最终降维到单量子比特测量。该设计旨在避免随量子比特数增加而出现指数级硬件需求，为大规模QCNN程序的经典并行仿真提供一种可行实现路径。

articles.title: Video Generation Models are General-Purpose Vision Learners
articles.title_zh: 视频生成模型是通用视觉学习器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09024v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Driven by next-token prediction, NLP shifted from task-specific models into powerful generalist foundation models. What, then, is the equivalent catalyst needed to achieve a general-purpose model in computer vision? In this paper, we contend that large-scale text-to-video generation serves as a strong pre-training paradigm for computer vision, providing the necessary spatiotemporal priors, vision-language alignment, and scalability required for general visual intelligence. We introduce GenCeption, which leverages a pre-trained video generative diffusion backbone to define a feed-forward perception model, capable of performing various vision tasks steered by text instructions. Empirical results demonstrate that GenCeption achieves state-of-the-art performance across a diverse suite of tasks, including depth, surface normal, and camera pose estimation, expression-referring segmentation, and 3D keypoint prediction, often matching or surpassing specialized models (e.g. DepthAnything3, SAM3, D4RT, VGGT-Omega, Sapiens, David, Genmo, and Lotus-2). Furthermore, the video generative pretrained backbone outperforms alternative pretraining paradigms (e.g., V-JEPA, and Video MAE) under comparable settings. Importantly, GenCeption exhibits preliminary data and model scaling properties along with exceptional data efficiency, where it achieves comparable performance with leading models like D4RT and VGGT-Omega with 7 to 500 less training data. Finally, GenCeption also exhibits intriguing emergent behaviors: a model trained exclusively on synthetic human videos generalizes to real-world footage and out-of-distribution object categories (e.g., animals and robots). These findings suggest that video generation is not merely a synthesis tool, but a foundational path toward generalist vision intelligence for the physical world. Project page: https://genception.github.io
articles.abstract_zh: 本文认为，大规模文本到视频生成可作为计算机视觉的强预训练范式，为通用视觉智能提供时空先验、视觉—语言对齐能力与可扩展性。作者提出 GenCeption，利用预训练视频生成扩散骨干构建前馈感知模型，并通过文本指令执行多种视觉任务。实验显示，该方法在深度估计、表面法线估计、相机位姿估计、表达式指代分割和三维关键点预测等任务上达到或超过多种专用模型的性能。
authors: Letian Wang, Chuhan Zhang, Rishabh Kabra, Jasper Uijlings, Steven Waslander, Andrew Zisserman, Joao Carreira, Kaiming He, Misha Andriluka, Eduard Gabriel Bazavan, Andrei Zanfir, Cristian Sminchisescu

articles.title: When Routes Run Out: Adversarial Co-Learning and Explainable Robustness in Quantum Repeater Networks
articles.title_zh: 当路由耗尽：量子中继网络中的对抗协同学习与可解释鲁棒性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09378v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study an adversarial bandit problem for entanglement-based quantum-network routing over a modest graph corpus. Alice selects an end-to-end repeater route for an Ekert-91 protocol (E91) representing her move, while Eve selects an attack surface, either edge intercept--resend or repeater memory degradation. Payoffs are drawn from cached SeQUeNCe-simulated E91 transcripts, and Alice accepts a turn when the finite-sample statistic violates the Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt (CHSH) bound. Performing adversarial co-learning across 50 structured topologies, we find that learned retention tracks a full-matrix minimax reference closely (Pearson r=0.99): under a one-surface Eve action model, bottleneck families have zero retention, while non-bottleneck families follow a 1-1/N coverage principle. We then fit decision-tree explanation models to graph-, attack-, and route-level topology-corpus targets and report their faithfulness. Finally, we construct prompt records for local language models to summarize the tree evidence, resulting in an open-source explanation workflow for quantum-repeater network games.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究基于纠缠的量子网络路由中的对抗性多臂老虎机问题，其中 Alice 为 E91 协议选择端到端中继路由，Eve 选择边拦截重发或中继存储退化等攻击面。作者基于 SeQUeNCe 模拟得到的 E91 记录进行对抗协同学习，并以 CHSH 不等式违规统计量作为接受判据。结果表明，学习得到的保留率与全矩阵极小极大参考高度一致，并进一步通过决策树和本地语言模型构建了面向量子中继网络博弈的开源解释流程。
authors: Brennan Bell, Inti Gabriel Mendoza Estrada, Andreas Trügler, Paul Erker

articles.title: Lean-QIT: Towards a Formal Infrastructure for Quantum Information Theory
articles.title_zh: Lean-QIT：迈向量子信息论的形式化基础设施
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09632v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum information theory (QIT) characterizes the capabilities and fundamental limits of quantum information processing, underpinning quantum communication, computation, and error correction. Formalizing its coding theorems requires connecting finite-block protocols, analytic inequalities, and asymptotic limits within a unified machine-checked framework. Existing developments, however, lack a reusable operational layer that defines codes, error criteria, achievable rates, and capacities independently of their information-theoretic characterizations. In this work, we present LeanQIT, a Lean 4 library for finite-dimensional QIT. It provides composable, kernel-checked interfaces for quantum states and channels, source and channel codes, finite-block performance criteria, hypothesis testing, one-shot quantities, and asymptotic rate constructions. Using this infrastructure, we formalize Schumacher's quantum source-coding theorem, the Holevo--Schumacher--Westmoreland classical-capacity theorem, and the entanglement-assisted classical-capacity theorem together with its strong converse. By separating operational definitions from analytic characterizations and exposing reusable achievability, converse, and asymptotic components, Lean-QIT provides a machine-readable foundation for formal QIT and a compositional knowledge substrate for emerging AI-assisted formalization, automated proof search, and agentic reasoning in quantum information and computation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 LeanQIT，一个面向有限维量子信息论的 Lean 4 库，旨在为量子编码定理的机器校验形式化提供可复用基础设施。该库提供量子态与信道、源编码与信道编码、有限块性能准则、假设检验、一次性量以及渐近速率构造等可组合接口。基于该框架，作者形式化了 Schumacher 量子源编码定理、Holevo–Schumacher–Westmoreland 经典容量定理以及纠缠辅助经典容量定理及其强逆定理。
authors: Chengkai Zhu, Ziao Tang, Guocheng Zhen, Yimeng Cao, Yusheng Zhao, Ranyiliu Chen, Xuanqiang Zhao, Lei Zhang, Xin Wang

articles.title: Improving Language Agents through BREW: Bootstrapping expeRientially-learned Environmental knoWledge
articles.title_zh: 通过 BREW 改进语言智能体：自举式经验环境知识学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.20297v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents are increasingly capable of complex, multi-step tasks such as GUI automation, tool use, and data manipulation, yet they cannot learn from experience: each new session rediscovers solutions from scratch. We introduce BREW (Bootstrapping expeRientially-learned Environmental knoWledge), a framework that distills an agent's past interaction trajectories into a structured, retrievable knowledge base (KB) of natural-language recipes, concept-level procedural documents that capture what to do, when it applies, and what to watch out for. Drawing on the principle of library learning from program synthesis, BREW decomposes agent memory into modular, concept-localized documents and formalizes KB construction as a state-space search problem. To navigate this space, we introduce Expand-and-Gather Monte Carlo Tree Search (EG-MCTS), a reward-guided algorithm that jointly optimizes recipe accuracy and retrievability across parallel, per-concept search trees. We further adapt hindsight relabeling to convert near-miss trajectories into positive demonstrations, surfacing latent agent competencies as reusable knowledge. On three domain-grounded benchmarks, OSWorld, tau²⁻Bench, and SpreadSheetBench, BREW achieves 10-20% gains in task success and 10-15% fewer execution steps over base agents, while consistently outperforming existing memory-augmented baselines that can degrade below memoryless performance. The resulting KB is inspectable, modular, and extensible, providing a transparent and controllable substrate for agent optimization.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 BREW 框架，用于将大语言模型智能体过去的交互轨迹蒸馏为结构化、可检索的自然语言知识库，从而缓解智能体在新会话中无法复用经验的问题。该知识库由概念级过程性“配方”组成，记录适用条件、操作步骤和注意事项，并将构建过程形式化为状态空间搜索问题。作者进一步提出 Expand-and-Gather 蒙特卡洛树搜索算法，并结合 hindsight relabeling 将近似失败轨迹转化为可复用示范，以提升配方准确性和可检索性。
authors: Shashank Kirtania, Param Biyani, Priyanshu Gupta, Yasharth Bajpai, Roshni Iyer, Sumit Gulwani, Gustavo Soares

articles.title: RIS-Assisted Downlink Pinching-Antenna Systems: GNN-Enabled Optimization Approaches
articles.title_zh: RIS 辅助下行捏合天线系统：基于图神经网络的优化方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.20305v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This paper investigates a reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-assisted multi-waveguide pinching-antenna (PA) system (PASS) for multi-user downlink information transmission, motivated by the unknown impact of the integration of emerging PASS and RIS on wireless communications. First, we formulate sum rate (SR) and energy efficiency (EE) maximization problems in a unified framework, subject to constraints on the movable region of PAs, total power budget, and tunable phase of RIS elements. Then, by leveraging a graph-structured topology of the RIS-assisted PASS, a novel three-stage graph neural network (GNN) is proposed, which learns PA positions based on user locations, and RIS phase shifts according to composite channel conditions at the first two stages, respectively, and finally determines beamforming vectors. Specifically, the proposed GNN is achieved through unsupervised training, together with three implementation strategies for its integration with convex optimization, thus offering trade-offs between inference time and solution optimality. Extensive numerical results are provided to validate the effectiveness of the proposed GNN, and to support its unique attributes of viable generalization capability, good performance reliability, and real-time applicability. Moreover, the impact of key parameters on RIS-assisted PASS is illustrated and analyzed.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究可重构智能表面辅助的多波导捏合天线系统在多用户下行信息传输中的优化问题。作者在统一框架下建立和速率最大化与能效最大化问题，并考虑捏合天线可移动区域、总功率预算和 RIS 单元相位可调等约束。基于系统的图结构拓扑，论文提出三阶段图神经网络，分别学习天线位置、RIS 相移和波束成形向量，并通过无监督训练及与凸优化结合的多种策略在推理速度和解质量之间折中。
authors: Changpeng He, Yang Lu, Yanqing Xu, Chong-Yung Chi, Arumugam Nallanathan

articles.title: A Quatre-Lobed Arc-Slotted Microstrip Patch Antenna for Ku-Band Applications at 14.45 GHz
articles.title_zh: 面向 14.45 GHz Ku 波段应用的四叶弧缝微带贴片天线
articles.abstract: This paper presents the design of a Quatre-Lobed Arc-Slotted microstrip patch antenna, having a size of 8 mm × 8 mm × 0.8 mm, with an objective to attain an optimal value of 14.45 GHz for its operating frequency in the Ku frequency band (12–18 GHz) application. Simple, single-layer microstrip antennas typically involve a design trade-off between the antenna’s profile, cost-effectiveness, level of performance, and stability of radiation patterns. The constructed patch antenna accommodates a microstrip feed with a lumped port. The feed structure facili-tates impedance matching and effective excitation of the dominant mode. The High Frequency Structure Simulator (HFSS) was used to run the full-wave elec-tromagnetic simulations. By including a finite conductor with a dielectric loss, the simulated metal and dielectric structures closely modeled the antenna’s behav-ior in the high-frequency region of the band. The antenna showed an impedance bandwidth of 14.05 to 15.10 GHz (broadside radiation pattern), with reflection coefficient S11 = − 18.5 dB at 14.45 GHz; the angular distribution of the radi-ation pattern was stable and showed a maximal gain of 6.27 dBi, demonstrating effective radiation performance. Thus, the symmetric arc-slot geometry design of the patch antenna facilitated a trade-off between current path control, structural simplicity, and impedance balance. The proposed patch antenna design is a practi-cal and deployable solution for integration into Ku-band satellite communication systems, wireless applications, and high-frequency communication systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文设计了一种尺寸为 8 mm × 8 mm × 0.8 mm 的四叶弧缝微带贴片天线，目标工作频率为 Ku 波段的 14.45 GHz。作者采用 HFSS 进行全波电磁仿真，并考虑有限导体和介质损耗以更贴近高频工作特性。仿真结果显示，该天线在 14.05 至 15.10 GHz 范围内具有阻抗带宽，在 14.45 GHz 处反射系数为 −18.5 dB，最大增益为 6.27 dBi，表现出稳定的宽边辐射特性。

articles.title: Quantum Tensor Magnetometry with Bright Multi-Dimensional Entangled Lights
articles.title_zh: 利用明亮多维纠缠光实现量子张量磁测量
articles.abstract: Tensor measurements play a vital role in both fundamental sciences and interdisciplinary applications such as navigation and remote sensing which require sensitive perception of the gradient of vector fields. Fundamentally, these measurements rely on the estimation of multiple parameters, which is a key focus in metrology. Quantum metrology has achieved remarkable success in surpassing the standard quantum limit for single-parameter estimation, offering extraordinary sensitivity. Quantum multiparameter estimation has also been demonstrated recently with few-particle quantum systems. Here, we develop tensor quantum metrology by advancing multiparameter quantum sensing to an unprecedented level with both high scalability and multidimensional performance, fulfilling the essential demands on sensitivity for tensor measurements. We generate a bright, multidimensional polarization-entangled light source from an atomic ensemble, with three simultaneously squeezed Stokes operators, enabling superior performance in multiparameter quantum sensing compared to conventional polarization-entangled light. By employing such a quantum light in a tensor magnetometry, we achieve a 6 dB quantum enhancement in both direction and amplitude measurements of magnetic field gradient, with a directional gradient sensitivity of 21μrad/cm/√Hz and an amplitude gradient sensitivity of 6 fT/cm/√Hz. As the first realization of high-sensitivity quantum-enhanced sensing of a tensor field, this work marks a milestone in the advancement of quantum metrology.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文面向需要感知矢量场梯度的张量测量任务，发展了具有高可扩展性和多维性能的多参数量子传感方法。作者从原子系综中产生明亮的多维偏振纠缠光源，并实现三个 Stokes 算符的同时压缩，使其在多参数量子传感中优于传统偏振纠缠光。将该量子光用于张量磁测量时，实验实现了约 6 dB 的量子增强，显示出其在导航、遥感等高灵敏测量场景中的潜力。

articles.title: Gravitational-Wave Echoes from a Hayward Black Hole under Minimal Geometric Deformation
articles.title_zh: 最小几何形变下 Hayward 黑洞的引力波回声
articles.abstract: We study a regular black-hole geometry obtained by applying a radial minimal geometric deformation (MGD) of dimensionless strength α to the Hayward seed, characterized by its ADM mass M and its regularity scale g,and then trace the construction through the odd-parity perturbation problem. The background sector is kept exact: the deformation function is written in closed form, the Einstein equations separate into seed and decoupler blocks (the decoupler being the additional effective source that deforms the seed), asymptotic flatness is preserved, and the deformed metric remains curvature regular at the center while inheriting the seed horizon structure in an explicit admissible range of the deformation parameter α. In the axial sector we work under the frozen-source odd-parity closure appropriate to a static anisotropic background without an independent propagating odd matter mode. Within that framework the master equation acquires an exact effective potential whose seed contribution retains the nonvacuum Hayward correction proportional to the radial derivative m_H'(r) of the Hayward mass function m_H(r) and whose decoupling contribution is isolated analytically. We show that this potential passes from a single-barrier profile to a genuine max--min--max structure in an open region of the (g,α) plane, so the exact geometry itself supplies a trapping cavity without any externally imposed mirror or phenomenological reflecting surface. A representative characteristic evolution is then used to connect the potential structure to delayed secondary pulses in the time domain. The analysis makes each algebraic step explicit, states every assumption at the point of use, distinguishes exact statements from numerical evidence, and records the numerical methodology in enough detail for direct audit and reproduction.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究在 Hayward 正则黑洞背景上施加径向最小几何形变后得到的正则黑洞几何，并将该构造推进到奇宇称扰动问题。作者保持背景解的精确性，给出闭式形变函数，分离种子与解耦源的爱因斯坦方程，并讨论渐近平坦性、中心曲率正则性以及形变参数允许范围内的视界结构。在轴向扰动框架下，论文推导了精确有效势，解析分离 Hayward 非真空修正与形变解耦贡献，用于分析可能的引力波回声特征。

articles.title: Empty scaffold allocation bias in molecular distribution shift evaluation
articles.title_zh: 分子分布偏移评估中的空骨架分配偏差
articles.abstract: Scaffold-based evaluation is widely used to estimate molecular machine-learning generalization to unseen scaffolds, but its validity depends on each split unit representing a chemically meaningful shared core. Here we show that this principle breaks down for molecules with empty Bemis–Murcko scaffold representations. These no-scaffold molecules are not an ordinary scaffold class: they lack a common ring–linker framework, are internally heterogeneous, show much lower within-unit similarity than true scaffold groups, and are weakly supported by the scaffold-bearing chemical space. Nevertheless, standard scaffold splitting collapses them into a single empty-scaffold bucket and treats them as one indivisible split unit. Across MoleculeNet and Deep-PK/ADMET benchmarks, this is not rare: 8 of 16 MoleculeNet datasets and 40 of 73 Deep-PK/ADMET tasks contain more than 10% no-scaffold molecules, with several physicochemical endpoints approaching 50%. We further show that Scaffold Split, UMAP-based clustering, DataSAIL and LoHi can all deplete no-scaffold molecules from training while enriching them in validation or test sets. This hidden allocation bias confounds scaffold-level evaluation with residual-subpopulation underrepresentation, compressing classification ranking toward the prior baseline and enriching high-multiple regression error inflation. Empty-Scaffold-Aware repair restores training-side representation while retaining evaluation exposure and controlling train-facing similarity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出，基于分子骨架的机器学习泛化评估在处理 Bemis–Murcko 空骨架分子时存在系统性问题。无骨架分子并不构成化学上有共同核心的普通骨架类别，而是内部异质、相似性较低，并且与含骨架化学空间的支持较弱。作者在 MoleculeNet 和 Deep-PK/ADMET 基准上发现无骨架分子占比并不罕见，且多种划分或聚类方法可能使其在训练集被耗尽而在验证/测试集中富集，从而混淆对骨架级分布外泛化能力的评估。

articles.title: Fabrication and H2S gas sensitive performance of NiO ultrathin film encapsulated VO2(A) nanowire core-shell heterojunction structure
articles.title_zh: NiO 超薄膜包覆 VO2(A) 纳米线核壳异质结的制备及 H2S 气敏性能
articles.abstract: High performance hydrogen sulfide (H2S) gas sensor is highly desired to develop for the harmfulness of H2S to human’s health. In this work, a NiO/VO2(A) nanowire core-shell heterojunction is constructed through chemical precipitation and annealing to improve the sensitivity to H2S. The influence of precursor molar ratios on the composition, morphology, and gas-sensing performance of the core-shell heterojunction structure was investigated. The NiO/VO2(A) nanowire core-shell heterojunction based sensor exhibits high sensitivity when the precursor molar ratio is 1:0.5. The gas response value is reached up to 11.57 to 1 ppm H2S gas at 100°C. And the gas sensor also shows excellent response and recovery characteristics. The high sensing performance is related to the heterojunction between VO2(A) and ultrathin NiO film and the catalytic activity of NiO, which can enhance the chemical adsorption of oxygen on the surface of the heterojunction structure. The results suggest that VO2(A) nanowires core-shell nanostructure have great potential for H2S gas detection.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过化学沉淀和退火构建 NiO/VO2(A) 纳米线核壳异质结，以提升对硫化氢气体的检测灵敏度。作者考察了前驱体摩尔比对材料组成、形貌和气敏性能的影响，发现摩尔比为 1:0.5 时传感器表现最佳。该传感器在 100°C 下对 1 ppm H2S 的响应值达到 11.57，并具有良好的响应与恢复特性，其性能提升归因于 VO2(A) 与超薄 NiO 膜形成的异质结以及 NiO 的催化活性。

articles.title: A Stress-Based Prediction of Support Failure and Its Influence on Machining Quality in Support-Assisted Milling of LPBF Parts
articles.title_zh: LPBF 零件支撑辅助铣削中基于应力的支撑失效预测及其对加工质量的影响
articles.abstract: Laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) enables the fabrication of complex metallic components; however, milling-based post-processing is required to achieve functional surface quality and dimensional accuracy. Once separated from the build plate, the fabricated part must be re-fixed to a milling machine using additional clamping fixtures, and this procedure increases process complexity and machining errors due to repeated setup and alignment. To address this limitation, this study proposes a stress-based design approach for utilizing as-built support structures as structural fixtures during support-assisted milling. Cutting forces of LPBF-fabricated Pure Titanium specimens were experimentally measured under various machining conditions, and a mechanistic load model was established. The derived load model was used to estimate cutting loads for different process parameters. Support-assisted milling experiments were conducted to observe structural behavior and identify the onset of support failure under increasing cutting loads. Finite element simulations were performed using the calculated cutting loads to evaluate stress distributions within the support structures. For each design variable, the critical maximum principal stress corresponding to failure initiation was determined. Validation using a complex cage geometry demonstrated that the proposed stress criterion reliably predicts machining stability. The influence of stress levels on machining quality was further examined. Even below the critical stress threshold, increasing stress resulted in gradual deterioration of straightness error and surface roughness, indicating that stress magnitude affects machining performance prior to structural failure. The proposed approach provides a quantitative framework linking cutting load, stress distribution, failure initiation, and machining quality, thereby enabling predictive evaluation of support-assisted milling feasibility prior to machining.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对激光粉末床熔融零件后处理铣削中的重复装夹和对准误差问题，提出利用原位成形支撑结构作为加工夹持结构的基于应力的设计方法。作者对 LPBF 纯钛试样在不同切削条件下的切削力进行实验测量，并建立力学载荷模型以估算不同工艺参数下的切削载荷。随后通过支撑辅助铣削实验和有限元仿真分析支撑结构在载荷增加过程中的行为和失效起点，为支撑设计与加工质量控制提供依据。

articles.title: A generative framework for precise topology engineering of polymer networks
articles.title_zh: 用于聚合物网络精确拓扑工程的生成式框架
articles.abstract: The mechanical performance of crosslinked polymer networks is typically predicted from the average crosslink density, yet topological heterogeneity of the crosslink functionality distribution P (f) can produce vast differences in elasticity and fracture at fixed density. Existing kinetic and reaction-diffusion algorithms cannot prescribe P (f) precisely, limiting systematic topological studies. We introduce a generative framework that maps abstract graph topologies into physically equilibrated molecular networks at arbitrary resolution. Atomistic simulations of PDMS and PMTFPS built on identical graph topologies reproduce chemical specificity, capturing the distinct glass transition temperatures driven by side-group sterics. A coarse-grained ensemble of over 300 architectures at fixed mean functionality but varied P (f) reveals a state-dependent hierarchy of design drivers: brittle networks fail via local stress concentrations (high betweenness centrality), while tough networks are governed by cooperative load sharing (high eigenvector centrality). Topological order thus acts as an orthogonal design variable to crosslink density, enabling mechanical tuning without altering chemistry.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种生成式框架，可将抽象图拓扑映射为物理平衡的分子网络，从而在任意分辨率下精确控制交联聚合物网络的拓扑结构。作者利用相同图拓扑构建 PDMS 和 PMTFPS 的原子级模拟，捕捉由侧基空间位阻导致的不同玻璃化转变温度。进一步的粗粒化大规模网络集合表明，在平均交联功能度固定时，功能度分布和网络中心性等拓扑特征会显著影响弹性与断裂行为，使拓扑有序性成为独立于交联密度的力学设计变量。

articles.title: Physics-Informed Ensemble Learning for Structural Wall Plastic Hinge Length Prediction
articles.title_zh: 用于结构墙塑性铰长度预测的物理信息集成学习
articles.abstract: This paper presents a novel stacking ensemble framework for predicting the plastic hinge length of reinforced concrete shear walls, a critical parameter in seismic design and performance assessment. The proposed methodology leverages a two-level ensemble architecture, combining multiple base learners with a meta-learner to capture the complex nonlinear relationships between geometric and material properties and the resulting plastic hinge length. The framework is grounded in a theoretical paradigm that bridges causal inference with stochastic differential geometry, providing rigorous mathematical underpinnings for the learning objective and establishing convergence and generalization guarantees. Comprehensive experimental validation on the Hoult RCSW database, comprising 721 experimental samples, demonstrates the superiority of the proposed approach. The stacking ensemble with a gradient boosting meta-learner achieves the lowest mean squared error of 0.012 square metres and the highest coefficient of determination of 0.916, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art ensemble learning methods and empirical formulations. The framework exhibits robust performance across different wall length ranges, strong transferability to related structural engineering tasks, and stability under input perturbations. This work establishes a new paradigm for data-driven structural engineering, demonstrating the value of ensemble architectures for capturing the stochastic and causal nature of plastic hinge formation in reinforced concrete walls.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种堆叠集成学习框架，用于预测钢筋混凝土剪力墙的塑性铰长度这一抗震设计与性能评估关键参数。该方法以两级集成结构结合多个基学习器与元学习器，并引入连接因果推断与随机微分几何的理论范式，以刻画几何和材料参数与塑性铰长度之间的复杂非线性关系。在包含721个试验样本的Hoult RCSW数据库上验证表明，以梯度提升为元学习器的堆叠模型取得最低均方误差和最高决定系数，优于现有集成学习方法和经验公式。

articles.title: Operationalizing Generative Spatial Intelligence: A Conversational GeoAI Framework for Flood Risk Communication
articles.title_zh: 生成式空间智能的操作化：面向洪水风险沟通的对话式GeoAI框架
articles.abstract: Official flood maps, while technically robust, present significant usability challenges for non-expert decision-makers, creating a critical communication gap between scientific flood data and immediate community action. This research addresses this gap by designing and evaluating a novel, human-centered GeoAI framework that integrates a conversational AI assistant with an interactive geospatial interface to transform static maps into dynamic storytelling mediums. Beyond technical tool development, the study draws upon the emerging concept of Generative Spatial Intelligence (GSI) as a geospatial interaction framework that extends the foundations of Exploratory Spatial Data Analysis (ESDA), examining how AI-mediated systems support knowledge generation, contextual interpretation, and human–AI collaborative spatial reasoning. By bridging the gap between physical Earth observation data and their social implications, the proposed framework enables the autonomous, real-time synthesis of multi-domain datasets. We combine principles of user-centered design and GIS to develop an interactive prototype grounded in a domain-specific knowledge graph and a curated database of hydrologic and social geospatial layers. Through data storytelling, the system translates complex map features into plain-language, contextual insights, transforming passive map viewing into an active process of spatial learning and decision support. The AI-powered storytelling capability is evaluated using a targeted test suite of 40 synthesized, domain-specific questions that integrate hydrologic concepts with physical and social geospatial data to simulate realistic flood scenarios. Findings demonstrate that the system effectively synthesizes complex information into location-specific advisories, illustrating how conversational GeoAI can automate the translation of raw spatial telemetry into actionable disaster intelligence and thereby democratize high-stakes emergency decision-making for community leaders.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对官方洪水地图对非专业决策者不够易用、难以转化为社区即时行动的问题，设计并评估了一种以人为中心的GeoAI框架。框架将对话式AI助手与交互式地理空间界面结合，把静态洪水地图转化为动态叙事媒介。研究以生成式空间智能为概念基础，探讨AI中介系统如何支持知识生成、情境解释和人机协同空间推理，并通过领域知识图谱及水文、社会等多域数据支撑实时综合分析。

articles.title: ℓ0-Regularized Quadratic Surface Support Vector Machines
articles.title_zh: ℓ0正则化二次曲面支持向量机
articles.abstract: Kernel-free quadratic surface support vector machines (QSVM) have recently gained traction due to their flexibility in modeling nonlinear decision boundaries without relying on kernel functions. However, the introduction of a full quadratic classifier significantly increases the number of model parameters, scaling quadratically with data dimensionality, which often leads to overfitting and makes interpretation difficult. To address these challenges, we propose sparse variants of the QSVM by enforcing a cardinality constraint on the model parameters. While enhancing generalization and promoting sparsity, leveraging the ℓ0-norm inevitably incurs additional computational complexity. To tackle this, we develop a penalty decomposition algorithm that produces solutions that provably satisfy the first-order Lu-Zhang optimality conditions. We show that the subproblems arising in the algorithm either admit closed-form solutions or can be solved efficiently via dual formulations, thereby contributing to the method’s overall effectiveness. Besides, we analyze the convergence behavior of the algorithm under both loss settings. In addition, the numerical experiments on public benchmark datasets indicate that the proposed model is competitive with commonly used SVM variants and produces sparse solutions as expected. Moreover, its strong performance on real-world credit datasets demonstrates its potential for credit scoring applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究无核二次曲面支持向量机在非线性分类中的稀疏化问题。由于完整二次分类器的参数数量随数据维度呈二次增长，容易导致过拟合并降低可解释性，作者通过对模型参数施加基数约束提出稀疏QSVM变体。为处理ℓ0范数带来的计算复杂性，论文设计了惩罚分解算法，并证明其解满足一阶Lu-Zhang最优性条件；相关子问题可通过闭式解或对偶形式高效求解。数值实验用于评估该方法在公共基准数据集上的表现。

articles.title: A Novel Method for Determining Phase-Specific Microhardness from Non-targeted Automated Testing of Fine-grained Multiphase Structures
articles.title_zh: 基于细晶多相组织非定向自动测试确定相特异性显微硬度的新方法
articles.abstract: Microscale characterization of the mechanical properties of individual phases in multiphase alloys provides important information for alloy design, production, and in-service performance. Automated microhardness testing has significant potential for the statistical characterization of multiphase materials. However, successful application of this technique is limited for fine-grained multiphase structures due to indentations overlapping grain boundaries, and the resulting misinterpretation of the true microhardness of individual phases. To determine the true phase-specific microhardness in multiphase fine-grained structures, a novel experimental-simulation methodology was proposed based on the principle of non-targeted microhardness measurements (NTM). The program for virtual NTM testing was developed and applied to regular and irregular grain morphologies in two-phase microstructures. This provided a quantitative understanding of the statistical relationship between the NTM measured dataset and the underlying microstructure. It was shown that the dimensionless parameter R, defined as the ratio of indentation diameter to the characteristic grain diameter, is a fundamental descriptor of datasets obtained during NTM testing. Simulations proved that, for specific values of the R-ratio, phase fraction and microhardness, NTM test delivers the unique microhardness probability distribution function. This property of datasets from NTM tests was used to determine intrinsic phase characteristics from inverse simulation. The proposed methodology provides a basis for optimizing NTM testing procedures, and, most importantly, improving phase-specific property characterization in fine-grained structures. The proposed combination of stochastic simulation with large experimental dataset from NTM test can be used for alloy design and quality control of multiphase engineering alloys.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种实验—模拟结合的方法，用于在细晶多相合金中从非定向自动显微硬度测试结果反推出各相真实显微硬度。传统自动压痕测试在细晶多相组织中易跨越晶界，导致对单相硬度的误判；作者通过虚拟非定向测试程序研究规则和不规则两相组织中测量数据与真实组织之间的统计关系。结果表明，压痕直径与特征晶粒直径之比R是描述测量偏差和相硬度识别能力的关键无量纲参数。

articles.title: A Complex-Quaternionic Riemann–Silberstein Formalism for Single-Photon Electromagnetic Wave Packets
articles.title_zh: 单光子电磁波包的复四元数Riemann–Silberstein形式
articles.abstract: Single photons are elementary excitations of the quantized electromagnetic field, yet their electromagnetic structure is often described through separate electric and magnetic field operators. Here we develop a theorem-based complex-quaternionic Riemann-Silberstein representation of single-photon electromagnetic wave packets. The formalism embeds the transverse electric and magnetic components into one helicity-resolved biquaternionic field, so that transversality, electric-magnetic orthogonality, helicity projection, and mode-wise nullity are encoded within a single algebraic structure. We show that the source-free Maxwell equations reduce to one first-order quaternionic Maxwell equation and that canonical quantization yields the one-photon electromagnetic amplitude as a vacuum-to-one-photon transition matrix element. The resulting expression is a spectral superposition of transverse modes weighted by the photon wave-packet envelope. Beyond notational compactness, the construction separates three operational ingredients of a one-photon state: spectral localization, helicity selection, and mode matching to a detector or target mode. The framework is fully compatible with standard QED and clarifies that broadband photon wave packets are generally not pointwise null, although each Fourier component is null.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了一种基于定理的复四元数Riemann–Silberstein表述，用于描述单光子电磁波包。该形式将横向电场与磁场分量嵌入一个按螺旋度分辨的双四元数字段中，使横向性、电磁正交性、螺旋度投影和逐模零性可由统一代数结构表达。作者证明无源麦克斯韦方程可化为一个一阶四元数麦克斯韦方程，并通过正则量子化得到单光子电磁振幅的真空到单光子跃迁矩阵元。该框架有助于区分单光子态中的谱局域、螺旋度选择以及与探测器或目标模式的匹配。

articles.title: Microstructure and mechanical properties of laser deposition repairing ZM5 magnesium alloy in the aerospace field
articles.title_zh: 航空航天领域ZM5镁合金激光沉积修复的显微组织与力学性能
articles.abstract: To address metallurgical defects and abnormal damages occurring in magnesium alloy components during casting, machining, and service operation in the aerospace component, research has been conducted on laser deposition repairing of ZM5 alloy. Using equipment such as optical microscopes, scanning electron microscopes, microhardness tester and tensile testing machines, the microstructural characteristics and mechanical properties of the repaired samples were analyzed. The results show that the repaired zone forms a good metallurgical bond with the base material without obviously unfused and crack defects. The microstructure of repaired zone is fine and consists of equiaxed α-Mg matrix, β-Mg17Al12 and Al8Mn5 phases dispersively distributed at the grain boundaries and intragranular. The microhardness of the repaired zone is increased by 27% compared with the base material. The ultimate tensile strength of the repaired sample is slightly lower than that of the base material, but the elongation is higher. Both base materials and the repaired samples show the typical cleavage fracture.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对航空航天镁合金构件在铸造、加工和服役过程中出现的冶金缺陷与异常损伤，研究了ZM5合金的激光沉积修复。通过光学显微镜、扫描电镜、显微硬度计和拉伸试验机分析修复样品的组织与力学性能。结果显示，修复区与基体形成良好冶金结合，无明显未熔合和裂纹缺陷；修复区组织细小，由等轴α-Mg基体及分散于晶界和晶内的β-Mg17Al12、Al8Mn5相组成。修复区显微硬度较基体提高27%，修复样品抗拉强度略低于基体但延伸率更高，二者均表现出典型解理断裂特征。

articles.title: Validation Of a Modified Normalized Kruskal-Walis Fractal Dimension For Characterizing Pore Structure in Khuff Carbonate Reservoirs, Central Saudi Arabia
articles.title_zh: 用于表征沙特阿拉伯中部Khuff碳酸盐岩储层孔隙结构的改进归一化Kruskal–Wallis分形维数验证
articles.abstract: Carbonate samples were collected from surface exposures of the Khartam Reservoirs within the Permo–Triassic Khuff Formation of central Saudi Arabia. Porosity and permeability measurements were obtained for all samples, and pore-network heterogeneity was investigated using two independent fractal approaches derived from capillary-pressure data. The first method utilized the relationship between log-normalized pore radius, Log(R/Rmax), and Log10(water saturation), whereas the second employed Log(modified normalized Kruskal–Wallis parameter, MNKW) versus Log10(water saturation). In both methods, the fractal dimension was determined from the positive linear coefficient of the fitted quadratic expression according to Df = 2 + b. The calculated fractal dimensions ranged from approximately 2.36 to 2.86 and showed a strong positive association with permeability and pore-network connectivity. Porosity ranged from 2.269–11.253%, whereas permeability ranged from 0.264–3.445 mD. Representative samples with low, average, and high fractal dimensions yielded Df values of approximately 2.36, 2.72, and 2.86, respectively. Corresponding coefficients of determination increased from about 0.826 to 0.995 and 0.9997, indicating that fractal behavior becomes increasingly pronounced as pore-system complexity increases. Comparison of the two approaches demonstrated remarkable consistency. Regression analysis of 26 paired Df values produced a slope of 0.99531, an intercept of 0.00641, and R² = 0.9999986, confirming near-perfect agreement between methods. Bland–Altman analysis revealed a small mean bias (~ 0.0063 Df units) and narrow limits of agreement; however, a strong proportional bias was identified, indicating that differences between methods increase systematically with increasing Df. The results demonstrate that fractal dimension is an effective quantitative descriptor of pore-structure heterogeneity in tight carbonate reservoirs. Both approaches provide robust and highly consistent characterization of pore systems and may be extended to other porous materials, including nanomaterials, ceramics, catalysts, and engineered porous media.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采集沙特阿拉伯中部二叠—三叠系Khuff组Khartam储层地表露头碳酸盐岩样品，测量其孔隙度和渗透率，并基于毛管压力数据用两种分形方法分析孔隙网络非均质性。第一种方法利用归一化孔喉半径对数与含水饱和度对数的关系，第二种方法采用改进归一化Kruskal–Wallis参数与含水饱和度对数的关系，并由拟合二次表达式的正线性系数计算分形维数。结果显示，分形维数约为2.36至2.86，并与渗透率和孔隙网络连通性呈强正相关，说明该指标可用于表征碳酸盐岩储层孔隙结构复杂性。
authors: Prof. Khalid Elyas Mohamed Elameen AlKhidir

articles.title: Limited propagation of Pb-Pb interactions through graphene and Pb film growth for Pb/graphene/Pb/SiC intercalation systems
articles.title_zh: 石墨烯与Pb膜生长中Pb–Pb相互作用的有限传播：Pb/石墨烯/Pb/SiC插层体系研究
articles.abstract: Author(s): Yong Han, Shen Chen, Marek Kolmer, Michael C. Tringides, and James W. Evans The growth of epitaxial thin films is directed by the substrate. Here, the authors investigate Pb film growth on SiC-supported graphene with an intercalated Pb(111)-like layer under graphene. They find that Pb–Pb interactions propagate only weakly through graphene, and that the potential energy surface for Pb adatoms does not inherit the periodicity of the intercalated Pb layer. Thus, the intercalated Pb(111) does not “remotely” direct the formation of a Pb(111) film. Nevertheless, the intercalated and on-top Pb(111)-like layers are in-registry reflecting their interaction with the same graphene sheet. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 045417] Published Mon Jul 13, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了SiC支持的石墨烯上Pb薄膜生长及其与插层Pb(111)-样层之间的耦合关系。结果表明，Pb–Pb相互作用穿过石墨烯的传播很弱，插层Pb层并不会“远程”引导上层Pb(111)薄膜的形成。尽管如此，插层层与上层Pb(111)-样结构仍保持一定注册关系，反映出它们共同受到同一石墨烯层的影响。
authors: Yong Han, Shen Chen, Marek Kolmer, Michael C. Tringides, and James W. Evans

articles.title: Mott-Anderson crossover without metallization in pressurized Sr₃Ir₂O₇
articles.title_zh: 加压Sr3Ir2O7中无金属化的莫特—安德森交叉
articles.abstract: Author(s): Xia Yin, Weicheng Guo, Miao Li, Chunlei Yang, Chengyu Li, Dong Wang, Jianbo Zhang, Yongjin Chen, Takeshi Nakagawa, Caoshun Zhang, Chunsheng Xia, Pengfei Shan, Xiaoping Yang, Sheng Meng, Jun Chang, Ho-kwang Mao, and Yang Ding Here, the authors use high-pressure transport, low-temperature magnetoresistance, x-ray diffraction and transmission electron microscopy to show that Sr 3 Ir 2 O 7 evolves, without metallization, from a Mott regime dominated by electronic correlations to an Anderson-like localized regime dominated by disorder. Pressure collapses the activation gap near 12–17 GPa, yet low-temperature conduction remains nonmetallic and follows three-dimensional variable-range hopping, highlighting how localization can preempt metallization in bandwidth-tuned correlated materials. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 055114] Published Mon Jul 13, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文结合高压输运、低温磁阻、X射线衍射和透射电镜研究了Sr3Ir2O7在压力作用下的电子态演化。结果表明，该材料在压力增加过程中由以电子关联主导的莫特态转变为以无序局域化主导的类安德森态，但并未发生金属化。尽管激活能隙在约12–17 GPa附近显著塌缩，低温输运仍保持非金属性并符合三维变程跳跃机制，说明局域化可在带宽调控材料中先于金属化出现。

articles.title: Characterization and Design of 3D Printed Composite Insole Fabricated by Dual-Nozzle 3D Printer Using CB-PLA and Fe-PLA Filaments
articles.title_zh: 基于双喷嘴3D打印机、采用CB-PLA和Fe-PLA丝材制备的3D打印复合鞋垫的表征与设计
articles.abstract: Purpose of this study is to develop 3D printed integrated insoles fabricated using a dual-nozzle fused deposition modeling (FDM) 3D printing process. Polylactic acid (PLA) was employed as the sheath and insole material, while carbon black-filled PLA (CB-PLA) and iron-filled PLA (Fe-PLA) served as core materials. Initially, composite sheath-core structures were fabricated in both assembled and integrated forms with core diameters of 1.25, 2.50, 5.00, 7.50, and 10.00 mm and a thickness of 5.00 mm. Based on the performance evaluation of the composite structures, the integrated structure was selected for insole fabrication for its stable electrical, higher magnetic, and mechanical properties. The integrated insoles were subsequently produced with core diameters of 2.50, 5.00, 7.50, and 10.00 mm and thicknesses of 1.0, 2.5, and 5.0 mm. The 3D printed structures were characterized in terms of printing time, weight, electrical conductivity, magnetic field strength, and mechanical properties. The developed smart insole incorporated six sensing regions distributed across the primary plantar pressure zones, including the metatarsal, midfoot, and heel areas. The results demonstrated that larger core diameters and thinner insole structures enhanced electrical conductivity, with the integrated PLA/CB-PLA insole containing a 10.00 mm core and 1.0 mm thickness exhibiting the highest current of 0.10 A at 24 V. In contrast, the integrated PLA/Fe-PLA insole with the same geometry achieved a maximum magnetic field strength of 351 ± 8.84 Gs. These findings suggest that the structure, core diameter, and thickness significantly influence the electrical, magnetic, and mechanical performance for fabricating integrated insoles.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究利用双喷嘴熔融沉积成形工艺，开发了一体化3D打印智能鞋垫。作者以PLA作为外壳与鞋垫材料，以碳黑填充PLA和铁填充PLA作为芯材，对不同芯径和厚度的夹芯结构进行了比较，并据此选定性能更稳定的一体化结构用于鞋垫制造。所得鞋垫在打印时间、重量、电导性、磁响应和力学性能方面进行了系统表征，并集成了分布于前足、中足和足跟等主要受力区的多个传感区域。

articles.title: Fungi enhance chlorine resistance via binding metal ions in drinking water systems: A novel phenomenon and underlying mechanisms
articles.title_zh: 饮用水系统中真菌通过结合金属离子增强氯耐受性：一种新现象及其机制
articles.abstract: While drinking water disinfection strategies primarily target bacteria and viruses, pathogenic fungi represent an emerging yet underestimated threat, causing severe opportunistic infections that are difficult to treat and exhibiting inherently higher chlorine resistance than bacterial pathogens. This resistance enables fungi to penetrate disinfection barriers and enter distribution networks where they actively complex with metals (e.g., Cu, Fe) from pipe corrosion and other sources. Here, we show that fungal spore complexation with environmental metal ions substantially enhances chlorine resistance through integrated multilayered defenses. Fungal spores exhibit strong adsorption affinity for metal ions, binding up to 11.27 pg Cu(II), 7.86 pg Fe(II), 0.97 pg Mn(II), and 4.72 pg Co(II) per spore. Metal-complexed spores exhibit 42-61% reduced log inactivation within 20 minutes and >40% faster chlorine decay. At Cu(II) saturation, lag phase extends 7.5-fold and inactivation rate constants decline by 21.1%, demonstrating that metal complexation by fungal spores governs chlorine tolerance. Multi-omics and physicochemical analyses reveal that metal ions function at both extracellular and intracellular levels: altered surface properties drive spore aggregation, cell wall chemical consumption and metal deposition create physical barriers, intracellular antioxidant activation, metabolic pathway remodeling, and reactive site redistribution enhance defense capacity. These coordinated mechanisms establish a hierarchical protection framework integrating physical obstruction, chemical consumption, and molecular regulation that collectively impedes chlorine-mediated structural and functional damage. Our findings demonstrate that active metal complexation by fungal spores is a critical but overlooked resistance mechanism.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究揭示了饮用水系统中真菌孢子与环境金属离子结合后，可显著增强其对氯消毒的耐受性。作者发现孢子可吸附并络合Cu、Fe、Mn、Co等金属离子，从而造成更低的灭活效率和更快的余氯衰减。多组学与理化分析表明，金属离子在真菌耐氯过程中发挥了重要作用，提示传统消毒策略对真菌风险的应对需要重新评估。

articles.title: A Comparative Study on the Efficiency of an SnO2/n-Si Photodetector Using a Planar Un-scratched and a CNC Mechanically Scratched Wafer
articles.title_zh: 平面未刻划与CNC机械刻划硅片制备的SnO2/n-Si光探测器效率比较研究
articles.abstract: The efficiency of an SnO2/n-Si photodetector was increased using regular mechanical micro-scratches performed by a precise CNC machine operating according to a program written in G-code. A 7×6 matrix pattern was engraved on an n-type silicon wafer. Then, using a vacuum thermal evaporation system, Sn was deposited and the wafer was oxidized in a furnace; SEM and XRD examinations showed an increase in surface area and an improvement in the polycrystalline nature of the film, and optically, the mechanical scratches acted as light traps that broadened the absorption range (Vis-NIR). The optoelectronic performance (I-V) of the p-Si heterojunction photodetector was substantially enhanced via mechanical texturing. Under 70 mW/c broadband illumination, the scratched Si substrate generated a net photocurrent (2.85 mA), marking a 163.8% performance boost over the planar device (1.74 mA}). Consequently, the external quantum efficiency EQE rose from 8.64% to 14.13%, and responsivity (R) jumped from 59.2 to 96.9 mA/W. This improvement is physically driven by the CNC-induced micro-grooves, which suppress surface reflectance and maximize light-trapping within the silicon absorber. Conversely, a trade-off occurred in specific detectivity (D*), which decreased from Jones due to elevated dark current (resulting from the increased effective surface area and induction). "Charge transport analysis (∅ = 0.93) proved the dominance of the monomolecular recombination mechanism compared to the unscratched detector (∅ = 0.5), demonstrating high efficiency in charge separation. The transient photoresponse showed that the scratched detector possesses a superior response speed, recording a rise time of 480 ns compared to 560 ns for the unscratched detector. This fundamental difference is evident in the fall time, where the unscratched detector took a significantly long time (87.20 µs) to return to the dark state, confirming the dominance of the 'trap-assisted recombination' mechanism, which traps charges and hinders their discharge. In contrast, the scratched detector exhibited a rapid recovery with a fall time not exceeding 17.2 µs, proving the efficiency of the scratched detector's surface structure in providing trap-free pathways and confirming the dominance of the monomolecular recombination mechanism, which ensures ultra-high speed in charge separation and extraction.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过在n型硅片表面引入规则机械微刻划，提升了SnO2/n-Si光探测器的性能。CNC加工形成的微沟槽增加了表面积并充当光陷阱，改善了薄膜的结构与吸收特性，从而扩大了可见至近红外波段的响应范围。与平面器件相比，刻划后的器件在光电流、外量子效率和响应度方面均有明显提升，说明机械纹理化是增强硅基异质结探测器性能的有效途径。

articles.title: Frequency combs due to the magnetic square well scheme and dissipative exchange flows in one-dimensional ferromagnetic channels
articles.title_zh: 磁平方势阱方案与一维铁磁通道中的耗散交换流所致频率梳
articles.abstract: In this paper, we investigate the formation of frequency combs as a result of non-local interactionbetween supersonic spin-polarized currents at two different injection sites along a one-dimensionalferromagnetic channel. This injections scheme, which we termed magnetic square well (’well’), allowsfor dissipative exchange flows (DEFs), where DEFs are large-amplitude boundary value solutionsto ferromagnetic channels. In the low-injection limit, DEFs reduce to spin superfluids while inthe strong injection limit nonlinearities dominate close to the injection site and a contact solitonis formed. This spin superfluid and nonlinearity allows for this non-local interaction, resulting ininteresting and novel magnetic textures, including frequency combs. Here, we numerically investigatea perturbed and unperturbed magnetic square well solutions in the high injection regime, wheresoliton dynamics are excited when two injection regions are separated by a certain distance, allowingfor non-local interaction that we termed DEF-interaction. This interaction results in magnetictextures with the properties of frequency combs inside and outside the well.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了沿一维铁磁通道在两个不同注入点施加超声速自旋极化电流时产生的非局域相互作用。作者将这种注入方案称为“磁平方势阱”，并分析其对应的耗散交换流（DEF）解在弱注入和强注入条件下的演化特征。数值结果表明，当两个注入区域相隔合适距离时，非线性孤子动力学会被激发，并形成具有频率梳特征的磁结构。

articles.title: MHD Mixed Convection Control in an Actuated Vertically Rectangular Vented Cavity with a Rotating Core Cylinder
articles.title_zh: 带旋转核心圆柱的可驱动竖直矩形通风腔中的磁流体混合对流控制
articles.abstract: This study employs the Galerkin FE approach to assess the impact of magnetic field (Lorentz force) on the MHD mixed convection dynamics of CuO-water nanofluid flow within a vented vertical cavity. The system incorporates a centrally positioned rotating cylinder with an entry port at the lower-left corner and a discharge port at the upper-right boundary. A comprehensive parametric investigation was conducted by systematically varying key dimensionless parameters: the Hartmann number (0 ≤ Ha ≤ 100), the Reynolds number (10 ≤ Re ≤ 500), the cylinder’s rotational speed (ω = 0 to 50), and the nanoparticle volume fractions (0% ≤ ϕ ≤ 6%). The resulting fluid behaviour and thermal characteristics were evaluated through detailed visualizations of streamlines and isotherms, alongside quantitative tracking of average temperature and the overall Nusselt number (Nu). The computational results demonstrate that higher Re significantly intensifies heat transfer rates especially when the cylinder undergoes counter-clockwise rotation. Furthermore, adjusting Ha and ϕ proves vital for optimizing thermal efficiency. Notably, severe magnetic field suppression (Ha =100) induces approximately 47.90% reduction in heat transfer compared to the non-magnetic baseline for Re = 500. Conversely, introducing an anticlockwise rotation boosts localized heat transfer near the bottom ends by nearly 13.09% relative to the stationary configuration (ω = 0). For clockwise cylinder rotation (ω = 10) yields a massive 195.74% increase in the local Nusselt number as Re escalates from 10 to 500. These insights establish a robust design framework for high-efficiency thermal management systems, with direct implications for advanced compact radiators, electronic thermal controllers, and next-generation energy conversion technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究采用Galerkin有限元方法，考察磁场对通风竖直腔体内CuO-水纳米流体混合对流行为的影响。系统包含一个位于腔体中心的旋转圆柱，并通过改变Hartmann数、雷诺数、圆柱转速和纳米颗粒体积分数进行参数分析。结果表明，较高雷诺数通常会增强传热，而磁场会抑制流动与热对流；圆柱旋转和纳米颗粒浓度则为优化热性能提供了重要调控手段。

articles.title: Lyapunov Integrability Test (LIT): a numerical framework for exploring integrability in continuous dynamical systems
articles.title_zh: Lyapunov可积性测试：用于探索连续动力系统可积性的数值框架
articles.abstract: We introduce the Lyapunov Integrability Test (LIT), a new numerical framework for exploring integrability in nonlinear dynamical systems. The main idea is inspired by the role of the Mandelbrot set in complex dynamics: instead of identifying parameter values associated with stable periodic orbits, the LIT seeks parameter regions that may correspond to integrable dynamics. The method is based on a global analysis of Lyapunov exponents across parameter space and provides a simple and efficient way to visualize candidate integrable regimes. Its performance is demonstrated on several benchmark systems, including the ABC flow, the heavy top, quantum dots, a helically symmetric Hamiltonian system with three degrees of freedom, and the classical double pendulum. The results demonstrate that the LIT is an effective and computationally efficient framework for the global exploration of parameter space and the identification of candidate integrable regimes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种新的数值方法——Lyapunov可积性测试（LIT），用于探索非线性动力系统中的可积性。该方法借鉴了Mandelbrot集合在复动力学中的思想，通过在参数空间中对Lyapunov指数进行全局分析，识别可能对应可积动力学的区域。作者在ABC流、重陀螺、量子点、三自由度螺旋对称哈密顿系统和经典双摆等基准模型上验证了该框架的有效性与计算效率。

articles.title: Large language models do not replace chemists in a closed-loop catalysis experiment
articles.title_zh: 大语言模型并不能在闭环催化实验中取代化学家
articles.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping scientific research and laboratory automation1. Large language models (LLMs) can perform aspects of scientific reasoning, which could in principle reduce human decision-making as a rate-limiting step in closed-loop automated experiments2-7. Yet the reasoning performance of LLMs compared with human experts in complex, noisy, long-running laboratory experiments is largely unexplored. Here we benchmarked LLM reasoning head-to-head against a team of human domain experts for a noisy 25-dimensional closed-loop colloidal catalysis problem8 explored using a mobile robot9. The LLM (GPT-5.1) navigated the available chemical space across a 528-experiment campaign, using background information and experimental data to propose an anionic surfactant that gave the largest single gain in catalyst activity, also adapting to a mid-campaign change in the measurement set-up. In a like-for-like final phase of 160 experiments, the human experts found a catalyst formulation that was, on average, more active than the best two formulations found in independent LLM runs. At the same time, the LLM reasoned 35 times faster and was estimated to be around 1,900 times less expensive than human reasoning. Inspection of the LLM reasoning traces found them mostly sound, but with some costly silent errors, logical inconsistencies, and apparent memory limitations, suggesting that LLMs are not out-of-the-box replacements for expert reasoning in problems of this complexity10. This points to a need to design closed-loop systems that combine the speed of machine reasoning with expert oversight.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将大语言模型与人类领域专家在一个噪声较强、维度较高的闭环胶体催化实验中进行正面对比。结果显示，模型能够利用背景知识与实验数据快速提出有效候选，并适应实验过程中测量设置的变化，但在人类专家参与的最终阶段，人工团队在平均催化活性上仍优于独立运行的模型。总体而言，LLM在速度上具有明显优势，但在复杂、长周期且不确定性较高的实验决策中，尚不能替代化学家。

articles.title: Solving a 30-year-old puzzle about a mysterious superconducting material
articles.title_zh: 破解一种神秘超导材料的30年谜题
articles.abstract: A material made from yttrium, barium and copper oxide (better known as YBCO) has intrigued scientists since its discovery in 1987, largely because it retains its superconductive properties at a higher-than-normal temperature. However, it is extremely brittle, which makes it tricky to put to practical use.
articles.abstract_zh: 这则新闻介绍了长期困扰研究者的YBCO超导材料难题。该材料自1987年被发现以来就因其较高的超导转变温度而备受关注，但同时也因为极其脆弱、难以应用而受到限制。报道强调，围绕这种铜氧化物高温超导体的机理和实际应用问题，科学界仍在持续推进研究。

articles.title: World's first superconducting quantum heat engine offers path to larger quantum computers
articles.title_zh: 世界首个超导量子热机为更大规模量子计算机提供路径
articles.abstract: Recent improvements in our understanding of how the principles of thermodynamics apply in the quantum realm could give a boost to quantum technology, and a clearer picture of quantum thermodynamics could in turn enhance our understanding of classical thermodynamics. Now, Aalto University researchers have demonstrated the first cyclic quantum heat engine inside a superconducting circuit.
articles.abstract_zh: 这则新闻报道了阿尔托大学研究人员在超导电路中实现了首个循环式量子热机。该成果基于近年来对量子热力学的深入理解，展示了热力学原理在量子体系中的新应用。研究不仅有助于推动量子技术发展，也可能为理解经典与量子热力学之间的联系提供新的视角。

articles.title: Exact Lindbladian Dynamics from Conformal Embeddings and Topological Defects in Conformal Field Theory
articles.title_zh: 由共形嵌入与共形场论中的拓扑缺陷导出的精确 Lindbladian 动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08827v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Analyzing the dynamics of physical observables in open quantum many-body systems is a fundamental but highly challenging task that has yielded very few exact results. In this work, we identify intrinsic conformal structures that restore exact solvability in (1+1)D conformal field theories. For N Majorana fermions with linear mode jumps, the adjoint Lindbladian is triangular on reduced even Majorana monomials, yielding recursive exact Heisenberg evolution. In Wess-Zumino-Witten models admitting conformal Majorana embeddings, this hierarchy gives exact dynamics of affine-current products realized as Majorana bilinears, including regimes where the Kac-Moody current algebra alone does not close. In diagonal rational conformal field theories, Verlinde topological defect lines furnish jump operators whose primary-sector dynamics is exactly diagonal: topological-charge probabilities are conserved, while intersector coherences dephase at rates fixed by the modular S matrix and nonnegative measurement strengths. These examples show that intrinsic conformal structures, such as conformal embeddings and modular data, can organize exactly solvable open conformal dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究开放量子多体系统中物理可观测量的动力学问题，并指出在某些一维共形场论中可由内禀共形结构恢复精确可解性。作者以 N 个 Majorana 费米子线性模跃迁为例，发现伴随 Lindbladian 在约化偶 Majorana 单项式上呈三角结构，从而可递归求得精确的海森堡演化。进一步地，在具有共形 Majorana 嵌入的 Wess–Zumino–Witten 模型以及对角有理共形场论中，文中构造了可精确处理的跳跃算符与拓扑缺陷线，展示了模 S 矩阵与拓扑数据在精确动力学中的组织作用。

articles.title: Fermion-mediated Casimir effect on mesoscopic rings implementing non-Clifford SWAPα gates
articles.title_zh: 实现非 Clifford SWAPα 门的介观环中费米子介导的 Casimir 效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08840v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Casimir effect is typically governed by intrinsic material properties and lacks in situ tunability. We show that, in mesoscopic rings, both the magnitude and sign of the fermion-mediated Casimir interaction can be controlled via the Aharonov-Bohm effect. The resulting interplay between the Aharonov-Bohm phase and the Casimir interaction provides a route to engineer long-range interactions. In particular, this mechanism enables the implementation of non-Clifford SWAPα gates between spatially separated spin qubits, thereby reducing the overhead for universal quantum computation and quantum error correction in spin-qubit architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出在介观环中可通过 Aharonov–Bohm 效应调控费米子介导的 Casimir 相互作用，从而实现其强度与符号的可控调节。该机制使得远距离长程相互作用的工程化成为可能。作者进一步指出，这一效应可用于实现分离自旋量子比特之间的非 Clifford SWAPα 门，有望降低自旋量子计算与量子纠错中的资源开销。
authors: Liang Du, Qing-Dong Jiang, Yijia Wu

articles.title: Negligible current-induced torque from the bulk and interface of Al
articles.title_zh: 来自铝体与界面的可忽略电流诱导转矩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09055v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The light metal Al was predicted to have strong orbital Hall and Rashba effects from its bulk and interface, respectively. In this letter, we report experimental evidence that neither the bulk nor the interface of the Al contributed a detectable torque on adjacent Co and FePt layers with significant spin Hall effect, spin-orbit coupling, and resistivity mismatch with Al. These results suggest minimal orbital-spin conversion in Al and negligible orbital transport and spin-vorticity torque in Co/Al, Al/Co, and Al/FePt bilayers. Our findings suggest poor generality and/or effectiveness of torque contributions by the orbital Hall effect, the interfacial orbital Rashba effect, and the spin-vorticity coupling.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对轻金属 Al 的体相和界面是否能够对相邻磁层产生可探测的电流诱导转矩进行了实验检验。尽管先前曾预测 Al 具有显著的体相轨道霍尔效应和界面 Rashba 效应，作者在与 Co 和 FePt 层构成的异质结构中未观测到可检测的转矩信号。结果表明，Al 中的轨道-自旋转换、轨道输运以及由此引发的转矩效应都十分微弱，对相关机制的普适性与有效性提出了质疑。
authors: Taiyang Zhang, Lujun Zhu, Zhihao Yan, Lijun Zhu

articles.title: Topological phase transition driven by Hatsugai-Kohmoto interaction on the Kagome lattice
articles.title_zh: Kagome晶格上由Hatsugai–Kohmoto相互作用驱动的拓扑相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09182v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The interplay between band topology and strong correlations is central to modern condensed matter physics, but exact solutions are rare. Here, we present an exactly solvable model on the Kagome lattice by combining a Kane-Mele-type spin-orbit coupling with the Hatsugai-Kohmoto interaction. At 1/3 filling, we uncover a continuous topological quantum phase transition driven by electron interaction. A weakly correlated Z₂ topological insulator gives way to a strongly correlated insulator that, while Z₂₋ₜᵣᵢᵥᵢₐₗ, hosts a nontrivial spin Chern number Cₛ₌₂. The transition exhibits critical scaling consistent with the universality class of two-dimensional Dirac fermions. At half-filling, the same model yields a non-Fermi-liquid to Mott-insulator transition, demonstrating that correlation-driven topological and Mott transitions can be unified within a single solvable framework. Our results establish the Kagome Hatsugai-Kohmoto model as a valuable benchmark for interacting topological systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在Kane-Mele型自旋轨道耦合与Hatsugai–Kohmoto相互作用结合下，构造了Kagome晶格上的一个精确可解模型。在1/3填充下，发现了由电子相互作用驱动的连续拓扑量子相变：弱关联Z₂拓扑绝缘体转变为强关联绝缘体，后者虽为Z₂平庸态，但具有非平庸自旋陈数Cs=2。该相变的临界标度符合二维Dirac费米子的普适类；在半填充下，同一模型还给出非费米液体到Mott绝缘体的转变。

articles.title: Observation of a Rydberg-atom time crystal with an ultralong lifetime
articles.title_zh: 具有超长寿命的里德伯原子时间晶体的观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09247v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Continuous time crystals (CTCs) represent a nonequilibrium quantum phase that spontaneously breaks time-translation symmetry without periodic external driving, manifesting as persistent, long-lived oscillations under steady pumping. The lifetime is constrained by the instability of the limit cycle phase, balanced between nonlinear feedback and energy dissipation, which have rarely been studied in experiments before. Here, we report an observation of an ultralong-lived Rydberg-atom CTC in a driven-dissipative many-body atomic system. By harnessing long-range interactions and engineering a dissipative environment that stabilizes the limit-cycle dynamics, we suppress heating and decay effects that typically destroy time-crystalline order. The key factor underlying the ultralong-lived CTC is the closing of the Liouvillian gap and the near-zero real part of the system's Liouvillian eigenspectrum. Through systematic optimization, we achieve an oscillatory lifetime exceeding 16.95 hours-orders of magnitude longer than previous CTC realizations. Our work establishes a robust platform for exploring long-lived autonomous nonequilibrium phases and paves the way for applications in quantum sensing and continuous-time quantum information processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 连续时间晶体是在持续泵浦下自发破缺时间平移对称性的非平衡量子相，表现为长期持续的振荡。本文在受驱耗散多体原子系统中观测到一种超长寿命的里德伯原子连续时间晶体，并通过长程相互作用与耗散环境工程抑制加热和衰减。其稳定性的关键与Liouvillian能隙闭合及谱实部接近零有关。经优化后，振荡寿命超过16.95小时，远长于以往实现。
authors: Qi-Feng Wang, Tian-Yu Han, Ya-Jun Wang, Dong-Yang Zhu, Chao Yu, Yu Ma, Yi-Ming Yin, Guang-Can Guo, Bang Liu, Li-Hua Zhang, Dong-Sheng Ding, Bao-Sen Shi

articles.title: Is the Eyring Plot Misleading? A Case for Arrhenius Analysis of Activation Parameters
articles.title_zh: Eyring图是否误导？支持用Arrhenius分析活化参数的论证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09341v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A common view in physical chemistry literature is that the Eyring representation, in which a linear fit of łn(k/T) versus 1/T is attempted, is more fundamental than the Arrhenius representation, łn(k) versus 1/T. This perception is typically motivated by its derivation from statistical mechanics and quantum mechanics, and by the interpretation of the intercept in terms of the activation entropy Δ S^ddagger, whereas the Arrhenius equation and its prefactor are often regarded as purely phenomenological. However, harmonic approximation models yield exact linearity in Arrhenius plots but not in Eyring plots, although for real experimental data both generally appear equally linear within typical experimental accuracy. Furthermore, the impression that the Eyring formulation is inherently quantum mechanical arises from the presence of the Planck constant in the prefactor, whereas this term results from normalization conventions in the partition function. This also highlights an interpretational issue in Δ G^ddagger, which is based on partition functions of different dimensionality between reactant and transition state. This dimensional mismatch can be reformulated in an alternative representation that improves interpretability and reduces to an Arrhenius-type expression in which the prefactor is directly related to an entropy of activation. In this framework, both activation enthalpy and entropy obtained from an Arrhenius fit are arguably more physically relevant than the corresponding Eyring fit values.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者讨论了物理化学文献中一个常见观点：ln(k/T) 对 1/T 的 Eyring 图是否比 ln(k) 对 1/T 的 Arrhenius 图更“基础”。文章指出，尽管 Eyring 公式常因其统计力学和量子力学推导而被赋予更强理论地位，但在谐振近似模型中 Arrhenius 图可呈现精确线性，而 Eyring 图未必如此；对实际实验数据，两者通常都在误差范围内表现出相近的线性。文中还强调，Eyring 公式中的普朗克常数主要来自配分函数的归一化约定，而非其本身固有的量子性，并指出ΔG‡解释中存在维度不一致问题。

articles.title: Coherent dynamics of individual excitons in a quantum dot embedded in a nanopost
articles.title_zh: 嵌入纳米柱中的量子点内单个激子的相干动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09419v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We measured coherent ultrafast dynamics of exciton complexes in a single strongly-confined InAs quantum dot embedded in a GaAs nanopost. Such a photonic structure combines a wave guiding with a cavity effect and assures an enhanced light-matter coupling. Coherence properties of an exciton-biexciton system hosted by a quantum dot are assessed with four-wave mixing microscopy. Our results show that this broad-band photonic structure is an excellent asset to probe coherent couplings in a small set of solid state quantum systems and to investigate the coherence dynamics within the level structure of their excited states.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者利用四波混频显微术，测量了嵌入GaAs纳米柱中的单个强受限InAs量子点内激子复合体的超快相干动力学。该光子结构兼具波导与腔效应，可增强光与物质耦合。结果表明，这类宽带结构非常适合探测固态量子体系中的相干耦合，并研究激发态能级结构中的相干演化。
authors: Maxime Gaignard, Karolina Ewa Polczynska, Niels Gregersen, Daniel Wigger, Jean-Philippe Poizat, Jean-Michel Gérard, Julien Claudon, Jacek Kasprzak

articles.title: Effective theories for many-body systems with nonuniform symmetries
articles.title_zh: 具有非均匀对称性的多体系统的有效理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09427v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The low-energy dynamics of many-body systems is governed by gapless modes whose properties are dictated by symmetry. Their existence follows from Goldstone's theorem, while their effective description at zero temperature is determined by the pattern of symmetry breaking. At finite temperature, an analogous role is played by hydrodynamics, which describes the universal behavior of many-body systems over long times and large distances. These principles are well understood for uniform symmetries, which act homogeneously in spacetime and lead to a correspondence between massless Goldstone modes and broken generators, as well as gapless hydrodynamic modes and conserved charges. However, this simple picture changes in the presence of nonuniform symmetries, whose generators do not commute with spacetime translations. The low-energy implications of these symmetries remain less understood, as they do not introduce additional gapless modes but instead constrain the dynamics of the existing degrees of freedom. In this thesis, we develop a unified framework for many-body systems with nonuniform symmetries and show that their effects can be understood in terms of additional fields that are not independent at low energies and can be eliminated, leading to kinematic constraints that reshape the infrared dynamics. In systems with spontaneous symmetry breaking, this mechanism modifies the effective theory and often softens the dispersion relations of the remaining modes. At finite temperature, it manifests in hydrodynamics as constraints on macroscopic currents. As a result, nonuniform symmetries give rise to qualitatively new physical phenomena, including modified spectra of collective excitations, exemplified by transverse Tkachenko oscillations in quantum vortex crystals, and unconventional transport phenomena, such as anomalously slow diffusion and softened sound modes in dipole-conserving systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了一个统一框架，用于描述具有非均匀对称性的多体系统低能动力学。与均匀对称性不同，非均匀对称性并不引入额外的无能隙模，而是通过约束现有自由度来影响动力学。作者表明，这些对称性在零温下可纳入有效场论描述，并在有限温下对应于对长时长程行为的流体力学约束。该工作旨在系统刻画这类对称性对低能物理的影响，具体细节需查阅原文。

articles.title: Level statistics in the fractal phase of generalized Rosenzweig--Porter models
articles.title_zh: 广义Rosenzweig–Porter模型分形相中的能级统计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09444v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Rosenzweig--Porter (RP) random matrix ensemble has emerged as a minimal model for the integrability-to-chaos crossover in quantum many-body systems. Its phase diagram features a region with fractal eigenstates, exhibiting intermediate spectral and localization properties between the fully localized and fully delocalized regimes. In this work, we explore several generalizations of the RP model and determine their level statistics at the scale of the Thouless energy E_T, which characterizes the crossover. Using tools from free probability theory and the replica method, we compute the full counting statistics in the limit of large system size, and show that it takes a simple, universal scaling form around E_T, shared across all variations of the model. We validate our analytical predictions using exact numerical diagonalization of large samples, and large-deviation algorithms that resolve the full counting statistics down to probabilities as low as 10⁻⁴⁰. We also contrast our predictions with measurements on the quantum random energy model, which is the simplest model displaying many-body localization.
articles.abstract_zh: Rosenzweig–Porter随机矩阵系综被视为量子多体系统从可积到混沌交叉的极简模型。本文研究了若干广义RP模型在Thouless能量E_T尺度上的能级统计，利用自由概率理论与复制法计算大系统极限下的完整计数统计，发现其在E_T附近呈现简单且普适的标度形式，并被所有模型变体共享。数值精确对角化与大偏差算法验证了这些分析结果，作者还将其与量子随机能量模型的测量结果进行了比较。
authors: Victor Delapalme, Leticia F. Cugliandolo, Alexander K. Hartmann, Marco Tarzia, Davide Venturelli

articles.title: Strongly correlated quantum matter: t--J model, real-space pairing, spin-dependent masses, and atomicity in chemical bond and nanosystems
articles.title_zh: 强关联量子物质：t-J模型、实空间配对、自旋依赖有效质量，以及化学键和纳米体系中的原子性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09465v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: I critically overview my research on strongly correlated fermion systems for almost five decades. It concentrated on: (i) the first derivation of what is now called the t--J model, comprising both the limit of Anderson kinetic exchange of spin--spin interaction in the Mott--Hubbard insulator and taking into account real-space pairing, subsequently applied to high-temperature superconductivity; (ii) the concept of spin-dependent heavy mass of quasiparticles in heavy-fermion systems, and (iii) the first nontrivial model of statistical thermodynamics of the Mott--Hubbard transition. Those three features, together with the specific quantum critical phenomena provide, in my view, fundamental components of the theory of strongly correlated fermions established in the 1960s. Some related questions such as introduction of atomicity in the chemical bonding (iv), and specific properties of correlated nanosystems within the rigorous EDABI (v) approach are also briefly elaborated at the end.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文是作者对其近五十年来强关联费米系统研究的批判性回顾。重点包括：t-J模型及其在莫特-哈伯德绝缘体中的安德森动能交换极限、实空间配对与高温超导；重费米子体系中的自旋依赖重有效质量；以及莫特-哈伯德转变的统计热力学模型。文末还简要讨论了化学键中的原子性概念以及基于EDABI方法研究相关纳米体系的问题。

articles.title: Quantum Chaos with a Macroscopic Zero-Mode Sector
articles.title_zh: 具有宏观零模扇区的量子混沌
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09504v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chaotic many-body spectra are expected to densely fill their energy window. We show that constrained spin chains with chiral symmetry evade this expectation by hosting an exponentially large manifold of symmetry-protected exact zero modes separated from the surrounding spectrum by a sharp gap at zero energy. The gap is generated by chaotic level repulsion, with width set by the number of zero modes times the mean level spacing. We verify this mechanism in an East-West kinetically constrained chain, develop a minimal random-matrix description, and show how the gap can be detected through linear-response spectroscopy.
articles.abstract_zh: 通常预期混沌多体谱会密集填满其能量窗口。本文表明，具有手征对称性的受限自旋链可以违背这一预期：它们包含指数级大的对称性保护精确零模集合，并在零能处与周围谱之间形成清晰能隙。作者解释了该能隙由混沌能级排斥产生，宽度由零模数目与平均能级间隔共同决定。该机制在East-West动力学约束链中得到验证，并可通过线性响应光谱检测。
authors: Cheryne Jonay, Kun W. Kim, Frank Pollmann, Alexander Altland

articles.title: Majorana parity qubit in coupled minimal Kitaev chains
articles.title_zh: 耦合最小Kitaev链中的Majorana宇称量子比特
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09511v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Majorana zero modes provide a route to fault-tolerant qubits by encoding information non-locally in fermion parity. Their sensitivity to noise is expected to decrease exponentially with increasing separation between the Majoranas, a suppression known as topological protection. Kitaev chains engineered in quantum dot-superconductor arrays provide a tunable platform in which separated Majorana zero modes can emerge at the ends of the chain, even in two-site chains. These minimal-chain modes are known as poor man's Majoranas and retain characteristic Majorana properties, including near-zero energy and equal electron-hole character, but have only limited protection. A key outstanding challenge is to move beyond identifying such modes in electrical transport measurements and achieve coherent qubit control in the time domain. Here, we demonstrate a Majorana parity qubit by realizing coherent coupling between two-site Kitaev chains. Since total fermion parity is conserved, the system separates into global even and odd parity manifolds. We observe coherent parity oscillations in both manifolds with equal oscillation frequencies at the Majorana sweet spot, as predicted for isolated Majorana zero modes. We further show that the oscillation frequency and coherence depend systematically on inter-chain coupling and quantum-dot detunings, in close agreement with our model for short, partially protected chains. Our results establish the first coherent control of a Majorana qubit, encoded in the fermion parity of Majorana zero modes in minimal Kitaev chains.
articles.abstract_zh: Majorana零模可通过将信息非局域地编码在费米宇称中，为容错量子比特提供路径。本文利用量子点-超导阵列实现的Kitaev链平台，在耦合的两站点最小链中演示了Majorana宇称量子比特，并在总费米宇称守恒下区分全局偶、奇宇称扇区。实验观测到两个扇区中的相干宇称振荡，且振荡频率一致，表明可以在时间域实现对这类最小Majorana体系的相干控制。
authors: Francesco Zatelli, Bart Roovers, Nick van Loo, Antonio Lombardi, Juan D. Torres Luna, Sebastian Miles, Vincent P. M. Sietses, Florian J. Bennebroek Evertsz', Pablo Cova Fariña, Alberto Bordin, Ghada Badawy, Erik P. A. M. Bakkers, Michael Wimmer, Leo P. Kouwenhoven

articles.title: Confinement drives valley splitting above 4K in buried silicon quantum wells
articles.title_zh: 约束将埋置硅量子阱中的谷分裂提升到4 K以上
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09570v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Controlling the energy scales of a quantum system is essential for defining robust qubits. In silicon spin qubits, the nearly degenerate conduction-band valleys create a leakage channel from the single-spin computational basis, posing a challenge to scaling and to shuttling-based architectures. Here, we measure the relevant energy scales of single-electron spin qubits in buried silicon quantum wells co-designed for low disorder and high valley splitting. Across a linear array of four quantum dots with an average orbital energy of 2.4(2) meV, we report an average single-electron valley splitting of 0.40(6) meV and an average two-electron singlet-triplet splitting of 0.24(7) meV. In three dots, we observe a strong correlation between valley splitting and orbital energy, with an average linear coefficient of approx 0.22 (meV/meV), demonstrating that electrostatic confinement can increase the valley splitting by several hundred microelectronvolts. In contrast, the remaining dot exhibits the highest valley splitting of 0.76(2) meV and low correlation, suggesting excellent characteristics for spin-qubit operation. Our findings demonstrate that strong confinement can be exploited in buried quantum wells to effectively enhance the valley splitting, thereby establishing a viable path toward the realization of shuttling and sparse-occupation-based architectures in low-disorder heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 在硅自旋量子比特中，导带近简并的谷会形成泄漏通道，因此谷分裂的精确调控对器件扩展至关重要。本文测量了埋置硅量子阱中单电子自旋量子比特的相关能标：在线性排列的四个量子点中，平均轨道能量为2.4(2) meV，平均单电子谷分裂为0.40(6) meV，平均两电子单重-三重态分裂为0.24(7) meV。部分量子点中谷分裂与轨道能量呈显著线性相关，说明静电约束可将谷分裂提升数百微电子伏；另一个量子点则表现出更高的谷分裂与更弱相关性，显示出更适合自旋量子比特操作的特性。
authors: Davide Degli Esposti, Emma Catherine Brann, Asser Elsayed, Davide Costa, Mark Friesen, Giordano Scappucci

articles.title: Thermalization in a Height-Conserving Quantum Dimer Model
articles.title_zh: 高度守恒量子二聚体模型中的热化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09580v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strongly constrained quantum systems, in which local rules forbid most configurations, play a central role in condensed matter and lattice gauge theory. Their thermalization is often thought to be delicate: extensive conservation laws and dynamically frozen states can shatter the Hilbert space into many disconnected sectors. A natural question is whether, once the frozen states are removed, the dynamics within a single sector still thermalizes. We address this in the height-conserving quantum dimer model on the square lattice, whose local plaquette flips conserve an emergent height field.
