articles.title_zh: 压力使二硫化钽在三倍温度下实现三维超导
articles.abstract: Superconductors have long been considered a promising technology for the energy systems of the future. They can conduct electricity without resistance, thus eliminating both conduction losses and waste heat. Up to now, however, superconductors have only been applied in special cases, as in the immensely powerful magnet coils of particle accelerators such as the Large Hadron Collider at CERN. This is because superconductors must be well cooled, down to extremely low temperatures for some materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道介绍了通过施加压力调控二硫化钽超导性质的研究，重点在于压力诱导的三维超导行为及其较高转变温度。超导体可实现无电阻输运，但实际应用长期受低温冷却条件限制，因此提高工作温度和理解压力效应具有重要意义。

articles.title: A Machine-Checked Cost Analysis of the BMSSP Recurrence in Isabelle/HOL With a Non-Vacuous Size-Parametric Runtime Witness
articles.title_zh: 在 Isabelle/HOL 中对 BMSSP 递归进行机器检验的代价分析及非空的规模参数化运行时间见证
articles.abstract: In 2025 Duan, Mao, Mao, Shu and Yin broke the long-standing O(m + n log n) “sorting barrier” for directed single-source shortest paths (SSSP) with a deter- ministic O(m log2/3 n) algorithm whose engine is a recursive subproblem, the Bounded Multi-Source Shortest Path (BMSSP) recurrence. We present what is, to the best of our knowledge, the first mechanized formalization of this recurrence and its running-time analysis, in Isabelle/HOL. The development is layered: an abstract semantic model with a machine-checked recursive correctness proof and an executable shortest-distance function; an amortized cost model built over an abstract Insert/BatchPrepend/Pull partition interface, realized by a paper-faithful bucketed data structure with the critical O(log(N/M )) insert scale; and a size-parametric layer over an unbounded graph family. Our headline result is a size- parametric validation layer for this cost model—a fully unconditional, non-vacuous running-time theorem witnessing that, on the unbounded unit-weight directed path family, the charged running time of the BMSSP loop is O |V |·(ln|V |)2/3 in the genuine graph size, with no hypotheses, on a family whose size tends to infinity and for which a complete run provably exists. We are deliberately precise about scope: this is a formalization of the BMSSP recurrence—its correctness and its charged operation-cost analysis—and not a machine-step verification of the full Duan–Mao–Mao–Shu–Yin SSSP implementation; the asymptotic theorems bound an exact operation count, and the size-parametric headline bounds the 1least-cost run of a specific unbounded family. As a separate contribution we for- mally diagnose a stronger coupling we attempted: a faithful per-step cost relation that we machine-check to be non-total over its intended inputs, which the decou- pled charged relation of the headline avoids. The entire development is checked by the Isabelle kernel with no sorry, oops, or axiomatization, and builds under Isabelle2025-2 importing only HOL and HOL-Library.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在 Isabelle/HOL 中形式化了有界多源最短路（BMSSP）递归及其运行时间分析，该递归是 2025 年突破有向单源最短路排序障碍算法的核心。作者构建了分层框架，包括抽象语义模型、经机器检验的递归正确性证明、摊还代价模型以及面向无界图族的规模参数化层。其主要结果是在单位权有向路径族上给出无条件且非空的运行时间定理，证明 BMSSP 循环的计费运行时间随真实图规模满足相应的多对数复杂度界。

articles.title: From Instrumented Towers to Vulnerable Blocks: A Physics-Informed Federated Edge Digital-Twin Framework for Translational Seismic Damage Assessment in Andean Emerging Economies (NSET-Andes)
articles.title_zh: 从仪器化高塔到脆弱街区：面向安第斯新兴经济体平移式地震损伤评估的物理信息联邦边缘数字孪生框架（NSET-Andes）
articles.abstract: Structural Health Monitoring (SHM) in seismic megacities faces a persistent trade-off between the fidelity of centralized cloud-based Digital Twins (DT) and the latency, bandwidth, and single-point-of-failure risks these architectures incur during network-congested disaster scenarios. This paper proposes NSET-Andes, a physics-informed Federated Learning (FL) and edge-computing framework for real-time seismic damage estimation, and — as its central contribution — a structured translational methodology for adapting instrumentation practices developed for Tokyo's high-rise steel moment-resisting frames to Peru's markedly different, largely undocumented building stock. The framework embeds verified structural-dynamics formulations — the multi-degree-of-freedom (MDOF) equation of motion integrated via the Newmark-β method, the Bouc-Wen hysteretic model, the Park-Ang damage index (DPA), and Gazetas' frequency-dependent soil-structure interaction (SSI) impedance functions — as physics residual penalties inside a federated training loop (FedAvg), so that gradient-only communication replaces raw-data transmission. Performance figures reported here (inference latency, bandwidth reduction, drift-prediction accuracy) are derived from a synthetic Nankai Trough-calibrated benchmark scenario and are presented as preliminary, simulation-based indicators — not as field-validated measurements — pending instrumented pilot testing. The principal gap this work addresses is the absence, in the current SHM/DT literature, of an explicit adaptation pathway from data-rich, high-instrumentation contexts to low-resource, connectivity-constrained, typologically heterogeneous contexts such as metropolitan Lima. Accordingly, the paper develops a normative harmonization layer under Peru's NTE E.030-2016 seismic code, a hybrid-typology digital-twin library covering confined masonry and adobe-RC hybrid systems, and an asynchronous, connectivity-tolerant federated protocol informed by the connectivity disruptions documented after the 2007 Pisco earthquake. The framework is offered as a research and institutional roadmap — requiring CISMID/SENCICO empirical validation — rather than as a deployed or field-tested system.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 NSET-Andes 框架，将物理信息联邦学习与边缘计算结合，用于地震灾害场景下的实时结构损伤估计。其核心贡献是把东京高层钢框架结构的监测经验转化适配到秘鲁等安第斯地区资料不足、类型复杂的建筑存量中。框架在联邦训练中嵌入多自由度动力方程、Newmark-β 积分、Bouc-Wen 滞回模型、Park-Ang 损伤指标以及土-结构相互作用阻抗等物理约束，以减少原始数据传输并提升灾时可用性。

articles.title: Synergistic effects of chitosan and Ce–Fe oxides on methylene blue adsorption by magnetic biochar
articles.title_zh: 壳聚糖与铈–铁氧化物对磁性生物炭吸附亚甲基蓝的协同作用
articles.abstract: Biochar is a promising adsorbent for wastewater treatment, but its adsorption performance is often limited by the insufficient abundance of active surface functional groups. In this study, a chitosan-loaded Ce–Fe oxide magnetic biochar (CCFBC) was synthesized to investigate the synergistic effects of chitosan and Ce–Fe oxides on methylene blue (MB) adsorption. FT-IR, SEM–EDX, BET, and XPS analyses confirmed the successful incorporation of chitosan and Ce–Fe oxides onto the biochar surface, providing diverse adsorption sites and surface functionalities. The highest MB removal efficiency (95.2%) was achieved at pH 10 within 180 min using 0.5% (w/v) CCFBC. Adsorption performance increased with chitosan loading, indicating a synergistic contribution from amino functional groups and metal-oxide surface sites. Adsorption kinetics were better described by the pseudo-second-order model than by the pseudo-first-order model, while both Langmuir and Freundlich isotherms adequately fitted the experimental data. The maximum adsorption capacity estimated from the Langmuir model was 142.8 mg·g⁻¹. Spectroscopic analyses suggested the involvement of amino-, oxygen-containing, and metal-oxide surface groups in MB adsorption. These findings demonstrate that the synergistic integration of chitosan and Ce–Fe oxides effectively enhances the adsorption performance of magnetic biochar for dye-contaminated wastewater treatment.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究制备了负载壳聚糖和铈–铁氧化物的磁性生物炭，用于考察其对亚甲基蓝的吸附性能。FT-IR、SEM–EDX、BET 和 XPS 表征证实壳聚糖与金属氧化物成功引入生物炭表面，提供了多种官能团和吸附位点。在 pH 10、180 分钟和 0.5% 投加条件下，材料对亚甲基蓝的去除率达到 95.2%，Langmuir 模型估算的最大吸附容量为 142.8 mg·g⁻¹。

articles.title: PV-YOLO: Collaborative Lightweight Improved YOLOv8 for Micro-Defect Detection of Photovoltaic Cells in UAV Edge Inspection
articles.title_zh: PV-YOLO：面向无人机边缘巡检中光伏电池微缺陷检测的协同轻量化改进 YOLOv8
articles.abstract: Detecting tiny micro-defects on photovoltaic cells is essential to guarantee power generation efficiency, yet mainstream detection models frequently fail to balance detection precision and inference speed. This study proposes PV-YOLO, a lightweight improved YOLOv8n model embedded with four custom-designed modules to elevate micro-defect recognition while lowering model parameters and computational overhead. The C2f_faster backbone optimizes gradient transmission and reduces redundant computation; GhostConv replaces ordinary convolutions to compress feature duplication; an efficient multiscale attention (EMA) module strengthens feature extraction for faint micro-cracks and hotspots; the adaptive feature pyramid network (AFPN) realizes dynamic multi-scale feature fusion for small targets. Comparative experiments are conducted on a public dataset containing 4500 EL and infrared PV cell images. The proposed PV-YOLO reaches 72.3% mAP@0.5, 3.13% higher than original YOLOv8n, with FLOPs reduced by 2.46%. Especially, the recall of microcracks rises by 7.2%. Deployed on NVIDIA Jetson Orin with CUDA and TensorRT acceleration, the model runs at 140 FPS to support real-time edge detection. Industrial tests under variable illumination and cell textures verify that PV-YOLO achieves stable and reliable micro-defect detection for practical photovoltaic inspection scenarios.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 PV-YOLO，一种面向光伏电池微裂纹和热点等微小缺陷检测的轻量化 YOLOv8n 改进模型。模型通过 C2f_faster 主干、GhostConv、效率多尺度注意力模块和自适应特征金字塔网络，在提升小目标特征表达的同时降低计算开销。在包含 4500 张电致发光与红外图像的公开数据集上，PV-YOLO 的 mAP@0.5 达到 72.3%，较原 YOLOv8n 提升 3.13%，并可在 NVIDIA Jetson Orin 上实现 140 FPS 的实时边缘检测。

articles.title: Machine Learning Classification for Irradiated Material Gamma Ray Spectra
articles.title_zh: 辐照材料伽马射线能谱的机器学习分类
articles.abstract: This work presents a preliminary evaluation of Machine Learning (ML) methods for automated gamma-ray spectroscopy classification across two levels of spectral complexity and three levels of detector resolution. Samples analyzed include both single isotope sources and materials irradiated at the University of Texas at Austin Research Reactor. Sample collection was conducted with Sodium Iodide (NaI(Tl)), Cadmium Zinc Telluride (CZT), and High Purity Germanium (HPGe) detectors. A collection of ML techniques was used and compared to classify spectra according to their correct identity; contrastive techniques were first applied to the single isotope sources before application to the complex irradiated samples with changing activities. Activated samples included NIST-certified coal, soil, tomato leaves, and natural uranium oxide (U3O8) irradiated at the UT Austin TRIGA reactor. A five-step preprocessing pipeline consisting of counts-per-second normalization, interpolation onto a common energy grid, total-area normalization, log1p transformation, and Poisson noise augmentation was applied to place all spectra on a physically meaningful, detector-agnostic representation. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) reduced the 3001-dimensional feature vectors to between 4 and 13 components prior to classification. Three classifiers were evaluated under Leave-One-Out Cross-Validation (LOO-CV): Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine with RBF kernel (SVM), and k-Nearest Neighbors (KNN). For single-isotope sources, all three classifiers achieved no observed failures across all detector types. For the complex irradiated samples, RF and KNN achieved no observed failures (accuracy 1.000, Matthews Correlation Coefficient 1.000) on all three detectors, with SVM reaching 0.974 on HPGe due to cooling-time-dependent spectral drift in the tomato leaf class. Clopper-Pearson 95% confidence intervals and per-class prediction confidence analysis indicate that observed accuracy and prediction reliability diverge for low-statistics measurements, most notably for short-count CZT spectra. These results establish a validated preprocessing and classification baseline for experimental gamma spectroscopy datasets with variable acquisition times, detector types, and post-irradiation histories, and provide a framework for extension into more complex identification.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作初步评估了多种机器学习方法在伽马射线能谱自动分类中的应用，覆盖不同能谱复杂度和不同探测器分辨率。研究样品包括单一同位素源以及在德克萨斯大学奥斯汀研究反应堆中辐照的煤、土壤、番茄叶和天然氧化铀等材料，数据由 NaI(Tl)、CZT 和 HPGe 探测器采集。作者采用归一化、能量网格插值、对数变换和泊松噪声增强等预处理流程，以构建具有物理意义且尽量不依赖探测器类型的能谱表示。

articles.title_zh: 通过 Al3+/Sn4+/Cu2+ 三元掺杂调控 BaM 六角铁氧体的磁性与介电性能
articles.abstract: Publication date: September 2026 Source: Chemical Physics Letters, Volume 896 Author(s): Jiaming Wang, Jiawen Wu, Chujun Wang, Haoran Long, Jiayu Qin, Zhongcai Wu, Yongzheng Feng, Hui Zheng
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究围绕 BaM 六角铁氧体的 Al3+、Sn4+ 和 Cu2+ 三元掺杂改性展开，关注掺杂对其磁学和介电性能的调控作用。论文可能讨论离子取代引起的结构、磁各向异性、磁化行为和介电响应变化，但具体实验结果和机理分析需查阅原文。

articles.title: NEP89: universal neuroevolution potential for inorganic and organic materials across 89 elements
articles.title_zh: NEP89：覆盖89种元素的无机与有机材料通用神经演化势
articles.abstract: Nature Computational Science, Published online: 08 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s43588-026-01009-6 The researchers developed NEP89, a foundation model for large-scale molecular dynamics across 89 elements with near-quantum-level accuracy and high efficiency. It can be rapidly adapted to address complex challenges in inorganic and organic materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究者开发了NEP89，这是一个面向大规模分子动力学模拟的基础模型，覆盖89种元素。该模型旨在以接近量子力学计算的精度和较高效率处理无机与有机材料问题，并可快速适配复杂材料挑战。

articles.title: CLAWDIA: a dictionary learning framework for gravitational-wave data analysis
articles.title_zh: CLAWDIA：用于引力波数据分析的字典学习框架
articles.abstract: Deep-learning methods are becoming increasingly important in gravitational-wave data analysis, yet their performance often relies on large training datasets and models whose internal representations are difficult to interpret. Sparse dictionary learning (SDL) offers a complementary approach: it performs well in scarce-data regimes and yields physically interpretable representations of gravitational-wave morphology. Here we present clawdia (Comprehensive Library for the Analysis of Waves via Dictionary-based Algorithms), an open-source Python framework that integrates SDL-based denoising and classification under realistic detector noise. We systematise previously isolated SDL workflows into a unified, modular environment with a consistent, user-friendly interface. The current release provides several time-domain denoising strategies based on LASSO-regularised sparse coding and a classifier based on low-rank shared dictionary learning. A companion toolbox, gwadama, supports dataset construction and realistic conditioning of real and simulated interferometer data. We demonstrate clawdia’s performance by denoising the signal from binary neutron star event GW170817 and by classifying families of instrumental glitches from LIGO’s third observing run, highlighting robustness at low signal-to-noise ratios. clawdia is intended as a community-driven, interoperable library extensible to additional tasks, including detection and parameter estimation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出开源Python框架CLAWDIA，将稀疏字典学习用于真实探测器噪声条件下的引力波去噪与分类。与依赖大规模训练集且可解释性较弱的深度学习方法相比，该框架在数据稀缺场景中具有优势，并能提供与引力波形态相关的物理可解释表示。作者还配套提供gwadama工具箱用于构建和处理真实及模拟干涉仪数据，并以GW170817等案例展示其性能。
authors: Miquel Llorens-Monteagudo, Alejandro Torres-Forné and José A Font

articles.title: An interpretable convolutional neural network framework for fluid dynamics
articles.title_zh: 一种用于流体动力学的可解释卷积神经网络框架
articles.abstract: Modelling fluid dynamics with machine learning (ML) has advanced rapidly, yet most data driven approaches remain opaque because they rely on complex architectures to capture nonlinear flow behaviour. This lack of interpretability limits the reliability and hinders the understanding of when and why some models succeed or fail. To address this, we present a transparent approach that provides insights into how data-driven fluids dynamics and ML work. This is achieved by training a convolutional neural network (CNN), on data from a simple laminar fluid flow, to behave as an operator that exactly matches the finite-difference numerics, providing a direct link between well-established theory and this new world of ML models. Importantly, the model demonstrates strong generalisation capability by reproducing the dynamics for a wide range of distinct and unseen flow conditions within the same flow category. The CNN learns the forward Euler three-point stencil weights, capturing physical principles such as consistency and symmetry despite having only three tuneable weights. This interpretable ML model goes beyond pure numerical training (numCNN), the approach is shown to work when trained on analytical (anCNN) and even molecular dynamics (mdCNN) data. In some cases, the physics is not captured, and thanks to the simple and interpretable form, these CNNs provide insight into the limits, pitfalls and best practice of data-driven fluid models. Because the approach is based on finite-difference operators, it naturally extends to many structured-grid computational fluid dynamics problems, including turbulent, multiphase and multiscale flows as well as systems beyond the continuum such as molecular dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种透明的卷积神经网络方法，用简单层流数据训练模型，使其作为算子精确匹配有限差分数值格式。模型仅通过少量可调权重学习前向欧拉三点模板，并体现一致性、对称性等物理原则。结果表明，该可解释模型不仅能连接传统数值理论与机器学习，还能在同类但未见过的多种流动条件下保持较强泛化能力。
authors: Kwame Agyei-Baah, Muhammad Rizwanur Rahman and Edward R Smith

articles.title: A physics-informed deep operator network for modeling of atmospheric RF plasmas
articles.title_zh: 用于大气射频等离子体建模的物理信息深度算子网络
articles.abstract: Fast surrogate modeling of atmospheric radio-frequency (RF) plasma fluid systems is useful for accelerating parameter scans and supporting rapid system design. However, traditional discretization methods, such as finite difference or finite element methods, remain computationally expensive when repeated evaluations are required under multiple discharge conditions. In this work, a Physics-Informed Deep Operator Network (PI-DeepONet) is developed and assessed using a simplified one-dimensional fluid model of atmospheric RF plasmas as a proof-of-principle benchmark. In the present architecture, the network is conditioned on voltage-specific (300–500 V) initial electron and ion density profiles, rather than on the applied voltage amplitude as an explicit scalar input. Therefore, for each voltage-conditioned prediction, the corresponding initial density profiles must be supplied to the network. Given these externally supplied initial profiles, a single trained model can predict plasma discharge dynamics across the entire spatiotemporal domain, including electron and ion densities, particle fluxes, electric potential, and electric field distributions. Numerical verification against finite-difference results shows that the global relative errors of all benchmark fields are below 2.1%, while the inference time is reduced by more than 300 times compared with the reference solver. Region-bounded error analysis further shows that the sheath-region relative errors remain below 5.0%, with the largest localized discrepancies occurring near the sheath and electrode boundaries. Furthermore, once the required voltage-specific initial profiles are available, the trained network can rapidly reconstruct the current–voltage characteristic curve without rerunning the full fluid solver for each voltage case. These results demonstrate that the proposed PI-DeepONet can serve as an efficient surrogate for the prescribed one-dimensional fluid model, enabling rapid voltage-parameter scans while preserving consistency with the governing equations used in the present model.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作开发并评估了一种物理信息DeepONet，用于快速替代建模一维大气射频等离子体流体系统。模型以不同电压条件下的初始电子和离子密度分布为输入，而非直接输入电压标量，并可预测整个时空域内的粒子密度、通量、电势和电场分布。该方法旨在降低多放电条件参数扫描和快速设计中的重复数值求解成本，并通过与传统离散化计算对比进行验证。
authors: Wenkai Li, Kun Sun and Yuantao Zhang

articles.title: Magnetotransport of tomographic electrons in a Corbino disk
articles.title_zh: Corbino圆盘中层析电子的磁输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.05540v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In clean electron gases at low-to-moderate temperatures, odd-parity modes of the Fermi surface are anomalously long-lived due to Pauli blocking, giving rise to ``tomographic transport'' that is not captured by a hydrodynamic model. Here we show that tomographic flow in a Corbino disk induces an extended boundary layer near electrodes with superballistic transport and enhanced slip velocity, which leads to a parametric enhancement of the quadratic magnetoresistance coefficient. The enhancement depends explicitly on the electrode curvature, allowing its strength to be controlled by the device geometry. The magnetoresistance coefficient reveals three distinct regimes as a function of magnetic field: a tomographic regime at weak fields; a hydrodynamic regime at intermediate fields, reached when the cyclotron radius becomes comparable to a large odd-mode mean free path; and a conventional Ohmic regime at large fields, reached when the cyclotron radius becomes comparable to the short even-mode mean free path. The tomographic regime is characterized by an anomalous dependence of the magnetoresistance on temperature and density, which may account for recent experimentally observed anomalous scaling of the electron viscosity.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究分析了低至中等温度下洁净电子气中的层析输运，此时费米面奇宇称模式因泡利阻塞而异常长寿命，不能由普通流体动力学模型充分描述。作者指出，在Corbino圆盘中，层析流会在电极附近形成扩展边界层，产生超弹道输运和增强滑移速度，从而显著提高二次磁阻系数。磁阻随磁场呈现层析、流体动力学和常规欧姆三个区间，并表现出对温度、密度和电极曲率的特殊依赖。

articles.title: Effect of pressure on the magnetic properties of (Co₀.₅Fe₀.₅)₅GeTe₂
articles.title_zh: 压力对(Co₀.₅Fe₀.₅)₅GeTe₂磁性质的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.05548v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cobalt-doped Fe₅GeTe₂ possesses a rich magnetic phase diagram as a function of Co concentration. The nature of magnetic order in (Co₀.₅Fe₀.₅)₅GeTe₂ is especially interesting, as it has been shown to exhibit ferromagnetic order, A-type antiferromagnetic (AFM) order, or potentially both at the same time. Here we present magnetoresistance measurements on antiferromagnetic (Co₀.₅Fe₀.₅)₅GeTe₂ at a series of pressures and extract the anisotropy and interlayer exchange fields using the two-sublattice model. We show a 50 % increase of the interlayer exchange at 2 GPa, highlighting the sensitivity of magnetic properties to interlayer distance. In addition, we find that the sharp hysteretic transitions observed within the AFM state can be qualitatively described by a linear chain model, which suggests an even-odd effect as a function of layer number instead of a coexisting ferromagnetic phase.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文通过不同压力下的磁阻测量研究反铁磁(Co₀.₅Fe₀.₅)₅GeTe₂，并利用双子晶格模型提取各向异性场和层间交换场。结果显示，在2 GPa下层间交换增强约50%，凸显磁性质对层间距离的敏感性。作者还指出，反铁磁态中尖锐的滞后跃迁可由线性链模型定性解释，暗示其可能源于层数奇偶效应，而非共存的铁磁相。
authors: Tamás Prok, Zoltán Kovács-Krausz, Harvey Stanfield, Bing Zhao, Michael Leonárd Morgan, Bálint Fülöp, Marcos H. D. Guimarães, Ivan J. Vera-Marun, Saroj Prasad Dash, Szabolcs Csonka, Péter Makk, Endre Tóvári

articles.title: Raman spectroscopy of the van der Waals altermagnet Co₁/₄NbSe₂
articles.title_zh: 范德华交替磁体Co₁/₄NbSe₂的拉曼光谱研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.05616v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the influence of Co intercalation and altermagnetic order on the lattice dynamics of the layered compound Co₁/₄NbSe₂. Polarization-resolved Raman spectroscopy, supported by density-functional theory, enables identification of six Raman-active phonons. Co intercalation drives a substantial reconstruction of the vibrational spectrum through zone folding of NbSe₂ phonons, producing hybridized modes with mixed zone-center and zone-boundary character. Despite this, Co atoms do not participate in any Raman-active modes by symmetry, which is in marked contrast to related 1/3 compounds where intercalant modes do contribute to the Raman spectrum. Temperature-dependent Raman measurements across the altermagnetic transition show no discontinuities, which is consistent with short-range spin correlations in the quasi-one-dimensional Co chains. However, we find evidence for spin-phonon coupling in A₁g symmetry modes owing to their out-of-plane Se displacements. Our work demonstrates the substantial impact of intercalation on the vibrational properties of transition metal dichalcogenides and the presence of spin-phonon interactions in a newly discovered altermagnetic material.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合偏振分辨拉曼光谱和密度泛函理论，考察Co插层及交替磁有序对层状化合物Co₁/₄NbSe₂晶格动力学的影响，并识别出六个拉曼活性声子。Co插层通过NbSe₂声子的区折叠显著重构振动谱，产生兼具区中心和区边界特征的杂化模，但对称性禁止Co原子参与拉曼活性模。跨越交替磁转变的变温拉曼实验未见不连续变化，但A₁g对称模中与面外Se位移相关的特征显示出自旋-声子耦合迹象。
authors: Dushyanthini Balasundaram, Bishal Thapa, Resham Regmi, Nirmal J. Ghimire, Igor I. Mazin, Patrick M. Vora

articles.title: Domain-Growth Kinetics and Scaling Laws Governing Pulse-Driven Accumulative Polarization Switching in HZO
articles.title_zh: HZO中脉冲驱动累积极化翻转的畴生长动力学与标度律
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.05617v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accumulative polarization switching driven by sequential sub-coercive electric-field pulses offers a promising route toward low-power ferroelectric memories and neuromorphic devices. However, the kinetic regimes governing this nonequilibrium process remain poorly understood. Here, we employ a phase-field model based on the time-dependent Landau-Ginzburg formalism to investigate pulse-driven accumulative switching in ferroelectric HZO. By systematically varying the initial domain configuration, pulse amplitude, pulse-on time, and pulse-off time, we establish a quantitative link between microscopic domain-wall dynamics and macroscopic polarization accumulation. We show that the effective switched-domain radius follows distinct scaling regimes characterized by the local kinetic exponent. Initially, a local exponent greater than 1 indicates superlinear domain growth driven by enhanced irreversible domain-wall propagation under successive pulses. As switching progresses, a local exponent close to unity marks steady self-similar growth, whereas a local exponent less than 1 signifies decelerating dynamics caused by geometric confinement, depletion of switchable polarization, and relaxation-induced back switching. The transition between these regimes is governed by the competition between field-driven excitation during the pulse-on interval and spontaneous relaxation during the pulse-off interval. The initial domain geometry further influences this transition. Increasing the pulse amplitude or pulse-on duration extends the superlinear regime, whereas longer pulse-off times promote relaxation and suppress accumulation. These findings establish a unified scaling framework for pulse-driven accumulative switching, providing quantitative insight into nonequilibrium ferroelectric domain evolution and design guidelines for HZO-based memory and neuromorphic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用基于含时Landau-Ginzburg形式的相场模型，研究亚矫顽电场脉冲序列驱动的HZO铁电累积极化翻转。作者系统改变初始畴构型、脉冲幅值、导通时间和关断时间，建立微观畴壁运动与宏观极化累积之间的定量联系。结果表明，有效翻转畴半径经历不同标度区间：早期超线性增长，中期近似自相似稳态增长，后期因几何限制等因素减速。

articles.title: Electric Field Induced Multi-Space Topological Phase Transitions in Janus Monolayer MnBi2Se2Te2
articles.title_zh: 电场诱导Janus单层MnBi₂Se₂Te₂中的多空间拓扑相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.05631v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Manipulating coexisting multi-space topological states within a single material is a critical frontier for low-power spintronic applications, for which perpendicular electric-field gating offers a highly precise tuning mechanism. Using first-principles calculations and atomistic spin simulations, it is demonstrated that Janus monolayer MnBi2Se2Te2 can exhibit simultaneous momentum-space and real-space topological phase transitions under an external electric field. Specifically, the electric field drives momentum-space transitions across a topologically trivial state (C = 0), a low-Chern-number quantum anomalous Hall state (C = -1), and a high-Chern-number state (C = 2). Concurrently, by actively tuning the competition between the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction and magnetic anisotropy, the electric field induces real-space magnetic transitions from a uniform ferromagnetic state to an isolated skyrmion state, and ultimately to a skyrmion-spiral domain coexistence phase. Electric-field-induced variations in both the QAHE and magnetic textures may give rise to multiple topological phase transitions, involving distinct topological regimes: a purely k-space topology, RK-joint skyrmions, and pure real-space skyrmions. These findings establish a powerful material platform and efficient route for the synergistic control of coexisting topological orders, making it highly promising for next generation multi-functional spintronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文通过第一性原理计算和原子级自旋模拟表明，Janus单层MnBi₂Se₂Te₂可在外加垂直电场下同时发生动量空间和实空间拓扑相变。电场可驱动体系在拓扑平庸态、低陈数量子反常霍尔态和高陈数态之间转变。与此同时，电场通过调控Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用与磁各向异性的竞争，使磁结构由均匀铁磁态转变为孤立斯格明子态，并进一步进入斯格明子-螺旋畴共存相。
authors: Kefan Zhang, Jian Wu, Weiyi Pan

articles.title: Modern view of activated rate processes: unidirectional fluxes at equilibrium, correlation functions, and splitting probabilities
articles.title_zh: 活化速率过程的现代视角：平衡态单向通量、关联函数与分裂概率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.05672v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: More than 80 years ago Kramers published a paper calculating how fast a Brownian particle escapes from a potential well over an activation barrier. Since then Kramers' model has been widely adopted by nuclear physics, biophysics and chemical physics communities as a description of activated barrier crossing. From a chemical kinetics perspective, Kramers' theory provides a mapping from continuous dynamics to discrete-state chemical kinetics. Motivated by recent developments, this Perspective provides a rigorous way of performing such a mapping, explaining why and how Kramers' theory works from several points of view. Specifically, we consider transitions of a Brownian particle between two potential wells corresponding to the ``reactant'' and the ``product'' of a chemical reaction. A central unifying idea is to divide the equilibrium ensemble of possible states of the system into two sub-ensembles corresponding to the reactant and product states and then to consider fluxes between these sub-ensembles. Importantly, naive separation based on the location measured relative to the barrier top does not result in a mapping that is physically tenable, and instead the past of the trajectory should be considered. Thus constructed reactant and product ensembles provide an internally consistent description of the problem when also viewed from two different perspectives: one based on the definition of the rate as a conditional transition probability per unit time and the other based on the relaxation modes of the time-evolution operator governing the dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该综述性文章从现代角度重新审视Kramers关于布朗粒子跨越活化势垒逃逸的理论，以及其在化学动力学中将连续动力学映射为离散态反应过程的作用。作者围绕双势阱体系，讨论如何将平衡系综划分为反应物和产物子系综，并通过子系综之间的通量理解速率过程。文章强调，简单地按相对于势垒顶的位置进行划分并不总能得到物理上合适的映射，并结合关联函数和分裂概率等概念给出更严格的表述。
authors: Alexander M. Berezhkovskii, Kevin Song, Dmitrii E. Makarov

articles.title: Equivalence between the Axion Invariant and the S₄ Symmetry Indicator
articles.title_zh: 轴子不变量与S₄对称性指标的等价性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.05719v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The equivalence between the axion invariant and the S₄ symmetry indicator is established for three-dimensional S₄₋ₛymmetric axion insulators with vanishing three-dimensional Chern numbers. Starting from the Chern-Simons expression for the magnetoelectric polarizability, 2P₃₌θ/π is rewritten in terms of the S₄ sewing matrix. After stable reduction to determinant-one two-band blocks, the invariant is expressed as the degree of a map from the Brillouin zone to SU(2). The degree modulo two is then evaluated from the S₄ eigenvalues at the four S₄₋ᵢₙᵥₐᵣᵢₐₙₜ momenta and is shown to coincide with the symmetry indicator z₂. A minimal tight-binding model verifies the correspondence between 2P₃ and z₂. The result closes a gap between the topological-field-theory description of the axion response and the topological-band-theory classification by symmetry indicators. It also extends the known response-indicator equivalence from antiunitary settings such as CₙT symmetry to the unitary, orientation-reversing rotoinversion symmetry S₄.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究证明了在三维S₄对称、三维陈数为零的轴子绝缘体中，轴子不变量与S₄对称性指标等价。作者从磁电极化率的Chern-Simons表达式出发，将2P₃=θ/π改写为S₄缝合矩阵形式，并通过约化到行列式为一的双能带块得到从布里渊区到SU(2)映射的度。该度的模二值由四个S₄不变动量点处的S₄本征值给出，并与对称性指标z₂一致，同时由最小紧束缚模型验证。

articles.title: Magnon-Mediated Superconductivity in a 2D Itinerant Ferromagnet with Weak Easy-plane Magnetic Anisotropy
articles.title_zh: 弱易平面磁各向异性二维巡游铁磁体中的磁振子介导超导
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.05754v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by recent observations of superconductivity in a quarter-metal state of spin- and valley- polarized graphene multilayers, we investigate pairing within a ferromagnetic phase of a single-valley model of itinerant two-dimensional (2D) electrons with Hubbard-type interaction and no artificial high-energy cutoff. In 2D, the Stoner transition is first-order into a fully-polarized state wherein the only gapless collective excitations are transverse magnons. We find that in a spin-SU(2) symmetric model, this magnon-mediated pairing interaction between equal-spin fermions vanishes at T=0. We show that a small easy-plane magnetic anisotropy Ømega₀ łl E_F, where E_F is the Fermi energy, breaks the SU(2) symmetry and generates an attractive interaction for equal-spin p-wave pairing. We explicitly derive the corresponding coupling constant łambdaₚ as the scaling function of both the relative strength of the easy-plane anisotropy, Ømega₀/E_F, and the proximity to the ferromagnetic transition. While łambdaₚ is parametrically small in Ømega₀/E_F deep inside the ferromagnetic phase, it becomes enhanced near the ferromagnetic transition, reaching order unity regardless of how small Ømega₀/E_F is. This mechanism yields a sizable T_c, peaked near the onset of ferromagnetism.
articles.abstract_zh: 受自旋和谷极化石墨烯多层体系中四分之一金属态超导观测的启发，该文研究二维单谷巡游电子铁磁相中的配对机制。作者发现，在自旋SU(2)对称模型中，零温下横向磁振子介导的同自旋配对相互作用消失；而微弱的易平面磁各向异性会打破SU(2)对称性，并产生吸引性的同自旋p波配对相互作用。研究进一步推导了相应耦合常数随各向异性能量与费米能之比以及接近铁磁转变程度变化的标度形式，指出其在铁磁转变附近可被增强。
authors: Vladimir Calvera, Heqiu Li, Yijie Wang, B. Andrei Bernevig, Andrey V. Chubukov

articles.title: From Closed-Loop Optimization to Open Decision Making: Coupled Digital Twins for Predictive and Autonomous Microscopy
articles.title_zh: 从闭环优化到开放式决策：用于预测与自主显微学的耦合数字孪生
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.05758v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Automated experimentation is moving from closed-loop optimization toward open decision-making, where human or AI planners must forecast the consequences of candidate actions before executing them. Such forecasts require a model of both sides of the experiment: how the sample is likely to respond and what the instrument is likely to detect. We therefore introduce a coupled digital-twin framework that separates these roles and then links them. In this framework, the sample twin encodes material state inferred from prior knowledge and measurements till the moment. The instrument twin captures signal formation, feedback dynamics, and operating constraints based on prior knowledge. When coupled, the two twins estimate expected outcomes, uncertainty, and risk for candidate microscope operations. For amplitude-modulation scanning probe microscopy, we realize this framework with a physics-informed encoder of force-distance curves, a deterministic scanner model of cantilever and feedback dynamics, and sparse learned residual corrections. The encoder first recovers scanner-driving descriptors with sub-nanometer accuracy. The calibrated scanner then reproduces typical traces within a few nanometers and identifies operating-point noise amplification as the main source of mismatch. Supplementary phase analysis localizes residual error to the phase channel, which clarifies where added physics is needed. Together, these results establish coupled sample and instrument twins as a practical foundation for predictive microscope operation and autonomous experimental planning.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种耦合数字孪生框架，用于将自动化实验从传统闭环优化推进到能够预判候选操作后果的开放式决策。框架将样品孪生体与仪器孪生体分离建模并耦合，分别描述材料状态、信号形成、反馈动力学与操作约束，从而估计显微操作的预期结果、不确定性和风险。作者以振幅调制扫描探针显微术为例，结合物理约束编码器、确定性扫描器模型和稀疏学习残差修正，展示了对扫描驱动描述符和仪器响应的高精度预测能力。
authors: Yu Liu, Boris Slautin, Ian Mercer, Jon-Paul Maria, Sergei V. Kalinin

articles.title: Engineering nonlinear magnon scattering in artificial spin ice via vertex dipolar control
articles.title_zh: 通过顶点偶极控制在人工自旋冰中工程化非线性磁振子散射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.05797v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial spin ice (ASI), composed of geometrically frustrated arrays of interacting nanoislands, provides a versatile platform for reprogrammable magnonic functionality. However, the commonly used geometric control parameters such as island length, width, and aspect ratio simultaneously modify the island footprint, inter island dipolar spacing, and shape anisotropy, making it difficult to tune the nonlinear response independently of the linear spectrum and lattice density. Using micromagnetic simulations of kagome ASI under strong microwave drive, we identify edge curvature as a geometric degree of freedom that separates nonlinear magnon scattering from the island footprint. Sharp tipped islands predominantly generate integer harmonics, whereas dumbbell shaped tips produce a transition toward subharmonic rich spectra by concentrating demagnetizing and exchange fields near the island ends without changing the overall island volume or lattice spacing. By mapping the curvature and drive parameter space, we identify a continuous threshold for subharmonic onset controlled by tip curvature. We further show that the angular dependence of the second harmonic amplitude reverses between sharp and dumbbell geometries, providing an experimentally accessible signature of curvature localized nonlinearity. Width and leg length asymmetry can also modify harmonic amplitudes, but they do not remove the intrinsic trade off between footprint and coupling. These results establish tip curvature as a footprint preserving design parameter for engineering nonlinear magnon scattering in ASI, with implications for reconfigurable magnonic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用微磁模拟考察 kagome 人工自旋冰在强微波驱动下的非线性磁振子响应，重点提出边缘曲率可作为独立调控非线性散射的几何自由度。结果表明，尖锐端部纳米岛主要产生整数谐波，而哑铃形端部会增强端点附近的退磁场和交换场，使谱线转向富含次谐波的响应。作者进一步绘制曲率与驱动参数空间，识别出由端部曲率控制的次谐波出现阈值，说明顶点偶极结构可用于设计可重构非线性磁振子功能。

articles.title: Efficient Bethe-Salpeter Equation Calculations Based on Numerical Atomic Orbitals and Norm-Conserving Pseudopotentials: Dual-boldsymbol k-Mesh Strategy
articles.title_zh: 基于数值原子轨道和模守恒赝势的高效 Bethe–Salpeter 方程计算：双 k 网格策略
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.05853v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present an efficient implementation of the Bethe--Salpeter equation (BSE) based on numerical atomic orbitals (NAOs) and norm-conserving pseudopotentials within the ABACUS+LibRPA framework. By exploiting the localized resolution-of-identity (LRI) technique, the screened Coulomb interaction is cast into a real-space, unit-cell-indexed form Wμν(boldsymbol R) that is inherently short-ranged and well localized. This spatial locality enables an efficient Fourier interpolation of the BSE kernel from the coarse boldsymbol k-mesh used in the preceding GW calculation to an arbitrarily dense boldsymbol k-mesh on which the BSE Hamiltonian is assembled and diagonalized, thereby giving rise naturally to a dual-boldsymbol k-mesh workflow. Building on this scheme, we systematically examine the convergence of the absorption spectra with respect to the NAO basis set, the auxiliary basis set, and the boldsymbol k-point sampling. Benchmark calculations for both molecular and periodic systems collectively validate the accuracy of the present implementation and establish the dual-boldsymbol k-mesh strategy as a practical and reliable approach for GW+BSE calculations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文在 ABACUS+LibRPA 框架内实现了基于数值原子轨道和模守恒赝势的高效 Bethe–Salpeter 方程计算方法。借助局域分辨率恒等式技术，屏蔽库仑相互作用被表示为实空间中短程且局域的形式，从而可将 BSE 核从 GW 计算所用粗 k 网格高效插值到更密 k 网格。作者系统检验了吸收谱对原子轨道基组、辅助基组和 k 点采样的收敛性，并通过分子和周期体系基准测试验证了该双 k 网格 GW+BSE 流程的准确性与实用性。
authors: Ziqing Guan, Yu Cao, Min-Ye Zhang, Peize Lin, Ruiyi Zhou, Xinguo Ren

articles.title: Anomalous Piezoelectricity from Polarization-Dependent Electrostriction in Wurtzites
articles.title_zh: 纤锌矿中由极化依赖电致伸缩引起的反常压电性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.05854v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The piezoelectric coefficient is a third-rank tensor connecting the strain or stress with the electric field or polarization, whereas the electrostriction coefficient is a fourth-rank tensor relating the strain to the square of electric polarization. The electrostriction tensor components in the current literature are often treated as constants independent of polarization, resulting in piezoelectric tensor components that are linearly proportional to polarization and the dielectric susceptibility tensor. Here, we study the electrostriction and piezoelectricity in strongly polar wurtzites, including AlN, Al₁₋ₓScₓN, Al₁₋ₓBₓN, GaN, and ZnO. We discover that electrostriction and the elastic modulus in wurtzites are both strongly polarization-dependent, and the piezoelectric coefficient is highly nonlinear with respect to polarization, including the anomalous possibility that decreasing polarization increases the electromechanical strain response. These unusual dependencies of electrostriction and piezoelectric effects on polarization arise from the evolution of a layered reference nonpolar structure toward a tetrahedrally coordinated wurtzite network structure as the polarization increases. The findings have important implications in understanding the thermodynamics of the general class of wurtzite ferroelectrics and in manipulating their piezoelectric and ferroelectric behaviors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察强极性纤锌矿材料中的电致伸缩与压电响应，包括 AlN、Al₁₋ₓScₓN、Al₁₋ₓBₓN、GaN 和 ZnO。作者发现，纤锌矿中的电致伸缩系数和弹性模量均强烈依赖极化，导致压电系数随极化呈高度非线性变化，甚至可能出现极化降低而机电应变响应增强的反常情形。该行为被归因于从层状参考非极性结构向四面体配位纤锌矿结构演化过程中结构与键合特征的变化。
authors: Guo-Dong Zhao, Aiden Ross, Yueze Tan, Yujie Zhu, Jia-Mian Hu, Long-Qing Chen

articles.title: Local moment magnon spectrum in conduction electron tunnelling
articles.title_zh: 传导电子隧穿中的局域磁矩磁振子谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.05858v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The surface tunnelling spectrum of a dual system consisting of localised moments with antiferromagnetic order coupled to conduction electrons by on-site exchange interaction is investigated. In the static approximation of the local moment order it is known that magnetic band reconstruction leads to an anomalous tunnelling spectrum at the magnetic ordering vector of local moments although the latter cannot contribute directly. In this work we consider dynamic effects by including the scattering of conduction electrons from the local moment magnon excitations. They lead to self energies and renormalisation of conduction states which in turn appreciably modify the tunnelling spectrum beyond the influence of static order, interpreted as the appearance of magnon sidebands.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究由反铁磁有序局域磁矩与传导电子通过在位交换耦合构成的双组分体系的表面隧穿谱。在静态局域磁矩有序近似下，磁性能带重构已知会在局域磁矩的磁有序波矢处产生反常隧穿谱特征。本文进一步引入传导电子与局域磁矩磁振子激发的散射，表明由此产生的自能和传导态重整化会显著改变隧穿谱，可解释为磁振子旁带的出现。

articles.title: Spatially heterogeneous noise restructures flocking into geometry-locked and vortex states
articles.title_zh: 空间非均匀噪声将群集运动重构为几何锁定态和涡旋态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.05870v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spatially heterogeneous environments continually challenge the ability of active matter to sustain coherent collective motion. Understanding how collective motion remains robust under changing environments is central to both the functioning of biological systems and the design of smart active matter. Here, we extend the Vicsek model to include a circular non-noisy region surrounded by a noisy environment - a configuration in which the noise difference sets up a contrast in local directional order between the two regions. We find that, as the surrounding noise is increased, the system passes through three distinct dynamical regimes: (i) conventional global flocking at low noise; (ii) geometry-locked motion, aligned with simulation boundaries, at intermediate noise; and (iii) vortical motion within the non-noisy region at high noise. Extending the environment to multiple non-noisy regions, we find that the geometry-locked regime can develop a directional coupling, while the vortex mode leads to antiferromagnetic order between the regions. Taken together, our results demonstrate that the spatial modulation of order and disorder offers a powerful and generic strategy for steering active matter, aligning with recent experimental observations of active particles in patterned landscapes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究扩展 Vicsek 模型，引入一个圆形无噪声区域及其周围有噪声环境，以考察空间非均匀噪声对主动物质集体运动的影响。随着外围噪声增强，系统依次经历低噪声下的全局群集运动、中等噪声下与模拟边界对齐的几何锁定运动，以及高噪声下无噪声区域内部的涡旋运动。作者还将模型推广到多个无噪声区域，发现几何锁定态可形成方向耦合，而涡旋态可导致区域间类似反铁磁的有序排列。
authors: Ankush Semwal, Mahak Poonia, Pintu Patra

articles.title: Microscopic theory of the lower critical field in superconducting thin-film strips
articles.title_zh: 超导薄膜窄条下临界场的微观理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.05890v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The lower critical field (Bc₁) of a narrow superconducting thin-film strip sets the thermodynamic scale for vortex-free operation in a perpendicular magnetic field. The standard Pearl--London estimate requires a phenomenological vortex-core cutoff, because the London theory does not resolve the core. We formulate a microscopic theory for a dirty strip by solving the two-dimensional Usadel equations in the film plane, with the applied field included directly in the gauge-invariant momentum. Self-consistent vortex and Meissner solutions are computed at fixed field, and (Bc₁) is obtained from their Gibbs-energy difference. The calculation resolves the vortex core and its finite-width deformation without introducing a cutoff. The resulting vortex self-energy is larger than the naive Pearl--London estimate and cannot, in general, be represented by a London logarithm with a single width-independent cutoff. The formulation applies at any (T
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对垂直磁场中的窄超导薄膜条带，建立了下临界场 Bc₁ 的微观理论。作者在脏极限下求解薄膜平面内的二维 Usadel 方程，并直接在规范不变动量中纳入外加磁场，通过比较自洽涡旋态与 Meissner 态的 Gibbs 能量来确定 Bc₁。该方法无需引入伦敦理论中的唯象涡核截断，能够解析涡核及其有限宽度变形，并表明涡旋自能通常高于朴素 Pearl–London 估计。

articles.title: Machine learning prediction of the convergence criterion for a topological invariant of finite non-Hermitian chains
articles.title_zh: 有限非厄米链拓扑不变量收敛判据的机器学习预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.05900v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A topological invariant based on polar-decomposition of matrices correctly captures the topology of finite non-Hermitian chains exhibiting the non-Hermitian skin effect, provided that an appropriate crop-length parameter is chosen. This parameter, which sets the cutoff used in the calculation of the invariant, is usually chosen empirically and becomes especially important near topological phase transitions, where finite-size effects are strongest. Here we show that the required crop-length is controlled by physical decay (localization) lengths. For nearest-neighbor and pure longer-range hopping Hatano-Nelson-type chains, the crop-length is set mainly by a single localization length and is well approximated by a scalar multiple of that length. For more general longer-range hopping models, it is governed instead by a multichannel root structure of the characteristic polynomial. Random-forest regression captures finite-size and near-boundary corrections while preserving this decay-length interpretation. Trained on one set of Hamiltonians, the predictor accurately generalizes to unseen Hamiltonians and complex base energies, reproducing crop-lengths across full phase diagrams. We further show that the predictions learned from clean nearest-neighbor hopping chains remain stable under moderate hopping disorder. These results provide a practical and physically interpretable way to choose the crop-length, which in turn determines when the real-space invariant can reliably capture the topology of finite non-Hermitian chains.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注一种基于矩阵极分解的拓扑不变量在有限非厄米链中的适用性，特别是非厄米趋肤效应下裁剪长度参数的选择问题。作者表明，该裁剪长度由物理衰减或局域化长度控制：在近邻和纯长程 Hatano–Nelson 型链中主要由单一局域化长度决定，而更一般长程跃迁模型中则受特征多项式的多通道根结构支配。随机森林回归能够捕捉有限尺寸和相边界附近修正，并可推广到未见过的哈密顿量和复基准能量。
authors: Raghav Chaturvedi, Viktor Könye, Ewelina M. Hankiewicz

articles.title: Interfacial Noncollinear Filtering of Spin Hall Currents
articles.title_zh: 自旋霍尔电流的界面非共线过滤
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.05912v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin Hall currents generated in nonmagnetic materials are conventionally regarded as bulk responses whose polarization is fixed by crystal symmetry. This view has motivated the search for intrinsically low-symmetry spin sources when unconventional spin polarizations are required. Here we point out that, in realistic heterostructures, the device-relevant quantity is not the fully symmetry-averaged bulk spin Hall current, but the emitted spin current transmitted across the interface. We therefore establish emitted spin currents as bulk-interface hybrid responses and propose interfacial noncollinear filtering as a mechanism to bypass the bulk-symmetry constraint. A low-symmetry interfacial spin-orbit field, generally noncollinear with the momentum-resolved spin polarization of the incident spin Hall current, imposes spin-dependent transmission and converts hidden momentum-resolved spin-polarization components into an observable unconventional emitted spin current. Using both a rotationally symmetric minimal model and a realistic high-symmetry Dirac-semimetal model, we show that conventional spin Hall sources can emit sizable out-of-plane spin currents when their hidden bulk spin Hall textures are selectively transmitted by the interfacial spin-orbit field. Our results reveal that spin-current polarization emerges from the cooperative action of bulk and interfacial responses, providing a strategy for reprogramming spin-current polarization in high-efficiency, CMOS-compatible spin Hall materials without relying on intrinsically low-symmetry bulk crystals or external symmetry-breaking schemes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文指出，在实际异质结构中器件相关的量并非完全体平均的自旋霍尔电流，而是穿过界面发射出的自旋流，因此应视为体相—界面混合响应。作者提出界面非共线过滤机制：低对称界面自旋轨道场与入射自旋霍尔电流的动量分辨自旋极化通常不共线，从而通过自旋依赖透射将隐藏的动量分辨自旋分量转化为可观测的非常规发射自旋流。基于最小模型和高对称狄拉克半金属模型的分析表明，常规自旋霍尔源也可在界面作用下发射显著的面外自旋极化。
authors: Dan-Yang Han, Zi-An Wang, Hong-Liang Chen, Bo Li, Wen-Jian Lu, Yu-Ping Sun, Liang Liu, Shu-Hui Zhang, Ding-Fu Shao

articles.title: Orientation-resolved ultrafast spin reorientation dynamics in ferrimagnetic DyCo₅
articles.title_zh: 亚铁磁 DyCo₅ 中取向分辨的超快自旋重取向动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.05946v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Under quasi-static conditions, ferrimagnetic DyCo₅ thin films exhibit a thermally induced spin-reorientation transition, in which the equilibrium magnetization changes from an out-of-plane to an in-plane orientation, mostly as a result of the competing magnetic anisotropy contributions of the Dy 4f rare-earth and Co 3d transition-metal sublattices. While this equilibrium transition has been studied, it remains an open question whether such a reorientation can be triggered on ultrafast timescales using femtosecond laser excitation. In this work, we investigate the ultrafast spin-reorientation dynamics in DyCo₅. The time-dependent orientation of the magnetization vector following femtosecond laser excitation is quantified by combining polar with transverse magneto-optical Kerr effect (MOKE) measurements in the extreme ultraviolet spectral range, which are sensitive to the out-of-plane and in-plane magnetization component, respectively. Both techniques are implemented at the Co M₃,₂ resonance and are complemented by visible-light MOKE measurements. This combined approach allows us to resolve the canting of the magnetization from an out-of-plane toward an in-plane orientation and to determine the characteristic timescales of the transient spin-reorientation process.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察亚铁磁 DyCo₅ 薄膜在飞秒激光激发后是否能发生超快自旋重取向。DyCo₅ 在准静态条件下存在热诱导自旋重取向转变，其平衡磁化方向由 Dy 4f 稀土子晶格和 Co 3d 过渡金属子晶格的竞争磁各向异性决定。作者结合极向和横向极紫外磁光 Kerr 效应测量，并辅以可见光 MOKE，以分别解析面外和面内磁化分量，从而追踪激光激发后磁化矢量的倾斜和取向演化。
authors: Johanna Richter, Martin Hennecke, Martin Schmidbauer, Ilie Radu, Clemens von Korff Schmising, Stefan Eisebitt

articles.title: Modelling the mean inner potential of alloyed and strained materials
articles.title_zh: 合金化与应变材料平均内势的建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.05948v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this publication, we study the influence of strain and alloying on the mean inner potential (MIP) using density functional theory (DFT) within an augmented plane waves plus local orbitals basis set. Two major effects have been identified allowing to model the influence of strain and alloying on the mean inner potential with a reasonable accuracy. First, alloying for constant volume results in a linear relationship between the MIP and the concentration. Second, the MIP scales with changes in volume as we already pointed out in an earlier publication (M. Schowalter, D. Lamoen, A. Rosenauer, P. Kruse, and D. Gerthsen, Appl. Phys. Lett. 85, 4938-4940 (2004)). Specifically, a linear relationship between MIP and concentration x was found for AlGaAs (nearly no change in lattice parameter), whereas InGaP and GeSi (volume changes with concentration x) exhibits a clear bowing. The bowing can be modeled by taking the rescaling of the MIP with the varying volume additionally into account. The rescaling could be also used to model the dependence of the MIP on strained binary cells and the density dependence of e.g. amorphous materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文利用基于增强平面波加局域轨道基组的密度泛函理论，研究应变和合金化对平均内势的影响。作者指出两个主要效应可较准确地描述这种影响：在恒定体积下，平均内势与合金浓度近似呈线性关系；同时，平均内势会随体积变化而重新标度。对于 AlGaAs 可观察到近线性浓度依赖，而 InGaP 和 GeSi 中因晶格体积随浓度改变产生明显弯曲；将体积重标度纳入后可统一描述合金、应变二元晶胞以及非晶材料密度变化对平均内势的影响。
authors: Marco Schowalter, Peer Kruse, Andreas Rosenauer

articles.title: CE-antiferromagnetic electronic structure in LaSr₂Mn₂O₇ revealed by micro-focused angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy and tight-binding models
articles.title_zh: 微聚焦角分辨光电子能谱与紧束缚模型揭示 LaSr₂Mn₂O₇ 中的 CE 型反铁磁电子结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.05949v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We have investigated the electronic structure of LaSr₂Mn₂O₇ in the CE-type antiferromagnetic (CE-AFM) state below the Néel temperature using micro-focused angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (μ-ARPES) and tight-binding models. In agreement with the tight-binding calculations, we found a dispersive intensity around the X point in the μ-ARPES spectra, where the A-type antiferromagnetic (A-AFM) phase has no bands experimentally and theoretically, demonstrating that we have successfully captured the signatures of the CE-AFM band structure for the first time. Many observed features can be explained by the CE-AFM tight-binding bands, although some of them and the overall near-Fermi level intensity mapping can be explained by the A-AFM band structure. This indicates that the CE-AFM domain size would be no larger than the beam footprint size of a sim!20~textmum scale.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用微聚焦角分辨光电子能谱和紧束缚模型，研究 LaSr₂Mn₂O₇ 在 Néel 温度以下 CE 型反铁磁态中的电子结构。实验在 X 点附近观测到色散强度，与 CE-AFM 紧束缚计算一致，而 A 型反铁磁相在该区域实验和理论上均无相应能带，表明首次捕捉到 CE-AFM 能带结构的特征。尽管许多观测特征可由 CE-AFM 能带解释，部分近费米能级强度分布仍可由 A-AFM 结构解释，暗示 CE-AFM 畴尺寸可能不超过约 20 微米量级的光束足迹。
authors: Yasutaka Sawata, Yudai Hirai, Rintaro Miyabayashi, Goro Shibata, Hideki Kuwahara, Miho Kitamura, Koji Horiba, Kenichi Ozawa, Noriaki Hamada, Tomohiko Saitoh

articles.title: The Ramsey community number as a renormalization-group crossing
articles.title_zh: 作为重整化群交叉的拉姆齐社群数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.05954v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Ramsey community number rₖ is the smallest size at which a network is better described by communities than by none, under a Bayesian detection rule. On the diamond hierarchical lattice we show that rₖ is an exact renormalization-group crossing: the block-model sufficient statistics obey a linear map with eigenvalues bs,b, the degree-corrected evidence density flows to łn K at a community fixed point, and rₖ is the generation at which the running evidence clears the detection threshold. Degree correction advances detection by two generations. We derive rₖ₍b,s;q) in closed form for the whole family. Finally, placing on the lattice the Reichardt--Bornholdt community Hamiltonian -- whose ground state is the partition itself -- we find an exact community-ordered phase: below the ferromagnetic critical temperature the two hubs lock into opposite communities for any resolution γ>0, a staggered order that persists as n→infty. Allowing each nested sub-community its own label, the optimal partition is a hierarchy of qₘ̊ ₒₚₜsimsqrtn communities, so the number of Potts states that best describes the network grows with the network. This hierarchy orders thermally level by level, through a cascade of first-order transitions whose temperatures fall as 1/łn q, so every stable level persists as n→infty: the emergent partition is detectable, optimal, and thermodynamically ordered.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文将拉姆齐社群数定义为在贝叶斯检测规则下，网络从“无社群”描述转向“有社群”描述的最小规模。作者在钻石型层级晶格上证明该数对应一个精确的重整化群交叉，并给出相关族的闭式表达式；度校正会使社群检测提前两个世代。文章还将 Reichardt–Bornholdt 社群哈密顿量置于该晶格上，发现精确的社群有序相以及随网络规模增长的最优层级社群数。

articles.title: High temperature ferromagnetism in epitaxial monolayers of Co-doped Fe5GeTe2
articles.title_zh: Co 掺杂 Fe5GeTe2 外延单层中的高温铁磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.05962v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic van der Waals materials have mainly been investigated in their bulk form or as few-layers flakes. Due to the challenges in producing atomically thin films, only a few have been isolated as monolayers, which typically exhibit long-range magnetic order below 150 K. In this work, we use molecular beam epitaxy to synthesize Co-doped Fe5GeTe2, achieving precise control over both thickness and composition. We demonstrate ferromagnetism well above room temperature in multilayer samples and present clear evidence of ferromagnetic ordering in monolayers up to sim200 K. The changes in Curie temperature and magnetic anisotropy with composition exhibit similar trends in both monolayers and thicker films, indicating that the magnetic properties are primarily governed by intralayer magnetic interactions. Through element-specific X-ray magnetic circular dichroism and density functional theory, we identify the substitution site of Co dopants and reveal the mechanism behind the Curie temperature enhancement induced by Co doping. Our findings suggest that, despite their weak magnetic moment, Co dopants strengthen the magnetic moments on neighboring Fe atoms and enhance the intralayer ferromagnetic exchange interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用分子束外延合成 Co 掺杂 Fe5GeTe2，实现了对厚度和成分的精确控制。作者在多层样品中观察到远高于室温的铁磁性，并给出单层样品中铁磁有序可维持至约 200 K 的证据。结合元素特异性 X 射线磁圆二色性和密度泛函理论，研究确定了 Co 掺杂位点，并揭示 Co 掺杂通过增强邻近磁矩相互作用来提高居里温度的机制。
authors: Jules Courtin (SPINTEC), Fatima Ibrahim (SPINTEC), Davide Benettin (SPINTEC), Djordje Dosenovic (MEM), Roberto Sant (ESRF), Pâmella Vasconcelos Borges Pinho (ESRF), Vincent Polewczyk (SPINTEC), Alain Marty (SPINTEC), Isabelle G de Moraes (SPINTEC), Matthieu Jamet (SPINTEC), Denis Jalabert (DRF), Fadi Choueikani (SSOLEIL), Philippe Ohresser (SSOLEIL), N. B. Brookes (ESRF), Hanako Okuno (MEM), Mairbek Chshiev (SPINTEC, IUF), Frédéric Bonell (SPINTEC)

articles.title: Bose Einstein Condensation of Magnons in BaCuSi₂O₆: An experimental perspective
articles.title_zh: BaCuSi₂O₆ 中磁振子的玻色–爱因斯坦凝聚：实验视角
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06028v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Han Purple, a pigment first obtained in ancient China, is one of the earliest known synthetic pigments. Also naturally occurring, as a mineral, it is known as colinowensite (Cwn). Its chemical formula is BaCuSi₂O₆, and its structure is a layered cyclosilicate in which magnetic Cu²⁺ ions (S = 1/2) form dimers arranged on a square lattice, making it also the first known synthetic metal dimer compound. Most interesting magnetic properties arise from a strong intradimer spin coupling, accompanied by weaker interdimer interactions within and between Cu-dimer layers. In zero or small magnetic fields, BaCuSi₂O₆ remains a quantum paramagnet. However, under high magnetic fields between 23 and 49 Tesla -- about a million times stronger than Earth's magnetic field -- it undergoes magnetic ordering at subliquid Helium temperatures into an almost ideal easy-plane (XY) antiferromagnetic state regarded as a realization of a Bose-Einstein condensate of magnons. Within this experimentally accessible field range, BaCuSi₂O₆ serves as an extraordinary playground for testing predictions of quantum many-body physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文从实验角度综述汉紫 BaCuSi₂O₆ 的磁性及其作为量子磁体的意义。BaCuSi₂O₆ 中 Cu²⁺ 自旋二聚体形成层状结构，在零场或弱磁场下表现为量子顺磁体。强磁场下，该材料在低温进入近似理想的易平面反铁磁有序态，被视为磁振子玻色–爱因斯坦凝聚的实现，为检验量子多体物理预言提供了重要平台。

articles.title: Identifying Non-Ideal Reaction-Diffusion Systems Unable to Maintain Diffusion Out-of-Equilibrium
articles.title_zh: 识别无法维持非平衡扩散的非理想反应–扩散系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06030v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a general method, based on the construction of a kinetic potential acting as a Lyapunov function, to establish when diffusion necessarily equilibrates in non-ideal reaction-diffusion systems, under arbitrary driving by autonomous homogeneous chemostats. Using this method, we generalize the results of J. Chem. Phys. 161, 174108 (2024) by relaxing some of the underlying assumptions. Specifically, we show that diffusion equilibrates in reaction-diffusion systems whose chemical reaction network is either pseudo-detailed balanced, with reaction fluxes controlled by the stoichiometry of reactants and products, or complex balanced, with reaction fluxes controlled only by the stoichiometry of the reactants. The different constraints on the reaction fluxes are shown to originate from the distinct stoichiometric properties of the two classes of networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出一种基于构造动力学势并将其作为 Lyapunov 函数的一般方法，用于判断非理想反应–扩散系统中扩散何时必然达到平衡。该方法适用于由自主均匀化学恒温器任意驱动的情形，并推广了此前工作的若干结果。研究表明，在伪详细平衡或复合平衡的化学反应网络中，在相应反应通量约束下扩散会平衡化，而这些约束源于两类网络不同的化学计量性质。
authors: Francesco Avanzini, Timur Aslyamov, Massimiliano Esposito

articles.title: From Active to Odd to Smart Matter
articles.title_zh: 从活性物质到奇异物质再到智能物质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06051v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The study of active matter has reshaped our understanding of collective states of matter far from equilibrium by proving that energy pumped into the microscopic scale leads to order on the macroscopic scale, collective motion, and anomalous mechanical responses. More recently, the discovery of odd elasticity and nonreciprocal mechanical couplings has extended these ideas to solid-like active systems, revealing materials with nonconservative elastic response. Simultaneously, innovative developments in swarm robotics , programmable metamaterials , and learning algorithms have led to the emergence of a new frontier in which collective behavior and mechanical response are no longer fixed by design, but adapted, optimized, and learned toward functional goals. This Perspective proposes a unifying trajectory, from active to odd to smart matter, organized along two intertwined axes: the traditional gas--liquid--solid progression of condensed matter, and the more recentparadigm shift from spontaneous collective dynamics to task-driven functionality. We try to highlight emerging principles, conceptual shifts, and open challenges that come along this trajectory, and argue that learning may play the role of a specific form of emergence, which could advantageously replace the more traditional view of control, at least in the realm of physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 这篇观点文章梳理了从活性物质、奇异弹性材料到智能物质的发展脉络。作者指出，活性物质研究揭示了微观能量输入如何导致宏观有序、集体运动和反常力学响应，而奇异弹性和非互易耦合则将这些思想扩展到类固体活性系统。文章进一步讨论群体机器人、可编程超材料和学习算法如何推动材料从自发集体动力学走向面向任务的自适应功能，并概述相关概念转变和开放问题。

articles.title: Deep-learning Hamiltonian reveals twist-tunable flat bands and nonlinear photocurrents in SrTiO3 moire bilayers
articles.title_zh: 深度学习哈密顿量揭示 SrTiO3 莫尔双层中可由扭角调控的平带与非线性光电流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06053v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The extension of moire physics to complex oxides offers new ways to manipulate electronic states, but the large oxide moire supercells make systematic first-principles calculations demanding. Here, we combine density functional theory with the E(3)-equivariant deep-learning Hamiltonian framework DeepH-E3 to investigate the twist-angle-dependent electronic structure and optical responses of twisted bilayer SrTiO3. The model is trained on untwisted bilayers with different interlayer-sliding configurations and then applied to commensurate twisted bilayers with twist angles from 8.80 degrees to 53.13 degrees. Compared with the untwisted bilayer, decreasing twist angle systematically flattens the valence bands and leads to nearly dispersionless bands at the smallest angles studied. Based on the predicted Hamiltonians, we evaluate the dielectric response, second-harmonic generation (SHG), shift current, and spin Hall conductivity. The dielectric response and spin Hall conductivity remain close to those of the untwisted bilayer, whereas the nonlinear optical responses are more strongly affected by twisting. SHG is strongly enhanced relative to the weak untwisted response, and the shift current shows a clear twist-angle dependence within the response-calculation range (53.13 degrees-22.62 degrees). These results show that twist engineering can control electronic and optoelectronic responses in oxide moire systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合密度泛函理论与 E(3) 等变深度学习哈密顿量框架 DeepH-E3，研究扭转双层 SrTiO3 的角度依赖电子结构和光学响应。模型在不同层间滑移构型的非扭转双层上训练，并推广到多种公度扭角结构，结果显示扭角减小时价带系统性变平，在最小角度下接近无色散。基于预测哈密顿量，作者计算介电响应、二次谐波产生、位移电流和自旋霍尔电导，发现非线性光学响应对扭转更为敏感。
authors: Meiyang Yu, Chen Shen, Ruiwen Xie, Jingwei Tao, Lijun Zhang, Hongbin Zhang

articles.title: Weak-coupling altermagnetism and chiral magnetic excitations in a checkerboard lattice
articles.title_zh: 棋盘格晶格中的弱耦合交替磁性与手性磁激发
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06106v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets, characterized by spin-split electronic bands with compensated magnetic moments, have emerged as a new class of magnetic materials garnering attention in recent years. Here, using a minimal one-band Hubbard model, we show that the checkerboard lattice serves as a natural platform for altermagnetism for electrons. The instability towards altermagnetic order is denoted by diverging altermagnetic susceptibility at weak-coupling. Carrying out mean-field treatment of the Hubbard repulsion, we show phase transitions from the nonmagnetic to altermagnetic semimetal and then to altermagnetic insulating phase, allowing clear identification of spin-split states. We then examine magnetic excitations in the altermagnetic phases using a random-phase approximation treatment of the dynamical spin susceptibility. The altermagnetic order is found to be stable against spin-fluctuations with the excitation spectra showing well-defined magnon excitations, which decay into single-particle excitations with decreasing interaction strength. Remarkably, the magnetic excitations exhibit strong dependence on both chirality and direction, showing an alternating chirality splitting, similar to the alternating spin splitting of the electronic bands, which serves as a salient feature of altermagnetism.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者利用最小单带 Hubbard 模型表明，棋盘格晶格可作为电子交替磁性的自然平台，其弱耦合不稳定性表现为交替磁化率发散。通过平均场处理，研究展示了从非磁态到交替磁半金属再到交替磁绝缘相的相变，并识别出自旋劈裂态。进一步采用随机相位近似分析动力学自旋磁化率，发现交替磁有序对自旋涨落稳定，磁激发具有明确的磁振子特征，并呈现显著的手性和方向依赖性。
authors: Abhigya Rangari, Manna Paul, Sayandip Ghosh

articles.title: Multiscale modelling of diffusion and retention of hydrogen in multi-occupancy traps in irradiated bcc metals
articles.title_zh: 辐照 bcc 金属中多占据陷阱内氢扩散与滞留的多尺度建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06122v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We use molecular dynamics simulations to directly compute the effective diffusivity of hydrogen gas atoms in homogeneous distributions of monovacancies in tungsten and vanadium, and voids in tungsten. Rather than fitting the results to an Arrhenius law, we compare to an analytic approximation for the effective diffusivity recently derived for multi-occupancy traps [Kaur et al (2025), Phys. Rev. Mater. 9:125404]. We find good agreement between full atomistic simulation and our theory, validating the analytic model for diffusivity for materials containing nanoscale defects characteristic of radiation damage. There are no parameters fitted, only physically motivated quantities that can be computed with static density functional or atomistic potential calculations. In this study we prove rapid convergence of hydrogen trap occupation to the steady state using lattice kinetic Monte Carlo, the spontaneous emergence of voids in tungsten using atomistic simulation with empirical potentials, and molecular hydrogen formation in voids using molecular dynamics. We conclude with a prediction for diffusion and retention of hydrogen in voids in tungsten starting from first principles. This work shows that not only is the analytic form for diffusivity and retention in multi-occupancy traps a practical scheme for making predictive simulations of hydrogen isotope diffusion and retention in irradiated microstructures, derived and parameterized from first principles, it is superior to existing single-occupancy trap formalisms.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用分子动力学直接计算氢在钨和钒中单空位均匀分布以及钨中空洞体系内的有效扩散率。作者将结果与近期针对多占据陷阱推导的解析近似比较，而非简单拟合 Arrhenius 定律，发现原子级模拟与理论吻合良好。研究还通过晶格动力学蒙特卡罗、经验势原子模拟和分子动力学分别验证陷阱占据的快速稳态收敛、钨中空洞自发形成以及空洞内分子氢形成，并用于预测辐照钨中氢的扩散与滞留。
authors: Daniel Mason, Sanjeet Kaur, Samanyu Tirumala, Prashanth Srinivasan, Ville Jantunen, Max Boleininger

articles.title: Self-Bound Droplets of Ultracold Dipolar Molecules under Tunable Double Microwave Shielding
articles.title_zh: 可调双微波屏蔽下超冷偶极分子的自束缚液滴
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06130v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We use the Ground-State Path Integral Monte Carlo method to study a Bose-Einstein condensate of strongly interacting NaCs polar molecules under the action of a fully anisotropic double microwave shielding potential characterized by a linear and an elliptical polarization field. In particular, we analyze the ground state of the system and its structure as a function of the ellipticity angle ξ. While for the circularly polarized case (ξ=0) a gas phase is realized, one or more self-bound droplets are observed for small |ξ|'s above a threshold value near 3ⁱ̧rc. With increasing ξ, the observed droplets rapidly become tightly bound and are estimated to form a superfluid array. Our results compare favorably to the experimental observations in [Zhang et al., Nature 651, 601 (2026)] for positive ξ, while moderate differences show up for ξ<0 where our simulations conform to the expected symmetries of the intermolecular potential.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者采用基态路径积分蒙特卡罗方法，研究强相互作用 NaCs 极性分子玻色–爱因斯坦凝聚体在完全各向异性双微波屏蔽势下的基态性质。该屏蔽势由线偏振场和椭圆偏振场组成，体系结构随椭圆率角 ξ 改变。结果表明，圆偏振情形下为气相，而当小的 |ξ| 超过约 3° 的阈值后会形成一个或多个自束缚液滴；随着 ξ 增大，液滴迅速变得强束缚，并可能形成超流阵列。
authors: Roger Melero, Jordi Boronat, Ferran Mazzanti

articles.title: Layer-selective chirality switch in bilayer graphene intercalated by Janus monolayers
articles.title_zh: Janus 单层插层双层石墨烯中的层选择性手性开关
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06159v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We predict that intercalating bilayer graphene with nonmagnetic WSSe or magnetic MnSSe Janus monolayers induces a layer-selective switch of the in-plane Rashba spin texture, resulting in opposite spin current directions in the top and bottom graphene layers. First-principles calculations reveal that both Janus monolayers decouple the two graphene layers while simultaneously inducing opposite signs of the proximity-induced Rashba spin-orbit coupling in each. Tight-binding modeling of the proximitized layers, combined with Rashba-Edelstein charge-to-spin conversion calculations, confirms that the spin current direction can be independently controlled by gating the top or bottom graphene layer. Bilayer graphene intercalated by Janus monolayers thus represents a promising platform for gate-tunable, layer-selective spintronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文预测，在双层石墨烯中插入非磁性 WSSe 或磁性 MnSSe Janus 单层，可诱导面内 Rashba 自旋纹理的层选择性反转，使上下石墨烯层中的自旋流方向相反。第一性原理计算显示，Janus 单层既能解耦两层石墨烯，又能在各层诱导符号相反的邻近 Rashba 自旋–轨道耦合。紧束缚模型和 Rashba–Edelstein 电荷-自旋转换计算进一步表明，可通过门控上层或下层石墨烯独立控制自旋流方向。

articles.title: Piezoaxial coupling for strain-selected ferroaxial domain control
articles.title_zh: 用于应变选择性铁轴畴控制的压轴耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06209v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We formulate a symmetry-based hierarchy of strain-derived conjugate fields for ferroaxial order, and demonstrate strain-selected ferroaxial domain control using first-principles calculations. Since ferroaxial order is even under both spatial inversion and time reversal, ordinary electric and magnetic fields cannot serve as universal linear conjugate fields. Homogeneous strain, however, can generate symmetry-allowed piezoaxial fields whose leading order is determined by the parent point group and by the chosen ferroaxial-axis component. For basal-plane strain, the leading field is linear in orthorhombic systems, quadratic in tetragonal systems, and cubic in trigonal and hexagonal systems. Cubic parent groups further split into two classes: cubic-I groups, 23 and mbar3, allow linear full-strain fields for selected axes, whereas cubic-II groups, 432, bar43m, and mbar3m, forbid linear fields and require quadratic or cubic strain combinations depending on the selected axis. In trigonal systems, the basal-plane deviatoric strain with signed amplitude ǎrepsilonₘ̊ ᵤ and principal-axis angle θ gives the single-axis field hproptoǎrepsilonₘ̊ ᵤ³sin6θ. First-principles calculations for the trigonal ferroaxial compound Na₂BaMg(PO₄₎₂ verify both the predicted angular dependence and cubic strain scaling of the ferroaxial domain splitting, and fixed-strain atomic relaxations show strain-selected evolution from the para-axial structure. These results establish static homogeneous strain as a symmetry-allowed conjugate field for ferroaxial order and suggest a route to ferroaxial domain control through strain-field cooling.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者建立了基于对称性的、由应变导出的铁轴序共轭场层级，并用第一性原理计算展示应变选择性铁轴畴控制。由于铁轴序在空间反演和时间反演下均为偶，普通电场和磁场不能作为普适线性共轭场，而均匀应变可产生对称性允许的压轴场。文章按母相点群和铁轴方向分类给出不同阶数的主导耦合，并指出正交、四方、三方、六方和立方体系中所需应变组合具有不同的阶数与选择规则。

articles.title: Local spin magnetization in itinerant non-collinear magnets: The local spin Berry curvature
articles.title_zh: 巡游非共线磁体中的局域自旋磁化：局域自旋 Berry 曲率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06253v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Conventionally, the local spin magnetization in itinerant magnets is determined from the equilibrium local spin density. Here, we propose a thermodynamic approach in which the local spin magnetization is defined from the response of the system to an infinitesimal external magnetic field. The predictions of the two theories are identical for collinear magnets, but differ qualitatively and quantitatively for non-collinear magnets. In the present thermodynamic approach, the spin coherences determine an alternative distribution of local spin magnetization due to the field-induced deformation of the energy eigenstates. This effect is captured by a Berry-curvature-like contribution reminiscent of orbital magnetization and has several distinct observable consequences. We explore the differences between the conventional and thermodynamic approaches in several test cases.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种热力学方法，将巡游磁体中的局域自旋磁化定义为体系对无穷小外磁场的响应，而非传统的平衡局域自旋密度。两种定义在共线磁体中给出相同结果，但在非共线磁体中会出现定性和定量差异。在新方法中，外场诱导的能量本征态形变使自旋相干性产生类似 Berry 曲率的贡献，类似于轨道磁化，并带来可观测后果；作者在若干测试体系中比较了两种理论。

articles.title: Uncovering Collective Modes Underlying the Giant Dielectric Response of Ferroelectric Nematic Liquid Crystals
articles.title_zh: 揭示铁电向列液晶巨介电响应背后的集体模式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06257v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferroelectric nematic liquid crystals (FNLCs) are polar fluids in which spontaneous polarization coexists with nematic orientational order, giving rise to unusual dielectric and electromechanical responses. However, the collective modes underlying their giant dielectric response remain unclear. Here, we show that this response originates from the superposition of two distinct relaxation modes rather than a single process. Dielectric spectroscopy reveals that the low-frequency mode exhibits soft-mode-like behavior associated with short-axis molecular rotation, whereas the high-frequency mode corresponds to a Goldstone-like phase displacement of an effective transverse polarization component rotating around the director. These assignments are supported by systematic analyses of temperature, electric-field, cell-thickness, and alignment-layer dependences. Our results demonstrate that the giant dielectric response of ferroelectric nematics reflects multiple collective polarization dynamics with different symmetries and restoring forces, providing a framework for interpreting dielectric spectra in polar nematic fluids.
articles.abstract_zh: 铁电向列液晶是自发极化与向列取向有序共存的极性流体，表现出异常的介电和机电响应。该研究通过介电谱表明，其巨介电响应并非来自单一过程，而是两个不同弛豫模式的叠加：低频模式与短轴分子转动相关并呈软模特征，高频模式则对应有效横向极化分量绕指向矢旋转的类 Goldstone 相位位移。温度、电场、盒厚和取向层依赖性分析支持了这一模式归属，为理解极性向列流体中的多重集体极化动力学提供了框架。
authors: Kazuma Nakajima, Hirokazu Kamifuji, Masanori Ozaki, Hirotsugu Kikuchi, Kenjiro Fukuda

articles.title: Chiral Graviton Modes in Non-Abelian lattice Fractional Quantum Hall states
articles.title_zh: 非阿贝尔晶格分数量子霍尔态中的手性引力子模式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06267v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Synthetic quantum matter provides a highly tunable route to fractional quantum Hall physics beyond the constraints of conventional electronic materials. However, previous theoretical studies have mostly focused on their ground state properties. It remains unclear to what extent such platforms could reveal key excitation properties of fractional quantum Hall states. Here, we study charge-neutral collective excitations in a non-abelian lattice fractional quantum Hall state realized in the bosonic Harper-Hofstadter model at unity filling factior, realizing a Moore-Read ground state. Combining full exact diagonalization, band-projected exact diagonalization, and matrix-product-state simulations, we demonstrate the existence of a long-lived chiral graviton mode, probed by chiral 3-body correlators, for the first time on lattice non-Abelian states. The graviton signal is topological sector-independent and could be observed via geometric quenches in small open droplets directly relevant to current cold-atom experiments, while other neutral modes, such as the magnetoroton and neutral fermion, are less resolved at presently achievable volumes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察合成量子物质平台中非阿贝尔晶格分数量子霍尔态的电荷中性集体激发，而不仅限于基态性质。作者在填充因子为 1 的玻色 Harper-Hofstadter 模型中实现 Moore-Read 基态，并结合精确对角化、能带投影精确对角化和矩阵乘积态模拟，首次在晶格非阿贝尔态中展示了长寿命手性引力子模式。该信号与拓扑扇区无关，可通过小型开放液滴中的几何淬火观测，因而与当前冷原子实验具有直接关联。
authors: Zeno Bacciconi, Min Long, Hernan Xavier, Hongyu Lu, Marcello Dalmonte, Zi Yang Meng

articles.title: Composite-Fermion Study of Cavity-Modified Fractional Quantum Hall Excitation Gaps
articles.title_zh: 复合费米子框架下腔修饰分数量子霍尔激发能隙研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06298v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate how cavity-mediated attractive electron-electron interactions modify the excitation gaps of fractional quantum Hall states within the composite-fermion framework. We compute both the neutral magnetoroton excitation spectrum and the charged excitation gap relevant to transport experiments for the Laughlin ν=1/3 and ν=1/5 states. We consider a spin-polarized lowest-Landau-level model in which the interaction is mediated by a cavity mode with a spatially uniform vacuum-field gradient and a finite interaction range controlled by a long-distance cutoff.
