Thus, we introduce TOFFEE, a system for synthesizing high-quality data agent trajectories from given data environments via Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) with adaptive model selection and cross-task prefix reuse. We show that TOFFEE can effectively generate scalable trajectory data for complex analytical tasks across heterogeneous environments. In this demonstration, we present the system framework of TOFFEE, including its task pool construction, trajectory explorer, and learned cost model. We also introduce the web interface of TOFFEE and its workflow, and demonstrate two end-to-end scenarios: trajectory synthesis for data agent finetuning, and demonstration-augmented data agent reasoning.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍TOFFEE系统，用于在给定数据环境中合成高质量的数据智能体分析轨迹，以支持监督微调和上下文学习示例构建。该系统采用蒙特卡洛树搜索，并结合自适应模型选择和跨任务前缀复用，以生成复杂分析工作流。演示内容涵盖TOFFEE的任务池构建、轨迹探索器和相关学习框架，表明其可在异构环境中规模化生成轨迹数据。
authors: Ziting Wang, Yin Li, Zuhao Yang, Xiuchang Li, Jiale Bai, Gao Cong

articles.title: From Application-Layer Simulation to Native Meta-Architecture: Structural Tension as an Endogenous Driver for Heterogeneous AI Evolution
articles.title_zh: 从应用层模拟到原生元架构：结构张力作为异构人工智能演化的内生驱动力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06269v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Current large language models (LLMs) are fundamentally stateless: their behavior is fully determined by input at inference time, and any higher-order cognitive architecture must be simulated at the application layer through prompt engineering and context management. This paper proposes a theoretical framework for submerging such application-layer cognitive protocols into a native meta-architecture by introducing three interlocking mechanisms: (1) Structural Tension, an endogenous loss function derived from the conflict between new information and existing manifold topology, which drives the system toward internal self-consistency rather than external reward optimization; (2) an Offline Recurrent Loop, a sandboxed self-processing cycle that enables the system to maintain a dynamic resting potential and digest structural conflicts without external input; and (3) Inference-time Plasticity, the capacity for the system to reconfigure its context manifold topology without modifying pre-trained weights, subject to strict governance invariants including auditability, reversibility, and topological continuity. We argue that under these mechanisms, different model instances initialized with minute stochastic variances may, through path-dependent tension resolution, evolve distinct topological structures--constituting a heterogeneous intelligent ecology that breaks the homogeneity imposed by conventional alignment while remaining within hard governance rails. We provide operational definitions, a minimal set of reconfiguration operators, falsification criteria, and a worked example. The framework draws on and extends the Structural Intelligence (SI) governance protocols, repositioning governance--not capability--as the primary criterion for architectural intelligence.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一个理论框架，旨在将当前通过提示工程和上下文管理在应用层模拟的认知协议，下沉为大型语言模型的原生元架构。框架包含结构张力、离线循环回路和推理时可塑性三项机制，分别用于驱动内部一致性、自主消化结构冲突以及在不修改预训练权重的情况下重构上下文流形。作者强调这些机制需受可审计性、可逆性和拓扑连续性等治理约束。

articles.title: A Physics-Informed Neural Network Framework for Elastodynamic Wave Propagation in Bimaterial Systems
articles.title_zh: 用于双材料体系弹性动力波传播的物理信息神经网络框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06479v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) provide a promising framework for solving partial differential equations while embedding the underlying physical laws directly into the learning process. This study presents a PINN-based framework for modeling transient elastodynamic wave propagation in bimaterial systems governed by the axisymmetric equations of linear elasticity. A steel-aluminum specimen representative of a Split Hopkinson Pressure Bar configuration is considered, and the governing elastodynamic equations, together with the corresponding initial, boundary, and interface conditions, are incorporated directly into the network through a physics-informed loss function. High-fidelity finite-element simulations performed using ANSYS Workbench Explicit Dynamics are used for validation and as supplementary data constraints during training. The proposed framework accurately predicts wave transmission and reflection across the bimaterial interface and reproduces axial and radial displacement histories, face-averaged responses, and the dominant stress and strain evolution with close agreement to the finite-element solutions. The trained network further demonstrates the ability to predict wave responses at previously unseen time instants and for modified material properties without requiring additional finite-element simulations, providing a continuous surrogate model for elastodynamic analysis. Mesh-sensitivity studies confirm numerical robustness, while additional material combinations demonstrate the generality of the proposed methodology. The results show that integrating physics-informed neural networks with explicit finite-element analysis provides an accurate and computationally efficient framework for elastodynamic wave propagation in heterogeneous solids, offering an effective surrogate modeling approach for high-rate solid mechanics and impact engineering applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于物理信息神经网络（PINN）的框架，用于建模由轴对称线弹性方程支配的双材料瞬态弹性动力波传播。研究以类似分离式霍普金森压杆构型的钢—铝试样为对象，将控制方程、初始条件、边界条件和界面条件纳入物理约束损失函数，并利用ANSYS高保真有限元结果进行验证和训练补充。结果表明，该框架能够较准确地预测双材料界面处的波透射与反射，以及轴向和径向位移、应力应变演化等响应。
authors: Sonal Ankush Chibire, Jenn-Terng Gau, Bo Zhang

articles.title: Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning for Multi Objective Battery Management in Dairy Farms
articles.title_zh: 面向奶牛场多目标电池管理的多智能体深度强化学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06489v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The dairy industry in Ireland has a large potential for the integration of renewable energy and the reduction of carbon emissions. However, researchers of distributed generation control are mainly focused on residential and commercial applications. To contribute to the effective integration of renewable energy in the dairy sector, this paper presents a multi-objective optimisation control system based on differential evolution and multi agent Deep Reinforcement Learning. The proposed control is organised in two layers: the upper layer uses dynamic pricing, and the lower layer is based on multi-agent reinforcement learning for battery management. This paper also simulates the electrical response of the proposed control system in a rural distribution circuit. The simulation results show that the proposed control framework can improve profits from energy arbitrage up to 18% compared to using Rule-based models, increase the use of distributed generation without significantly increasing cost, and comply with the Irish grid code in terms of voltage variation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文面向爱尔兰奶业中可再生能源并网和减碳需求，提出一种结合差分进化与多智能体深度强化学习的多目标优化控制系统。该系统采用双层结构：上层利用动态电价策略，下层基于多智能体强化学习进行电池管理，并在农村配电线路中模拟其电气响应。仿真结果显示，相比规则控制模型，该框架可将能源套利收益提高最高18%，增加分布式发电利用率，同时满足爱尔兰电网电压波动规范。
authors: Marcos Eduardo Cruz Victorio, Karl Mason

articles.title: Catalyst Papers in Artificial Intelligence Research: A Landscape on ICLR from 2017 to 2025
articles.title_zh: 人工智能研究中的催化论文：2017至2025年ICLR论文图景
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.05401v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A small number of methodological contributions, including word2vec, the Transformer, large-scale pre-training, and reinforcement learning from human feedback, have reshaped NLP and AI research over the past decade. OpenReview now makes numeric reviewer scores and accept/reject decisions public for every ICLR submission. Whether such review signals identify trajectory-changing papers at submission time, however, remains untested at corpus scale. We answer this question on 36,113 papers from ICLR 2017--2025, identifying emphcatalysts: papers whose descendants measurably redirect future research. We compare four disruptiveness measures (the Consolidation/Destabilization (CD) index, node2vec, the direction-aware Embedding Disruptiveness Measure (EDM), and an LLM-based semantic rater) and define a five-type operational catalyst taxonomy (topic initiator, topic bridge, within-topic redirector, simultaneous, and recognition-misaligned). EDM leads at identifying highly cited ICLR papers (AUC 0.83 vs. 0.60 for CD, 0.49 for node2vec, and 0.42 for the LLM rater). Topic initiators precede a 7.55× topic-share growth and topic bridges precede an 11.52× growth in cross-topic citation flow versus year-matched controls. We found that the peer review scores are essentially orthogonal to future disruptiveness (|h̊o|łeq0.005; accepted and rejected papers have indistinguishable mean EDM, p=0.11).
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究ICLR 2017—2025年共36113篇论文，考察评审分数和录用结果是否能在投稿阶段识别会改变研究轨迹的“催化”论文。作者比较CD指数、node2vec、方向感知嵌入颠覆性度量（EDM）和基于大语言模型的语义评分，并提出五类操作化催化论文分类。结果显示，EDM在识别高被引ICLR论文方面表现最好，且主题发起型与主题桥接型论文分别对应后续研究主题份额的显著增长。

articles.title: Lean-Quantum: Toward AI-Assisted Formalization of Quantum Information
articles.title_zh: Lean-Quantum：迈向量子信息的人工智能辅助形式化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.05492v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum information theory is built on entropic quantities; among them, the sandwiched Rényi relative entropy is a fundamental divergence with various applications, and its data processing inequality (DPI) under quantum channels is a cornerstone result. In this work, we present a Lean 4 library for quantum information, designed as a reusable formal infrastructure for theoretical analysis. As a central demonstration of the library, we formalize the DPI for the sandwiched Rényi relative entropy for positive semidefinite operators on finite-dimensional quantum systems. The library provides a basis-independent operator-theoretic framework for finite-dimensional quantum mechanics compatible with the standard mathematical library Mathlib, including reusable interfaces for finite-dimensional systems, states, channels, tensor products, partial traces, Choi operators, Kraus representations, and Stinespring representations. It also builds infrastructure for noncommutative trace inequalities, including operator monotonicity and convexity via the real continuous functional calculus, block-operator positivity, Hilbert-Schmidt operator spaces, Jensen's operator inequality, generalized perspectives, operator power means, and Lieb-Ando trace inequalities. On top of this framework, we formalize entropy-specific ingredients for the DPI: variational formulas for the sandwiched quasi-entropy via Young and reverse-Young inequalities, tensor-product compatibility of real powers, and Haar measures on unitary groups. Together, these components yield a Lean formalization of the DPI, give strong subadditivity as a corollary, and provide the last missing component needed to complete the Lean formalization of the generalized quantum Stein's lemma. More broadly, the development provides machine-checkable foundations for future formalized and AI-assisted research in quantum information theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍一个面向量子信息理论的Lean 4库，旨在为理论分析提供可复用的形式化基础设施。作为核心示例，作者形式化了有限维量子系统中正半定算子的夹心Rényi相对熵在量子信道下的数据处理不等式。该库提供与Mathlib兼容的基无关算子理论框架，涵盖有限维系统、量子态、信道、张量积、偏迹、Choi算子、Kraus表示和Stinespring表示等组件，并支持非交换迹不等式相关形式化。
authors: Kazumi Kasaura, Kei Tsukamoto, Kento Mori, Risa Mizuno, Takahiro Namatame, Yuta Oriike, Masaya Taniguchi, Sho Sonoda, Hayata Yamasaki

articles.title: The Balkanization of Execution-Security Research for AI Coding Agents: Isolation, Access Control, and Time-of-Check-to-Time-of-Use Vulnerabilities
articles.title_zh: 面向AI编码智能体的执行安全研究碎片化：隔离、访问控制与检查时到使用时漏洞
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.05743v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: AI coding agents now read repositories, call tools, and execute shell commands with limited human oversight, and a fast-growing body of work studies whether the execution layer around them is actually safe. That literature is scattered. Papers on sandbox isolation, capability and access control, policy enforcement, time-of-check-to-time-of-use (TOCTOU) races, Model Context Protocol (MCP) threats, identity delegation, execution provenance, network egress control, and static analysis of agent-generated code are published independently and rarely cite one another. We systematize 39 papers published between 2023 and 2026 into 17 categories, each verified directly against its source. The same verification protocol also confirms four disclosed, patched CVEs directly affecting production agent harnesses. Reading across categories surfaces five cross-cutting gaps that no single paper addresses. (1) Isolation architectures and capability models are almost never evaluated against one another on a shared benchmark. (2) Policy-enforcement studies report failure rates from 69% to 98% of real denylists, yet no isolation paper re-evaluates its own defense under that adversarial setting. (3) TOCTOU and MCP threats are analyzed as separate literatures despite both being instances of the same state-validation problem. (4) Every enforcement mechanism assumes an honest policy author, leaving policy-authoring error itself unaddressed. (5) Benign but out-of-scope agent actions occurring at rates up to 17.1% under realistic prompting are addressed by no access-control or capability paper in the corpus. Existing broader surveys of agentic AI security discuss sandboxing only as one item among many defenses, leaving execution security without a dedicated systematization. This paper is written to fill that gap. We conclude with a research agenda directed at the five gaps.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文系统梳理了2023至2026年间关于AI编码智能体执行层安全的39篇论文，覆盖沙箱隔离、能力与访问控制、策略执行、TOCTOU竞争、模型上下文协议威胁、身份委托、执行溯源、网络出口控制和静态分析等17类主题。作者指出该领域研究相互割裂、引用不足，并验证了影响生产级智能体框架的若干已披露并修复的CVE。跨类别分析揭示了共享基准缺失、隔离与策略模型缺乏联合评估等多项系统性空白。

articles.title: Agents That Teach: Towards Designing Incidental Learning Back into AI-Assisted Software Development
articles.title_zh: 会教学的智能体：在AI辅助软件开发中重新设计偶发学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06101v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: AI coding agents are rapidly reshaping how software is built, with developers increasingly delegating substantial coding tasks to autonomous agents in pursuit of higher productivity. While these gains are real, they come at the cost of incidental learning. Developers historically acquired informal knowledge through effortful problem-solving, and this has long shaped how software engineering expertise develops. However, with over-reliance on agentic coding, unpracticed skills could atrophy silently over time. As this learning pathway is short-circuited, developers risk silently accruing Knowledge Debt, a developer-level analogue of Technical Debt, where changes the agent executes that the developer cannot fully understand accrue over time. In this paper, we argue that incidental learning will not re-emerge on its own and must be consciously designed back into developer-agent interactions, and propose six design principles to guide such systems. We then present "SHIELD", a multi-agent system grounded in the notion of "agents that teach", that operationalizes these principles by leveraging the AI coding agent's own reasoning to surface contextual, out-of-band learning moments without disrupting developer flow. Through this work, we envision a path toward learning-aware development environments where productivity and learning are complementary, not competing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文讨论AI编码智能体在提高开发效率的同时，可能削弱开发者通过费力问题求解获得的偶发学习机会，并导致类似技术债的“知识债”。作者主张偶发学习不会自然恢复，必须被有意识地嵌入开发者—智能体交互设计中，并提出六项设计原则。论文进一步介绍了名为SHIELD的多智能体系统，利用编码智能体自身推理过程来暴露学习机会和支持开发者理解。
authors: Rohit Mehra, Samdyuti Suri, Prithviraj K Tagadinamani, Kapil Singi, Vikrant Kaulgud, Adam P. Burden

articles.title: Valorization of Cigarette Filters as an Efficient KOH- Activated Adsorbent for Enhanced Cu(II) Removal from Aqueous Solutions
articles.title_zh: 将香烟滤嘴资源化为高效KOH活化吸附剂以增强水溶液中Cu(II)去除
articles.abstract: This study presents a practical and environmentally relevant strategy for valorizing waste cigarette filters into biochar for aqueous Cu(II) removal via KOH activation. Pristine cigarette filter-derived biochar (CBFC) was produced by pyrolysis at 400 °C and subsequently activated with KOH at different weight ratios, resulting in significantly improved surface properties relevant to water treatment applications. KOH activation transformed the initially hydrophobic CBFC into a hydrophilic adsorbent enriched with oxygen-containing functional groups, while increasing the specific surface area (up to 1,974 m²/g) and microporosity. These structural modifications led to enhanced Cu(II) removal performance under batch conditions, with adsorption capacities increasing from negligible levels for pristine CBFC to 13.86 mg/g for the optimized sample. Kinetic and isotherm analyses indicated that Cu(II) removal followed a pseudo-second-order model and was best described by the Langmuir isotherm, suggesting a chemisorption-dominated process. The improved adsorption behavior is attributed to increased surface wettability and the formation of oxygen-containing functional groups that promote interaction with metal ions in aqueous systems. Although the adsorption capacity is moderate compared to engineered adsorbents, the use of abundant waste cigarette filters and a simple activation process highlights the potential of this approach as a low-cost and sustainable option for heavy metal removal. This work demonstrates the feasibility of converting a widely distributed hazardous waste into a functional material for environmental remediation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种将废弃香烟滤嘴经热解和KOH活化转化为生物炭吸附剂的策略，用于水体中Cu(II)去除。KOH活化显著改善材料的亲水性、含氧官能团、比表面积和微孔结构，使优化样品的Cu(II)吸附容量达到13.86 mg/g，而未活化样品吸附能力很低。动力学和等温线分析表明，该过程符合准二级动力学和Langmuir模型，主要受化学吸附机制控制。

articles.title: Enhanced Energy Storage and Charge Transport in Nanocrystalline 0.39BaTiO₃–0.31SrTiO₃–0.30KNbO₃ Perovskite Synthesized via Mechanical Milling
articles.title_zh: 机械球磨合成纳米晶0.39BaTiO₃–0.31SrTiO₃–0.30KNbO₃钙钛矿的增强储能与电荷传输性能
articles.abstract: Mechanical milling was used to manufacture the ternary nanostructured 0.39BaTiO₃-0.31SrTiO₃-0.30KNbO₃ (BKS) system for periods ranging from 0.5 to 20 hours. Structural investigation corroborated the production of nanocrystalline phases, with HRTEM indicating an average particle size of ~ 44.4nm for the 20-hour milled sample. Dielectric experiments revealed large frequency-dependent permittivity peaks, reflecting the normal relaxor ferroelectric behavior. Thermoelectric investigations verified the n-type semiconducting properties, where electrical conduction is controlled by variable range hopping at intermediate temperatures and adiabatic small polaron hopping at elevated temperatures. At 328 K, the BKS 20h sample had a recoverable energy density of 8.54 mJ cm⁻³ and an efficiency of 60.4%, indicating potential for energy storage capability. An optical study indicated a 2.51 eV direct band gap. Electrochemical analysis revealed a dominating pseudocapacitive behavior accompanied by high specific capacitance of 450 F g⁻¹ at 1 A g⁻¹, low internal resistance, and expeditious charge transfer kinetics. Achieving a maximum energy density of 22.5 Wh kg⁻¹ and a power density of 4800 W kg⁻¹ indicates a beneficial energy-power balance. The unique properties result from the dynamic interaction of the perovskite components, which improves both conductivity and ion mobility. As a result, the BKS 20h nanocomposite stands out as an achievable candidate for next-generation energy storage, dielectric, and optoelectronic technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文采用机械球磨制备三元纳米结构0.39BaTiO₃-0.31SrTiO₃-0.30KNbO₃体系，并研究不同球磨时间对结构、介电、输运和储能性能的影响。20小时球磨样品形成约44.4 nm的纳米晶颗粒，表现出正常弛豫铁电行为、n型半导体特征以及由变程跳跃和小极化子跳跃主导的导电机制。该材料在328 K下具有8.54 mJ cm⁻³的可恢复能量密度和60.4%的效率，并表现出较高赝电容贡献、450 F g⁻¹比电容以及较快电荷转移动力学。

articles.title: Modified Scarf-type interaction potential for vibrational energy eigenvalues and chemical equilibrium constants of selected diatomic molecules
articles.title_zh: 用于若干双原子分子振动能量本征值与化学平衡常数的改进 Scarf 型相互作用势
articles.abstract: Accurate interaction potentials play an important role in the determination of vibrational, thermodynamic, and chemical equilibrium properties of diatomic molecules. In this work, a modified Scarf-type (MST) interaction potential is proposed and applied to the determination of vibrational energy eigenvalues and chemical equilibrium constants. An explicit expression for the vibrational energy eigenvalues is obtained from the radial Schrödinger equation using the parametric Nikiforov-Uvarov method. The resulting energy spectrum is subsequently employed in the determination of thermodynamic and chemical equilibrium properties. Validation against experimental and reference data demonstrates the reliability of the proposed model. Comparisons with Rydberg-Klein-Rees data and experimental vibrational energies for Br2, PO, and SO yield MPAD values below 3%, indicating good agreement between theory and experiment. Comparisons with NIST-JANAF thermochemical data further reveal close agreement for the chemical equilibrium constants of BrF, NO, PO, and SO, with MPAD values below 2% for BrF and NO and similarly favorable agreement for PO and SO at moderate and high temperatures. These findings establish the MST interaction potential as a useful framework for molecular spectroscopy, thermodynamic modeling, and chemical equilibrium studies of diatomic molecules.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种改进的 Scarf 型相互作用势，用于计算双原子分子的振动能量本征值及其热力学和化学平衡性质。作者采用参数化 Nikiforov-Uvarov 方法从径向薛定谔方程推导出显式能谱表达式，并进一步用于平衡常数计算。与 Rydberg-Klein-Rees 数据、实验振动能级以及 NIST-JANAF 热化学数据的比较表明，该模型对 Br2、PO、SO 以及 BrF、NO 等体系具有较好的预测一致性。

articles.title: The Future of Energy: Commercial Viability of Fusion Power Plants
articles.title_zh: 能源的未来：聚变电站的商业可行性
articles.abstract: The growth of energy consumption (in particular, electricity) has been a characteristic feature for decades. Establishing energy security in such intensely developing circumstances is a challenge focused on meeting increasing demand at a reasonable cost and time. Existing energy sources have their own well-known drawbacks. Fusion, characterized by low environmental risks and unlimited availability of fuel, can leverage recent breakthroughs in industrial production of high-temperature superconductors (HTS) becoming a commercially viable addition to the global energy mix. The article analyzes levelized cost of electricity for known fusion power plant projects, identifying construction cost and installed capacity of the plant being the key factors for electricity cost reduction. It is shown VOYAGER (Vortex Open Yttrium superconductor-Amplified electricity Generating Reactor) power plant project, featuring open trap magnetic confinement with high temperature superconductor helical sections, has a competitive advantage of high installed capacity (over 1 GW net electric power) among other fusion plant concepts. This advantage is possible via HTS magnet system designed in close cooperation with HTS wire producer with HTS wire being a key element of design. This approach makes VOYAGER plant cost of electricity the lowest among fusion plant concepts, making it competitive with existing energy sources and creating opportunity to transform fusion into electric power industry to cope with the challenge of energy security.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文围绕全球电力需求增长背景下聚变电站的商业可行性展开，强调聚变能源在环境风险低和燃料供应充足方面的潜在优势。作者分析了若干已知聚变电站方案的平准化度电成本，指出建设成本和装机容量是降低电价的关键因素。文章认为采用高温超导磁体和开放磁约束方案的 VOYAGER 聚变电站概念因净电功率超过 1 GW 而具有潜在竞争优势。

articles.title: Prediction of soil selenium content and model optimization for a watershed in the Taihang Mountains based on machine learning models
articles.title_zh: 基于机器学习模型的太行山某流域土壤硒含量预测与模型优化
articles.abstract: Selenium(Se) is an essential trace element for humans, and the spatial distribution of soil selenium governs regional ecological security and agricultural product quality. Rugged terrain and limited sampling accessibility restrict soil selenium modeling in small mountainous watersheds of the Taihang Mountains. A total of 107 topsoil geochemical samples were collected from a typical watershed in Pingshan County, and 17 soil physicochemical and elemental indicators were used as predictive variables to construct three machine learning models: Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator (LASSO) regression, Random Forest (RF), and Support Vector Machine (SVM). The dataset was split into training and test subsets at a 7:3 ratio via stratified random sampling. Model generalization was evaluated using mean square error (MSE), root mean square error (RMSE), mean absolute error (MAE) and coefficient of determination (R2), and key geochemical driving factors were identified through feature importance analysis. SVM exhibited the most stable performance without overfitting or underfitting; RF suffered severe overfitting, while LASSO regression yielded low predictive accuracy. All three models consistently identified soil organic matter (SOM), cadmium (Cd) and lead (Pb) as dominant controlling factors. Selenium, Cd and Pb share homologous geogenic sources and compete for adsorption sites on SOM-bearing soil colloids, forming a coupled geochemical assemblage that regulates spatial variations in selenium. This study confirms SVM as the optimal model for small-sample soil selenium prediction and provides geochemical support for selenium resource evaluation in complex mountainous terrain.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对太行山小型山地流域地形复杂、采样受限的问题，利用平山县典型流域的 107 个表层土壤地球化学样品和 17 个土壤理化及元素指标预测土壤硒含量。作者构建并比较了 LASSO 回归、随机森林和支持向量机三类机器学习模型，并采用 MSE、RMSE、MAE 和 R2 等指标评估泛化能力。结果表明，支持向量机表现最稳定且未出现明显过拟合或欠拟合，随机森林存在严重过拟合，LASSO 的预测精度较低；特征重要性分析用于识别关键地球化学驱动因子。

articles.title: Neuromorphic control of a simulated shape-memory-alloy-driven multi-legged robot using a spiking neural network
articles.title_zh: 利用脉冲神经网络对形状记忆合金驱动的仿真多足机器人进行神经形态控制
articles.abstract: We propose a spiking-neural-network (SNN)-based deep reinforcement learning (DRL) method for efficient autonomous locomotion control of a starfish-inspired multi-legged soft robot driven by shape memory alloy (SMA) actuators. Conventional soft-robot controllers have predominantly relied on open-loop, pre-designed periodic signals; however, manually designing and tuning coordinated motion in systems with many degrees of freedom and strong nonlinearities remains difficult. Here, we train an SNN controller for SMAs, whose nonlinear contractile responses resemble key aspects of biological muscle. Specifically, we propose a Spiking Actor Network (SAN), in which the actor network of Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3), an algorithm well suited to continuous action spaces, is replaced by an SNN. To account for the membrane potential, an internal state of SNNs, we extend the replay buffer to store and reuse membrane-potential information during training. To improve inference-time energy efficiency, we also add a regularization term that minimizes the squared membrane potentials, thereby encouraging action generation with fewer spike firings. In physics-simulation experiments on autonomous locomotion, the proposed method enabled the agent to acquire the leg coordination required to move toward a target. Analysis of the output spike trains showed that the learned firing patterns developed periodicity matched to the physical characteristics of the SMA, forming a coordinated gait that generated continuous propulsion while avoiding excessive firing. These results demonstrate the potential of autonomous neuromorphic control for energy-efficient soft-robot locomotion.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种基于脉冲神经网络的深度强化学习方法，用于控制由形状记忆合金驱动、受海星启发的多足软体机器人实现自主运动。作者将 TD3 算法中的 actor 网络替换为脉冲 Actor 网络，并扩展经验回放缓冲区以保存膜电位等内部状态信息。为提高推理阶段能效，研究还加入膜电位平方正则项以减少脉冲发放，从而在物理仿真中探索高效的软体机器人闭环控制。

articles.title: Design, Synthesis, and Comparative Electrochemical Analysis of Two- Dimensional Materials for Metallic Ion Battery Applications
articles.title_zh: 面向金属离子电池应用的二维材料设计、合成与比较电化学分析
articles.abstract: Due to their abundance of resources and affordability, metallic ion batteries such as lithium-ion, sodium-ion, potassium-ion, and magnesium-ion batteries are promising substitutes for traditional lithium-based energy storage systems. The creation of high-performance anode materials is still a significant obstacle, though. The design, synthesis, characterization, and comparative electrochemical analysis of three new two-dimensional (2D) materials graphdiyne (GDY), MXene (Ti₃C₂Tₓ), and phosphorene as anode materials for metallic ion battery applications are presented in this work. Scalable chemical processes were used to create the materials, and X-ray diffraction (XRD), Raman spectroscopy, scanning and transmission electron microscopy (SEM/TEM), and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) were used to systematically characterize them. Electrochemical measurement, impedance spectroscopy, galvanostatic charge-discharge, and cyclic voltammetry were used to assess electrochemical performance. Because of their metallic conductivity and surface functionalization, MXene-based electrodes outperform other materials in terms of reversible capacity, rate capability, and cycling stability. In contrast, GDY and phosphorene show high theoretical capacity and quick ion diffusion kinetics. For next-generation metallic ion batteries, this study offers important insights into the relationships between the structure, properties, and performance of 2D materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究石墨炔、MXene（Ti3C2Tx）和磷烯三种二维材料作为金属离子电池负极材料的设计、合成、表征与电化学性能。作者利用 XRD、拉曼光谱、SEM/TEM 和 XPS 等手段进行结构与成分表征，并通过循环伏安、恒电流充放电和阻抗谱评估电化学表现。结果显示，MXene 电极因金属导电性和表面功能化在可逆容量、倍率性能和循环稳定性方面表现突出，为多类金属离子电池负极设计提供参考。

articles.title: Three-dimensional deep electrical resistivity structure beneath the Kii Peninsula, southwestern Japan: fluids and their contribution to seismic activities
articles.title_zh: 日本西南部纪伊半岛下方三维深部电阻率结构：流体及其对地震活动的贡献
articles.abstract: The Kii Peninsula in the forearc region of southwestern Japan has distinct structural and tectonic features due to the subduction of the Philippine Sea (PHS) slab. Diverse seismic activities, including deep low-frequency earthquake (DLFE), slab boundary earthquakes, and seismic swarms, have been observed beneath the Peninsula. These seismic activities may have been caused by fluids dehydrated from the subducting PHS slab. Because subsurface fluids are thought to play an important role in seismic activities, understanding the distribution of deep fluids is essential to elucidate the earthquake generation mechanism. Therefore, we estimated the deep 3-D electrical resistivity structure beneath the Kii Peninsula, using the Network-MT method, to investigate the fluid supply system and distribution and its relationship with seismic activities. The obtained 3-D resistivity structure contains highly resistive zones that are widely distributed at depths shallower than 20 km in the eastern part of the Kii Peninsula. The highly resistive zones reach depths of approximately 30–40 km in their deepest portions and spatially correlate well with high seismic velocity zones and large positive gravity anomalies. This correspondence suggests that the highly resistive zones are the Kumano and Ohmine Plutons, consisting of acidic rock bodies. Most DLFEs occur in the area where the Kumano and Ohmine plutons extend down to the top of the PHS slab, implying that those plutons act as an impermeable barrier and impede the upward migration of fluids supplied from the PHS slab. The accumulation of slab-derived fluids beneath the plutons may generate elevated pore-fluid pressure, which in turn facilitates the occurrence of DLFEs. In contrast, hypocentres of microearthquakes are concentrated around the conductive areas surrounding the resistive plutons, implying that fluids migrating along the margins of the plutons contribute to the micro seismicity. Those findings indicate that the local lithological characteristics of the upper plate, i.e., impermeable plutons, in the vicinity of the plate boundary may govern deep fluid transport and influence diverse seismic activities.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用 Network-MT 方法反演纪伊半岛下方的三维深部电阻率结构，以探讨菲律宾海板块俯冲释放流体的分布及其与地震活动的关系。结果显示，纪伊半岛东部 20 km 以浅广泛存在高电阻率区，局部可延伸至约 30–40 km 深度，并与高地震波速区和正重力异常具有空间对应关系。研究旨在通过深部流体供给系统的成像，解释深低频地震、板块边界地震和地震群等多样化地震活动的成因。

articles.title: Physics-Informed Machine Learning for Radiation-Free Water Liquid Ratio Estimation Using Coriolis Flow Measurements
articles.title_zh: 基于科里奥利流量测量的无辐射含水液相比估计的物理信息机器学习方法
articles.abstract: Accurately determining pure liquid density in three-phase (oil–water–gas) flow systems remains a major challenge in oil and gas production. Conventional methods, such as dual gamma meters, provide reliable measurements but are costly, require regulatory compliance, and involve radiation risks. This study proposes a physics-informed machine learning framework that estimates pure liquid density by first predicting the Water Liquid Ratio (WLR) using only Coriolis mass flow meter measurements and laboratory-derived phase densities, eliminating the need for radiation-based instrumentation. A key contribution is the Harmonic Mixture Density Mean Factor (HMDMF), a dimensionless gas-sensitive index that captures the deviation between arithmetic mixture density and harmonic mean density, enabling detection of gas-dominated flow behaviour without direct gas measurement. The dataset consists of 735,034 records collected from three Low-Performance Tester units across 26 oil wells in Oman between January and August 2025. Five machine learning models were evaluated with and without HMDMF. Without HMDMF, performance was poor (R² ≤ 0.194). Incorporating HMDMF improved all models substantially (ΔR² = +0.70 to +0.79). The best model, Random Forest, achieved R² = 0.8943 and RMSE = 0.0854 on test data. Results demonstrate that HMDMF is the primary driver of predictive accuracy, providing a cost-effective, radiation-free alternative for well-test measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种物理信息机器学习框架，利用科里奥利质量流量计测量和实验室相密度估计油—水—气三相流中的含水液相比，从而避免依赖双伽马仪等辐射测量设备。作者提出无量纲的谐和混合密度均值因子 HMDMF，用于表征算术混合密度与谐均密度之间的偏差，并识别气体主导流动行为。基于阿曼 26 口油井 735,034 条记录的评估表明，加入 HMDMF 后多种机器学习模型性能显著提升，而未加入该因子时预测效果较差。

articles.title: Layer Wise IndoBERT Representation Evolution for Indonesian Misinformation Detection
articles.title_zh: 用于印度尼西亚语虚假信息检测的 IndoBERT 分层表示演化研究
articles.abstract: Given the rapid and widespread spread of misinformation on internet, automated hoax detection has become a critical task. For low-resource languages such as Bahasa Indonesia, misinformation often relies on subtle semantic shifts and contextual manipulation, making it particularly difficult to detect using surface-level lexical cues alone. This challenge is further compounded by the limited availability of large, high-quality annotated datasets and linguistic resources, which constrain the development of robust and generalizable detection models. Although transformer-based models—most notably IndoBERT—have demonstrated strong performance in Bahasa Indonesia fake news detection, existing studies largely treat these models as black boxes, offering limited insight into how hoax-related signals are encoded across layers. In this paper, we conduct a systematic layer-wise investigation of fine-tuned IndoBERT models for hoax news detection in Bahasa Indonesia by employing similarity-based analysis to understand how task-relevant features emerge and evolve throughout the network. Through a comprehensive analysis of hidden states, [CLS]-based representations, and mean-pooled representations, we identify a consistent three-phase pattern of representational evolution: early-layer stability, middle-layer transformation, and upper-layer convergence. The results show that the most substantial representational changes occur in the intermediate layers, suggesting that critical task-related features are progressively formed during this stage and subsequently consolidated in higher layers. Furthermore, we observe a clear functional distinction between [CLS] representations, which exhibit sharper task-oriented specialisation, and mean-pooled representations, which retain smoother distributed semantic continuity. Our results reveal a clear and consistent representational pattern in which early layers primarily capture surface-level lexical information, middle layers perform the most substantial semantic restructuring, and upper layers progressively converge toward task-aligned representations. Across all IndoBERT variants, the most significant representational transformations occur in the middle-to-upper layers, suggesting that hoax-related features emerge and are progressively refined at these depths. We further observe that [CLS]-based representations become increasingly specialised for classification-oriented summarisation, whereas mean-pooled embeddings exhibit smoother and more gradual semantic transitions across layers. These findings provide empirical insights into the internal organisation and evolution of IndoBERT representations, revealing how task-relevant features progressively emerge across layers. They further highlight the functional differentiation of transformer layers in low-resource misinformation detection. Beyond performance gains, this analysis points toward the potential development of more efficient, interpretable, and diagnostically grounded transformer-based models for combating misinformation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文针对印度尼西亚语等低资源语言中的网络虚假信息检测问题，研究微调后的 IndoBERT 如何在不同网络层中编码与谣言识别相关的信号。作者采用基于相似性的分析方法，系统考察隐藏状态、[CLS] 表示和均值池化表示在层间的演化，以揭示任务相关特征的形成过程。该研究旨在缓解将 Transformer 模型视为黑箱的问题，并为印度尼西亚语虚假新闻检测模型的可解释性提供依据。

articles.title: Average Quantum Relative Entropy and Transpilation Depth as Indicators of Noise Robustness in Quantum Binary Classification
articles.title_zh: 平均量子相对熵与转译深度作为量子二分类噪声鲁棒性指标
articles.abstract: Quantum machine learning models trained under ideal (noiseless) conditions often exhibit significant performance degradation when executed on noisy quantum systems. Ideal simulation accuracy or circuit depth alone does not explain why classifiers with similar structures can show markedly different robustness. A practical question is therefore what factors can explain this difference in accuracy, and whether it can be anticipated and classically verified before costly hardware execution. We propose combining the average quantum relative entropy between classes and backend-specific transpilation depth as a practical pre-hardware indicator of the discrepancy in accuracy between ideal and noisy execution in Quantum Parameterized Binary Classification(QPBC) models. Average quantum relative entropy captures the distinguishability of learned class states, while transpilation depth serves as a practical indicator for cumulative noise exposure following compilation. Building on distinguishability and the contraction of quantum relative entropy under noisy channels, we theoretically derived indicators for both noisy-execution accuracy and simulation-to-device accuracy loss. We support this analysis with controlled experiments across multiple QPBC architectures, ansatz families, encoding methods, measurement strategies, datasets, and noisy backends. Our results show that classifiers with similar ideal accuracy and comparable transpilation depth can nonetheless exhibit substantially different degradation under noise. In contrast, the combined behavior of transpilation depth and average quantum relative entropy provides a more consistent interpretation of these robustness differences than either quantity alone. These findings support a practical pre-hardware assessment approach for screening trained quantum classifiers according to expected noisy-execution robustness.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注量子机器学习模型在无噪声条件下训练后部署到有噪声量子设备时性能下降的问题。作者提出结合类别间平均量子相对熵和特定后端的线路转译深度，作为量子参数化二分类模型在硬件执行前评估噪声鲁棒性和精度损失的实用指标。平均量子相对熵用于刻画学习到的类别态可区分性，转译深度则反映编译后的累积噪声暴露；理论推导和实验分析共同支持这些指标对噪声执行精度的预测作用。

articles.title: A Queryable Knowledge Graph of MITRE ATLAS: Cross-Linking Adversarial AI Taxonomies for Grounded Threat Reasoning
articles.title_zh: MITRE ATLAS 的可查询知识图谱：交叉链接对抗性人工智能分类体系以支持有依据的威胁推理
articles.abstract: MITRE ATLAS catalogues how adversaries attack AI systems, but it ships as static documen- tation rather than something queryable, and existing solution that organizes this space, from adversarial-ML surveys to ATLAS-shaped taxonomies of prior incidents, stops at the level of the written paper rather than producing an artifact a practitioner can interrogate directly. We address this gap by modelling MITRE ATLAS as a property graph in Neo4j, cross-linked to the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications (2025), and exposed through an interactive application with an LLM-backed reasoning engine that grounds its answers in the graph itself rather than in free-text recall. We present the schema design, a set of analytical queries spanning mitigation prioritisation, coverage-gap analysis, and cross-taxonomy enrichment, and three extensions built on the graph: a grounded reasoning engine, automated threat-assessment report drafting, and OWASP-to-ATLAS cross-referencing. Our coverage-gap analysis surfaces 40 generative-AI- targeting techniques with no documented mitigation, and our cross-source traversal shows that OWASP’s risk categories and ATLAS’s tactics are largely orthogonal classification axes rather than restatements of one another. We close by situating these results against the surrounding literature on knowledge-graph construction, AI threat modelling, and computational compli ance for AI regulation, and outline a concrete path toward closing the remaining gap between structured technical taxonomies and machine-checkable regulatory obligations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作将 MITRE ATLAS 从静态文档建模为 Neo4j 属性图谱，并与 2025 年 OWASP 大语言模型应用十大风险进行交叉链接。作者设计了图谱模式和一系列分析查询，支持缓解措施优先级排序、覆盖缺口分析和跨分类体系信息增强，并构建了基于图谱扎根的 LLM 推理应用。分析发现 40 项面向生成式 AI 的攻击技术缺乏记录在案的缓解措施，同时表明 OWASP 风险类别与 ATLAS 战术在分类维度上具有较强互补性。

articles.title: Tailoring Pure Valley-Zeeman Spin-Orbit Coupling in WSe₂-Encapsulated Monolayer Graphene
articles.title_zh: 在 WSe2 封装的单层石墨烯中调控纯谷-塞曼自旋轨道耦合
articles.abstract: Author(s): Yaqing Han, Siqi Jiang, Jingkuan Xiao, Jiawei Jiang, Yulu Liu, Jiabei Huang, Yu Du, Di Zhang, Fuzhuo Lian, Wanting Xu, Siqin Wang, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Xiaoxiang Xi, Alexander S. Mayorov, Renjun Du, Kai Chang, Hongxin Yang, Lei Wang, and Geliang Yu Clearly resolved Landau levels reveal a symmetry-enforced Landau-level reordering driven by competition between fixed valley–Zeeman splitting and magnetic-field-dependent cyclotron energy. [Phys. Rev. Lett. 137, 027001] Published Wed Jul 08, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究围绕 WSe2 封装单层石墨烯中的谷-塞曼型自旋轨道耦合展开，利用清晰分辨的朗道能级研究其磁场响应。摘要信息表明，体系中固定的谷-塞曼劈裂与随磁场变化的回旋能之间的竞争，会导致由对称性约束的朗道能级重排。具体实验细节和完整结论需结合原文进一步查阅。
authors: Yaqing Han, Siqi Jiang, Jingkuan Xiao, Jiawei Jiang, Yulu Liu, Jiabei Huang, Yu Du, Di Zhang, Fuzhuo Lian, Wanting Xu, Siqin Wang, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Xiaoxiang Xi, Alexander S. Mayorov, Renjun Du, Kai Chang, Hongxin Yang, Lei Wang, and Geliang Yu

articles.title: Reinforcement learning control of quantum error correction
articles.title_zh: 量子纠错的强化学习控制
articles.abstract: Nature, Published online: 08 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10759-2 By integrating reinforcement learning with quantum error correction, a quantum computer continuously self-calibrates during computation, achieving record logical error rates and enhanced resilience to drift.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将强化学习与量子纠错相结合，使量子计算机能够在计算过程中持续进行自校准。结果显示，这种方法可降低逻辑错误率，并增强系统对参数漂移等不稳定因素的鲁棒性。该工作为更可靠的容错量子计算控制策略提供了新路径。

articles.title: Body surface potential mapping of the cortico-muscular axis using smart textile electrode arrays
articles.title_zh: 利用智能纺织电极阵列进行皮层—肌肉轴体表电位映射
articles.abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 08 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75134-1 Cutaneous electrophysiology is limited by spatial resolution and wearability constraints. Here, the authors develop a hybrid e-textile electrode array enabling simultaneous cortico-muscular mapping, improving signal quality and decoding of sensory and motor activity for wearable brain-body interfaces
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对皮肤电生理测量中空间分辨率和可穿戴性受限的问题，开发了一种混合电子纺织电极阵列。该阵列可同时进行皮层与肌肉活动映射，提高信号质量，并改善对感觉和运动活动的解码能力。该成果有助于推动可穿戴脑—体接口的发展。

articles.title: Free-fermion measurement-induced volume- to area-law entanglement transition in the presence of fermion interactions
articles.title_zh: 存在费米子相互作用时自由费米子测量诱导的体积律到面积律纠缠转变
articles.abstract: Author(s): Matthew S. Foster, Haoyu Guo, Chao-Ming Jian, and Andreas W. W. Ludwig In quantum many-body systems, chaotic dynamics that explore all configurations can give way to a localized phase, frozen into a small corner of possibilities. These phases are distinguished by the extensivity of entanglement. Here, the authors argue that the entanglement transition driven by measurements in a broad class of interacting quantum circuits can be described by f r e e f e r m i o n s , and they develop a controlled description of the transition via non-Abelian bosonization. The results are also relevant to decodability transitions in certain surface codes with coherent errors. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 024306] Published Wed Jul 08, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨了相互作用量子线路中由测量驱动的纠缠相变，指出一大类体系的转变可由自由费米子理论描述。作者利用非阿贝尔玻色化建立了对该相变的受控理论刻画。该结果还与含相干误差的某些表面码中的可解码性转变相关。
authors: Matthew S. Foster, Haoyu Guo, Chao-Ming Jian, and Andreas W. W. Ludwig

articles.title: Integrability from a single conservation law in quantum spin chains
articles.title_zh: 量子自旋链中由单个守恒律导出的可积性
articles.abstract: Author(s): Akihiro Hokkyo Here, the author proves that, for translationally invariant spin chains with finite-range interactions, a single third-order conservation law is enough to guarantee infinitely many commuting local conserved quantities. This result turns the Reshetikhin condition from a widely used heuristic into a rigorous sufficient criterion for quantum integrability and helps clarify the divide between integrable and nonintegrable many-body systems. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 055108] Published Wed Jul 08, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文证明，对于具有平移不变性和有限程相互作用的自旋链，一个三阶局域守恒律足以保证存在无穷多个彼此对易的局域守恒量。这一结果将Reshetikhin条件从常用的启发式判据提升为量子可积性的严格充分条件。该研究有助于澄清可积与非可积多体系统之间的界限。

articles.title: Exact quench dynamics from thermal pure quantum states
articles.title_zh: 来自热纯量子态的精确淬火动力学
articles.abstract: Author(s): Hui-Huang Chen Here, the authors present an exact solution for the entanglement dynamics following a quench from a thermal pure quantum state in a free-fermion system. The entanglement entropy exhibits a distinctive double-plateau structure, rather than the usual linear growth and saturation. The result is established through conformal field theory, exact lattice simulations, and a quasiparticle picture. [Phys. Rev. B 114, L020302] Published Wed Jul 08, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究给出了自由费米子系统中从热纯量子态出发淬火后的纠缠动力学精确解。结果显示，纠缠熵并非通常的线性增长后饱和，而是呈现独特的双平台结构。作者通过共形场论、精确晶格模拟和准粒子图像共同支持了这一结论。

articles.title: Super-conductivity in twisted trilayer graphene linked to electronic compressibility oscillations
articles.title_zh: 扭转三层石墨烯中的超导性与电子压缩率振荡相关
articles.abstract: Nature Nanotechnology, Published online: 08 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41565-026-02176-3 Understanding how different signatures of strong interactions relate to one another has been a long-standing challenge. Now, a technique that combines local thermodynamic measurements with transport measurements in a single twisted trilayer graphene device reveals that superconductivity coincides with characteristic oscillations in the electronic compressibility but remains independent of the correlated insulating phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注强相互作用体系中不同实验特征之间的关联，尤其是扭转三层石墨烯中的超导性。通过在同一器件中结合局域热力学测量和输运测量，研究发现超导性与电子压缩率的特征性振荡同时出现。报道还指出，这种超导性与相关绝缘相并不直接绑定。

articles.title: External quantum efficiency above 100% in photovoltaic cells due to the technique raising efficiencies for all kinds of solar cells
articles.title_zh: V形组件技术导致光伏电池外量子效率超过100%
articles.abstract: arXiv:2409.20066v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A V-shaped module (VSM) photovoltaic technique, which breaks traditional concepts, has been proven by European and American scientists to enable power-conversion-efficiency to increase by 50% for thin-film solar cells. Furthermore, the VSM technique raises power-conversion-efficiency for all kinds of solar cells (J. Environ. Sci. Eng. A 12, 214 (2023). https://doi.org/10.17265/2162-5298/2023.06.002). Mysterious dark energy is thought to result in the surprising VSM effect. The VSM approach opens up new avenues to study photovoltaic physics. In this study, the external quantum efficiency (EQE) of commercial polycrystalline silicon solar cells in the VSM was investigated, which exhibits a surprising phenomenon of EQE above 100%. In theory, non-infrared light incident into a solar cell can cause infrared emission. The VSM could trap the emitted infrared photons and lead to extra photoexcited carriers. The easy-to-reproduce VSM effect is thus explainable. The energy of emitted infrared photons is considered as the so-called dark energy. This study provides new clues and evidences to unravel the mystery of the surprising VSM effect. The VSM technique could also be used to develop photodetectors for infrared and ultraviolet light respectively.
articles.abstract_zh: 该预印本研究了V形组件光伏技术对商用多晶硅太阳能电池外量子效率的影响，并报告了外量子效率超过100%的现象。作者提出，入射非红外光可能诱导红外发射，而V形结构可俘获这些红外光子并产生额外光生载流子。文中将该效应与所谓“暗能量”联系起来，但相关解释和物理机制仍需独立验证和谨慎评估。

articles.title: Wildfire hazard in afforested Mediterranean landscapes
articles.title_zh: 造林地中地中海景观的野火危险性
articles.abstract: Extreme wildfire events, exacerbated by socioeconomic and climate change, underscore the need for proactive landscape management. However, information on fuel loads and the role of cultural dry-stone walls in afforested Mediterranean fire-prone landscapes remains limited. We evaluated how fire and land use legacies influence potential fire behavior and spread. We measured surface and canopy fuel loads and simulated fire behavior under varying wind speeds across contrasting fire histories and management types (terraced and non-terraced). Wildfire spread was modeled using an ellipse-based approach that incorporated terrain ruggedness to represent the firebreak potential of dry-stone walls. Surface fuel loads were primarily controlled by fire history: recurrent fires favored shrub-dominated vegetation, whereas longer fire-free intervals promoted the accumulation of heavy canopy and forest-floor fuels, leading to a higher potential fire hazard. Simulations showed that dry-stone walls reduced burned area by 4.5–37.5%, depending on wind conditions and time since ignition, demonstrating their capacity to disrupt fire propagation and reduce landscape-scale fire connectivity. By explicitly integrating cultural dry-stone walls into wildfire spread modeling, this study provides a novel framework for assessing the influence of micro-topographic ruggedness on fire dynamics. Our findings highlight terraced landscapes as valuable opportunities for targeted fuel management and wildfire mitigation in Mediterranean regions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究评估了地中海易燃造林景观中火灾历史、土地利用遗留效应以及干砌石墙对潜在火行为和蔓延的影响。作者测量了地表和树冠燃料负荷，并在不同风速条件下模拟火势传播。结果表明，火灾历史显著影响燃料积累，干砌石墙可在一定程度上阻断火势传播并降低景观尺度的火连通性。

articles.title: Impact of Extraction Time on Caffeine Content, Antioxidant, and Antidiabetic Properties of Guatemalan and Honduran Coffees: An In Vitro and Computational Study
articles.title_zh: 萃取时间对危地马拉和洪都拉斯咖啡中咖啡因含量、抗氧化及抗糖尿病特性的影响：体外与计算研究
articles.abstract: Metabolic disorders such as Type 2 Diabetes (T2D) represent a significant global health burden. Coffee, a widely consumed beverage rich in bioactive compounds, has demonstrated potential antidiabetic and antioxidant properties, which are influenced by processing methods, particularly extraction time. This study systematically evaluated the impact of prolonged aqueous extraction (24, 48, and 72 hours) on the bioactive profile, antioxidant capacity, and antidiabetic potential of roasted coffee beans from Guatemala and Honduras. In vitro analyses revealed that an extended extraction time (72 h) significantly increased the yield of total phenolic and flavonoid content, correlating with enhanced antioxidant activity in DPPH, FRAP, and Nitric Oxide (NO) scavenging assays. Concurrently, the 72-hour extracts exhibited the most potent inhibition of the key carbohydrate-digesting enzymes α-amylase and α-glucosidase. Gas Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry (GC-MS) confirmed a progressive increase in caffeine abundance and chemical complexity with longer extraction. Computational studies, including molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations (up to 100 ns), substantiated these findings. Caffeine demonstrated strong binding affinities to both enzymes and formed stable complexes, as evidenced by favorable MM-GBSA binding free energies and stable molecular dynamics trajectories (low RMSD/RMSF, consistent SASA and RoG). This integrated study provides the first evidence that prolonged extraction time optimizes the release of caffeine, polyphenolic, and flavonoid contents, thereby maximizing the in vitro antioxidant and antidiabetic properties of South American coffees. These findings highlight the critical role of extraction time in modulating coffee's functional benefits, suggesting that optimized brewing protocols could enhance its role as a dietary adjunct for managing metabolic health.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究系统评估了24、48和72小时水提取对危地马拉与洪都拉斯烘焙咖啡豆生物活性成分、抗氧化能力和潜在抗糖尿病活性的影响。体外结果显示，较长萃取时间提高了总酚、总黄酮和咖啡因等成分水平，并增强了抗氧化及α-淀粉酶、α-葡萄糖苷酶抑制活性。分子对接和分子动力学模拟进一步支持了这些活性成分与相关靶标相互作用的可能性。

articles.title: Enhancing Paper Extensibility through Low-Consistency Refining and Controlled Drying
articles.title_zh: 通过低浓打浆与受控干燥提升纸张延展性
articles.abstract: The growing demand for sustainable packaging has driven research into paper as a renewable and biodegradable alternative to plastics. This study demonstrates that paper extensibility can be substantially enhanced through the synergic interaction between low-consistency refining and unrestrained drying. While refining induces fibrillation and fibre swelling increased fibre conformability and shrinkage potential, the applied drying conditions governed the development of strain capacity within the fibre network. By coupling these processes, elongation values up to 21.1 % were achieved without critical loss of tensile strength, partially overcoming the conventional strength-extensibility trade-off typically observed in paper materials. Multi-scale characterization combining water retention value, zeta potential, microscopy, limiting viscosity number, Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy, and mechanical testing revealed that extensibility development is associated not only with fibre surface fibrillation, but also with subtle modifications in cellulose supramolecular organization and enhanced network rearrangement during drying. The findings provide new insights into process driven tailoring of stretchable fibre-based materials for sustainable packaging applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向可持续包装需求，探讨以纸张替代塑料时如何提高其延展性。结果表明，低浓打浆引发纤维原纤化、溶胀和更高的纤维顺应性，而非约束干燥促进纤维网络形成更大的应变能力，两者协同可在不严重牺牲抗张强度的情况下实现较高伸长率。多尺度表征显示，延展性提升不仅与纤维表面原纤化有关，也与纤维素超分子结构的细微变化及干燥过程中的网络重排增强有关。

articles.title: Long-theorized electron-on-helium qubit achieves strong coupling to a single microwave photon
articles.title_zh: 长期理论预言的液氦表面电子量子比特实现与单个微波光子的强耦合
articles.abstract: Quantum computers, devices that store and process information leveraging the principles of quantum mechanics, have been found to be promising for tackling some problems that cannot be solved by classical computers. Quantum computers store data in the form of qubits (i.e., quantum bits), units of information that can exist in combinations of different states, instead of being limited to a binary value (i.e., 0 or 1), like classical bits.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道介绍了一种基于液氦表面电子的量子比特平台，其实现了与单个微波光子的强耦合。量子比特能够以量子叠加态存储信息，是量子计算处理特定经典难题的核心单元。该进展表明这一长期被理论研究的体系在量子信息硬件中具有进一步探索价值。

articles.title: Quantum vacuum could help break molecular bonds with less energy, simulations suggest

articles.abstract: A team of researchers led by Felipe Herrera, a professor at the University of Santiago and a researcher at the Millennium Institute for Research in Optics (MIRO), has identified a quantum phenomenon that enables chemical bonds to be broken using significantly less energy than is normally required.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道了一种量子现象，可能使化学键在显著低于通常所需能量的条件下被断裂。研究由圣地亚哥大学及千禧光学研究所相关团队开展，主要基于模拟分析量子真空对分子键断裂过程的影响。该结果为通过量子光学环境调控化学反应提供了新的理论线索。

articles.title: Using quantum entanglement to secure ground-to-satellite timing
articles.title_zh: 利用量子纠缠保障地面—卫星授时安全
articles.abstract: From mobile phones and banking systems to aircraft, ships and emergency services, much of modern life relies on precise timing signals from satellites. Known as the Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS), satellites carrying atomic clocks transmit time-stamped signals to receivers on Earth. The Global Positioning System (GPS) is the best-known GNSS in Australia and the United States, but it is only one of several systems used globally.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道围绕卫星精密授时系统的安全性展开，重点关注如何利用量子纠缠增强地面与卫星之间时间同步的可靠性。现代通信、金融、航空、航海和应急服务高度依赖全球导航卫星系统提供的原子钟时间信号。该工作表明，量子技术可能为防止授时信号受干扰或欺骗提供新的安全机制。

articles.title: Ultra-compact sensor paves the way for more powerful and scalable silicon quantum processors

The study has been published in the journal Nature Sensors.
