articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出MatSKRAFT框架，用于从材料科学文献中的半结构化表格自动提取并整合知识。其方法将表格转化为图表示，并采用约束驱动的图神经网络，将科学原则嵌入模型结构；在性质提取和成分提取任务上优于多种前沿大语言模型，同时处理速度更快且硬件需求较低。作者将该框架应用于超过4.55万篇论文中的66267张表格，构建了包含50余万条记录的大型数据库，扩展了现有材料数据库的覆盖范围。

articles.title: Metastable excited states of iodide–alkyl halide cluster anions: Insights from photodetachment spectroscopy and non-Hermitian quantum chemistry

articles.abstract: We present experimental and theoretical results for photodetachment from a series of iodide–ethyl halide cluster anions, I − ·C 2 H 5 X (X = Cl, Br, I). We also analyze previously reported results for the iodide–methyl halide series I − ·CH 3 X, as comparisons between the two series are instructive. The photoelectron angular distributions for detachment from I − ·C 2 H 5 Cl, I − ·C 2 H 5 Br, and I − ·CH 3 Cl are remarkably similar to detachment from unclustered iodide, while those of I − ·C 2 H 5 I, I − ·CH 3 Br, and I − ·CH 3 I are clearly different, suggesting that autodetachment mediated by excited anion states competes with direct detachment. In addition, the I − ·C 2 H 5 I and I − ·CH 3 I cluster anions reveal a fragmentation pathway that is clearly inconsistent with direct detachment. By means of equation-of-motion coupled-cluster theory combined with a complex absorbing potential, we identify metastable excited anion states in the detachment continuum whose positions explain why the photoelectron angular distributions of only some of the cluster anions are influenced by autodetachment. However, these resonances do not evolve into bound anion states and, therefore, do not mediate photofragmentation. Rather, our calculations reveal for each cluster a second anion state that is related to virtual states in electron–molecule scattering. For such states, the Born–Oppenheimer approximation breaks down, resulting in a characteristic shape of the adiabatic potential energy surface and finite probability for decay into the detachment continuum even in regions where the anion state is below the neutral state.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文结合实验和理论研究了一系列碘离子—乙基卤化物簇阴离子 I−·C2H5X（X = Cl、Br、I）的光脱附过程，并与已报道的碘离子—甲基卤化物体系进行比较。部分簇阴离子的光电子角分布与游离碘离子相似，而另一些则明显不同，表明由激发阴离子态介导的自脱附会与直接脱附竞争。作者利用含复吸收势的运动方程耦合簇理论识别了脱附连续谱中的亚稳激发阴离子态，并解释了为何只有某些簇的角分布受到自脱附影响。

articles.abstract: Iron hydride with a double hexagonal close-packed structure (dhcp-FeH x ) undergoes a ferromagnetic–paramagnetic transition without changing its crystal structure. Despite its relevance to metal–hydrogen interactions and magnetically driven elasticity, the extensive investigation of this phase is almost limited to room temperature. Here, we performed x-ray diffraction measurements at high pressure and high temperature, identifying the singularity in the temperature–volume relationship as the Curie temperature ( T C ). Pressurization lowered the T C of dhcp-FeH x and produced pronounced volume anomalies, indicating that pressure enhanced magnetoelastic coupling. Density functional theory combined with dynamical mean-field theory (DFT + DMFT) reproduced the spontaneous magnetization and its negative pressure dependence of T C , consistent with our experimental results. This establishes a methodology for determining magnetic transition temperatures and magnetoelastic coupling effects and highlights dhcp-FeH x as a unique model system for providing new insights into itinerant-electron magnetism.

articles.title: Seniority eigenstate configuration interaction
articles.title_zh: 资历本征态构型相互作用方法
articles.abstract: Zero-seniority methods have shown great promise for the description of strongly correlated electronic systems. Other seniority sectors have been much less explored, and in particular, the maximal seniority sector and zero seniority have the same underlying algebraic structure. We introduce a seniority eigenstate configuration interaction in which the wave function is constrained to have good fixed local seniority for each paired orbital, by which we mean we partition orbitals into a pairing set with seniority zero, and a spin set with seniority one. We show how to build the effective Hamiltonian for this ansatz, and demonstrate that high-seniority wave functions have unexpectedly excellent accuracy for strongly correlated fermionic systems, with accuracy competitive with or better than seniority zero for the Hubbard model and for the dissociation of the nitrogen molecule.

articles.title_zh: 用于农药识别的分子印迹聚合物的计算筛选
articles.abstract: Molecularly Imprinted Polymers (MIPs) have emerged as highly selective materials for recognizing specific molecules, offering promising applications in environmental remediation. In this study, a computational approach was employed for the rational design of MIPs supported on heterogeneous catalytic surfaces targeting the selective recognition of pesticide residues, particularly acephate and glyphosate. The computational methodology was validated using Fe₃O₄ (magnetite), showing excellent agreement between theoretical and experimental bond lengths. Thermodynamic cycle calculations were then performed to evaluate the Gibbs free energy (ΔG) of interactions between selected monomers and catalytic surfaces (Fe₃O₄, TiO₂, and Fe₂O₃) in different solvents. TiO₂ exhibited the strongest interactions, especially with acrylic acid (ΔG = − 16.61 kcal/mol in acetonitrile), indicating favorable adsorption and interaction characteristics. Further interaction energy analyses between acephate and glyphosate with various monomers revealed that acrylic acid was the most favorable functional monomer, particularly at a 2:1 monomer-to-template ratio in acetonitrile, due to its more negative ΔG values. These findings highlight TiO₂-supported acrylic acid MIPs as promising candidates for the selective recognition of organophosphate pesticides. Overall, the results provide valuable theoretical insights into the rational design of efficient, selective, and recyclable MIP-based materials for environmental monitoring and water remediation applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用计算方法理性设计负载于异相催化表面的分子印迹聚合物，用于选择性识别乙酰甲胺磷和草甘膦等农药残留。作者以 Fe₃O₄ 模型验证计算方法，并比较 Fe₃O₄、TiO₂ 和 Fe₂O₃ 表面与不同单体在多种溶剂中的相互作用自由能。结果表明 TiO₂ 与单体相互作用较强，丙烯酸在乙腈中尤其有利，并在与目标农药的相互作用分析中表现为较优功能单体。

articles.title: Water Resource Conflict and Management Challenges in Post-Conflict Tribal Agricultural Communities: A Case Study of Waziristan, Pakistan
articles.title_zh: 冲突后部落农业社区中的水资源冲突与管理挑战：巴基斯坦瓦济里斯坦案例研究
articles.abstract: Waziristan, a mountainous and semi arid tribal region of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan, has undergone profound socio political transformation following more than a decade of militancy, military operations, mass displacement, and its 2018 administrative merger with the province. These disruptions have severely affected the region's water resource governance, which historically relied on customary institutions such as jirga based arbitration and traditional irrigation systems including karez (subsurface channels) and rod kohi (hill torrent flood irrigation). This study synthesizes secondary data from government reports, humanitarian and development agency documentation, and available academic literature to examine how conflict and displacement have reshaped water access, infrastructure, and governance in Waziristan's agricultural communities. A thematic analysis identifies recurring conflict typologies—including upstream downstream disputes, infrastructure destruction and rehabilitation gaps, and tension between customary and formal state water management institutions following the FATA merger. Findings indicate that displacement and return cycles disrupted established water sharing norms, weakened traditional dispute resolution mechanisms, and left irrigation infrastructure poorly rehabilitated, exacerbating competition over increasingly scarce water resources. The study further highlights a persistent institutional vacuum between eroded customary governance and incompletely extended state irrigation administration. Based on these findings, the paper proposes a hybrid governance framework that formally integrates customary water sharing practices with state institutional support, alongside prioritized infrastructure rehabilitation, to strengthen agricultural water security and reduce conflict potential in Waziristan's post conflict tribal communities.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究聚焦巴基斯坦开伯尔-普什图省瓦济里斯坦地区，分析长期武装冲突、军事行动、人口迁移及行政并入省级体系后对农业社区水资源治理的影响。作者综合政府报告、人道主义与发展机构文件以及学术文献，识别了上下游用水争端、基础设施破坏与修复不足、习惯治理与正式国家制度之间的张力等主题。研究指出，流离失所与返乡过程扰乱了传统分水机制和灌溉体系，凸显冲突后地区水治理重建的复杂性。

articles.title: Spacetime Emergence from Flux-Tube Connectivity: A Flux-First Framework, Renormalization-Group Analysis, String-Theoretic Embedding, and First Numerical Tests
articles.title_zh: 由通量管连通性涌现时空：通量优先框架、重整化群分析、弦论嵌入与初步数值检验
articles.abstract: We propose and develop an effective statistical field theory in which classical spacetime geometry, its gravitational dynamics, and several of its quantum gravitational phenomena emerge from the coarse-grained connectivity of a confining flux-tube network. The microscopic substrate is a dynamical graph of integer-valued flux occupation variables defined on the links of a lattice, motivated on one side by the confinement of non-Abelian gauge theories and the area-law behaviour of Wilson loops [1, 14], and on the other side by the Dirac quantization of p-form fluxes in string theory, where integrally quantized flux is already known to create geometry through geometric transitions [20, 21] and to stabilize it through flux compactification [25, 26, 30, 31]. We elevate this to a flux-first principle: quantized flux is taken as the fundamental building block, with both gauge dynamics and geometry derived. We show that the network admits a percolation phase structure—disconnected, critical, and percolated—and that a block-link renormalization-group (RG) transformation flows the system to a nontrivial interacting fixed point at which the lattice scale becomes irrelevant and a scale-invariant scalar connectivity field ρ(x) emerges [12]. Promoting the emergent metric to a conformal functional of ρ and integrating out fast connectivity fluctuations 'a la Sakharov [2], we obtain an induced Einstein–Hilbert action whose Newton constant is fixed by the connectivity stiffness of the network. The two-point function of ρ at the fixed point yields a massless, spin-two propagating mode; higher connectivity cumulants reproduce the cubic and quartic graviton self-interactions, and the diffeomorphism group emerges as the continuum limit of graph-relabelling symmetry. Black-hole entropy is recovered as the logarithm of the number of flux links severed by a minimal connectivity cut, giving an exact area law with 1/4G set by the flux-link density; we show that this construction is the lattice discretization of the Freedman–Headrick bit-thread reformulation of holographic entanglement entropy, so that the Bekenstein–Hawking coefficient [4, 5] follows from the max-flow/min-cut theorem [32, 33], and a Jacobson-type derivation of the Einstein equations from an entanglement first law [3] closes the thermodynamic loop. We construct a toy Antide Sitter bulk metric directly from flux correlators by identifying −log⟨δK δK⟩ with bulk geodesic distance and the RG scale with the holographic radial coordinate [6, 7], and we show that the RG flow equation for the connectivity kernel maps onto a radial Einstein evolution equation. Confinement observables anchor the construction: the Wilson-loop area law [1] fixes the string tension as the mean flux density, and a dilution relation M2 Pl ∼ σ (ρUV/ρIR) reframes the gravity–QCD hierarchy as an RG separation of phases rather than a fine tuning; embedded in a warped flux compactification of Klebanov–Strassler type [22, 23, 25], the same dilution factor is generated exponentially by modest integer flux quanta, ϵ ∼ e−4πK/3gsM, with K/gsM ≃ 21 reproducing the observed hierarchy. Throughout, spacetime foam is identified with the near-critical, fluctuation-dominated regime in which the smooth-geometry and minimal-surface approximations break down. We state the assumptions explicitly, separate postulates from derived results, satisfy the standard low-energy effective-field-theory consistency conditions (positivity [13], causality, IR stability), and report first Monte Carlo tests of the link ensemble that exhibit the predicted connectivity-percolation transition and confirm an area law for the boundary-cut entropy at the R2 ≃ 0.9996 level. We are explicit that this is a framework-and-proposal paper: the central claims are organised as a single internally consistent chain together with its string-theoretic embedding and first numerical checks, not as a first-principles derivation, and Section 15 delineates precisely what has and has not been established.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种有效统计场论，认为经典时空几何、引力动力学及若干量子引力现象可由禁闭通量管网络的粗粒化连通性涌现。模型以晶格链接上的整数通量占据变量构成动力学图，受到非阿贝尔规范理论禁闭、Wilson 环面积律以及弦论中量子化 p-形式通量的启发。作者讨论了网络的渗流相结构，并通过块链接重整化群变换研究非平庸相互作用不动点及尺度无关行为。

articles.title: Altermagnetic spintronics
articles.title_zh: 交替磁性自旋电子学
articles.abstract: Nature Physics, Published online: 06 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03337-w Altermagnetism, a recently identified unconventional magnetic order, might enable fast and efficient spin-based devices. This Review explores its interplay with ferroelectric and superconducting systems and its promise for scalable spintronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 交替磁性是一类新近提出的非常规磁有序态，兼具与反铁磁体相关的无净磁化特征和可用于自旋输运的动量依赖自旋分裂。该综述讨论交替磁性与铁电、超导等体系的耦合关系，并评估其在高速、低功耗、可规模化自旋电子器件中的潜力。

articles.title: Out-of-plane Ruddlesden–Popper ferroelectrics catch a break
articles.title_zh: 面外 Ruddlesden–Popper 铁电体的对称性突破
articles.abstract: Nature Electronics, Published online: 06 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41928-026-01665-6 By breaking the symmetry of a Ruddlesden–Popper ferroelectric material, an out-of-plane dielectric material with high tunability and low loss can be fabricated.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道通过打破 Ruddlesden–Popper 铁电材料的对称性，可制备具有面外介电响应的材料。所得材料表现出高可调性和低损耗特征，可能为可调射频、存储或低功耗电子器件提供新的材料平台。

articles.title: Superconductivity, magnetism, and directional plasmonic modes in two-dimensional penta-bipyramid boron allotropes
articles.title_zh: 二维五角双锥硼同素异形体中的超导性、磁性与方向性等离激元模式

Its structure is characterized by edge-sharing pentagonal bipyramids, with diverse bond lengths. These structural motifs facilitate the formation of unusual seven-center-two-electron π bon… [Phys. Rev. Materials 10, 074001] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究源自正交硼结构单元的二维五角双锥硼同素异形体，关注其独特多中心成键所带来的电子与集体激发性质。文章围绕这些二维硼结构中的超导、磁性以及具有方向依赖性的等离激元模式展开，为探索低维硼材料的多功能物性提供理论依据。
authors: L. Niu, O. J. Conquest, H. Ma, C. Verdi, and C. Stampfl

articles.title: Metallicity and eight-fold magnetic anisotropy of SrRuO₃ under the single-layer limit
articles.title_zh: 单层极限下 SrRuO₃ 的金属性与八重磁各向异性

Previous studies have shown that tunin… [Phys. Rev. Materials 10, 074402] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注二维铁磁金属在单层极限下如何同时保持金属性、强磁性和明确的磁各向异性。作者以 SrRuO₃ 为对象，探讨其在单层尺度下的电子输运与磁各向异性特征，并指出八重磁各向异性对于自旋电子器件设计具有潜在意义。
authors: Zhixiong Deng, Junhua Liu, Chenghe Liu, Qinghua Zhang, Runze Yao, Yulong Wang, Wen Xiao, Zhan Yang, Kai Chen, Yulin Gan, Jiandi Zhang, and Zhaoliang Liao

articles.title: Improving generalization and trainability of quantum eigensolvers via graph neural encoding
articles.title_zh: 通过图神经编码提升量子本征求解器的泛化能力与可训练性
articles.abstract: Determining the ground state of a many-body Hamiltonian is a central problem across physics, chemistry, and combinatorial optimization, yet it is often classically intractable due to the exponential growth of Hilbert space with system size. Even on fault-tolerant quantum computers, quantum algorithms with convergence guarantees—such as quantum phase estimation and quantum subspace methods—require an initial state with sufficiently large overlap with the true ground state to be effective. Variational quantum eigensolvers (VQEs) are natural candidates for preparing such states; however, standard VQEs typically exhibit poor generalization, requiring retraining for each Hamiltonian instance, and often suffer from barren plateaus, where gradients can vanish exponentially with circuit depth and system size. To address these limitations, we propose an end-to-end representation learning framework that combines a graph autoencoder with a classical neural network to generate VQE parameters that generalize across Hamiltonian instances. By encoding interaction topology and coupling structure, the proposed model produces high-overlap initial states without instance-specific optimization. Through extensive numerical experiments on families of one- and two-local Hamiltonians, we demonstrate improved generalization and trainability, manifested as reduced test error and a significantly milder decay of gradient variance. We further show that our method substantially accelerates convergence in quantum subspace-based eigensolvers, highlighting its practical impact for downstream quantum algorithms.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对变分量子本征求解器在不同哈密顿量实例间泛化差、需反复训练以及易出现贫瘠高原的问题，提出结合图自编码器和经典神经网络的端到端表示学习框架。该方法编码相互作用拓扑与耦合结构，直接生成可泛化的 VQE 参数，从而在无需逐实例优化的情况下制备与基态高度重叠的初态。研究旨在提升量子多体基态求解在物理、化学和组合优化中的实用性。
authors: Jungyun Lee and Daniel K Park

articles.title: Rotational Nonlocal Model for Large-Scale Galaxy Rotation Coherence Based on Proposed Nonlocal Coherence Mechanism
articles.title_zh: 基于非局域相干机制的星系大尺度旋转相干非局域模型
articles.abstract: Recent observational studies have reported possible large-scale coherence in galaxy rotations/directions and quasar polarization alignments, then need the reasonable nonlocal gravity theory without assuming rigid rotation. Motivated by recent observational reports, we explore a conceptual framework for long-range nonlocal synchronization based on phase coherence in collective wave phenomena. In previous studies, one of the authors investigated phase-synchronized lattice vibrations associated with optical modes under the wave number 𝑘=0 in fracture-induced shock-wave states. These studies suggested that collective phase coherence may emerge under specific dynamical conditions in extended systems. In the present work, this idea is phenomenologically extended to the rotational nonlocal model to examine whether similar phase-coherent rotational patterns could provide an alternative perspective on observed large-scale rotational coherence in galaxies. The proposed theory does not rely on direct interactions between distant systems, but instead considers the possibility of effective long-range synchronization originating from early-universe dynamical processes. Furthermore, we explore the hypothesis that galaxies exhibiting nonlocal coherent rotational alignment may display systematically enhanced rotational velocities, drawing a phenomenological connection to effects commonly attributed to dark matter in galactic rotation curves. While the model remains speculative and is not intended as a complete astrophysical description, it provides a conceptual basis for discussing large-scale coherence phenomena and suggests potential directions for observational and theoretical investigation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该预印本受星系旋转方向和类星体偏振可能存在大尺度相干性的观测启发，提出一种不依赖刚体旋转假设的现象学非局域旋转模型。作者将集体波动中的相位相干思想推广到宇宙学尺度，探讨早期宇宙动力学过程是否可能诱导有效的长程同步。该模型仍属概念性框架，具体物理机制和观测检验需进一步研究。

articles.title: Preparation and Microwave Absorption Mechanism of Graphene/Zinc Ferrite and Nickel Ferrite Composite Absorbers
articles.title_zh: 石墨烯/锌铁氧体与镍铁氧体复合吸波材料的制备及微波吸收机制
articles.abstract: With the rapid development of electronic devices and communication systems, electromagnetic interference (EMI) and radiation pollution have become critical issues, driving the demand for high-performance microwave absorbers with light weight, broad bandwidth, and strong absorption. In this work, graphene-loaded zinc ferrite (GZ series) and nickel ferrite (GN series) composite absorbers with different mass ratios (1:1, 1:2, and 1:3) were successfully synthesized via a facile hydrothermal method. The effects of ferrite type and graphene/ferrite ratio on the electromagnetic parameters and absorption performance were systematically investigated. Microstructural characterizations by XPS, SEM, and TEM confirmed that both zinc ferrite and nickel ferrite nanoparticles were uniformly anchored onto graphene sheets, forming intimate interfacial contacts, with the zinc ferrite composite showing better dispersion and smaller particle size (~ 40 nm). Electromagnetic analysis revealed that the composites benefit from the synergistic effects of dielectric loss (from graphene and interfacial polarization) and magnetic loss (from ferrite natural and exchange resonances), which effectively balance impedance matching and attenuation capability. Remarkably, the GZ2 sample (graphene:zinc ferrite = 1:2) exhibits an optimal reflection loss of − 28.3 dB at 17.2 GHz with a thickness of 3 mm, along with an effective absorption bandwidth covering the high-frequency region. In contrast, the nickel ferrite counterparts show slightly inferior performance due to larger particle sizes and weaker interfacial bonding. Compared with previously reported graphene/ferrite-based absorbers, the GZ2 composite demonstrates competitive absorption performance, which is attributed to the enhanced interfacial polarization, multiple resonance effects, and defect-induced relaxation. This work provides a systematic comparison between zinc and nickel ferrite in graphene-based composites, offering a rational design strategy for high-performance, tunable electromagnetic wave absorbing materials for potential application in cement-based functional composites.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用水热法制备不同质量配比的石墨烯负载锌铁氧体和镍铁氧体复合吸波材料，并系统考察铁氧体类型及配比对电磁参数和吸波性能的影响。表征结果显示铁氧体纳米颗粒均匀锚定在石墨烯片层上，形成紧密界面接触，其中锌铁氧体复合物表现出较好分散性和较小粒径。其吸波性能主要来自石墨烯和界面极化带来的介电损耗与铁氧体磁损耗之间的协同匹配。

articles.title: Nanoparticle-Enhanced Polymeric Fluid for Sand Control in Unconsolidated Petroleum Wells
articles.title_zh: 用于疏松油井防砂的纳米颗粒增强聚合物流体
articles.abstract: Sand production remains a critical challenge in petroleum engineering, particularly in unconsolidated sandstone reservoirs where reservoir pressure decline disrupts the stress equilibrium around the wellbore. Progressive depletion of reservoir pressure increases effective overburden stress, frequently inducing formation failure and mobilization of sand grains. Conventional mechanical sand-control methods, such as gravel packing and screens, are widely used but are costly, operationally complex, and less adaptable under harsh downhole conditions. Consequently, chemical consolidation using polymeric resins has attracted increasing attention as a more economical and technically flexible alternative. This study evaluates the performance of a furan-based polymer system for chemical consolidation of sandstone formations. At an optimized formulation of 20% CF and 18% CLA, the polymer demonstrated strong bonding capability, providing effective grain-to-grain adhesion while maintaining compatibility with reservoir brines, preserving initial rock wettability, and resisting thermal degradation. To further enhance consolidation efficiency, SiO₂ nanoparticles were incorporated into the chemical at concentrations ranging from 0.25 to 1.0 wt%. Experimental core tests revealed that nanoparticle inclusion significantly increased unconfined compressive strength, achieving values up to 2130 psi, while retaining as much as 81% of initial permeability. In addition, thermal stability was markedly improved, with high-temperature weight loss at 500°C reduced from ~ 50% to ~ 30%. Scanning electron microscopy confirmed enhanced polymer adhesion to sand particle surfaces. These findings demonstrate that nanoparticle-modified furan polymers represent a technically robust and field-viable alternative for chemical sand consolidation, with the potential to improve wellbore stability and reduce operational costs in unconsolidated petroleum reservoirs.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向疏松砂岩油藏中的出砂问题，评估呋喃基聚合物体系作为化学固结剂的性能。优化配方能够在保持与地层水相容性、维持初始润湿性和抗热降解的同时，实现砂粒间有效胶结。进一步引入 SiO₂ 纳米颗粒旨在增强固结效率，为复杂井下条件下的低成本防砂提供替代方案。

articles.title: Engineering direct nonlinear coupling between microwave photons
articles.title_zh: 微波光子间直接非线性耦合的工程实现
articles.abstract: The rich dynamics and large Hilbert space of quantum harmonic oscillators make them natural candidates for hardware-efficient and error-correctable quantum information processing. However, implementing direct entangling operations between oscillators remains an outstanding challenge. Existing strategies typically rely on parametrically activating interactions that necessarily populate the excited states of a nonlinear coupler, introducing additional dissipation channels and potential leakage outside the encoded manifold. Here, we present a fundamentally different approach to generate nonlinear coupling between bosonic modes: a Raman-assisted cross-Kerr interaction between microwave photons hosted in two superconducting cavities, which does not populate the mediating coupler. Crucially, this dynamics preserves the bosonic code space throughout, which is essential for fault-tolerant bosonic quantum computation. We demonstrate that the engineered cross-Kerr can be used to directly implement controlled-phase gates between two oscillators encoded in the single- and two-photon subspaces. Further, we apply the engineered dynamics to implement code-space-preserving parity checks using one of the oscillators as an ancillary mode, demonstrating an all-bosonic syndrome extraction that extends the effective lifetime of a storage oscillator. This work establishes a qualitatively different strategy for bosonic control, providing a pathway toward fault-tolerant quantum information processing with purely bosonic gates and syndrome measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种在两个超导腔微波光子之间实现非线性耦合的新方法，即利用拉曼辅助的交叉 Kerr 相互作用，并避免实际占据中介耦合器的激发态。该动力学可在演化过程中保持玻色编码空间，有利于容错玻色量子计算。作者展示了其可用于在单光子和双光子子空间编码的振子之间实现受控相位门，并进一步用于保持编码空间的奇偶校验操作。

articles.title: A Systematic Review of Security Privacy and Provenance in EEG-Based Brain-Computer Interfaces with a Blockchain-Based Reference Architecture
articles.title_zh: 基于 EEG 的脑机接口中安全、隐私与溯源的系统综述及区块链参考架构
articles.abstract: Neural data from brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) cannot be revoked once com- promised, yet the security, privacy, and provenance landscape of EEG-based BCI systems has received no systematic analysis. This PRISMA 2020-compliant review synthesises 729 records (64 analysed in depth) from five databases—IEEE Xplore (67), PubMed (10), Scopus (94), SciSpace (272), and Google Scholar/arXiv (286). Dominant deep learning architectures—CNNs, transformers, and federated models— introduce a substantive security surface: adversarial perturbations can mislead clas- sifiers, membership-inference attacks can expose participant identity from deployed models, and public benchmark datasets lack cryptographic integrity guarantees. Critically, only 4 of 729 papers (
articles.abstract_zh: 该系统综述按照 PRISMA 2020 方法分析 EEG 脑机接口中神经数据的安全、隐私和数据溯源问题，指出神经数据一旦泄露难以撤销。研究发现，CNN、Transformer 和联邦学习等模型带来对抗扰动、成员推断和数据完整性不足等风险，而公开基准数据集普遍缺乏密码学完整性保障。作者进一步提出区块链式参考架构，以加强 EEG-BCI 系统中的数据 provenance、可审计性和信任机制。

articles.title: Improving Reanalysis Hub-Height Wind Speeds and Wind Shear Across Large Spatial Domains Using Near-Surface Observational Networks
articles.title_zh: 利用近地面观测网络改进大区域再分析轮毂高度风速与风切变估计
articles.abstract: Data-driven approaches have emerged as a complementary strategy to physics-based models for learning unresolved processes and parameterization biases in reanalysis products. Most data-driven efforts have focused on improving reanalysis wind speeds at heights where observational data are routinely collected. In this study, data from networks of near-surface meteorological stations in Canada and the United States are combined with a smaller network to derive a theoretical wind-shear exponent. This combined dataset was used to train a machine learning model that incorporates the power-law into its loss function, enabling it to simultaneously learn a correction factor for ERA5 wind speeds at 100 m and predict the wind shear exponent. When evaluated using multi-height wind speed data from the Tall Tower Dataset (TALLDB), the new framework demonstrated significant improvements. It reduced the median absolute error and root mean squared error and improved the temporal variability of ERA5 wind speeds between 10 m and 100 m at test locations not used during training. At several TALLDB stations, the predicted shear exponent outperformed ERA5-derived values. Overall, this framework offers a practical solution for enhancing hub-height wind speed estimates from reanalysis data over large regions, relying solely on near-surface meteorological variables that are more widely available.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将加拿大和美国近地面气象站网络数据与较小规模的多高度观测网络结合，用于推导理论风切变指数并训练机器学习模型。模型在损失函数中融入幂律关系，同时学习 ERA5 在 100 m 高度风速的校正因子并预测风切变指数。基于高塔数据集的评估显示，该框架可降低误差、改善 10 m 至 100 m 风速的时间变化刻画，并在部分站点优于 ERA5 推导的切变指数。

articles.title: Natural visibility graph-based multiscale dispersion entropy for chatter identification in thin-walled parts finishing milling
articles.title_zh: 基于自然可见图多尺度散布熵的薄壁件精铣颤振识别
articles.abstract: Thin-walled parts are highly susceptible to chatter during finishing milling, which adversely affects machining quality. However, due to their time-varying weak rigidity and non-stationarity, chatter components are weak and easily masked, making effective detection particularly challenging. To address this issue, this paper proposes an intelligent chatter identification method for thin-walled parts finishing milling based on multiscale dispersion entropy of natural visibility graph (NVG-MDE). By mapping vibration signals into graph signals and computing multiscale dispersion entropy over their topological structures, NVG-MDE effectively captures the implicit topological relationships and nonlinear characteristics embedded in weak chatter signals. First, the second-order generalized synchrosqueezing transform (GSST2) is employed to preprocess the vibration signals, filtering out periodic components and reconstructing the chatter signal. Then, NVG-MDE is used to construct a feature dataset characterizing different chatter conditions. Finally, the crayfish optimization algorithm (COA) is introduced to optimize support vector machine (SVM) parameters for automatic chatter identification. Finishing milling experiments on thin-walled parts validate the effectiveness of the proposed method. Results show that the proposed method achieves an average recognition accuracy of 90.08%, verifying the effectiveness and feasibility of defining entropy on graph signals as feature vectors for milling chatter identification.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对薄壁件精铣过程中弱刚度、非平稳性导致颤振信号微弱且易被掩盖的问题，提出基于自然可见图多尺度散布熵的智能识别方法。方法先利用二阶广义同步压缩变换预处理振动信号、滤除周期成分并重构颤振信号，再将信号映射为图结构并提取多尺度拓扑熵特征。最后引入小龙虾优化算法优化支持向量机参数，实现不同颤振状态的自动识别。

articles.title: On-Board Real-Time AI Compensation System for Nonlinear Drift in Electrochemical Seismometers
articles.title_zh: 面向电化学地震仪非线性漂移的板载实时人工智能补偿系统
articles.abstract: Electrochemical seismometers (MET) are gaining importance in geophysical exploration due to their high sensitivity, wide bandwidth, and strong tilt/impact resistance, and are considered a promising next-generation seismic detection solution. However, complex coupling among mechanical, fluid, and electrochemical processes induces significant magnitude-dependent nonlinearity, causing frequency response drift and limiting dynamic range, ultimately degrading seismic data quality and event detection reliability. Traditional force feedback methods risk closed-loop oscillation at large magnitudes, while data-driven deep learning methods, despite high accuracy in nonlinear compensation, struggle to meet real-time requirements on resource-constrained microcontrollers due to intensive matrix operations. To address real-time compensation and feedback-stability limitations, this paper proposes Wiener-KAN, a feedforward compensation system for on-board real-time execution. The system adopts the Wiener-model decomposition into linear dynamics and static nonlinearity: in the linear part, the Wiener linear layer is initialized with the relative frequency response between the target and ideal systems, injecting a physical prior and enabling rapid frequency feature extraction; in the nonlinear part, a sign- and symmetry-constrained Kolmogorov-Arnold network (KAN) with trainable spline activation functions is introduced and precomputed into lookup tables, replacing spline-function evaluation with low-latency table lookup during inference. Furthermore, this paper constructs and releases a three-dimensional frequency response dataset capturing amplitude-frequency coupling effects, and designs an amplitude-frequency loss (AFMAE) targeting frequency characteristic drift to improve frequency-domain fitting accuracy. Experimental results show that with input magnitude increased by over 10-fold, Wiener-KAN reduces frequency drift from 34.50 Hz to 2.34 Hz, 100 Hz sensitivity drift from 84.56 V s/m to 9.09 V s/m, and linearity error from 2.004% to 0.511%. For real-time feasibility, the precomputed KAN lookup table converts complex floating-point operations into ultra-low-latency memory addressing, achieving a throughput of 6986.7 points/s and a minimal RAM footprint of 5.6 KB on the STM32F405 microcontroller, providing an effective solution for real-time MET nonlinear compensation.
articles.abstract_zh: 电化学地震仪因高灵敏度、宽频带以及较强抗倾斜和抗冲击能力，在地球物理探测中具有重要应用潜力，但机—液—电化学耦合会导致幅值相关非线性、频响漂移和动态范围受限。该文提出一种名为 Wiener-KAN 的前馈补偿系统，将 Wiener 模型的线性动态部分与静态非线性部分结合，以满足资源受限微控制器上的实时补偿需求。该方法旨在避免传统力反馈在大幅值下的闭环振荡风险，同时降低深度学习补偿的计算负担。

articles.title: Demonstration of Continuous Net-Energy Production in Tomoiu Internal Confinement Fusion (TICF) Reactors
articles.title_zh: Tomoiu 内约束聚变（TICF）反应器连续净能量产生的演示
articles.abstract: Since Arthur Eddington proposed nuclear fusion as the energy source of stars in 1920, achieving controlled fusion with net-positive energy production has remained one of the greatest challenges in modern science and engineering. Here, I’m reporting the development and experimental evaluation of the Tomoiu Internal Confinement Fusion (TICF) process, a hybrid chemical-thermonuclear system designed to generate continuous net-positive thermal energy through the continuous formation and confinement of transient hydrogen-based microplasmas. The TICF process employs internally generated acoustic, electromagnetic, and magnetic fields to heat, compress, and stabilize high-temperature microplasmas formed within hydrogen-air-water reaction systems. Experimental testing conducted between 2019 and 2025 at multiple independent facilities, including the City College of New York and the University of Maryland, reported sustained thermal output-input ratios (Q-values) ranging from 2 to 8 across several reactors configurations. The experiments further reported the absence of measurable neutron flux or gamma radiation, while positively charged particle signatures and transient plasmas bursts were observed during operation. These findings are interpreted as evidence consistent with aneutronic fusion reactions involving Protium and Nitrogen species. The results indicate that TICF provides a pathway toward continuous, radiation-free, and scalable fusion-based energy generation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文报告一种名为 Tomoiu 内约束聚变（TICF）的混合化学—热核过程，声称可通过连续形成并约束瞬态含氢微等离子体实现持续净正热能输出。作者称该系统利用内部产生的声场、电磁场和磁场对氢—空气—水反应体系中的高温微等离子体进行加热、压缩和稳定，并在多个设施的测试中观察到热输出/输入比大于1。摘要还称实验未检测到可测中子通量或伽马辐射，但观察到带正电粒子信号和瞬态等离子体爆发；相关结论仍需结合原文实验细节与独立验证审慎评估。

articles.title: Quantum Mechanical Studies And Monte Carlo Simulations On The Corrosion Inhibitive Potentials Of Some Imidazole Derivatives
articles.title_zh: 若干咪唑衍生物缓蚀潜力的量子力学研究与蒙特卡罗模拟
articles.abstract: Experimental methods have been used to clarify the corrosion inhibition mechanism, they are frequently expensive and time-consuming, which makes the search for further options necessary. The efficient application of theoretical modeling techniques that properly correlate the inhibitors' inhibitory efficacy with their molecular structures and properties has been made possible by the advancement of computer software and hardware. The anti-corrosion potentials of three imidazole derivatives were investigated using the density functional theory (DFT) approach and Monte Carlo (MC) simulation. The energies of the frontier molecular orbitals (FMOs) like the lowest unoccupied molecular orbital energy (ELUMO), highest occupied molecular orbital energy (EHOMO), energy gap (Eg), number of transferred electrons (ΔN), and other reactivity descriptors were computed at DFT/B3LYP/6-31G(d) level of theory. The energy band gaps were as follows: A, 4.50 eV, B, 4.28 eV, and C, 4.23 eV; C > B > A. This suggests that molecules C and B would be more effective at preventing rusting on metal surfaces than A. The active adsorption sites were discovered to be on heteroatom molecules (nitrogen and sulfur), according to Fukui index values. Molecule (A) was found to be the least adsorbed when compared to the other derivatives, and the results of calculating the adsorption energies showed that the more negative − 13719.09kcal/mol (C), -13039.52kcal/mol(B) and − 13032.45kcal/mol(A) C > B > A. values indicates that the compounds are strongly bound onto the surface of Fe through covalent bonding which follows the mechanism of Chemical adsorption.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用密度泛函理论和蒙特卡罗模拟评估三种咪唑衍生物的金属腐蚀抑制潜力，以替代或补充成本较高、耗时较长的实验方法。作者计算了前线分子轨道能级、能隙、电子转移数等反应性描述符，并指出分子 C 和 B 相比 A 可能具有更好的缓蚀性能。模拟结果表明，含氮、硫等杂原子的位点可能是主要吸附活性中心，有助于分子在金属表面形成保护性吸附层。

articles.title: QUAMET: Structural and Semantic Metric Analysis for Quantum Code Smell Detection
articles.title_zh: QUAMET：用于量子代码异味检测的结构与语义度量分析
articles.abstract: The field of Quantum Computing (QC) is advancing rapidly, introducing new programming paradigms and frameworks. This rapid growth also increases the vulnerability of quantum programs (QPs) to bugs and code smells. Despite considerable research, detecting code smells in QPs remains underexplored. To bridge this gap, this paper presents QUAMET, a novel structural and semantic analysis approach designed to establish software metrics for QPs and detect quantum code smells. Structural analysis examines code structure and program architecture, focusing on rules and patterns essential for identifying code smells. Semantic analysis, utilising quantum circuit analysis and parse trees, explores the meaning of the code. The study used a publicly available LintQ dataset, which contains real-world QPs implemented with Qiskit. After thorough pre-processing, the dataset was refined to extract structural and semantic metrics, resulting in a labelled dataset of 4,102 projects. This dataset is instrumental in identifying six distinct types of code smells, reviewed by industry and academic experts. The dataset and metrics are validated using reviews and classifications, demonstrating significant advancements in detecting quantum code smells. The results highlight the importance of combining structural and semantic analyses to enhance code smell detection accuracy, providing insights into their potential impact on QPs' performance and maintainability.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 QUAMET，一种面向量子程序代码异味检测的结构与语义分析方法，旨在为量子软件建立可用度量并识别潜在缺陷模式。结构分析关注代码组织、程序架构及规则模式，语义分析则结合量子线路分析和解析树以理解代码含义。研究基于公开 LintQ 数据集中的 Qiskit 项目，经预处理后构建了包含4102个标注项目的数据集，并用于识别六类量子代码异味。

articles.title: Quantum LEGO Learning: A Modular Design Principle for Hybrid Artificial Intelligence
articles.title_zh: 量子 LEGO 学习：面向混合人工智能的模块化设计原则
articles.abstract: Hybrid quantum–classical learning has emerged as a promising paradigm for leveraging near-term quantum devices in practical machine learning tasks. However, many existing hybrid architectures rely on tightly coupled end-to-end training schemes that are difficult to optimize, sensitive to quantum noise, and strongly dependent on specific encoder designs. In this work, we introduce Quantum LEGO Learning, a modular framework for hybrid artificial intelligence that decomposes learning into reusable classical and quantum blocks with explicitly separated roles. Within this framework, a pre-trained classical neural network acts as a frozen feature extractor, while a variational quantum circuit (VQC) serves as the only trainable, adaptive module that operates on structured latent representations. This design enables stable optimization, reduces parameter coupling between classical and quantum components, and supports architecture-agnostic integration across different classical backbones. We develop a block-wise theoretical analysis that decomposes the learning behavior of the hybrid model into components of approximation, estimation, optimization, and noise-induced error. The analysis shows that once expressive classical representations are fixed, the overall model's approximation capability depends primarily on the classical feature block, while the trainable quantum module governs the complexity of downstream adaptation. We further derive optimization and noise-resilience bounds demonstrating how freezing the classical block suppresses the propagation of noisy gradients during training. To validate the proposed framework, we conduct systematic experiments on quantum dot classification and genome transcription factor binding site prediction using multiple frozen feature extractors, including ResNet and tensor-train network backbones, combined with both quantum and classical adaptive heads. Experimental results from noiseless simulations, realistic quantum-noise models, and IBM Heron quantum hardware demonstrate stable optimization, robustness to noise, and improved performance of VQC-based adaptive heads under matched parameter budgets. These results suggest that modular hybrid architectures provide a practical and scalable pathway for quantum-enhanced learning in the NISQ regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 Quantum LEGO Learning，一种面向混合量子—经典人工智能的模块化框架，用可复用的经典与量子模块替代紧耦合端到端训练。框架中，预训练经典神经网络作为冻结的特征提取器，变分量子线路作为唯一可训练模块，在结构化潜在表示上进行自适应学习。作者还从近似、估计、优化和噪声误差等方面进行分块理论分析，强调该设计有助于提升优化稳定性并降低对特定编码器结构的依赖。

articles.title: Carbon storage efficiency and permeability decay during microbubble and conventional carbon dioxide injection in high-permeability sandstone
articles.title_zh: 高渗透砂岩中微气泡与常规二氧化碳注入过程的碳封存效率和渗透率衰减
articles.abstract: Microbubble (MB) CO₂ injection has been proposed to improve sweep efficiency and dissolution trapping, yet its implications for injectivity and near-wellbore integrity in high-permeability formations remain poorly constrained. We conducted repeated volume-balance core-flooding experiments on high-permeability Berea sandstone (~ 1000 mD) under deep saline aquifer conditions (40°C, 10.7 MPa), comparing MB and conventional supercritical CO₂ injections across flow rates of 0.05–0.5 cc/min (Ca: 1.15–11.5 × 10⁻⁹) while monitoring brine permeability. At 0.05 cc/min, MB injection increased average CO₂ saturation by 8.9% relative to conventional flooding due to temporary microbubble-induced blockage of dominant flow channels. This benefit diminished at higher flow rates (0.1–0.5 cc/min), where MB injection consistently yielded lower final CO₂ saturations. Across sequential floods, correlation curves using a single exponential with asymptote fitting show that the sample’s permeability declined further during the microbubble stage after prior conventional CO₂ exposure, suggesting additional permeability impairment under the combined effects of CO₂ exposure, microbubble generation, filter effects, and cumulative sample alteration. This could indicate accelerated near-wellbore damage likely driven by fines mobilisation and enhanced mineral reactions associated with rapid microbubble dissolution. These results demonstrate a clear trade-off in microbubble CO₂ injection: potential sweep-efficiency gains at low flow rates, offset by permeability loss and injectivity difficulties at higher flow rates. The results of this study suggest the need for further research at higher flow rates, considering practical operation and optimising microbubble-based storage strategies will require careful control of flow rate and consideration of reservoir heterogeneity in high-permeability systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在深部盐水含水层条件下，对高渗透 Berea 砂岩进行重复体积平衡岩心驱替实验，比较微气泡 CO₂ 注入与常规超临界 CO₂ 注入对封存效率和渗透率的影响。结果显示，在较低流量下，微气泡可通过暂时阻塞优势流道提高平均 CO₂ 饱和度，但在较高流量下这一优势减弱甚至导致最终饱和度降低。连续驱替实验还表明，经历常规 CO₂ 暴露后再进行微气泡注入可能进一步造成渗透率损害，提示其近井地带注入能力和完整性风险需重点评估。

articles.title: Emerging Two-Dimensional Materials in PFAS Remediation: A Comprehensive Review of Adsorption Mechanisms and Efficiency
articles.title_zh: PFAS 修复中的新兴二维材料：吸附机制与效率综述
articles.abstract: Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) are extensively applied in both industrial and consumer products. To overcome the drawbacks of traditional treatment techniques, researchers are increasingly exploring two-dimensional (2D) materials as innovative solutions for PFAS remediation. Due to their distinctive properties, 2D materials exhibit significant potential for environmental remediation applications. This review examines a range of 2D materials, including graphene, MXenes, 2D metal-organic frameworks (MOFs), covalent organic frameworks (COFs), layered double hydroxides (LDHs), phosphorene, and hexagonal boron nitride (h-BN). It highlights their efficacy in adsorbing PFAS from water. By exploring the results of performance from available literature, it can be stated that graphene has been among the best-performing materials for a number of reasons. These reasons include its extensive surface area and the ability to alter its surface chemistry to capture PFAS via adsorption. Due to their structural and electrochemical stability, as well as the capacity to remove PFAS from waters of different matrices/conditions, MXenes (although with a limited number of reports) were the second-best-performing material. In addition, among the 2D MOFs and COFs, the ability to adsorb PFAS efficiently was attributed to their engineered porous frameworks. LDHs also have an effective surface for capturing PFAS in the waters because their silicate layers are positively charged, and PFAS are negatively charged. h-BN, which possesses a graphene-like layered architecture, provides remarkable chemical and thermal stability. Phosphorene, although less studied, exhibits a highly reactive surface owing to its high electron density, suggesting significant potential for adsorption applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该综述围绕全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFAS）水体修复，系统讨论石墨烯、MXene、二维金属有机框架、共价有机框架、层状双氢氧化物、磷烯和六方氮化硼等二维材料的吸附性能。文章指出，石墨烯因高比表面积和可调表面化学，在多类 PFAS 吸附中表现突出；MXene 虽报道数量有限，但凭借结构与电化学稳定性也展现出良好潜力。综述强调二维材料可通过表面改性、孔结构调控和界面相互作用提升 PFAS 去除效率，但实际水体条件下的稳定性、再生和规模化应用仍需进一步研究。

articles.title_zh: 不采用自力截断的 O(G⁵) 散射振幅与保守双体动力学

Smirnov, Sid Smith, and Mao Zeng We compute the complete potential-graviton contributions to the conservative radial action and scattering angle for two nonspinning bodies in general relativity, accurate through fifth order in Newton’s constant and including second-order self-force effects. The calculation is carried out in the sca… [Phys. Rev. Lett. 137, 021402] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究计算了广义相对论中两个非自旋天体保守动力学的势引力子贡献，精度达到牛顿常数五阶，并包含二阶自力效应。作者在散射振幅框架下获得径向作用量和散射角的完整结果。该成果推进了后闵可夫斯基引力两体问题的高精度解析计算，可用于引力波源动力学建模。

Rev. Lett. 137, 025201] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨弓形激波脉冲星风云附近观测到的丝状 X 射线结构及脉冲星周围慢扩散区现象，对传统宇宙线传播图像提出的挑战。作者关注相对论正负电子束在磁化星际等离子体中的自约束机制，并以脉冲星 X 射线丝状结构为典型情形。该工作有助于理解脉冲星环境中高能粒子输运、辐射形态和局域扩散抑制的物理起源。

articles.title_zh: PT 对称磁振子激光与反激光

articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种电可调的 PT 对称磁振子激光与反激光机制，并设计了包含电流偏置区域的磁有序平面波导器件。偏置区域中多根重金属导线承载直流电流，以调控磁振子系统中的增益、损耗和非厄米对称性。该方案为可控磁振子放大、吸收以及自旋波器件中的非厄米物理应用提供了新思路。

articles.title: Physiological and Biochemical Responses of Tomato (Solanum lycopersicum L.) to Polyethylene Microplastic Exposure
articles.title_zh: 番茄（Solanum lycopersicum L.）对聚乙烯微塑料暴露的生理和生化响应
articles.abstract: Microplastics (MPs) are emerging environmental pollutants with potential impacts on terrestrial ecosystems and crop productivity. This study examined the effects of polyethylene microplastics (PE-MPs) on the physiological and biochemical responses of tomato (Solanum lycopersicum L.) plants under controlled greenhouse conditions. A completely randomized design was employed with soil treatments containing 0%, 1%, 3%, and 5% (w/w) MPs, each replicated five times. Tomato seeds were grown in MP-amended soils for six weeks under uniform environmental conditions, after which growth parameters, photosynthetic pigments (chlorophyll a, chlorophyll b, and total chlorophyll), antioxidant enzyme activities (superoxide dismutase, catalase, and peroxidase), and stress biomarkers (malondialdehyde, MDA) were assessed using standard analytical procedures. Increasing MP concentrations significantly reduced plant growth, with shoot height declining from 47.6 cm in the control to 30.1 cm at 5% MPs, root length decreasing from 18.4 cm to 10.7 cm, and dry biomass decreasing from 3.25 g to 1.98 g. Total chlorophyll content declined from 2.56 to 1.51 mg g⁻¹ FW, indicating impaired photosynthetic capacity. In contrast, antioxidant enzyme activities increased markedly, with SOD, CAT, and POD reaching approximately 172%, 165%, and 159% of control levels, respectively, while MDA content increased by approximately 2.3-fold, confirming enhanced lipid peroxidation and oxidative stress. Overall, MPs caused dose-dependent toxicity by disrupting plant growth, impairing photosynthesis, and inducing oxidative stress, highlighting potential risks to crop productivity, soil health, and food security.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在温室条件下考察不同质量分数聚乙烯微塑料对番茄幼苗生长、光合色素、抗氧化酶活性和胁迫标志物的影响。结果表明，随微塑料浓度升高，株高、根长、干生物量和总叶绿素含量显著下降，提示生长和光合能力受损。研究还检测了超氧化物歧化酶、过氧化氢酶、过氧化物酶及丙二醛等指标，以评估微塑料诱导的氧化胁迫响应。

articles.title: Drought tolerance mechanisms in contrasting wheat genotypes: coordination of ABA signaling, antioxidant defense, and stress-responsive genes
articles.title_zh: 对比小麦基因型的耐旱机制：ABA 信号、抗氧化防御与胁迫响应基因的协同调控
articles.abstract: Background Drought stress is a major constraint on wheat productivity, particularly under climate change scenarios characterized by increasing drought frequency and severity. Drought tolerance involves the coordinated regulation of hormonal signaling, osmotic adjustment, antioxidant defense, and stress-responsive gene expression.Methods This study evaluated physiological, biochemical and molecular responses of drought-tolerant and drought-sensitive wheat genotypes at the seedling stage. Drought stress was applied by withholding irrigation for five days. Abscisic acid (ABA) accumulation, osmolyte content, antioxidant enzyme activities, and the expression of thirteen drought-responsive genes were analyzed.Results Drought stress significantly increased ABA accumulation in the sensitive genotype BT, whereas tolerant genotype Utique maintained stable ABA levels. Tolerant genotypes Utique and D117 accumulated higher proline and soluble sugar contents, indicating improved osmotic adjustment. They also showed enhanced antioxidant defense, particularly higher superoxide dismutase (SOD) and catalase (CAT) activities. Gene expression analysis revealed contrasting responses: sensitive genotypes exhibited stronger induction of ABA biosynthesis genes (NCED and AAO), stress-related transcription factors (WRKY44 and NAC48), and repression of the photosynthesis-related gene LHCb1. In contrast, tolerant genotypes showed higher expression of genes associated with osmolyte biosynthesis (P5CS and BADH), ion homeostasis (NHX1 and AVP1), and water transport (PIP2;1).Conclusions The identified physiological and molecular traits highlight key mechanisms underlying drought tolerance and provide potential biomarkers for the selection of drought-resilient wheat genotypes in breeding programs targeting water-limited environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究比较耐旱与敏感小麦基因型在幼苗期遭受停水胁迫后的生理、生化和分子响应。结果显示，敏感基因型在干旱下 ABA 积累显著增加，而耐旱基因型维持较稳定 ABA 水平，并积累更多脯氨酸和可溶性糖以增强渗透调节。耐旱材料还表现出更强的抗氧化防御，尤其是较高的 SOD 和 CAT 活性，同时多个干旱响应基因呈现基因型特异性表达模式。

articles.title: Permutation-Equivariant Deep Equilibrium Networks for Real-Time Single-Bus DER Dispatch with O(1) Parameter Scaling
articles.title_zh: 用于实时单母线分布式能源调度且参数规模为 O(1) 的置换等变深度平衡网络
articles.abstract: Real-time dispatch of heterogeneous distributed energy resources (DERs)— electric vehicles, battery storage, and flexible loads—under a single-bus real-time price requires solving a high-dimensional equilibrium every dispatch interval. We cast the problem as a competitive equilibrium with device-specific dynamics and constraints, and learn the equilibrium policy together with the clearing price using a permutation-equivariant Transformer Deep Equilibrium Network (DER�DEQN) whose parameter count is O(1) in the number of devices N, in contrast to MLP-DEQN baselines that scale O(N). We redesign the positional encod�ing to inject device-type, temporal-window, and feeder priors as the symmetry structure, and train with an unsupervised N-component equilibrium loss (an intertemporal marginal-value Euler analogue, three families of KKT complemen�tarities, and the market-clearing residual that pins the real-time price)—requiring no labeled data. Experiments on two NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPUs establish two distinct claims at their relevant scales. The architecture-level properties hold to N=5000: O(1) parameter scaling (a flat 1.19×105 parameters versus 8.6×107 for an MLP), machine-precision permutation equivariance (∼ 2 × 10−6), and a real-time inference latency of 8.8 ms at N=5000. The equilibrium-quality results—stable label-free training in which the market-clearing and KKT residu�als converge to ∼10−4 and a competitive welfare comparison to the centralized convex optimum—are validated at N=50, the largest N at which the unsuper�vised residual loss is observed to converge to small residuals under our training budget; we report an honest limitation that the intertemporal marginal-value residual settles to a nonzero floor, so exact welfare parity with centralized solvers remains open. JEL Classification: C63 , C68 , Q41 , L94
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将电动汽车、储能和柔性负荷等异构分布式能源在单母线实时电价下的调度问题表述为竞争均衡，并用置换等变 Transformer 深度平衡网络同时学习均衡策略和出清价格。与参数量随设备数增长的 MLP 基线相比，该模型参数规模对设备数量保持 O(1)，并通过设备类型、时间窗口和馈线先验重构位置编码。训练采用无监督的多组成均衡损失，包括边际价值类 Euler 条件、KKT 互补条件和市场出清残差，实验展示了大规模设备下的参数效率和置换等变性质。

articles.title: Egypt’s protected-area network at the land–sea interface: coastal reserve fragmentation, the 30×30 gap, and Lessepsian bioinvasion (1983–2022)
articles.title_zh: 埃及陆海交界保护地网络：海岸保护区碎片化、30×30 缺口与莱赛普斯生物入侵（1983—2022）
articles.abstract: Coastal and marine systems lie at the centre of the Kunming–Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework (KMGBF), whose Target 3 commits nations to conserving 30% of terrestrial, inland-water, coastal and marine areas through ecologically representative, well-connected and effectively managed systems by 2030. For the coastal zone — the contested land–sea interface where biodiversity, human pressure and area-based conservation converge — the first global stocktake (Protected Planet Report 2024) shows that progress on these quality dimensions, rather than on area alone, is now the binding constraint, and that marine and coastal protection across Northern Africa remains far below the global mean. We provide the first integrated, multi-decadal (1983–2022) assessment of Egypt’s protected-area (PA) network through a coastal-conservation lens, asking how well the network serves the Mediterranean and Red Sea coasts that concentrate the country’s marine biodiversity and its most acute coastal pressures. Combining official EEAA and CAPMAS datasets with structural-break detection, Lorenz/Gini inequality analysis, Monte-Carlo and exact contingency testing, and scenario-based trajectory projection, we show that the network expanded from a single 778 km² reserve to 30 reserves spanning 141,137 km² (14.1% of national territory) in two pulses (mid-1980s and mid-2000s) separated by a long plateau. Conservation effort is, however, distributed with pronounced inequality (Gini = 0.83): four large desert flagship reserves hold more than 80% of the estate, whereas the small reserves (nine averaging under 12 km²) are disproportionately the Mediterranean and Red Sea coastal and wetland sites of highest marine-biodiversity value. We interpret this size structure as a representativeness and connectivity concern for the coastal sub-network rather than as direct evidence of ecological decline. Under the status-quo trajectory Egypt is projected to reach only ~ 14% coverage by 2030. An inventory of 292 alien species, dominated by aquatic animals (about two-thirds of invasive animals: fish, crustaceans and molluscs), is consistent with the Suez Canal’s role as the principal corridor of Lessepsian migration into the Mediterranean, placing Egypt’s Mediterranean coastal reserves at the leading edge of the world’s most invaded sea. The mammalian assessment indicates comparable overall threat incidence between marine and terrestrial groups, with the most severe threat categories occupied only by terrestrial species. We argue that Egypt’s coastal-conservation priority should shift from area accumulation toward consolidating the representativeness, connectivity and management effectiveness of its coastal and marine reserves, underpinned by a marine-invasion early-detection-and-rapid-response capability and KMGBF-aligned coastal-conservation finance.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究从海岸保护视角，对 1983—2022 年埃及保护地网络在地中海和红海沿岸的覆盖、连通性和代表性进行综合评估。作者结合官方数据、结构突变检测、Lorenz/Gini 不平等分析、蒙特卡洛与精确列联检验以及情景轨迹预测，检验其与昆明—蒙特利尔全球生物多样性框架 30×30 目标的差距。研究强调埃及海岸带保护不仅面临面积不足，还受到保护区碎片化、管理质量约束和莱赛普斯生物入侵等压力影响。

articles.title: Integration of a Structural Coherence Model with a Semi-Universal Machine Learning Interatomic Potential to Predict Molten Salt Thermal Conductivity
articles.title_zh: 结合结构相干模型与半通用机器学习原子间势预测熔盐热导率
articles.abstract: The accurate design and performance assessment of energy generation systems that use molten salts as working fluids require accurate characterization of thermal conductivity, with a sufficiently low uncertainty. However, experimental data on several molten salt systems, of interest for various energy generation applications , are generally lacking. Physics-informed models, as well as molecular dynamic (MD) simulations, have the potential to populate gaps in current ther-mophysical property databases. Existing predictive models using MD simulation (Green-Kubo, non-equilibrium MD) take significantly longer to predict thermal conductivity than classical MD models that otherwise predict salt density with reasonable accuracy. We present an approach that uses the SuperSalt machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) for chloride salts, as well as a structural coherence model (SCM) to predict thermal conductivity of molten salts using vol-umetric heat capacity, adiabatic speed of sound, and the partial pair distribution function. The SCM uses this function to predict the mean free path of thermal transport and applies generalized kinetic theory to predict thermal conductivity near the melting temperature, achieving results 1–2 orders of magnitude faster 1 than existing MD methods. By also predicting the isothermal bulk modulus, the temperature dependence of thermal conductivity above the melting temperature can be determined. This integrated SCM-MLIP (ISM) methodology serves as a proof of concept for using MLIPs to predict thermal properties within current experimental uncertainties at a fraction of the computational cost. This enables investigation into thermal conductivity as well as other thermophysical properties across a variety of molten salt compositions. When coupled with targeted experimental studies, the ISM methodology can help contribute to existing databases necessary to safely implement molten salts into power generation systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向以熔盐为工质的能源系统热物性评估，提出将氯盐体系的 SuperSalt 机器学习原子间势与结构相干模型结合，用于预测熔盐热导率。方法利用体积热容、绝热声速和部分对分布函数估计热输运平均自由程，并基于广义动理论计算热导率。该框架旨在以较低计算成本弥补实验数据和传统分子动力学热导率预测的不足。

articles.title: Mechanism-Dependent Scaling in Porous Materials
articles.title_zh: 多孔材料中依赖机制的尺度标度关系
articles.abstract: Power-law scaling between physical properties and relative density is a well-established feature of porous, cellular, and microstructured materials. Transport properties, such as electrical, thermal, or diffusive response, and mechanical properties, such as stiffness or strength, are often described by relations of the form P propto h̊o^σ, where the exponent σ depends on material class, architecture, deformation mechanism, and transport pathway. Here, we revisit the comparison between transport and mechanical density-scaling exponents from a mechanism-dependent perspective. Across several porous and cellular systems, transport properties often scale with exponents in the approximate range σₜᵣₐₙₛₚ approx 1.1--1.6, whereas bending- or stability-dominated mechanical responses frequently exhibit larger exponents, commonly in the range σₘₑcₕ approx 2--3. In these classes, the ratio σₘₑcₕ/σₜᵣₐₙₛₚ is often found near two. This relation is not proposed as a universal scaling law. Stretching-dominated lattices, including triangular and octet-type architectures, provide expected counterexamples because their stiffness may scale approximately linearly with relative density. Likewise, anisotropic architectures, percolation-dominated networks, and microstructures in which transport and stiffness sample different structural pathways may deviate from the proposed trend. The contribution of this work is therefore not to replace established cellular-solids theory, but to organize transport--stiffness scaling in porous materials according to the dominant structural mechanism. We interpret the near-two exponent ratio as a recurrent signature of systems in which transport is primarily connectivity-controlled while mechanical response is bending- or stability-dominated. On this basis, we identify the expected validity range, discuss boundary cases and counterexamples, and formulate a falsifiable prediction for additively manufactured lattice structures, especially TPMS-based architectures in which geometry and relative density can be systematically controlled.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文重新审视多孔、胞状和微结构材料中物理性质随相对密度变化的幂律标度关系，强调标度指数取决于材料结构、变形机制和输运路径。作者指出，许多输运性质的密度指数约为1.1–1.6，而弯曲或稳定性主导的力学响应常见指数约为2–3，两者比值在若干体系中接近2。文章同时强调这并非普适定律，拉伸主导晶格和各向异性结构可构成重要反例。

articles.title: Exact Differentiable Inference for Fractional Stochastic Volatility: ADavies–Harte-Reparameterized Hamiltonian Monte Carlo Posterior of the Hurst Index, with Application to the VN30 Frontier Index
articles.title_zh: 分数随机波动率的精确可微推断：Davies–Harte 重参数化的哈密顿蒙特卡洛 Hurst 指数后验及其在 VN30 前沿指数中的应用
articles.abstract: We make full-posterior Bayesian inference of the Hurst index of a fractional stochastic-volatility SDE exact and differentiable, removing the O(N 3) inversion of the non-Markovian fractional covariance that forces practitioners onto the biased Whittle approximation. The driver is a fractional Brownian motion whose Hurst index H separates rough (H < 1/2) from long-memory (H > 1/2) volatility; embedding the Davies–Harte circulant-embedding generator of fractional Gaussian noise inside an automatic-differentiation Hamiltonian Monte Carlo sampler makes the full posterior of (µ, κ, σ, H) reachable at O(N log N) without forming or inverting the dense N × N matrix, and for the scalar Hurst marginal an analytic scale marginalisation sharpens this to an exact, sampling-free posterior. A simulation calibration at known H shows the payoff: the exact posterior is near unbiased with close to nominal 95% coverage, whereas the Whittle pseudo-posterior is biased toward roughness and, in the strong long-memory regime, covers the truth only 12.5% of the time. Measured timing confirms the near-linear cost of the differentiable generator against the cubic dense fac-torisation. Applied to the VN30 frontier index over N = 3585 daily returns from 2012-02-07 to 2026-06-22, the exact posterior places the Hurst index at 0.5828 with a 95% credible interval of [0.5614, 0.6052] entirely above 1/2; the exact posterior odds favour long memory over roughness by a Bayes factor of 1.5 × 10 20 , so the rough regime is refuted rather than merely disfavoured. Out of sample a horizon-aware forecaster cuts the one-day random-walk error by 18.7%, with a tuned GARCH(1, 1) a further 2.5% ahead through near-integrated persistence that approximates the same memory. The Python primary and the independent R verification agree to within 4.9×10 −11 , so every reported number is reproducible. MSC Classification: 60G22 , 62F15 , 62M10 , 65C05
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种针对分数随机波动率随机微分方程中 Hurst 指数的全后验贝叶斯推断方法，避免了非马尔可夫分数协方差矩阵的 O(N³) 求逆。作者将 Davies–Harte 循环嵌入的分数高斯噪声生成器纳入自动微分哈密顿蒙特卡洛采样，实现对参数后验的 O(N log N) 推断，并对标量 Hurst 边际给出解析尺度边际化。模拟结果显示，该精确后验相比 Whittle 近似偏差更小、覆盖率更接近标称水平，并被应用于 VN30 前沿指数分析。

articles.title: Reconstructing quantum dot charge stability diagrams with diffusion models
articles.title_zh: 利用扩散模型重建量子点电荷稳定性图
articles.abstract: Efficiently characterizing quantum dot (QD) devices is a critical bottleneck when scaling quantum processors based on confined spins. Measuring high-resolution charge stability diagrams (or CSDs, data maps which crucially define the occupation of QDs) is time-consuming, particularly in emerging architectures where CSDs must be acquired with remote sensors that cannot probe the charge of the relevant dots directly. In this work, we present a generative approach to accelerate acquisition by reconstructing full CSDs from sparse measurements, using a conditional diffusion model. We evaluate our approach using two experimentally motivated masking strategies: uniform grid-based sampling, and line-cut sweeps. Our lightweight architecture, trained on approximately 9000 examples, successfully reconstructs CSDs, maintaining key physically important features such as charge transition lines, from as little as 4% of the total measured data. We compare the approach to interpolation methods, which fail when the task involves reconstructing large unmeasured regions. Our results demonstrate that generative models can significantly reduce the characterization overhead for quantum devices, and provides a robust path towards an experimental implementation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对自旋量子处理器中量子点器件表征耗时的问题，提出用条件扩散模型从稀疏测量数据重建完整电荷稳定性图。作者考察了均匀网格采样和线扫描两种实验相关的掩蔽策略，模型在约9000个样本上训练后，可在仅使用少量测量数据时保留电荷跃迁线等关键物理特征。与插值方法相比，该生成式方法在大面积未测区域重建中表现更优，有望降低量子器件表征开销。
authors: Vinicius Hernandes, Joseph Rogers, Rouven Koch, Thomas Spriggs, Brennan Undseth, Anasua Chatterjee, Lieven M K Vandersypen and Eliska Greplova

Fernandes, and Eduardo Fradkin Metallic altermagnets offer a new setting for unconventional superconductivity because their Fermi surfaces are spin split despite vanishing net magnetization. Here, the authors show that equal-spin multicomponent p -wave pairing gives rise to multiple superconducting transitions and intertwined superconducting phases driven by subleading normal-state instabilities. They further demonstrate that fluctuations of competing electronic orders fundamentally reshape the superconducting state: nematic fluctuations stabilize nematic superconductivity, whereas spin loop-current fluctuations select chiral phases, revealing routes toward both nematic and topological superconductivity. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 014504] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026

This behavior is governed by a nontrivial accumulation of coupling phases in a closed loop mediated by traveling photons. Its microscopic origin is traced to polarization-dependent Zeeman coupling, on which a unified framework for structural and synthetic chirality is established. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 024408] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026

articles.title: Dynamics of photoexcited exciton-phonon systems: Time-dependent theoretical approaches
articles.title_zh: 光激发激子-声子体系的动力学：含时理论方法
articles.abstract: Author(s): Darius Abramavicius, Arunjyoti Baidya, Vytautas Bubilaitis, and Leonas Valkunas When molecular aggregates absorb light, the resulting exciton is shaped by a local phonon bath, which causes fluctuation, dephasing, and can eventually trap the excitation. This exciton-phonon coupling leads to exciton-polaron formation, transforming the coherent excitonic motion into the incoherent polaronic behavior. Here, the authors compare complementary time-dependent descriptions of this process. In the Heisenberg representation, the mean-field approximation treats phonons as classical fluctuating fields, while the one-quantum approximation retains one-phonon-assisted correlations and captures phonon sidebands in optical spectra. In parallel, a time-dependent variational polaron approach follows relaxation and self-trapping in the excited-state manifold. Together, these methods clarify how excitons evolve, decohere, and become coupled to vibrations. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 019602] Published Mon Jul 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究比较了描述分子聚集体中光生激子与局域声子浴耦合动力学的多种含时理论方法。海森堡表象下的平均场近似将声子视为经典涨落场，而单量子近似保留单声子辅助关联并可描述光谱中的声子边带；同时，含时变分极化子方法刻画激发态中的弛豫和自俘获过程。整体上，这些方法阐明了激子如何退相干并逐渐转变为与振动耦合的极化子行为。
authors: Darius Abramavicius, Arunjyoti Baidya, Vytautas Bubilaitis, and Leonas Valkunas

articles.title: A data-driven modeling study on the accurate identification of Doppler-free saturated absorption spectra in diatomic tellurium ( 130 Te 2 )

articles.abstract: The accurate identification of electronic transitions in high resolution molecular spectra is central to elucidating the complex energy level structures of excited states and characterizing intramolecular interactions in diatomic molecules. Here, we introduce a data-driven model that integrates the Dunham model with grid search iterative optimization and stepwise predictive matching methods to simultaneously characterize multiple coupled electronic excited states. Using Doppler-free saturated absorption spectra of molecular tellurium ( 130 Te 2 ) as a benchmark, our strategies enable the identification of 3701 lines across B 0 u + ← X 0 g + , A 0 u + ← X 0 g + , B 1 u − ← X 1 g − , and B 1 u + ← X 1 g + transitions with an accuracy on the order of MHz (∼10 −4 cm −1 ) and extend the reliable assignment of rotational quantum numbers ( J ) up to ∼200. The diatomic constants and potential energy curves for both A 0 u + and B 0 u + of 130 Te 2 were updated, and the energy-level perturbations between B 0 u + and B 1 u + were also exhibited. The present data-driven framework establishes a universal paradigm for high resolution spectroscopic analysis of homonuclear diatomic molecules, offering a robust approach for analyzing highly congested spectra and enabling reliable spectral assignment.

articles.title: Electric-Field-Driven Optical Tunability in MoSe₂/WSe₂ van der Waals Type-II Heterostructures: Valley-Selective Quantum Confined Stark Effect
articles.title_zh: MoSe₂/WSe₂范德华II型异质结构中电场驱动的光学可调性：谷选择性量子限制斯塔克效应
articles.abstract: This study investigates how an applied electric field affects light-matter interactions differently in the two momentum valleys (K and K′) of MoSe₂/WSe₂ van der Waals heterostructures — a phenomenon termed valley-selective quantum confined Stark effect (QCSE). A three-tier theoretical framework was built combining density functional theory for band parameters, an envelope-function formalism for carrier wavefunctions, and a massive Dirac fermion Hamiltonian that separately accounts for spin-orbit coupling in each layer. This allowed independent computation of how exciton energy, oscillator strength, and radiative lifetime evolve in each valley as a function of electric field (0–200 kV/cm) and bilayer twist angle (0°–60°). The key finding is a pronounced valley asymmetry: at 200 kV/cm and a 2° twist angle, the K valley experiences a wavelength redshift of ~ 101 nm while K′ shifts by only ~ 53 nm, producing a valley contrast ratio of ~ 1.91. This asymmetry arises from strong spin-orbit coupling and spin-valley locking, which cause the two valleys to respond fundamentally differently to the same out-of-plane field. Exciton lifetimes increase dramatically — from ~ 12 ns to ~ 115 ns — reflecting increasing spatial separation of electrons and holes across the two layers. A two-dimensional map of valley splitting across field and twist-angle space identifies optimal operating conditions, with small twist angles (below 5°, the moiré regime) yielding the greatest valley contrast. Monte Carlo analysis confirms robustness, with the contrast ratio exceeding 1.5 in 94% of simulations under realistic parameter uncertainties. The results provide a practical design framework for electrically tunable, valley-selective photonic devices in the near-infrared.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察外加电场对MoSe₂/WSe₂范德华异质结构中K与K′两个动量谷光-物质相互作用的差异影响，并将其称为谷选择性量子限制斯塔克效应。作者结合密度泛函理论、包络函数形式和含自旋轨道耦合的有质量狄拉克费米子哈密顿量，计算不同电场与扭转角下激子能量、振子强度和辐射寿命的变化。结果显示，在200 kV/cm和2°扭转角下，K谷红移约101 nm，而K′谷仅约53 nm，表明强自旋轨道耦合与自旋-谷锁定导致显著谷不对称响应。

articles.title: AlGaN/GaN heterojunction field effect transistor structure integrated photoelectrode probe with optical artifact suppression function
articles.title_zh: 具备光伪迹抑制功能的AlGaN/GaN异质结场效应晶体管结构集成光电极探针
articles.abstract: The integrated photoelectrode probe capable of simultaneously stimulating neurons with light and collecting electrophysiological signals is the core device of optogenetics. In this paper, AlGaN/GaN heterojunction field-effect transistors (HFETs) are used instead of the traditional metal microelectrode to prepare brain neural probe, and then bonded with the LED photoelectrode probe to form an integrated photoelectrode probe. The AlGaN/GaN HFET structure brain neural probe has high sensitivity and biocompatibility, which can effectively improve the quality of neuronal signal acquisition. While the light stimulation signal of the LED photoelectrode probe will affect the AlGaN/GaN HFET, severely degrading the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of neuronal signal acquisition. We prepared multiple pairs of recording HFET (R-HFET) and differential HFET (D-HFET) at the tip of the brain nerve probe. The R-HFET has a bare gate region that is sensitive to changes in extracellular potential and is used for collecting neuronal signals. The gate region of D-HFET is covered with a SiO2 passivation film, which has low sensitivity to changes in extracellular potential and can hardly collect neuronal signals. D-HFET, like R-HFET, is sensitive to the light stimulation signal from the LED photoelectrode probe. By adjusting the drain-source bias of D-HFET and performing differential processing with the signal collected by R-HFET, the neuronal signal can be clearly separated. Simulated biological experiments in phosphate buffered saline solution have shown that the integrated photoelectrode probe can reduce artifacts by 90%.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向光遗传学中同时进行光刺激和电生理信号采集的集成光电极探针，采用AlGaN/GaN异质结场效应晶体管替代传统金属微电极以提高灵敏度和生物相容性。针对LED光刺激对晶体管读出造成干扰、降低神经信号信噪比的问题，作者在探针尖端设计记录HFET与差分HFET阵列。记录器件用于感知细胞外电位，差分器件通过SiO₂钝化降低对神经信号的响应，从而为光伪迹抑制和高质量神经信号采集提供结构方案。

articles.title: Impact of geomagnetic storm intensity on thermospheric density and orbital decay of LEO satellites: a G1–G5 per-event analysis
articles.title_zh: 地磁暴强度对热层密度和低轨卫星轨道衰减的影响：G1–G5逐事件分析
articles.abstract: Geomagnetic storms enhance thermospheric density and increase atmospheric drag on low-Earth-orbit (LEO) satellites, accelerating their orbital decay, as illustrated by the loss of 38 Starlink satellites following the modest February 2022 storm. Prior multi-event analyses have characterized this response primarily through superposed epoch analyses of Challenge Minisatellite Payload (CHAMP) and Gravity Recovery and Climate Experiment (GRACE) observations. Here we apply a complementary, per-event approach: for each of 22 geomagnetic storms spanning G1 to G5 over two solar cycles (2003–2024) — five events per intensity level with two events for G5 — we compare the single storm-peak orbit of GRACE or GRACE-Follow On (-FO) with a matched quiet-time reference orbit, isolating the instantaneous peak response. Orbital decay rate enhancement scales monotonically with storm intensity: 77.2% for G1, 98.5% for G2, 138.1% for G3, 149.6% for G4, and 166.5% for G5. Beyond storm intensity, satellite operation altitude emerges as an independent modulating factor; low-altitude events produce strong drag responses even under relatively weak geomagnetic forcing. An empirical multi-linear regression model incorporating quiet-time decay rate, maximum Kp, and operation altitude reproduces the storm-time decay rate with correlation of determination (R²) = 0.91 and root mean square error (RMSE) = 12.3 m/day across all 22 events. These results provide a peak-response benchmark complementary to existing SEA-based analyses, offer a validation reference for empirical thermospheric models, and support the development of improved orbit-prediction and collision-avoidance strategies for the expanding LEO satellite population, including the May 2024 Gannon G5 storm.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究分析2003—2024年两个太阳周期内22次G1至G5级地磁暴事件，评估地磁暴增强热层密度并加速低轨卫星轨道衰减的效应。作者将每次风暴峰值轨道与匹配的平静期参考轨道进行比较，以隔离瞬时峰值响应。结果显示轨道衰减率增强随地磁暴强度单调增加，同时卫星运行高度也是独立调制因素，较低轨道在较弱地磁扰动下也可能出现显著阻力响应。

articles.title: Analysis of Network Classification and Optimization Based on Comprehensive Evaluation of Public Transportation Network – A Case Study of Guangzhou
articles.title_zh: 基于公共交通网络综合评价的网络分类与优化分析：以广州为例
articles.abstract: Urban bus networks in many megacities face simultaneous challenges of declining ridership, structural inefficiencies, and spatial inequity, yet existing evaluation frameworks rarely integrate topological, functional, and equity dimensions within a coherent analytical structure. This paper proposes a novel "structure–function–equity" evaluation framework that combines six topological indicators (network density, coverage rate, stop coverage, route length, repetition coefficient, and non-linear coefficient) with five functional indicators (supply index, population coverage, Gini coefficient, passenger flow, and metro overlap coefficient). The framework employs a two-stage machine learning pipeline—K-means clustering followed by random forest validation (92.3% cross-validated accuracy)—to classify bus routes into four distinct functional types: social security-oriented, benefit-oriented, metro-integrated, and functionally ambiguous. An empirical case study of Guangzhou's bus network (3,214 routes, 6,968 stops, 54,000 km) reveals severe structural deficiencies: a network-wide repetition coefficient of 4.9 (far above the recommended 2.5), average route length of 16.7 km versus typical trip distance of 7.5 km, and rural stop coverage of only 22%. The classification identifies 27% of routes as functionally ambiguous—lacking clear operational purpose yet consuming substantial resources. A bi-objective NSGA-II optimization model for these ambiguous routes generates three actionable strategies: shortening high-overlap routes (reducing overlap penalty by 38%), converting 112 routes to feeder services for planned metro extensions (improving last-mile connectivity for 340,000 residents), and reallocating resources to rural routes (reducing elderly Gini from 0.42 to 0.35 with a projected 15% ridership increase). The framework provides transit planners with a transferable, data-driven approach for diagnosing network inefficiencies and designing targeted, equity-aware interventions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出“结构—功能—公平”一体化评价框架，用于分析超大城市公交网络的客流下降、结构低效和空间不公平问题。框架整合网络密度、覆盖率、线路长度、重复系数、人口覆盖、基尼系数、客流和与地铁重叠度等指标，并采用K-means聚类与随机森林验证对公交线路进行功能分类。以广州3214条线路和6968个站点为案例，研究发现其公交网络存在较高线路重复、线路长度偏长等结构性问题，并将线路划分为社会保障型、效益导向型、地铁衔接型和功能模糊型。
