articles.abstract: Magnetic silver core–shell nanoparticles (Fe₃O₄@Ag) were synthesized via a sustainable green chemistry route using Alcea leaf extract, which acted as both reducing and stabilizing agent. Optimization of the extract concentration yielded uniform nanostructures with a silver coating efficiency of 88.7%, an average size of 95.4 nm, and good colloidal stability (zeta potential −27.2 mV). Structural characterization (EDX, XRD, FT-IR, SEM) confirmed the formation of the desired core–shell morphology. To rationalize the experimental observations, density functional theory (DFT) and time-dependent DFT (TDDFT) calculations were performed on a glucose-stabilized Fe₃O₄@Ag cluster. Theoretical analyses revealed orbital hybridization between Fe 3d, O 2p, and Ag states, with glucose introducing new Ag–O(C) contributions near the Fermi level. Frontier orbital analysis indicated a switch in the charge-transfer pathway, from interfacial core→shell transfer in the pristine system to shell→core metal-to-metal transfer after glucose adsorption. This orbital realignment reduced the HOMO–LUMO gap (3.31 → 3.20 eV) and increased the dipole moment (8.2 → 13.5 D), consistent with the experimentally observed zeta potential and red-shift in UV–Vis absorption. Non-covalent interaction analyses showed that stabilization is driven by physisorption through van der Waals and weak hydrogen-bond–like electrostatic contacts (O···Ag 2.4–2.7 Å, O–H···Ag 1.9–2.2 Å, ∠~92–107°), rather than covalent bonding.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究采用 Alcea 叶提取物作为还原剂和稳定剂，通过绿色化学路线合成磁性银核壳纳米颗粒 Fe₃O₄@Ag，并通过多种表征确认其核壳形貌与胶体稳定性。作者进一步利用 DFT 和 TDDFT 对葡萄糖稳定的 Fe₃O₄@Ag 团簇进行电子结构分析。计算显示葡萄糖吸附会改变 Fe、O、Ag 相关轨道杂化和电荷转移路径，降低 HOMO-LUMO 能隙并提高偶极矩，与实验观察到的稳定化趋势相一致。

articles.title: Valley Valves at Domain Walls in Symmetry-Broken Rhombohedral Graphene
articles.title_zh: 对称性破缺菱方多层石墨烯中畴壁处的谷阀效应
articles.abstract: Rhombohedral multilayer graphene polarized by a moderate perpendicular displacement field hosts a time-reversal-symmetry-breaking valley-and-spin-polarized metallic phase that may condense into a chiral superconductor. Recent magnetic imaging and transport measurements in this unconventional system suggest the presence of domain walls both in the metallic and superconducting phases. In this work, we show that valley domain walls are impenetrable barriers to transport in the metallic regime. Transmission through such a domain wall must therefore be mediated by intervalley interactions. We derive the symmetry-allowed terms and show via microscopic numerical simulations that they enable the transmission of electrons across the domain wall. In the superconducting phase, we find that intervalley mixing is crucial for supporting an appreciable supercurrent through a SNS' Josephson junction that connects opposite-chirality superconducting regions. Taken together, our work elucidates the nature of domain walls in these experimentally relevant multilayer systems and emphasizes the critical role of intervalley hybridization in governing their transport properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 中等垂直位移场极化的菱方多层石墨烯可出现破缺时间反演对称性的谷—自旋极化金属相，并可能凝聚为手性超导相。本文研究该体系中谷畴壁的输运性质，指出在金属态下谷畴壁对输运近似为不可穿透屏障，电子透射需依赖间谷相互作用。作者还发现，在连接相反手性超导区域的 SNS' 约瑟夫森结中，间谷混合对于产生显著超电流至关重要。

articles.title: Study of Hydrogen Storage Capacity of Double Perovskite Hydrides X2PdH6 (Li, Na, K, Rb) and Physical Aspects by DFT Approach
articles.title_zh: 基于 DFT 的双钙钛矿氢化物 X₂PdH₆（Li、Na、K、Rb）储氢容量与物理性质研究
articles.abstract: The unique structural framework and chemical properties of double perovskite hydrides make them prospective materials for hydrogen (H₂) storage. In the current article, the H2 storage capacity, desorption temperature, and key physical characteristics of X2PdH6 (Li, Na, K, Rb) are systematically studied by the WIEN2k code. The tolerance factor ensures structural existence, whereas formation energy and Born criteria certify thermodynamic and mechanical stability. The Li2PdH6, Na2PdH6, K2PdH6, and Rb2PdH6 have H₂ storage capacities 4.79%, 3.82%, 3.17%, and 2.13%, respectively. The H2 desorption temperatures 261.67K, 294.47K, 354.79K, and 434.62K, respectively, are reported. The 𝑇𝑑𝑒𝑠 of Li2PdH6, Na2PdH6 lie in the ideal range of 233 to 333K. The mechanical analysis reveals a ductile and anisotropic nature, characterized by high melting and Debye temperatures, along with minimal directional lattice thermal conductivity. Moreover, the optical properties are comprehensively analyzed through parameters such as the dielectric constant, optical loss, refractive index, absorption coefficient, and reflectivity of light energy. The modification of the band gap from 3.0 to 2.28 eV enables a range of optoelectronic applications, especially operating in the ultraviolet region. Therefore, the investigated materials have potential for both H2 storage and clean energy harvesting.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用 WIEN2k 代码系统研究双钙钛矿氢化物 X₂PdH₆（X = Li、Na、K、Rb）的储氢能力、脱附温度及相关物理性质。结果显示 Li₂PdH₆、Na₂PdH₆、K₂PdH₆ 和 Rb₂PdH₆ 的储氢质量分数分别为 4.79%、3.82%、3.17% 和 2.13%，其中 Li 和 Na 体系的脱附温度处于较理想范围。力学分析表明这些材料具有延展性和各向异性，光学性质与带隙变化也被进一步讨论。

articles.title: Nonlinear interaction of Kinetic Alfvén Waves with Electrons
articles.title_zh: 动力学阿尔芬波与电子的非线性相互作用
articles.abstract: Understanding solar wind acceleration and solar coronal heating remains a paramount, unresolved problem in space plasma physics. Kinetic Alfvén Waves (KAWs) and their cross-scale interactions are widely indicated to play a key role by channeling energy into particle heating and acceleration. In this paper, we investigate the dynamics of nonlinear KAW-particle interactions within a background density profile modified self-consistently by ponderomotive force and Joule heating. Numerical simulations are executed utilizing a high-resolution pseudospectral method to evaluate the time-dependent morphological evolution of coherent magnetic structures and the generation of magnetic field turbulence spectra. Our transient analyses reveal that early-stage localized, intense coherent structures progressively saturate and fragment into complex, spatially distributed current filaments over time. In wavenumber space, the saturated magnetic power spectra track the classical Kolmogorov scaling of k −5/3 ⊥ in the inertial range, followed by a distinct spectral break and steepened scaling near the electron kinetic threshold (k ⊥ λ e ≈ 1). This spectral broadening and energy redistribution provide direct evidence of strong kinetic mode coupling. Micro-physically, self-consistently generated parallel electric fields drive robust collisionless Lan-dau resonance. This drives severe structural deformation of the electron parallel velocity distribution function (VDF) into a quasilinear change (∂f /∂v ∥ → 0) alongside a prominent suprathermal tail (v ∥ /v te > 3.5). These findings demonstrate that nonlinear KAW-electron coupling efficiently converts macroscopic fluid cascades into micro-physical thermalization, offering crucial insights into plasma heating across solar coronal, auroral, and interstellar environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 太阳风加速和日冕加热是空间等离子体物理中的重要未解问题，动力学阿尔芬波及其跨尺度相互作用被认为在能量向粒子加热和加速转移中发挥关键作用。本文在由有质动力和焦耳加热自洽改变的背景密度剖面下，数值研究非线性 KAW-粒子相互作用。高分辨率伪谱模拟显示，早期局域强相干结构会逐渐饱和并破碎为复杂电流丝，磁功率谱在惯性区接近 Kolmogorov 的 k⊥−5/3 标度，并在电子动力学尺度附近出现谱断裂和变陡。

articles.title: Quantum Autoencoders for Anomaly Detection in Cybersecurity
articles.title_zh: 用于网络安全异常检测的量子自编码器
articles.abstract: Anomaly detection in cybersecurity is a challenging task, where normal events far outnumber anomalous ones with new anomalies occurring frequently. Classical autoencoders have been used for anomaly detection, but struggles in data-limited settings which quantum counterparts can potentially overcome. In this work, we apply Quantum Autoencoders (QAEs) for anomaly detection in cybersecurity, specifically on the BPF-extended tracking honeypot (BETH) dataset. QAEs are evaluated across multiple encoding techniques, ansatz types, repetitions, and feature selection strategies. Our results demonstrate that an 8-feature QAE using Dense-Angle encoding with a RealAmplitude ansatz can outperform Classical Autoencoders (CAEs), even when trained on substantially fewer samples. The effects of quantum encoding and feature selection for developing quantum models are demonstrated and discussed. In a data-limited setting, the best performing QAE model has a F1 score of 0.87, better than that of CAE (0.77). These findings suggest that QAEs may offer practical advantages for anomaly detection in data-limited scenarios.
articles.abstract_zh: 网络安全异常检测面临正常样本远多于异常样本且新型异常不断出现的挑战，经典自编码器在数据受限场景下性能可能受限。本文将量子自编码器应用于 BETH 蜜罐数据集的异常检测，并比较不同编码方式、线路 ansatz、重复次数和特征选择策略。结果表明，采用 Dense-Angle 编码和 RealAmplitude ansatz 的 8 特征 QAE 在少量训练样本下可优于经典自编码器，最佳 F1 分数为 0.87，高于经典模型的 0.77。

articles.title: Geomagnetic reversals are modulated by the motion of basal mantle structures
articles.title_zh: 地磁反转受基底地幔结构运动调制
articles.abstract: The Earth cools over time via convection. In the mantle, solid-state convection over millions of years changes heat and mass distribution and causes adjustments of Earth’s inertia axis with respect to the spin axis. In the outer core, convection of a liquid iron alloy drives dynamo action and generates a magnetic field that episodically changes polarity. Periods without any polarity reversals for tens of million years, called superchrons, have long been thought to be related to changes in core-mantle boundary (CMB) heat flux. However, a quantitative link between CMB heat flux and geomagnetic reversals has remained elusive. Here, we identify a strong correlation between changes in the amplitude of inertia-corrected equatorial CMB heat flux heterogeneities and geomagnetic reversal frequencies from 170 million years ago. This correlation is due to changes in the equatorial extent of hot basal mantle structures that increased during the Jurassic reversal hyperactivity period and decreased during the Cretaceous Normal Superchron. The direct relationship between CMB heat flux predicted by our models and reversal frequencies is driven by changes at shorter wavelengths than previously considered, opening new avenues to investigate the links between CMB heat flux heterogeneities, outer core stratification, and reversal frequencies.
articles.abstract_zh: 地球外核液态铁合金对流产生地磁场并导致偶发极性反转，而长期无反转的超静磁期被认为可能与核幔边界热通量变化相关。本文从 1.7 亿年以来的模型与记录出发，发现经惯性校正的赤道核幔边界热通量非均匀性幅度变化与地磁反转频率之间存在强相关。研究认为，这种相关性源于热的基底地幔结构赤道范围的变化，并指出较短波长的核幔边界热通量变化在调制反转频率中起关键作用。

articles.title: A Visual Guided Physics Informed Neural Networks Framework for Real Time Coagulant Dose Optimization in Water Treatment Plants
articles.title_zh: 用于水处理厂混凝剂投加实时优化的视觉引导物理信息神经网络框架
articles.abstract: Real-time sensing and visual information provide significant opportunities to reveal the internal dynamics of flocculation–coagulation processes in water treatment systems. Industrial operations commonly rely on turbidity measurements, while research studies frequently employ the degree of flocculation (DF) as a process indicator. However, both parameters exhibit inherent physical delays because they represent macroscopic outcomes of particle aggregation and sedimentation that require time to become observable. As a result, conventional control strategies depend on reactive adjustments based on previous system states, reducing operational efficiency and limiting prediction accuracy. To overcome these limitations, this study proposes a Real-Time Sensing and Visual Information-Guided Physics-Informed Neural Networks (RTS-VG PINNs) framework. The proposed method integrates real-time sensing, deep visual perception, and governing physical laws into unified learning architecture. A ResNet-50-based feature extractor combined with YOLOv8 is employed to identify regions of interest and extract early-stage predictive features from image sequences. These features are mapped to the time-varying effective sedimentation velocity within the Kynch sedimentation partial differential equation and coupled with the Langmuir–Smoluchowski formulation to estimate optimal coagulant dosage. Experimental results demonstrate that RTS-VG PINNs achieves superior predictive performance compared with purely data-driven models while maintaining low PDE residuals on the order of 10− 3. The framework successfully captures nonlinear relationships among coagulant dosage, turbidity, and zeta potential, reconstructs internal floc density distributions, and provides robust inverse predictions under limited and noisy data conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 水处理混凝—絮凝过程中的浊度和絮凝度等常用指标存在物理滞后，导致传统控制策略多依赖对既往状态的反应式调节。本文提出实时传感与视觉信息引导的物理信息神经网络框架，将实时传感、深度视觉感知和控制方程整合到统一学习架构中。该方法使用 ResNet-50 与 YOLOv8 从图像序列中提取早期预测特征，以支持混凝剂投加的实时优化。

articles.title: Exploring the Feasibility of the Anisotropic Property of ReS₂ in Long-Range Surface Plasmonic Sensing for Superior Performance
articles.title_zh: 利用ReS₂各向异性提升长程表面等离激元传感性能的可行性研究
articles.abstract: This paper presents a novel Kretschmann-configured Long-Range Surface Plasmon Resonance (LRSPR) sensor based on the anisotropic property of Rhenium disulfide (ReS₂) for highly sensitive biomolecular detection. The proposed sensor employs silver (Ag) as the plasmonic metal layer and Lithium niobate (LiNbO₃) as a protective passivation layer to prevent Ag oxidation and enhance stability. The rotation angle is fixed at θ = 0° to maximise the interaction between incident light and the Re-Re atomic chains of ReS₂. The proposed structure of the sensor is analysed using the Transfer Matrix Method (TMM) in MATLAB, while electromagnetic field distributions and LRSPP modes are investigated through COMSOL Multiphysics simulations. The monolayer ReS₂-based sensor achieves an imaging sensitivity (Simg.) of 18,361 RIU-1, detection accuracy (DA) of 100/°, angular figure of merit (FOMang.) of 1200 RIU-1, and penetration depth (PD) of 713.11 nm. Further enhancement in Simg is observed for bilayer and trilayer of ReS₂-based sensors. Compared with the conventional SPR sensor, the proposed LRSPR sensor demonstrates significantly improved performance parameters, which makes it highly suitable for ultrasensitive detection of biomolecules in advanced biosensing applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种基于二硫化铼各向异性的Kretschmann结构长程表面等离激元共振传感器，用于高灵敏生物分子检测。传感器采用银作为等离激元金属层，铌酸锂作为钝化保护层以抑制银氧化，并将ReS₂旋转角固定在0°以增强入射光与Re-Re原子链的相互作用。通过传输矩阵法和COMSOL仿真，单层ReS₂结构获得较高成像灵敏度、检测精度、品质因数和穿透深度，双层和三层结构还可进一步提升灵敏度。

articles.title: Earth–Brain Computer Interface a cross-disciplinary framework for earthquake and volcanic eruption forecasting
articles.title_zh: 地球—脑机接口：用于地震与火山喷发预测的跨学科框架
articles.abstract: Accurate forecasting of earthquakes and volcanic eruptions remains one of the foremost unsolved challenges in geoscience. Here we propose the Earth–Brain Computer Interface (E-BCI), a cross-disciplinary predictive framework that maps established brain–computer interface (BCI) methodology onto geophysical monitoring. We draw a systematic analogy between cortical neural dynamics and Earth's internal processes: tectonic plate networks correspond to neural connectivity topology, seismic wavefields to action potentials, magmatic degassing to neurotransmitter release, and crustal stress accumulation to neuronal excitation–inhibition balance. Building on this conceptual foundation, the E-BCI architecture integrates three layers: a multi-sensor acquisition layer comprising global seismograph networks, distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) arrays, GNSS deformation networks and satellite remote sensing; a signal-decoding layer employing deep learning architectures (Transformer, LSTM, RNN-DAS) for real-time feature extraction; and a prediction layer delivering probabilistic seismic and volcanic forecasts. A key methodological innovation is the ergodic precursor transfer learning strategy, which enables knowledge transfer across data-scarce fault zones and volcanoes. Proof-of-concept experiments indicate 78% recall for M≥6.0 earthquakes within a 72-hour window and eruption-onset lead times of 3–7 days at La Palma and Piton de la Fournaise volcanoes. We discuss outstanding challenges including temporal-scale disparity, data heterogeneity, and model interpretability, and outline prospects toward a global E-BCI sensor network and a physics–data fusion digital twin of the Earth.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出“地球—脑机接口”概念框架，将脑机接口方法类比并迁移到地球物理监测与灾害预测中。作者将板块网络、地震波场、岩浆脱气和地壳应力积累分别类比为神经连接、动作电位、神经递质释放和兴奋—抑制平衡。框架包括多传感器采集层、基于Transformer、LSTM和RNN-DAS等模型的信号解码层，以及输出概率化地震和火山预测的预测层，并提出前兆迁移学习策略作为方法创新。

articles.title: In-situ microwave modulation of non-equilibrium solidification stress in direct additive manufacturing of ternary eutectic ceramics
articles.title_zh: 三元共晶陶瓷直接增材制造中非平衡凝固应力的原位微波调控
articles.abstract: Direct, binder-free additive manufacturing of eutectic ceramics via laser directed energy deposition (LDED) offers immense potential. However, extreme temperature gradients during rapid melting and solidification induce severe thermal stress concentrations, rendering the fabricated components highly susceptible to cracking. Here, we propose an in-situ microwave-laser hybrid additive manufacturing approach for Al2O3/YAG/ZrO2 (AYZ) ternary eutectic ceramics. By leveraging a microwave hybrid heating mechanism featuring external microwave absorbing preheating, laser activated melt pool generation, and internal volumetric heating, we achieve continuous modulation of the thermal field and stress evolution throughout the entire deposition process. The in-situ microwave assistance reduces the maximum first principal stress in the initial deposited layer by 91.7% compared to conditions without microwave assistance. Concurrently, it decreases crack density and maximum crack length by 90.4% and 92.1%, respectively, ultimately enabling the successful fabrication of hundred-millimeter-scale crack-free components. This study establishes a robust in situ thermal stress modulation strategy for highly crack-sensitive oxide eutectic ceramics, providing fundamental insights and technical pathways for the high-quality laser additive manufacturing of complex melt-growth ceramics (MGCs) components.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对激光定向能量沉积直接制造共晶陶瓷时因急剧温度梯度导致热应力集中和开裂的问题，提出原位微波-激光复合增材制造方法。以Al₂O₃/YAG/ZrO₂三元共晶陶瓷为对象，作者通过外部微波吸收预热、激光激活熔池和内部体积加热协同调控沉积过程中的热场与应力演化。结果表明，微波辅助显著降低初始沉积层最大第一主应力、裂纹密度和最大裂纹长度，并实现百毫米尺度无裂纹构件制备。

articles.title: Structural origins of composition-dependent elasticity in DGEBA/BER epoxy networks from molecular dynamics simulations
articles.title_zh: 基于分子动力学模拟揭示DGEBA/BER环氧网络组成依赖弹性的结构起源
articles.abstract: Publication date: 25 June 2026 Source: Computational Materials Science, Volume 271 Author(s): Manoj Pola, Alexey V. Lyulin
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作围绕DGEBA/BER环氧网络中弹性性能随组成变化的微观结构起源展开，并采用分子动力学模拟进行分析。由于所给摘要仅包含出版元数据，具体建模方法、交联网络特征、力学参数和结构—性能关联结论需查阅原文。该研究可为环氧树脂配方设计及高分子网络力学性能调控提供分子尺度参考。

articles.title: MDcraft – A modern molecular dynamics simulation package with machine learning potentials support
articles.title_zh: MDcraft：支持机器学习势的现代分子动力学模拟软件包
articles.abstract: Publication date: October 2026 Source: Computer Physics Communications, Volume 327 Author(s): I.S. Galtsov, R.V. Muratov, G.V. Vyskvarko, S.A. Murzov, S.A. Dyachkov, P.R. Levashov
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作介绍MDcraft这一现代分子动力学模拟软件包，重点在于支持机器学习势以扩展材料模拟能力。由于所给摘要仅包含出版信息，软件架构、算法实现、支持的势函数类型、性能测试和应用示例需查阅原文。该软件可能面向高效原子尺度模拟以及传统分子动力学与机器学习势能模型的结合。

articles.title: Fast thermalization with quantum algorithms
articles.title_zh: 利用量子算法实现快速热化
articles.abstract: Nature Physics, Published online: 03 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03357-6 Quantum algorithms excel at simulating Hamiltonian dynamics, but they struggle with preparing the thermal equilibrium states needed for quantum simulation. Now it has been shown that a recent algorithm can efficiently prepare an important class of thermal states.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道关注量子模拟中热平衡态制备这一关键难题，指出尽管量子算法擅长模拟哈密顿量动力学，但热态制备仍具挑战性。文章介绍了一种近期算法能够高效制备一类重要热态的进展。该成果有望提升量子模拟在研究有限温度物理体系时的实用性。

articles.title: Quantum mutual information as a robust probe of integrability in open quantum systems
articles.title_zh: 量子互信息作为开放量子系统中可积性的稳健探针
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02462v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The dynamics of a quantum system encode signatures of whether the underlying Hamiltonian is integrable or chaotic, giving rise to the concept of quantum information scrambling through the properties of the resulting dynamical states or operators. We introduce an information-theoretic framework based on the Haar-averaged sum of total correlations (aSTC), together with average genuine multipartite entanglement generated dynamically from initially fully separable states, as robust probes of quantum information scrambling. Using the long-range quantum XYZ spin model in transverse and longitudinal magnetic fields, whose integrable limit is the nearest-neighbor transverse XY model, we demonstrate that the long-time average and, more importantly, the temporal fluctuations of the aSTC provide a faithful and system-size-independent signature of integrable and chaotic dynamics, similar to the conventional measure of scrambling, out-of-time-ordered correlator (OTOC). When the system is in contact with the thermal reservoir and system-bath coupling follows Markovianity, we find that the fluctuations of the aSTC and OTOC continue to distinguish integrable and chaotic dynamics only at intermediate times. However, we observe that in the non-Markovian domain, information backflow restores the scrambling dynamics, enabling the aSTC to retain its distinguishing power even at long times. Interestingly, we exhibit that, under Markovian amplitude damping and non-Markovian dephasing noise, the temporal fluctuations of the aSTC can discriminate between integrability and non-integrability in the weak Markovian regime, even when OTOC fails to do so.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出基于 Haar 平均总关联和动态生成的平均真实多体纠缠的信息论框架，用于探测量子信息扰乱并区分可积与混沌动力学。作者以长程量子 XYZ 自旋模型为例，表明平均总关联的长时间平均值及尤其是时间涨落，可作为与 OTOC 类似且对系统尺寸较稳健的判据。研究还讨论了系统与热库发生马尔可夫耦合时这些量在开放量子系统中的适用性。
authors: Nirupam Sen, Keshav Das Agarwal, Aditi Sen De

articles.title: The Effect of Magnetic and Non-Magnetic Impurities on Crystal Structure and Magnetic Properties of Electron-Doped Eu2-xCexCuO4 in Overdoped Regime
articles.title_zh: 磁性与非磁性杂质对过掺杂电子型 Eu2-xCexCuO4 晶体结构和磁性质的影响
articles.abstract: The most widely studied superconducting materials currently being studied are high-Tc cuprate-based superconductors, known as High-Tc Superconducting Cuprates (HTSC). HTSC research has two main focuses, producing superconducting materials with Tc at room temperature and studying the phenomenon of superconductivity. The effect of impurities on HTSC in overdoped region is very important to study, especially interesting phenomena such as Quantum Critical Point, cooper-pair breaking and stripe pinning. To investigate the effect of substituting magnetic (Fe) and non-magnetic (Zn) impurities on the superconducting properties of Eu2-xCexCuO4 (ECCO) in the overdoped regime. In this study we have chosen the concentration of x = 0.16 and 0.17, for y = 0.05 and has been synthesized by the solid-state reaction method. The crystal structure and magnetic properties of the samples were characterized by XRD and SQUID measurements. From the XRD data on all samples, the intensity values of the two highest diffraction peaks were found with the Miller indices (013) and (110). This indicates that the crystal structure formed is tetragonal (T'). From susceptibility measurements, with 0.5% of Fe and Zn impurity for all samples have the paramagnetic behaviour. The magnetic parameter values C and (:μ:ₑff) of all samples showed an increase with increasing Ce concentration. The increase in Curie constant and effective magnetic moment suggests enhanced localized magnetic contributions due to impurity substitution. The findings provide new insight into the role of impurity driven magnetism in electron-doped cuprates in the overdoped regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 该预印本研究 Fe 磁性杂质和 Zn 非磁性杂质替代对过掺杂 Eu2-xCexCuO4 超导体结构与磁性质的影响，样品采用固相反应法制备。XRD 表征显示样品主要衍射峰对应四方 T′ 晶体结构，磁化率则通过 SQUID 测量获得。摘要内容在末尾截断，因此关于 Fe、Zn 掺杂对超导转变或磁响应的具体影响需查阅原文。

articles.title: Design of Cooperative Converter with Optimized Deep Learning based Control Mechanism of Battery Cell Balancing for Automotive Applications
articles.title_zh: 面向汽车应用的基于优化深度学习控制的协同变换器电池单体均衡设计
articles.abstract: This paper presents a high power density battery cell balancing system for the electro-mobility application that integrates a voltage step-up and a cell balancing function in one converter topology. The Co-operative conversion technique is used and realized by means of a number of dual active bridge (CO-DAB) converter modules. The converter processes only a portion of the output power, proportional to the difference in voltage of the battery pack and the converter output, thus a smaller converter can be designed than conventional solutions. Furthermore, it does lead to more efficient power processing at the system level as well. The modular structure of the converter allows multiple connection to each battery cell for online cell balancing in the case of standstill, charging, and discharging modes. System is controlled through practical Deep Balancing Network (DBNet) Layer controller, which can perform cell balancing and output voltage regulation simultaneously. Simulation results of a cooperating converter for a 24–48 V, 250 W, and 120 kHz converter for small automotive motors have shown that the cooperative converter combines both functions and leads to physically smaller and more efficient power processing elements than traditional DAB and boost converters. The Co-operative DAB converter runs with a peak efficiency of 96.4% and extracts 64% of the output power.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种面向电动交通应用的高功率密度电池单体均衡系统，将升压与电池均衡功能集成在协同双有源桥变换器拓扑中。该方案仅处理与电池组电压和输出电压差相关的一部分功率，有望缩小变换器尺寸并提高系统级效率。作者引入深度均衡网络控制器以同时实现单体均衡和输出电压调节，并通过小型汽车电机用 24–48 V、250 W、120 kHz 系统仿真验证其可行性。

articles.title: Stick-Slip-Induced Time Delays in Reconfigurable Systems: Data-Driven Estimation and Sliding Mode Control
articles.title_zh: 可重构系统中黏滑诱导时延的数据驱动估计与滑模控制
articles.abstract: Stick-slip friction in reconfigurable mechanisms, such as cable-driven and tensegrity systems, introduces unknown and variable time delays that degrade trajectory tracking and control stability. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a novel hybrid control architecture that integrates data-driven delay prediction with a robust Super-Twisting Sliding Mode Controller. An experimental testbed is used to characterize stick-slip latency, leading to the development of a shallow Artificial Neural Network (ANN) that predicts real-time delay dynamics from measurable physical parameters (stiffness, force tension, weight, and speed). This neural predictor feeds a historical state buffer, injecting the delayed state directly into the equivalent control law for active latency compensation without requiring complex analytical friction models. Furthermore, robust asymptotic stability is formally guaranteed using a delay-dependent Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional and Linear Matrix Inequalities (LMIs) to systematically optimize the sliding surface gains. Validation on a cable-driven rehabilitator and a rotational tensegrity system demonstrates that the proposed LMI-optimized Super-Twisting Sliding Mode Controller significantly mitigates chattering and improves tracking precision, reducing the Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) by up to 99% compared to conventional heuristic tuning methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对缆驱动和张拉整体等可重构机构中的黏滑摩擦导致的未知可变时延问题，提出结合数据驱动时延预测与超螺旋滑模控制的混合控制架构。作者利用实验平台表征黏滑延迟，并训练浅层人工神经网络根据刚度、张力、载荷和速度等可测参数实时预测时延。预测结果被用于历史状态缓冲与等效控制律中的主动补偿，同时借助 Lyapunov-Krasovskii 泛函和线性矩阵不等式保证并优化稳定性。

articles.title: Orbitronics clears key hurdle with direct orbital currents, boosting signals 100-fold
articles.title_zh: 轨道电子学突破关键障碍：直接轨道电流使信号增强百倍
articles.abstract: Researchers at Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz (JGU) are the first to directly utilize orbital currents without the need for conversion of the orbital current into a spin current.
articles.abstract_zh: 这则物理新闻报道了美因茨约翰内斯·古腾堡大学研究人员在轨道电子学中的进展：他们首次无需将轨道电流转换为自旋电流即可直接利用轨道电流。该结果被认为可显著增强相关信号，并推动基于电子轨道自由度的新型器件研究。具体实验体系和技术细节需查阅原报道或相关论文。

articles.title: Spontaneous current loops in a kagome metal point to hidden quantum order
articles.title_zh: kagome 金属中的自发电流环指向隐藏量子有序
articles.abstract: Quantum materials, materials exhibiting physical behavior governed by the laws of quantum mechanics, have proved promising for the development of numerous advanced technologies, including quantum technologies, memory devices and solar panels. In some of these materials, electrons can collectively arrange themselves in unusual patterns, giving rise to states that cannot be explained by classical physics theories.
articles.abstract_zh: 该新闻报道介绍了在 kagome 金属中观察到的自发电流环现象，暗示材料内部可能存在隐藏的量子有序。此类量子材料中的电子可形成难以用经典理论解释的集体排列，对量子技术、存储器件和光电应用具有潜在意义。具体材料、测量方法和理论解释需参阅原文。

articles.title: Quantum properties of multimode light observed despite extreme losses
articles.title_zh: 在极端损耗下仍观测到多模光的量子性质
articles.abstract: Quantum properties of light are extremely delicate. When researchers attempt to measure them, even small losses on the way to a detector can make them invisible, limiting their use outside carefully controlled environments. A collaborative team of researchers involving scientists at the Max Planck Institute for the Science of Light (MPL) has shown a new way to measure several quantum channels of light at the same time and reveal their entanglement, even when almost all of the light is lost before reaching the detector. The results, recently published in Nature Communications, open new possibilities for scalable quantum technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该新闻报道介绍了一项关于多模量子光测量的新进展：研究团队提出方法，可在到达探测器前几乎全部光损失的情况下，同时测量多个量子光通道并揭示其纠缠。该成果有望缓解量子光态对损耗高度敏感这一限制，为可扩展量子技术提供新的测量思路。相关结果已发表于《自然·通讯》，具体方案和实验条件需查阅原论文。

articles.title: From Dirac Cones to Semions: An Exact Finite-Size Theory of Parity-Anomaly Transport in Chiral Spin Liquids
articles.title_zh: 从狄拉克锥到半任意子：手性自旋液体中奇偶反常输运的精确有限尺寸理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01341v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chiral spin liquids carry a hidden bookkeeping problem: the integer Chern number of their fractionalized spinons, the level of the emergent Chern--Simons gauge field, and the fractional spin response actually measured in experiment or simulation are related but distinct quantities, and the literature routinely conflates them. Here we resolve this by deriving the exact parity-odd determinant of a gapped Dirac cone on a spatial cylinder, resummed to all orders in the compact holonomy rather than truncated at leading order. The result proves that finite-circumference corrections to the topological response are strictly exponential, with no universal 1/L term, and fixes the precise map from microscopic spinon Chern number to physical spin Hall conductance. We validate this chain of reasoning on the kagome lattice at three independent levels: an exact parton band-structure calculation (C=-1, converging exponentially over cylinders four to twelve sites wide), and an interacting density-matrix renormalization group flux pump (νₛ₌₋₀.500±0.011) that agrees with the analytic prediction without any adjustable parameter. Together, these results turn a one-loop anomaly calculation into a quantitatively verified bridge between microscopic topology and observable fractional response.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文澄清了手性自旋液体中分数量子数、自旋子陈数、涌现 Chern-Simons 规范场能级和可测分数自旋响应之间的关系。作者推导了空间圆柱上带隙狄拉克锥的精确奇宇称行列式，并证明有限周长对拓扑响应的修正严格呈指数衰减，不存在普适的 1/L 项。研究进一步在 kagome 晶格上通过 parton 能带计算与相互作用 DMRG 通量泵浦验证了从微观自旋子陈数到物理自旋霍尔电导的映射。

articles.title: Quantum Tunneling-induced Hybridization and Coherent Dynamics of Jackiw-Rebbi Zero Modes in a Modified Su-Schrieffer-Heeger Chain
articles.title_zh: 改进 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger 链中量子隧穿诱导的 Jackiw-Rebbi 零模杂化与相干动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01344v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate analytically and numerically the tunneling-induced hybridization and coherent dynamics of Jackiw-Rebbi (JR) zero modes in a modified Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) model. Unlike the conventional SSH model, this modified system possess two bulk gap closing points, namely, the quadratic-type gap closing point at k=0 and the Dirac-type gap closing point at k=±π/4a. While the quadratic point does not support a topological domain wall due to the absence of mass inversion, the low-energy Dirac theory around k=±π/4a predicts an effective mass that changes sign at two spatially separated interfaces under a kink profile, generating a pair of JR bound states localized at those interfaces. We show that finite overlap between the JR zero modes lifts the zero-energy degeneracy through quantum tunneling, producing symmetric-antisymmetric hybridized states analogous to a quantum mechanical double-well system. An effective two-level description reveals coherent oscillations of the occupation probability between the two JR modes, accompanied by periodic transfer of sublattice polarization between the (A,C) and (B,D) sectors. The oscillation period is governed by the hybridization gap, providing a tunable route for controlling topological bound states. Our results establish a unified framework connecting JR zero modes, quantum tunneling, and coherent dynamics in modified SSH systems, offering a promising platform for controllable topological quantum-state transfer in engineered lattice structures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究解析和数值考察了改进 SSH 模型中 Jackiw-Rebbi 零模因量子隧穿而发生的杂化及其相干动力学。与传统 SSH 模型不同，该体系具有二次型和狄拉克型两个体能隙闭合点，其中狄拉克低能理论在 kink 构型下预言两个空间分离界面处的 JR 束缚态。有限重叠会解除零能简并，形成类似双势阱的对称/反对称杂化态，并导致两个 JR 模之间占据概率及亚晶格极化的周期性转移。

articles.title: Fabrication of high-quality topological insulator nanodevices from bulk-insulating air-sensitive Sb-Bi₂Se₃
articles.title_zh: 由体绝缘、空气敏感 Sb-Bi₂Se₃ 制备高质量拓扑绝缘体纳米器件
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01439v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-quality topological insulator (TI) materials are essential for the realization and detection of Majorana bound states (MBSs) in TI-superconductor hybrid platforms. Widely used compensated TIs exhibit substantial disorder and charge inhomogeneity, which may be detrimental for Majorana devices. In this regard, Sb-substituted Bi₂Se₃ (SBS) is promising, because it is non-compensated and yet achieves very low bulk carrier density. We systematically investigate the impact of thermal processing during microfabrication on the transport properties of SBS. We developed a room-temperature fabrication protocol that preserves the low carrier density of exfoliated SBS upon fabrication of Hall bar and nanowire devices as evidenced from the observation of quantum interference oscillations in nanowires, a large gate tunability, and clear signatures of weak antilocalization (WAL).
articles.abstract_zh: 该文面向拓扑绝缘体-超导体混合平台中 Majorana 束缚态的实现与探测，研究 Sb 掺杂 Bi₂Se₃ 这类低体载流子密度且非补偿拓扑绝缘体的纳米器件制备。作者系统考察微加工热处理对输运性质的影响，并发展了室温制备流程以保持剥离样品的低载流子密度。霍尔条和纳米线器件中的量子干涉振荡、强栅压可调性以及弱反局域化特征表明该流程可制备高质量器件。
authors: Linh T. Dang, Ayushi Solanki, Yongjian Wang, Oliver Breunig, Yoichi Ando

articles.title: Nonperturbative Nonlinear Hall Effect in Nonequilibrium Steady States
articles.title_zh: 非平衡稳态中的非微扰非线性霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01519v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The nonlinear Hall effect in quantum materials has attracted broad interest, yet most existing studies focus on the weak-field, perturbative regime. Here we develop a nonperturbative approach based on nonequilibrium steady-state Green's functions for dc-field-driven lattice systems, with dissipation and interactions incorporated through self-energies beyond the constant relaxation-time approximation and interband transitions treated alongside their intraband counterparts. Applied to a two-band semimetal model, our approach provides direct access to the strong-field Hall response beyond the nonperturbative crossover where the edge of the nonequilibrium distribution reaches Berry-curvature hot spots, a regime in which constant relaxation-time estimates and Berry curvature dipole calculations become unreliable. We further demonstrate that interaction and electron-phonon self-energies within dynamical mean-field theory can substantially change the Hall signal. Our framework enables quantitative simulations of nonequilibrium nonlinear Hall phenomena and provides guidance for strong-field transport experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对量子材料中强直流场驱动下的非线性霍尔效应，发展了基于非平衡稳态格林函数的非微扰理论框架。该方法可纳入耗散和相互作用自能，超越常数弛豫时间近似，并同时处理带内与带间跃迁。作者将其应用于双带半金属模型，展示强场区域中传统 Berry 曲率偶极和常数弛豫时间估计的局限，并说明相互作用及电子-声子自能可显著改变霍尔信号。
authors: Lei Geng, Martin Eckstein, Lei Chen, Shouvik Sur, Silke Paschen, Qimiao Si, Philipp Werner

articles.title: Phase-selective orbital-charge conversion in MoTe₂
articles.title_zh: MoTe₂中的相选择性轨道-电荷转换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01623v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-dimensional transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) have emerged as promising materials for spin--orbitronics owing to their strong spin--orbit coupling and rich electronic phases. However, their orbital transport properties remain largely unexplored. Here, we demonstrate that the orbitronic response of MoTe₂ is governed by a thickness-driven structural phase transition. RF-sputtered MoTe₂ thin films exhibit a crossover at a critical thickness of approximately 4.5,nm, stabilizing in the metallic 1T^prime phase below this threshold and in the semiconducting 2H phase above it. Raman spectroscopy and scanning tunneling spectroscopy (STS) confirm the structural and electronic transition, revealing gapless behavior in ultrathin films and a finite band gap in thicker samples. Spin-pumping measurements detect an additional transverse charge-conversion signal exclusively in metallic 1T^prime-MoTe₂, in agreement with first-principles calculations that identify a dominant orbital Rashba--Edelstein response as the underlying conversion mechanism.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究表明，MoTe₂的轨道电子学响应受厚度驱动的结构相变支配。射频溅射薄膜在约4.5 nm临界厚度附近发生转变：更薄样品稳定为金属性1T′相，更厚样品为半导体2H相。拉曼光谱、扫描隧道谱和自旋泵浦实验显示，额外的横向电荷转换信号仅出现在金属性1T′-MoTe₂中，第一性原理计算将其归因于占主导的轨道Rashba–Edelstein响应。
authors: J. L. Costa, E. Santos, G. R. Gallo, G. Rodrigues-Junior, R. O. Cunha, E. L. T. França, R. Cardias, T. G. Rappoport, J. B. S. Mendes, A. Azevedo

articles.title: Many-body benchmarking of DFT local-registry energetics in bilayer InSe
articles.title_zh: 双层InSe中DFT局域堆垛能量的多体基准检验
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01682v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Density functional theory (DFT) is widely used to model twisted bilayers, but the accuracy of the local stacking energetics underlying such models remains uncertain. Here, we benchmark the local-registry landscape of bilayer InSe using diffusion quantum Monte Carlo (DMC). DFT predicts that AB, AAr, and ABr stackings, which share the same interfacial Se registry, are nearly degenerate within 1.5 meV/f.u. and exhibit nearly indistinguishable DFT charge-density responses. DMC instead separates these stackings by 8(5) and 41(4) meV/f.u., while the energy difference between the most stable and least stable registries reaches 60(7) meV/f.u.. These large energy separations show that the stacking energetics are not determined by the interfacial atomic motif alone but depend on the full registry and its associated many-body electronic response. More broadly, these results show that DFT-based moiré models can substantially underestimate local stacking-energy corrugation, with direct consequences for predicted structural relaxation, domain formation, and electronic reconstruction in twisted layered materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用扩散量子蒙特卡罗方法检验双层InSe局域堆垛能量景观中密度泛函理论的准确性。DFT预测若干具有相同界面Se配位的堆垛近乎简并，但DMC给出了显著更大的能量分裂，表明堆垛能量不仅由界面原子图案决定，还取决于完整配准及其多体电子响应。研究指出，基于DFT的莫尔模型可能低估局域堆垛能量起伏，从而影响对结构弛豫、畴形成和电子重构的预测。
authors: Jeonghwan Ahn, Abdulgani Annaberdiyev, Jovan Nelson, Nathaniel P. Stern, Hyeondeok Shin

articles.title: Quantum Heat Under the Microscope: A Perspective on Cryogenic Scanning Thermal Microscopy
articles.title_zh: 显微镜下的量子热：低温扫描热显微术展望
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01691v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Exploring thermal transport at cryogenic temperatures presents both significant challenges and valuable insights. By uncovering the thermal counterpart of well-known quantum phenomena, researchers investigated fascinating phenomena ranging from the violation of the Wiedemann-Franz law to the quantisation of phonons. One key frontier remains : no existing method can image local heat transport at the nanoscale under cryogenic conditions. In this Perspective, we review the current state state of the art of local heat transport characterisation techniques and highlight their limitations. As a motivation for the development of cryogenic Scanning Thermal Microscopy, we provide five case studies illustrating how this approach could deepen our understanding of exotic quantum phases and enable the emergence of transformative technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该展望文章讨论低温下热输运研究的挑战与机遇，强调当前尚缺乏能够在低温条件下纳米尺度成像局域热输运的方法。作者综述了现有局域热输运表征技术及其局限，并以五个案例说明低温扫描热显微术的发展潜力。该方法有望加深对奇异量子相中热现象的理解，并推动相关低温量子技术的发展。
authors: Valentin Fonck, Jean Spiece, Pascal Gehring

articles.title: Elastic Modulus in One-Dimensional Quantum Droplets
articles.title_zh: 一维量子液滴中的弹性模量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01863v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum droplets (QDs) are self-bound states of ultradilute quantum fluids stabilized by the interplay between the Lee Huang-Yang (LHY) quantum-fluctuation correction and the mean-field interaction, providing a useful platform for exploring macroscopic quantum phenomena. Recent studies on three-dimensional QDs have introduced the concept of bulk modulus and revealed its connection with the breathing-mode frequency, thereby linking the elastic response of QDs to their collective dynamics. Motivated by this progress, we investigate the elastic modulus of one-dimensional QDs. Based on a super Gaussian variational ansatz, we systematically derive the elastic modulus B and analyze its dependence on the interaction strength and particle number. The analytical predictions are further validated by numerical simulations based on imaginary time evolution and the spatial scaling method. We also establish a quantitative relation between the elastic modulus and the eigenfrequency of the breathing mode. In addition, by incorporating corrections to the droplet width beyond the Thomas Fermi approximation, we obtain the dependence of the ratio η = B/2 on the control parameters g and N. Unlike the three-dimensional case, where the corresponding ratio follows a simple power-law scaling, the one-dimensional system is affected by the soliton-to-droplet crossover, leading to a more intricate dependence of η on g and N. Our results show that, in the high-particle-number regime, the elastic modulus asymptotically approaches a limiting value determined mainly by the interaction strength, whereas in the low-particle-number regime it depends on both the particle number and the interaction strength.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察由平均场相互作用与Lee–Huang–Yang量子涨落共同稳定的一维量子液滴的弹性响应。作者基于超高斯变分试探波函数推导弹性模量，并分析其随相互作用强度和粒子数的变化，同时用虚时间演化和空间标度方法进行数值验证。研究还建立了弹性模量与呼吸模本征频率之间的定量关系，并讨论了超越Thomas–Fermi近似的液滴宽度修正。
authors: Rui Zhang, Tianmiao Zhang, Huan-Bo Luo, Zibin Zhao

articles.title: Electrical transport in ultra-thin films: from Fuchs-Sondheimer to quantum-confinement
articles.title_zh: 超薄膜中的电输运：从Fuchs–Sondheimer理论到量子限域
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02120v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ultra-thin films are fundamental components of modern nanoelectronics, where reducing thickness to the few-nanometer scale leads to a dramatic increase in electrical resistivity. For decades, this behavior has been interpreted in terms of classical size effects, primarily surface scattering within the Fuchs--Sondheimer theory and grain-boundary scattering in the Mayadas--Shatzkes model. While these approaches successfully describe transport when the film thickness is comparable to the electronic mean free path, growing experimental evidence indicates that they become insufficient under extreme confinement. This review discusses the crossover from classical scattering to a quantum-confinement regime in which the electronic states available for transport are fundamentally restructured by finite size. We review the recently proposed reciprocal-space confinement theory, which predicts an exponential increase of resistivity with decreasing thickness at the nanoscale, and discuss how it can be combined with classical surface-scattering models to provide a unified description of ultra-thin metallic and semiconducting films. Finally, we summarize recent experimental evidence supporting this picture and discuss its implications for future nanoelectronic devices, nanoscale interconnects, and quantum transport under extreme spatial confinement.
articles.abstract_zh: 该综述讨论纳米级超薄膜中电阻率随厚度减小而急剧增加的物理机制。传统上这一现象由Fuchs–Sondheimer表面散射和Mayadas–Shatzkes晶界散射等经典尺寸效应解释，但在极端限域下这些模型可能不足。文章介绍了倒易空间限域理论，指出有限尺寸会重构可参与输运的电子态，并可与经典散射模型结合，用于统一描述金属和半导体超薄膜中的输运行为。

articles.title: Entropy of Non-Abelian Anyons from Slow Quasiparticle Dynamics in Quantum Hall Interferometers
articles.title_zh: 量子霍尔干涉仪中慢准粒子动力学揭示的非阿贝尔任意子熵
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02188v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Non-Abelian anyons emerging in fractional quantum Hall states carry a characteristic entropy, Δ S = k_B łog d, where (d) is the anyon's quantum dimension. This (O(1)) entropy can, in principle, be extracted from charge measurements of an antidot via Maxwell relations. However, equilibrium charge measurements in fractional antidots have proven to be challenging with conventional charge detectors. Here, we propose a scheme based on an antidot embedded in an interferometer, in which the charge can be inferred from the recently observed time-dependent switching of the interference phase. Performing such non-local charge measurements at equilibrium, the characteristic (O(1)) entropy of non-Abelian anyons (e.g., d = sqrt2 for the ν = 5/2 state) can be extracted for intermediate temperatures, which exceed the level spacing of the interferometer edge, but are much smaller than the level spacing of the antidot.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种通过量子霍尔干涉仪中的反点结构测量非阿贝尔任意子特征熵的方案。非阿贝尔任意子携带与量子维数相关的熵，原则上可由反点电荷测量和Maxwell关系提取，但常规电荷探测较困难。作者建议利用干涉相位随时间切换的现象间接推断电荷，从而在适当温度区间提取如ν=5/2态中非阿贝尔任意子的O(1)熵。

articles.title: Disorder-induced superconductivity in graphene
articles.title_zh: 石墨烯中的无序诱导超导
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02267v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Correlated phases of matter are typically investigated in crystalline systems, where disorder is considered to be detrimental. However, intriguing exceptions exist, such as superconductivity being enhanced in amorphous realizations of Al and Bi. Here, we demonstrate that superconductivity can even emerge entirely from disorder, using monolayer graphene as an example. In the clean limit, the semi-metallic nature of graphene requires prohibitively strong electronic interactions to achieve superconductivity. Despite the inherently random nature of disorder, we show that introducing low concentrations of vacancies or hydrogenation in graphene provides a large density of low-energy states that easily induce superconductivity. For conventional s-wave pairing, disorder induces a finite superconducting order parameter for arbitrarily weak attractive interactions. Rather than forming isolated superconducting puddles, global phase coherence is established through a finite superfluid weight of purely geometrical origin. Away from the chiral limit of vacancies, hydrogenation similarly yields a finite transition temperature and nonzero superfluid weight for weak interactions. For unconventional nearest-neighbor pairing, typically more disrupted by disorder, superconductivity exhibits quantum-critical-like behavior, yet phase coherence persists at low interaction strengths, with mixed d-wave symmetries. Our work demonstrates the robust emergence of macroscopic superconducting phase coherence engineered entirely from microscopic disorder.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究指出，无序并不总是破坏关联相，反而可在单层石墨烯中诱导超导。洁净石墨烯的半金属性使其需要很强相互作用才可能超导，而低浓度空位或氢化可产生大量低能态，使弱吸引相互作用也能形成超导序参量。作者进一步表明，体系并非仅形成孤立超导 puddle，而是可通过几何起源的有限超流权重建立全局相干性。
authors: Jannes van Poppelen, Tomas Löthman, Annica M. Black-Schaffer

articles.title: Intrinsic orbital Hall effect in a nonuniform electric field
articles.title_zh: 非均匀电场中的本征轨道霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02418v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Geometric analysis of electronic Bloch states offers a universal framework for understanding electronic properties, yet its role in the transport of orbital angular momentum remains unexplored. In this work, we establish an analytic connection between orbital angular momentum transport and the geometric properties of Bloch wave functions in electronic systems. Focusing on the intrinsic orbital Hall effect in the dc limit under a spatially nonuniform electric field, we show that its conductivity can be expressed in terms of universal geometric quantities, such as the orbital Berry curvature and quantum metric. This formulation provides a term-by-term correspondence with the geometric description of intrinsic charge Hall transport established in previous studies. Using a tight-binding model, we further illustrate that the higher-order orbital Hall response can exhibit enhanced sensitivity to the orientation of an anisotropic sample. Our work deepens the understanding of diverse intrinsic transverse transport phenomena and the role of quantum geometry in electronic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究建立了轨道角动量输运与Bloch波函数几何性质之间的解析联系。针对空间非均匀电场下直流极限中的本征轨道霍尔效应，作者将其电导表示为轨道Berry曲率、量子度量等普适几何量。紧束缚模型结果显示，高阶轨道霍尔响应可对各向异性样品取向表现出增强敏感性，从而深化了对本征横向输运和量子几何作用的理解。
authors: Min Ju Park, Jongjun M. Lee, Hyun-Woo Lee

articles.title: Anomalous thermopower from the drag of overdamped collective modes
articles.title_zh: 过阻尼集体模拖曳导致的反常热电势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02449v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Inspired by the observation of a Seebeck coefficient ratio that exhibits a seemingly logarithmic divergence at low temperature in high-temperature superconducting cuprates, we show that a mechanisms similar to the standard phonon drag can give rise to anomalies in the thermopower of a metal, if the dragged collective mode is overdamped, with a damping coefficient that increases with lowering the temperature. Our finding adds a piece to the puzzle of the strange-metal behavior observed in many different systems and supports our proposal that overdamped charge density fluctuations can be responsible of such a behavior in high-temperature superconducting cuprates.
articles.abstract_zh: 受高温超导铜氧化物中Seebeck系数比在低温呈现近似对数发散的实验启发，作者研究了金属热电势异常的可能机制。文章指出，类似常规声子拖曳的机制若涉及过阻尼集体模，并且其阻尼随降温增强，就可产生热电势异常。该结果为奇异金属行为提供了新的解释线索，并支持过阻尼电荷密度涨落可能参与高温超导铜氧化物异常输运的观点。
authors: G. Mirarchi, G. Seibold, M. Grilli, S. Caprara

articles.title: On the emergence of quantum many-body chaos for tunably-broken integrability
articles.title_zh: 可调破缺可积性下量子多体混沌的涌现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02506v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a quantitative theory for the emergence of quantum many-body chaos as integrability is broken via a tunable parameter. In a circuit model of free fermions, 'doped' with a tunable density of integrability-breaking gates, we uncover the microscopic mechanisms underpinning the crossover from early-time integrable behaviour to late-time chaos through the lens of the out-of-time-ordered correlators (OTOCs). The integrability-breaking gates act as local, in spacetime, hotspots which locally amplify the OTOCs such that an accumulation of them eventually leads to fully-developed chaos. We identify the explicit characteristic time and length scales governing this crossover, as well as the dependence of the chaotic OTOC characteristics -- such as the butterfly velocity and front broadening -- on the integrability-breaking parameter.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作发展了一个定量理论，用于描述通过可调参数破缺可积性时量子多体混沌如何涌现。作者在自由费米子电路模型中加入可调密度的破缺可积性门，并通过非时序关联函数研究从早期可积行为到晚期混沌的跨越。结果显示，这些门作为时空局域“热点”放大关联函数，逐渐累积形成充分发展的混沌，并给出了控制跨越的特征时间、长度尺度以及蝴蝶速度和前沿展宽等混沌特征对破缺参数的依赖。
authors: Sounak Biswas, Sthitadhi Roy, Roderich Moessner

articles.title: Logarithmic negativity typically equals exact entanglement cost
articles.title_zh: 对数负性通常等于精确纠缠成本
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01320v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum entanglement plays a leading role in modern understanding of physical systems, from quantum phases of matter to quantum gravity. In quantum information theory, one seeks operationally meaningful quantifiers of entanglement, which for large quantum systems are notoriously difficult to evaluate due to the lack of computationally efficient algorithms. In this Letter, we show that for large random induced mixed states the logarithmic negativity, an efficiently computable entanglement measure, generically coincides with the exact entanglement cost under positive-partial-transpose-preserving operations, thereby acquiring a precise operational interpretation. Our results establish logarithmic negativity as an exact characterization of entanglement in generic many-body states and provide a tractable route for quantifying entanglement in complex quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文研究量子信息中纠缠度量的可操作含义，重点关注计算上较易获得的对数负性。作者证明，对于大的随机诱导混合态，对数负性通常与在保持正偏转置操作下的精确纠缠成本相一致。该结果赋予对数负性明确的操作解释，并为复杂多体量子系统中的纠缠定量提供了可行路径。

articles.title: Controlling Waiting Time Statistics in Monitored Collective Spins: Mitigating Detector's Resolution Barrier in Measurement-Induced Phase Transitions
articles.title_zh: 受监测集体自旋中等待时间统计的控制：缓解测量诱导相变中的探测器分辨率障碍
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01332v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In collective dissipative spin systems, the postselection barrier can be partially mitigated; however, a further obstacle may be posed by the finite temporal resolution of detectors. In this work, we investigate how initial-state inhomogeneities can control waiting-time statistics between quantum jumps, thereby mitigating the detector-resolution problem. We consider a collectively monitored spin model with a boundary time-crystalline phase, introducing inhomogeneity by partitioning the ensemble into two subsystems rotated by an angle θ. We find that the measurement-induced phase transition survives under inhomogeneities, with different entanglement scaling regimes. The waiting time increases with θ, scaling as 1/N but with a prefactor strongly enhanced by orders of magnitude, and in the anti-aligned limit θ = π it remains finite, fully resolving the resolution barrier. This mitigation, however, comes at a cost: the entanglement saturation time becomes significantly longer, partially reintroducing the postselection barrier. Our results highlight a trade-off between detector resolution and postselection overhead, with direct implications for the experimental observation of measurement-induced phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究集体耗散自旋系统中，探测器有限时间分辨率对测量诱导相变观测造成的障碍，以及如何通过初态非均匀性来调控量子跃迁之间的等待时间。作者考虑具有边界时间晶体相的集体监测自旋模型，将自旋系综分成两个相对旋转角为 θ 的子系统以引入非均匀性。结果表明，测量诱导相变在非均匀性下仍然存在，并呈现不同的纠缠标度；等待时间随 θ 增大而显著延长，在反平行极限 θ=π 时保持有限，从而可消除分辨率瓶颈。但这种缓解以纠缠饱和时间显著变长为代价，部分重新引入后选择开销。

articles.title: Quantum Trajectory Entanglement in Seeded Boundary Time Crystals
articles.title_zh: 种子化边界时间晶体中的量子轨迹纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01335v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate the entanglement dynamics along quantum trajectories during the seeding of time-crystalline order in a boundary time crystal (BTC). Specifically, how entanglement spreads among different spin ensembles when a BTC attempts to seed its time-crystalline behavior onto otherwise static spin ensembles, through a collective dissipative channel. We analyse both the dynamical growth of entanglement in time and the steady-state properties of the system. Our results reveal two fundamentally distinct regimes. In the seeded BTC phase, the steady-state entanglement entropy between the ensembles grows with system size N, accompanied by macroscopic fluctuations along the trajectories. In contrast, in the non-seeded static phase, both the steady-state entanglement and its fluctuations decay exponentially with N. The model thus features a measurement-induced phase transition (MIPT) driven by the seeding mechanism. Furthermore, these findings establish dissipative seeding as a powerful mechanism for controlling quantum correlations in open many-body systems, with direct experimental relevance to this class of model without a postselection barrier.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究边界时间晶体在通过集体耗散通道将其时间晶体行为“种子化”到原本静态的自旋系综时，量子轨迹上的纠缠动力学。作者分析了不同自旋系综之间纠缠随时间的增长以及稳态性质。结果显示存在两个本质不同的区域：在种子化边界时间晶体相中，系综间稳态纠缠熵随系统尺寸 N 增长，并伴随宏观轨迹涨落；而在非种子化静态相中，稳态纠缠及其涨落随 N 指数衰减。该模型因种子化机制而呈现测量诱导相变，并表明耗散种子化可用于调控开放多体系统中的量子关联。

articles.title: Identical-Particle Symmetry-Enabled Complete Coherent Control of Ultracold Atomic and Molecular Collisions
articles.title_zh: 由同种粒子对称性实现的超冷原子与分子碰撞完全相干控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01620v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We show that exchange symmetry in collisions of identical particles enables symmetry-protected coherent control of the total scattering cross section. For identical fermions, antisymmetrization enforces complete phase synchronization of the contributing scattering channels, yielding maximal control visibility. For identical bosons, synchronization persists but with reduced visibility due to additional exchange (satellite) contributions. Collisions of distinguishable particles lack this symmetry-imposed phase locking, leading to lower controllability and visibility. We elucidate these principles through coupled-channel quantum-scattering calculations for lithium-lithium collisions, comparing the ⁶Li-⁶Li (identical fermions), ⁷Li-⁷Li (identical bosons), and ⁶Li-⁷Li (distinguishable) systems. Furthermore, in the identical particle cases, symmetry-enforced synchronization enables full control over the parity of the final state at any collisional energy. This mechanism is broadly applicable to identical-particle collisions, including homonuclear molecules for which established approaches -- DC electric fields, or microwave shielding -- are ineffective or unavailable.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出，同种粒子碰撞中的交换对称性可实现受对称性保护的总散射截面相干控制。对于同种费米子，反对称化强制参与散射通道发生完全相位同步，从而带来最大控制可见度；对于同种玻色子，同步仍存在但因额外交换贡献而可见度降低；可区分粒子则缺乏这种相位锁定，因而可控性较弱。作者通过锂-锂碰撞的耦合通道量子散射计算比较了 ⁶Li-⁶Li、⁷Li-⁷Li 与 ⁶Li-⁷Li 系统，并进一步表明在同种粒子情形中，对称性强制同步可在任意碰撞能量下完全控制末态宇称。
authors: Jing-Chen Zhang, Adrien Devolder, Timur V. Tscherbul, Paul Brumer, Yu Liu

articles.title: Shallow Unitary Circuits for Kramers-Wannier Dualities
articles.title_zh: 用于 Kramers-Wannier 对偶性的浅层幺正电路
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01624v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The quantum Kramers-Wannier (KW) duality is a fundamental transformation mapping short-range entangled (SRE) states to long-range entangled (LRE) states. While spatially local unitary circuits require linear-in-system-size depth to implement this duality, the ultimate speed limit for purely unitary circuits equipped with nonlocal connectivity remains an open question. Here, we explicitly construct logarithmic depth, spatially nonlocal unitary circuits that realize the exact Z₂ KW dualities in both one and two spatial dimensions. We further generalize the construction to arbitrary Zₙ KW dualities. Unlike algorithms tailored to prepare specific target states, our circuits implement complete duality maps. Within the symmetric (charge-neutral) sector, these dualities exactly transform arbitrary non-fixed-point SRE states into their corresponding LRE duals. Consequently, our results establish an efficient, purely coherent pathway for exploring phase transitions and topological dualities on modern quantum platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文构造了空间非局域、对数深度的幺正量子电路，可在一维和二维中精确实现 Z₂ Kramers-Wannier 对偶，并进一步推广到任意 Zₙ 对偶。Kramers-Wannier 对偶将短程纠缠态映射到长程纠缠态，而若仅使用空间局域幺正电路通常需要随系统尺寸线性增长的深度。与只为制备特定目标态而设计的算法不同，本文电路实现完整对偶映射，并在对称电荷中性扇区中将任意非固定点短程纠缠态精确变换为对应的长程纠缠对偶态。该结果为在现代量子平台上以纯相干方式研究相变和拓扑对偶提供了高效路径。

articles.title: Undamped Modes in an N-Qubit Heisenberg Chain with Collective Dissipation
articles.title_zh: 具有集体耗散的 N 量子比特海森堡链中的无阻尼模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02054v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate the undamped behaviors in a spin-1/2 Heisenberg chain coupled with an environment via collective spin jump operators. Using the Bethe ansatz basis, we show that undamped modes exist for any chain length N >= 3. These modes remain robust against variations in the system parameters, including the specific form of the collective dissipation, and the external field. Exploiting the Bethe ansatz solution, we further characterize the number of undamped modes and their oscillation frequencies, uncovering long-lived coherent dynamics in open integrable quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究自旋 1/2 海森堡链通过集体自旋跃迁算符与环境耦合时出现的无阻尼行为。利用 Bethe Ansatz 基底，作者证明对于任意链长 N≥3 都存在无阻尼模。此类模对系统参数变化具有鲁棒性，包括集体耗散的具体形式以及外场变化。进一步借助 Bethe Ansatz 解，文章刻画了无阻尼模的数量及其振荡频率，揭示了开放可积量子系统中的长寿命相干动力学。

articles.title: Open-boundary integrable quantum circuits with different geometries
articles.title_zh: 具有不同几何结构的开放边界可积量子电路
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02093v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a complete classification of integrable Yang-Baxter quantum circuits with open boundary conditions and arbitrary circuit geometries. Starting from the standard transfer-matrix construction with two types of staggered inhomogeneities, we derive a general mapping that determines the arrangement of circuit gates in terms of the inhomogeneities and the system size. We conjecture that time-periodic quantum circuits are integrable whenever the local bulk and boundary gates satisfy the Yang-Baxter equation and the same bulk gate is applied exactly once per period to every nearest-neighbor pair of spins. Our construction also provides an algorithm to detect Yang-Baxter integrability for circuits with arbitrary geometries. Furthermore, we introduce a third type of inhomogeneity, denoted by h̊o, and demonstrate that the minimum possible circuit depth is four. We show that when these h̊o-inhomogeneities are placed at the endpoints and in their immediate neighborhood, the resulting boundary gates can be interpreted as single gates acting on multiple sites. Our construction is fully general and applies to regular R-matrices, both of difference and non-difference type, together with their associated boundary matrices. As an application, we consider two-qubit gates corresponding to 6- and 8-vertex R-matrices of non-difference form satisfying the Yang-Baxter equation, and we construct the associated reflection matrices that generate integrable quantum circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文给出了具有开放边界条件和任意电路几何的 Yang-Baxter 可积量子电路的完整分类。作者从含两类交错非均匀性的标准转移矩阵构造出发，推导出由非均匀性和系统尺寸决定电路门排列的一般映射。文章提出猜想：只要局域体门与边界门满足 Yang-Baxter 方程，并且每个周期中同一个体门恰好作用于每一对最近邻自旋一次，时间周期量子电路就是可积的。该构造还给出了检测任意几何电路 Yang-Baxter 可积性的算法，并引入第三类非均匀性以证明最小电路深度为四。
authors: Miguel García Fernández, Chiara Paletta, Ana L. Retore

articles.title: Fluctuations of the Sherrington--Kirkpatrick free energy at critical temperature
articles.title_zh: 临界温度下 Sherrington-Kirkpatrick 自由能的涨落
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02172v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We consider the Sherrington--Kirkpatrick spin glass model at the critical inverse temperature β = 1 with zero external field. We prove that the free energy F_N = FN,β₌₁ of this model has variance [ Var(F_N) = frac16 łog N + O(1),, ] confirming a physics prediction of Aspelmeier i̧teaspelmeier2008free, and that the centered and scaled F_N satisfies a Gaussian CLT. We also identify the critical two-replica overlap scale, proving [ E łangle R₁,₂²ångle asymp N⁻²/³,, ] as conjectured by Talagrand i̧tetalagrand2011mean2, together with a uniform exponential moment bound for N¹/³ |R₁,₂|. The key input is a comparison between the Ising and spherical SK partition functions Z_N and Zsp_N: if X_N = Z_N / Zsp_N, then X_N = 1 + o(1) in L². Thus Zsp_N captures the diverging critical fluctuations of Z_N and serves as a tractable reweighting variable for estimating overlap moments.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究零外场 Sherrington-Kirkpatrick 自旋玻璃模型在临界逆温 β=1 时的自由能涨落。作者证明自由能方差为 Var(F_N)=1/6 log N+O(1)，验证了物理预测，并证明中心化、适当缩放后的自由能满足高斯中心极限定理。文章还确定了临界二副本重叠的标度，证明 E⟨R₁,₂²⟩ 与 N⁻²/³ 同阶，并给出 N¹/³|R₁,₂| 的一致指数矩界。关键技术是比较 Ising 型与球形 SK 配分函数，表明球形模型可捕捉临界发散涨落并用于估计重叠矩。

articles.title: Computable measures of fermionic non-Gaussianity from the covariance matrix
articles.title_zh: 由协方差矩阵得到的可计算费米子非高斯性度量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02242v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Fermionic non-Gaussianity, or fermionic magic, is a key resource underlying the computational complexity of fermionic quantum systems, yet tractable and operationally meaningful ways to quantify it remain limited. We address this challenge by developing a convex resource theory of fermionic non-Gaussianity and introducing two families of computable measures for pure fermionic states, both derived from the Williamson normal form of the covariance matrix. The first family, occupation number entropies, is defined as the Tsallis-α entropy of the occupation numbers. We prove that one member of this family is monotonic under Gaussian protocols, establishing it as a computable convex resource monotone. It consequently lower bounds the number of non-Gaussian gates needed for state preparation. The second family, natural-orbital participation entropies, is given by the Rényi-α entropy of the squared amplitudes of the state in the natural-orbital basis, defined by the eigenvectors of the covariance matrix. These measures quantify state compressibility in this basis and thus upper bound the classical simulation cost in an orthonormal Gaussian basis. We analyze both families for stabilizer and translation-invariant states, where they simplify and reveal additional structure. We further study representative examples, including random SWAP-doped matchgate circuits and the bond-modulated XXZ model, highlighting the role of non-Gaussianity in many-body phenomena. Our work establishes a resource-theoretic framework for computable fermionic non-Gaussianity that unifies notions arising across quantum information, condensed-matter physics, and quantum chemistry, opening new directions for studying the complexity of quantum many-body systems and providing practical tools to assess the classical simulability of fermionic states relevant for quantum advantage.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文围绕费米子非高斯性或费米子魔性这一决定费米子量子系统计算复杂性的关键资源，构建了一个凸资源理论框架。作者基于协方差矩阵的 Williamson 标准形，为纯费米子态提出两类可计算度量。第一类为占据数熵，即占据数的 Tsallis-α 熵，并证明其中一个成员在高斯协议下单调，因此可作为可计算凸资源单调量，并给出态制备所需非高斯门数的下界。第二类为自然轨道参与熵，即态在由协方差矩阵本征矢定义的自然轨道基底中振幅平方的 Rényi-α 熵，用于量化该基底下的态可压缩性，并为正交高斯基中的经典模拟成本提供上界。
authors: Poetri Sonya Tarabunga, Bernhard Jobst, Raúl Morral-Yepes, Marc Langer, Barbara Kraus, Frank Pollmann, Sheng-Hsuan Lin

articles.title: Bockstein braiding statistics
articles.title_zh: Bockstein 编织统计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02280v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Braiding statistics, from the Aharonov-Bohm phase to anyons in fractional quantum Hall systems, play a central role in quantum physics. For p- and q-dimensional excitations in d spatial dimensions, ordinary braiding requires p+q=d-2. In a field-theoretic description of mathbb Z_N excitations, ordinary braiding is described by the linking response (2π i/N)int Ad₋ₚu̧p Bd₋q, where Ad₋ₚ and Bd₋q are background fields coupled to the two excitation types. In this work, we identify new mutual statistics in the adjacent case p+q=d-1. For two invertible excitations obeying mathbb Z_N fusion, one can choose local creation operators X and Y whose supports have a staggered one-dimensional overlap. The closed unitary process W_N(X,Y)=(Y⁻¹X⁻¹)^N(YX)^N measures the resulting mutual statistic. Its field-theory description is (2π i/N)int Ad₋ₚu̧pβ_N Bd₋q, where β_N is the Bockstein operation; we therefore call the invariant Bockstein braiding statistics. The construction yields particle-particle statistics in one dimension, particle-loop statistics in two dimensions, and loop-loop or particle-membrane statistics in three dimensions. Nontrivial Bockstein braiding statistics obstructs simultaneous condensation of the two mathbb Z_N excitations. It also rules out a fully symmetric gapped phase for systems with the corresponding mixed anomaly and implies symmetry fractionalization when one of the mathbb Z_N symmetries is broken.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文识别了一类不同于通常编织的新的互统计，适用于 d 维空间中 p 维与 q 维激发满足 p+q=d-1 的相邻情形。对于服从 Z_N 融合的两个可逆激发，作者构造了支撑具有交错一维重叠的局域产生算符 X 和 Y，并用闭合幺正过程 W_N(X,Y) 测量相应互统计。其场论响应由含 Bockstein 操作 β_N 的项描述，因此被称为 Bockstein 编织统计。该构造可产生一维粒子-粒子统计、二维粒子-环统计，以及三维中的环-环或粒子-膜统计等。

articles.title: Mesoscopic Linear Statistics for Two Ensembles of Quantum Graphs
articles.title_zh: 两类量子图系综的介观线性统计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02356v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study mesoscopic linear spectral statistics for two ensembles of random quantum graphs. These are defined by a discrete graph G and a unitary-matrix-valued function U(k) indexed by directed edges of G. The matrix function U(k) is constructed from unitary matrices U⁽v⁾ indexed by the neighbours of each vertex v. The first ensemble is obtained by sampling the underlying discrete graph uniformly from the set of d-regular graphs. The second ensemble is obtained by sampling U⁽v⁾ uniformly from the Haar measure, independently for each vertex. We prove that the variance of a linear spectral statistic in the large graph limit on polynomial mesoscopic scales coincides with that of the Gaussian Orthogonal/Unitary Ensemble.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究两类随机量子图的介观线性谱统计，这些量子图由离散图 G 以及定义在有向边上的酉矩阵值函数 U(k) 构成。第一类系综通过从 d-正则图集合中均匀抽取底层离散图得到，第二类则通过对每个顶点独立地从 Haar 测度抽取相应酉矩阵得到。作者证明，在大图极限和多项式介观尺度下，线性谱统计的方差与高斯正交系综或高斯酉系综的对应结果一致。该结论表明这些随机量子图模型在介观谱涨落方面呈现随机矩阵普适性。

articles.title: Suppression of Bloch Oscillations and Nonreciprocal Landau-Zener Tunneling in Bose-Einstein Quantum Droplets
articles.title_zh: 玻色-爱因斯坦量子液滴中 Bloch 振荡的抑制与非互易 Landau-Zener 隧穿
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.02852v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the nonlinear Bloch dynamics and Landau-Zener (LZ) tunneling of quantum droplets in optical lattices. We show that the Lee-Huang-Yang (LHY) correction not only stabilizes the self-bound droplet, but also introduces nonlinear phase feedback that competes with the lattice-induced coherent motion. In the deep-lattice regime, applying a generalized super-Gaussian ansatz within the tight-binding model demonstrates that chirp accumulation modifies the internal phase profile and renormalizes mobility. The coherent Bloch oscillations (BO) are progressively arrested in the presence of the LHY interaction without dissipative damping. In the shallow-lattice regime, the system is mapped onto a nonlinear two-level Josephson-analog model in which the mean-field and LHY contributions enter through an effective nonlinear detuning, deforming the adiabatic spectrum and generating looped bands. Using the classical action-angle formulation, we demonstrate that the nonlinear LZ tunneling is governed by the underlying phase-space structure. In particular, the LHY correction suppresses the tunneling probability by modifying the separatrix action and renormalizing the exponential sweep-rate scaling through a nonlinear weighting factor. We further identify pronounced nonreciprocal LZ tunneling arising from branch-dependent population imbalance and the nonlinearly induced inertia. These results establish a unified mechanism in which the LHY interaction suppresses both coherent Bloch dynamics and interband tunneling by reorganizing the dynamical exchange among lattice motion, population imbalance, and internal phase modulation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究光学晶格中量子液滴的非线性 Bloch 动力学和 Landau-Zener 隧穿。作者表明，Lee-Huang-Yang 修正不仅稳定自束缚液滴，还引入与晶格诱导相干运动竞争的非线性相位反馈。在深晶格中，基于紧束缚模型和广义超高斯试探形式，啁啾积累会改变内部相位分布并重整化迁移率，使相干 Bloch 振荡在无耗散阻尼的情况下逐渐停止；在浅晶格中，系统可映射为非线性两能级 Josephson 类比模型，平均场和 LHY 项通过有效非线性失谐改变绝热谱并产生环状能带。文章还指出非线性 Landau-Zener 隧穿受底层相空间结构控制，LHY 修正可通过改变分 separatrix 结构抑制隧穿概率并导致非互易效应。
authors: Szu-Cheng Cheng, Yu-Wen Wang, Wen-Feng Hsieh, Vidar Gudmundsson, Wen-Hsuan Kuan

articles.title: Two-dimensional THz spectroscopy in electronic systems: a many-body diagrammatic approach
articles.title_zh: 电子系统中的二维太赫兹光谱：多体图解方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.25060v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The term two-dimensional coherent spectroscopy (2DCS) usually refers to experimental setups where a coherently generated electric field in a sample is recorded over many runs as a function of two time variables: the delay τ between two consequent excitation pulses and the time t over which the signal is emitted. While its implementation in the femtosecond time domain for studying vibrational molecular states has been developed for over two decades, its experimental application in the THz domain to interacting electronic systems remains in its infancy. This work provides a general theoretical framework for describing and interpreting 2DCS using a many-body language based on a perturbative diagrammatic expansion, as widely applied in linear spectroscopy. Focusing on centrosymmetric systems, we show that interpreting the 2D maps can be recast into two complementary problems. The first is the evaluation of a third-order response function to the gauge field. In the velocity gauge, this leads to semi-analytical expressions that both reduce computational complexity and assist in assigning spectral features to microscopic processes, as shown using a toy model of electrons undergoing a charge-density wave transition. The second is a careful treatment of multi-wave propagation effects, which, in bulk systems, can obscure the intrinsic nonlinear response, demonstrated here for soft superconducting Josephson plasmons. Our results provide a solid foundation for extending 2DCS to complex interacting systems and offer a flexible method to realistically model nonlinear responses across arbitrary spectral widths.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为相互作用电子系统中的二维相干太赫兹光谱建立了基于多体微扰图解展开的一般理论框架。二维相干光谱通常记录样品中相干产生的电场随两个时间变量的变化：相邻激发脉冲之间的延迟 τ 以及信号发射时间 t；其在分子振动态研究中已较成熟，但在太赫兹电子系统中的应用仍处于早期。针对中心对称系统，作者将二维谱图解释分解为两个互补问题，其中之一是规范场三阶响应函数的求解；在速度规范下可得到半解析表达式，从而降低计算复杂度并帮助将谱特征归因于微观过程。
authors: Jacopo Fiore, Niccolò Sellati, Mattia Udina, Lara Benfatto

articles.title: A new Fractal Mean-Field analysis in phase transition
articles.title_zh: 相变中的一种新分形平均场分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.20846v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Understanding phase transitions requires not only identifying order parameters but also characterizing how their correlations behave across scales. By quantifying how fluctuations at distinct spatial or temporal points are related, correlation functions reveal the structural organization of complex systems. In this work, we reexamine the theoretical foundations of these correlations in systems undergoing second-order phase transitions, with emphasis on the Ising model extended to non-integer spatial dimensions. We revisit the hypothesis that, at criticality, the equilibrium dynamics become effectively confined to the fractal edge of spin clusters and redo the analysis using fractional calculus. Within this framework, the fractal dimension that governs the correlations in that subspace is directly related to Fisher's exponent η, which quantifies the singular behavior of the correlation function near criticality. Importantly, this correlation fractal dimension is distinct from the fractal dimension associated with the order parameter. The fractional approach allows us to directly compute the correlation fractal dimension and to establish an explicit geometrical relation connecting the two fractal dimensions. Moreover, the formulation naturally extends to non-integer spatial dimensions, remaining valid below the upper critical dimension and yielding the correct value of Fisher's exponent η for a continuous spatial dimension d. Within this framework, we also provide empirical functions describing how the main critical exponents vary continuously as a function of the space dimension.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作重新考察二级相变体系中关联函数的理论基础，重点关注推广到非整数空间维度的 Ising 模型。作者提出在临界点平衡动力学可能有效受限于自旋团簇的分形边界，并用分数阶微积分重新分析这一假设。研究指出，支配该子空间关联的分形维数与 Fisher 指数 η 直接相关，且不同于序参量对应的分形维数。
authors: Ismael S. S. Carrasco, Henrique A. de Lima, Fernando A. Oliveira

articles.title: Large-n O(n) with long-range interactions: integrability and resonance dynamics
articles.title_zh: 具有长程相互作用的大 n O(n) 模型：可积性与共振动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.14868v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study the large-n dynamics of the long-range quantum O(n) model, focusing on the strong long-range regime α
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究长程量子 O(n) 模型在大 n 极限下的动力学，重点关注强长程相互作用区域。根据题录信息，论文围绕模型的可积结构及其共振动力学展开；由于所给摘要内容被截断，具体参数范围、解析结果和物理结论需查阅原文。

articles.title: Surpassing Carnot efficiency with relativistic motion
articles.title_zh: 利用相对论运动超越卡诺效率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.11554v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Relativistic thermal devices offer a unique platform for understanding the interplay between motion, quantum fields, and thermodynamics, revealing phenomena inaccessible to stationary systems. We consider a two-qubit SWAP heat engine whose working medium consists of inertially moving Unruh-DeWitt qubit detectors, each coupled to a scalar quantum field in thermal equilibrium at a distinct temperature. Relativistic motion causes the qubits to perceive frequency-dependent effective temperatures that are either hotter or colder than their respective reservoir temperature. We show that the relativistic temperature shift, perhaps the qubit velocity, can be harnessed as a thermodynamic resource to enhance the work output and the efficiency at maximum power of the heat engine. We derive a generalized second law for a heat engine with a moving working medium and demonstrate that it can exceed the standard Carnot bound defined by rest-frame temperatures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察由惯性运动的 Unruh-DeWitt 两能级探测器构成的双量子比特 SWAP 热机，每个量子比特分别耦合到不同温度的标量量子场热库。相对论运动使量子比特感受到依赖频率的有效温度，可能高于或低于热库静止系温度。作者表明，这种相对论温度偏移或速度本身可作为热力学资源，提高输出功和最大功率效率，并推导出适用于运动工质热机的广义第二定律。

articles.title: (2+1)D quantum electrodynamics at finite density on a quantum computer
articles.title_zh: 量子计算机上的有限密度（2+1）维量子电动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.20558v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In this paper, we explore (2+1)D quantum electrodynamics (QED) at finite density on a quantum computer, including two fermion flavors. Our method employs an efficient gauge-invariant ansatz together with a quantum circuit structure that enforces Gauss's law. As a proof of principle, we benchmark our simulation protocol on a small lattice system, demonstrating the identification of phase transitions in terms of the particle number of the fermion flavors. Classical simulations are used to obtain optimized variational parameters, which are then deployed in inference runs on IBM quantum hardware. We conclude by discussing hardware limitations and prospects for scaling this method to larger systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探索在量子计算机上模拟含两个费米子味的有限密度（2+1）维量子电动力学。作者采用高效的规范不变量子态 ansatz，并设计满足高斯定律的量子线路结构。在小晶格系统上的原理验证表明，该方案可通过费米子味的粒子数识别相变，并在 IBM 量子硬件上进行了推断运行。
authors: Emil Otis Rosanowski, Arianna Crippa, Lena Funcke, Paulo Vitor Itaborai, Karl Jansen, Simran Singh

articles.title: Monolithic Integration of Piezo-Optomechanical Photonics and CMOS Electronics
articles.title_zh: 压电-光机械光子学与 CMOS 电子学的单片集成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01514v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Next-generation photonic architectures for AI, sensing, and quantum computing require thousands to millions of reprogrammable photonic devices on a chip[1]. The monolithic integration of Electronically-backed Photonic Integrated Circuits (EPICs) allows for very high density electrical interconnection and electronic drivers that can scale with photonics. Piezo-optomechanical photonic integrated circuits (POMPICs) offer low power consumption, high speed modulation, cryogenic compatibility and broadband optical transparency from ultraviolet to infrared wavelengths[2,3], but have not been demonstrated with monolithically integrated CMOS electronics.
